Page 28 _(twenty eight)_



Rigarta ya rik'e ya janye ta daga jikin shi shima ya mik'e zaune.
    Gefe ta koma tana sauke ajiyar zuciya tana tunanin yadda zai fahimci abin.
   Shima kallonta yake yana tunanin abinda ya futo da ita cikin daren nan da yadda akayi ta had'a jikinta da nashi, yasan tana sane baza tab'a aikata haka ba.

    Sun d'auki y'an seconni suna zaune shiru kowa da abinda yake tunani kafun farouk ya tashi ya kunna glove d'in d'akin don haske ya wadata sosai ko tafi ganin abinda take nema d'in.

     Kifa kanta tayi a gwiwarta tana sake jin nauyin had'a ido dashi ma, a jikin bango ya jingina yana sake k'are mata kallo a kaikaice.

   Wasu lokutan suka sake d'auka shiru ba tare da tayi wani kwakkwaran motsi balle har ta kaiga bud'e bakin ta ba, zuwa yanzu ya soma gajiya kuma daman yana tsaka da baccin shi ta tashe shi da b'uruntun ta.

   Rab'awa yayi ya koma ya kwanta duk da yasan wanzuwar abu biyun nan ba zasu barshi bacci ba, ita da kuma hasken daya gauraye d'akin.

    Duk sai yaji ya takura da zaman ta kusa dashi gashi ba wata tazara mai nisa a tsakanin su, shi ya saba a gidan su d'akin shi shi d'aya yake kwana, kuma ya kasance mishi dabi'a ko bak'unta yaje baya iya bacci inda mutane a guri. 

  Sai ya sake mik'ewa zaune tare da mik'e k'afafun shi, shesshekar kukan ta a hankali ta soma futowa alamun kuka takeyi.

  Wannan wace irin yarinya ce ne haka? Shagwab'arta tayi yawa, yanzu shi me yayi mata fisabilillahi.
    Da sannu ta kasa ci gaba da b'oye kukan nata sai gashi sautin yana futowa sosai.

Tsaki yaja me sauti a fili don ya nuna mata kukan ta sam bai dame shiba ta shekara ma tanayi saivya kwanta ya juya mata baya.

Ganin haka sai ta sake fashewa da kuka tare da d'an bubbuga k'afar ta kamar wata yarinyar goye. Hannun shi yasa ya rufe duka kunnuwanshi dasu saboda kada ma yaji sautin kukan nata, sai dai Kash sai yaji kamar kusanta shi ma aka sakeyi da kukan nata mai wuyar sauraro.

   Mik'ewa zaune yayi yana fad'in, "wayyo Allah don Allah kibar ni inyi bacci na, wannan wane irin takura ne haka haba".

  Dakatawa tayi da kukan tana sauraron banbamin fad'an da yake, sai da yayi shiru sannan ta samu damar bud'e bakin ta a hankali cikin kwantaccen sauti  da shagwobarta tace, "ni yunwa nakeji". 

   Murmushi yayi ya sake gyara zaman shi zuwa opposite d'in ta yana kallonta da kyau yace, "da kyau kin gaji da satar kenan?".

  Sai ta sake shagwob'e fuska tana kallon fuskar shi tayi narai narai zata sake sa mishi wani kukan, ya d'aga mata hannu da sauri, "bafa kuka nace kiyi ba, tambayarki kawai nayi".

   "Toh bakai bane ka dena ajiye mun abinci".

    "good anzo gurin, ai ni banyi tunanin akwai abinda mai arzik'i zai nema a gurin mitsiyaci ba, shiyasa na daina ajiye miki kalar namu abincin mu talakawa mitsiyatan ki, na barki ki nemo kalar naku na masu arzik'i".

   Ya k'arasa maganar yana had'iye wani k'aton bak'in ciki daya tokare mak'oshin sa.

   Kallon shi take har yanzu a narke tana sake al'ajabin yadda ta zamo kamar wata bak'uwar yunwa, sai ta soma sakin siririn kuka tare da jingina kanta a jikin bango ta d'ora hannun ta saman kan.

     Banza yayi da ita shima ya jinginar da kanshi a jikin bangon tare da maida idanun shi ya lumshe.

    Ganin kamar kukan nata ma dad'in sauraro yake mishi sai ta rarrashi kanta ta daina kukan sai sautin sheshshek'ar ta kawai.

   "Please I'm really sorry....."

   Ta fad'a da narkakken muryar ta ta kuka.
    Bud'e idon shi yayi a hankali ya kalle ta jin abinda ta fad'a.
     Duk kuma sai yaji tausayin ta ya sake cika shi, sai yaji kamar bai kyauta ba abinda yayi matan, duk da shi yayi hakan ne ba don ya rama ba sai don ta gane illar furucinta a gareshi,
   Mik'ewa yayi sannu a hankali ya shiga kitchen, ruwan tea ya d'ora cup biyu ya zuba sugar da sauran kayan k'amshi daya siyo ya rufe, a kitchen d'in yaci gaba da zama ya barta can zaune tana zare ido kamar @deejat ta d'au wanka😜 tana ganin ba ya ita. 

    Sai da tean ya tafasa ya juye a cup biyu ya d'auki plate da spoon ya nufi parlon, tana a zaune yarda ya barta idon ta amma a rufe ruf, a gaban ta ya ajiye cupi d'aya bayan yasa mata cokali a ciki.
   Ko kafun ya zauna har ta soma juya tea d'in da cokali.

     A inda ya tashi ya koma ya zauna ya soma zuba mata abincin da aka bashi a gidan alhaji usman a plate d'in, da yawa ya zuba mata naman ma duka ya juye mata ya ajiye mata a gaban ta.

    Shikam iya tea d'in ya soma sha, shima saboda tashin da yayi ne gashi garin akwai sanyi sosai saboda ruwan da akayi.

    Sai da ta shanye shayin duka sannan ta soma cin abincin cikin nutsuwa da kwanciyar hankali kamar yadda yake bisa tsarin aiwatar da komai nata, babu laifi taci abincin da d'an yawa amma bata ci naman ba ta ture shi gefe.
    Ganin ta ajiye mishi plate d'in a gaban shi sai ya d'ago ya dubeta bayan ya kalli plate d'in, "har kin k'oshi". Ya samu kanshi da tambayar ta don shi ya d'auka yadda take kiran yunwa yunwar nan zata iya cinye wanda ya zuba matan duka.

  Duban shi tayi tana zaro ido jin abinda yace don ita bilhak'k'i gani takeyi taci da yawa, "ai yayi yawa in na cinye cikina sai ya fashe" itama ta fad'a batare da tasan sanda maganar ta futo ba. 

    Murmushin gefen baki yayi ya sake kallon plate d'in, "to meyasa ba kici naman ba?".

   Sai ta narke fuska cikin shagwab'arta tace, "ni bana cin nama".

  Sai ya sake kai Duban shi kanta, "me yasa?".

"nima ban sani ba".

Ta bashi amsa itama idon ta a kanshi.

  Musayar kallo sukayi na few seconds kafun su d'auke kansu lokaci guda, tattare duk kwanukan yayi har cooler ya mayar kitchen, sai daya kewaya toilet yayi uzurin shi ya futo d'aure da alwala.

Tana inda ya barta har yanzu amma wannan karon kanta a k'asa yake, wayar shi ya lalubo ya duba lokaci 2:53am ya gani, sai ya d'auki sallayar shi ya shinfid'a ya fuskanci alk'ibla ya kabbara sallah.

   Tana zaune still lokaci bayan lokaci takan d'ago ta kalle shi tana jin wani abu na yawo a cikin ranta da zuciyar ta.
    Yana da manyan d'abiu masu kyau, sallah farilla akan lokaci, yawaita azumtar Litinin da alkhamis, muraji'ar karatun alqur'ani, to bayan wannan kuma ga wani ma ta lura da yana yawan tashi dare, a lokuta da yawa takan farka taga ya kunna haske kuma zai dad'e kafun ya kashe, ashe nafifili yake yi cikin dare.
    Sai taji wata nutsuwa ta musamman tana sake kwaranya ta cikin jininta da ruhinta.

     Shiko farouk tak'aita tsayin sallar yayi bai sani ba ko tana son yin  magana ne dashi shiyasa ta zauna take jiran shi.

   Kallonta yayi yana sake nazartar ta, sai yaji duk ta bashi tausayi tunawa da wace ita zaune a gaban shi kuma sai yaji wani abu na taso mishi me kama da tsana da b'acin rai, bata saka hijab ba hakan ya bashi damar sake k'are mata kallo a karo na biyu, duk sai yaga ta rame kamar ba itace arfan da suka zo tare ba, da sannu idanun ta suka ci gaba da yawo a jikinta har suna neman huce gona da iri, da sauri ya d'auke idon shi tare da kiran sunanta cikin sanyin jiki dana murya. 

 "fatima".

 Bata amsa ba saboda yanda kiran yazo mata a bazata sai d'ago idonta da tayi ta kalle shi.

   "akwai abinda kike son fad'a mun ne?".

    Shiru tayi na wasu seconnin kafun cikin sanyi ta bud'e bakin ta tace, "wai dama ba aure mukayi ba d'auko ni kayi ni karuwar kace......" ba abinda taso fad'a ba kenan, amma sai ta samu bakin ta da furta hakan kodon saboda abin ya tsaya a ranta ne? Oho.

  Saukar maganar yaji kamar aradu a kanshi ya tsani jin duk abinda ya shafi zina bare ma har a dangan tashi da ita, "waye ya fad'i hakan?"

A nutse ta sake d'ago kanta, ganin har ynz kallonta yake sai ta maida nata kan k'asa tace, "wasu ne suka fad'a d'azu"
  Yasan ba zai huce mutanen gidan su ba, sai ya gyara zaman shi akan sallayar ya soma magana cikin nutsuwa, "eeh to kusan hakan ne kuma".
   Da sauri ta d'ago ta kalle shi saboda bata tsammaci abinda zai fad'a kenan ba.

   Ganin ta dubeshi sai yaci gaba da maganar shi, "eh mana kinga a ka'idar addinin mu ba'a d'aura aure da ciki, idan ma an d'aura daga baya aka gane da cikin to cikin ya warware auren ne gaba d'aya",  sai ya runtse ido saboda jin zafin abin da yake a cikin ranshi, a duniya yak'i jinin ya tuna da cikin jikin nata bare ma har ya had'a ta da cikin da bakin shi, "to mu kuma kinga an d'aura auren mu da cikin wani a jikin ki, kinga kenan ba aure a tsakanin mu muna zaune ne kurum batare ma da munsan makamar mu ba".

     Shiru tayi tana kallon shi cikin ranta tana sake jin k'una sosai, itama ta tsani farouk ya dinga ambata mata kalmar cikin nan,
   "Toh idan kuma ya kasance ba cikin fa". 

   Shiru yayi wannan karon don baisan amsar daya kamata ya bata bama, to meye ma dalilin wannan tambayar tunda da cikin dai a jikinta. 

Itama shirun tayi amma idonta a kanshi ko k'iftawa batayi. 
 take komai daya faru ya soma dawo mata cikin kwanyarta yadda doctor shuraim ya hak'ik'ancewa ammie kan lallai wai ciki ne da ita, yadda fareeda ma ta bada shaidar k'arya don kawai taga ta cimma wani buri nata daban daga k'arshe tunanin ta katsewa yayi akan yadda ammie ta korota daga cikin gidan su gidan mahaifinta kamar wata marar galihu.
      Siraran hawaye ne taji suna silmiyowa zuwa saman kuncinta.

  Sosai yaji tausayinta tare da takaicinta kuma again.
   Cikin bak'in cikin daya tsaye mishi a rai sakamakon abubuwa da yawa shima daya tuna ya soma magana, "wai meya dameki a rayuwa da har kika iya yin abinda kika aikata d'in? Meyasa kika lalata rayuwarki kikayi cikin........"

  Bai k'arasa ba ta tari numfashin shi cikin katse hanzari tace,
    "ni kaga nayi maka kama da me ciki?".

   Rasss! Gaban shi ya fad'i ba tare da yasan dalili ba, sai yayi shiru ya kasa bud'e bakin shi da lokaci d'aya yaji yayi mishi nauyi.

   "na tambaye ka Idan ya kasance bani da ciki meye matsayin auren mu?".

   Ta k'arasa maganar cikin wata fusatar yayinda kukanta ya sake k'aruwa.

Bashi da bakin magana, sai binta da kallo kawai da yake har ta tashi ta shige d'akin ta da sauri_sauri. 

   Maganar data fad'a sai ta tsaye mishi a rai, kuma kusan gaskiya ta fad'a, saboda tunda yake da ita bai tab'a ganin wani alamu da suke nuna tana d'auke da ciki ba, hasalima yanayin ta duka yana nuna bata tab'a sanin namiji ba, duk wasu kofofi na jikinta a kulle suke, to amma in hakane me yasa likitan ta yace tana d'auke da juna biyu a gaban kowa da kowa, sannan k'awar ta itama ta bada shaidar........ Sai kuma kanshi ya sake d'aurewa, zaren tunanin shi ya tsinke lokacin daya tuna to ai shaidar fareeda ta bayar ne akan tare dashi suke....... Wayyo Allah tunda abin nan ya faru bai tab'a tsayawa yayi tunani irin haka ba, duk lokacin daya tashi tunanin shi na tsayawa ne kawai akan yadda ya rabu da iyayen shi da kuma yadda mahaifiyarta ta iya korarta kamar ba ita ta haife ta ba, lallae ya tabbata akwai lauje cikin nad'i kuma akwai makirci da mak'ark'ashiya bunne a k'ark'ashin maganar cikin nan da abinda ya faru wancen ranar, "ina phatan Allah yasa abinda nake tunani haka yake" duk sai yaji ta bashi tausayi kwarai, sai ya sake komawa tunanin yadda yanayin ta yake komawa a duk lokacin da itama ya alak'an tata da ciki.


Daren ranar daga shi har ita ba wanda ya iya sake rintsawa har zuwa lokacin da aka kira sallar asubah.

   Bayan yayi alwala sau biyu ya mata knock ya huce masallaci.

     Itama alwalar ta d'auro ta shimfid'a sallaya ta tada sallah.

   Tana idar da sallar ta kwanta saman katifar ta rufe idonta ruf ko zata samu yanzu baccin ya d'auke ta.

    

     ********     *******


   K'arfe 10:30 dai dai na safiyar ranar ya tashe ta daga nannauyan baccin daya d'auke ta bayan sallar asuba,

  Koda ta bud'e idonta fuskar shi ta soma gani, kuma ga dukkan alamu shima tashin shi kenan daga baccin.

   "kina da bak'i".

"Bak'i kuma" ta maimaita abinda ya fad'a da alamun tambaya.

  Zama yayi gefen katifar karo na farko yace, "kije ki gani mana".

   Jiki a sanyaye ta gyara zaman hijabin jikinta, ta shiga bathroom ta wanke fuskar ta had'e da brush sannan ta nufi hanyar parlon.

    A jikin k'ofar bedroom d'in ta tsaya tana mamakin fuskokin bak'in nata.

   Mama saratu ce da wata lukurkutar mace mai kama da ita.

    Cikin fad'ad'a fara'ar fuskar ta tace, "kuyi hak'uri mun tashe ku kuna cikin baccin ku ko?".

Mama saratu ce tayi wannan maganar cikin inda inda.

   Fuska a had'e arfahn tace, "ba komai meya kawo ki?".

   Tayi mamakin jin abinda yarinyar ta fad'a a hausarda harshen larabci ya kanainaye da English, koda yake ita yanzu bata da lokacin munafunci so take ta wanke kanta a gurin arfahn

     Cikin inda inda da kame kame ta soma sosa k'eya tana fad'in," dama.... Dama dai akan... Akan maganar da su... Su fauziyyah suka fad'a ne Jiya......" 

Da sauri arfah ta d'aga mata hannu jin inda zancen nata ya nufa.

   "baki gane abind......" 

   Sake katse mata hanzari tayi da fad'in, "can u move out please".

    Mik'ewa tayi tsaye ta nufo inda arfan take ita lallae sai ta wanke kanta.

"nifa ba don kom...."

"I say out" wannan karon da d'an tsawa tayi maganar.

Yarinyar mama saratun ce ta taso tazo gaban arfahn tana nuna ta da yatsa tace, "karki kuskura kice zaki wulak'anta mun uwa a gaban ido na, saboda ita ba jakar ku bace da kowace irin bula kuka d'ebo a gidan nan sai ku nufi kanta dashi saboda gata juji''.

Wani irin wulak'antaccen duba arfah tayiwa matar sama da k'asa kamar taga kashi, sai kuma ta tab'e baki.

   "Keee! Ni sa'ar uwar kice da zakiyi mun wannan kallon".

Yarinyar ta fad'a cikin hargagi da ganin ta dama ta saba da bala'i da masifa.

   Mama saratu ce ganin yadda arfahn take tsaye kyam tana d'ibar su tana zubarwa da kallon banza ba alamun tsoro a idonta, ta ruk'o hannun y'ar ta ta.

"zo mu tafi nabeela, Allah shiyasa komai, amma tsakani har ga Allah ban ni bani nace ke karuwar farouk bace munafunce munafuncen su zainab da fauziyyah ne....."

  Tab'e baki arfah tayi cikin jin ciwon kalmar karuwa da suka kirata tace, "well ni ba ruwana da wanda yace da wanda baice ba, cox ni ban saba da irin wannan rayuwar ta dabbobi ba, zaki iya fita".

Ta k'arashe fad'a tana nuna mata hanyar futa da hannun ta.

   "mama na lura kan yarinyar nan fa yana hayak'i bari kiga in koya mata hankali".

   Nabeela ce me yin wannan maganar tare da ware mayafinta taci d'amara dashi a k'ugunta ta soma aunawa arfahn ashar irin ta rashin kunya da tarbiyyah.

   Har yanzu tana tsaye ko gezau sai wani irin duba da takeyi musu wanda yafi rashin maganar ta k'onawa nabeela rai, kamar y'ar wata da wani.

Gadan Gadan kuma haik'an tayi kan arfahn da nufin ta cafkota ta tumurmusata, sai dai ko kafun ta k'arasa farouk ya futo daga cikin d'akin.

   Janye arfah yayi ya mayar da ita bayan shi ya tsaya yana jifan su da kallo d'aya bayan d'aya, kafun cikin k'asaita nutsuwa had'e da izza yace, "bismillah u can try your madness against me, I think nine dai dai dake amma ba matata ba".

Page 29 _(twenty nine)_



Gefe tayi da sauri tana kallon farouk da yayi tsaye yana kallonta cikin matuk'ar hasala da fusatar da baisan ma lokacin data bijiro ma yanayin shi ba. 

K'aramar mara kunyar sai taja jiki baya tana kallon farouk d'in da yayi tsaye yana jiran yaga ta inda haukar tara zata fara, shin zata ce zata dakeshin ne shima. 

   Mama saratu ce ganin yadda abun ya sauya gaba d'aya ta soma bashi hak'uri, "kayi hak'uri farouku ita ba tasan ma wad'an da ya kamata ta nuna fushin ta akan su ba, yarinta ce kawai take damun ta, amma in banda haka kaida arfah da kuke rayuwar ku ba ruwan ku da kowa ma meye zata ce zatayi rigima daku".

   Kallon mama saratun yayi sannan ya kalli k'atuwar matar da aka lik'awa kalmar yarinya saboda kawai rashin kwab'a.

   Ita ko nabeela kallon shi take sosai tana mamakin daman a nan gidan yake, ta tab'a ganin shi sau biyu a k'ofar gidan su tare da wani, amma bata d'auka a cikin gidan yake da zama ba, saboda ita ba mazauniyar gidan bace din din din tana zaune a gidan kakarta ne data haifi mahaifinta, sai lokaci zuwa lokaci da takanzo gidan, kamar weakend ko kuma idan irin haka ta taso mama saratun ta kirata, sannan ko sau d'aya mama saratu bata tab'a yi mata maganar su shida matar shi ba.

    A hankali taja k'uma k'uman k'afafunta jiki a sanyaye ta nufi hanyar futa daga parlon.
   Itama mama saratu bin bayan ta tayi suka fuce tare.

Sassanyar ajiyar zuciya ya sauke ya k'arasa futowa daga cikin d'akin gaba d'ayan shi, a dakalin k'ofar kitchen ya zauna tare da dafe kanshi da hannun shi duka biyu.
   Idan kanshi ya d'au zafi sai ya rasa tunanin daya kamata ma yayi.

   Ya jima a haka cikin rashin sanin makama da abinyi, maganar da sukayi da fatima daren Jiya ta tsaye mishi a ranshi sosai, ga k'arin tambayoyin da yake dasu wanda ita kad'ai ce zata iya bashi amsa.


     Kitchen d'in ya shige daga k'arshe ya d'ora ruwan zafi a tukunya, wanka yayi bayan ya futo shirye cikin d'aya daga kala ukun kayan shi.

    Dubawa ya sakeyi, fanken ta yana nan kamar yadda yake ajiye mata ada bata d'auka ba, bai tab'a plask d'in shayin ba saboda yasan indai bata d'au fanken ba to shayin ma bata shaba.

    Vaseline ya shafa a jikin shi, har ya jingina kanshi da jikin bango sai kuma yaji yana buk'atar ya duba lafiyar ta.

Tsam ya mik'e ya nufi bedroom d'in, tana zaune ta k'udundune jikinta da hijab da alama har yanzu tana jin sanyin sosai, bai k'arasa shiga d'akin ba duk da ya lura kamar ma ba taji shigowar shi ba.

    Cupin shayin da yake gaban ta ta d'auka a hankali ta kai bakin ta.

    "Ta tsiyayi shayi kenan? To me yasa baza taci fanken ba?". Duka a ranshi yayi wannar maganar

   Shiru yayi still hannun shi hard'e a k'irji yana kallonta, har sai da yaga ta kwanta bayan ta gama shanye shayin ya juya ya fuce daga d'akin. 

   Itama kuma sai a lokacin taga gilmawarshi.


    Yinin ranar a gida ya yini zubur ba inda ya futa, saboda bashi da agendar aiki da kowa, duk kuma sai yaji ya takura da zaman shiru, ga shi itama ta yini a dak'i baiji ko motsin ta ba, sai duk yaji ya damu ko lafiya take? 


   Da yammacin ranar bayan ya sake muraji'ar karatun shi na alqur'ani, kitchen ya nufa ya d'ora tukunya a wuta yana tunanin abinda ma ya kamata ya dafa, su dai a gidan basu da komai sai shinkafa, kuma shima bai iya dafa komai inba shinkafa da taliya da shayi ba, duk da a gida yakan taya ummie da k'annen shi aiki sosai.

   Kud'i ya d'auka ya fuce daga gidan, kanti ya nufa kai tsaye ya siyo musu taliya guda uku da mai da magin da zasu d'an yi musu kwana biyu, sai sauran abubuwan buk'atun yau da kullum gwargwadon k'arfin shi.

  A hanyar shiga gidan yaci karo da mijin d'aya daga matan gidan zai futo shima, hannu farouk ya mik'a mishi sukayi musabiha, ratsewa farouk yayi da nufin huce shi, sai dai kafun yaje ko'ina mutumin ya tsayar dashi.

  "amm daman dai hak'uri zan k'ara baka akan abinda ya faru jiya, a office d'in y'an sanda naji wajen maida zancen ance har da kai da matarka suka sa ciki, don Allah kayi hak'uri kasan sha'anin mata wani lokacin ba hankali a ciki bare tunani, in banda haka ana tare lafiya qlou su biku da wannan irin mummunan k'azafi, gaskiya abin baiyi dad'i ba sam kuyi hak'uri don Allah".

   Murmushin yak'e farouk d'in yayi yace, "ba komai karka damu".

Daga haka sukayi sallama farouk ya shige, dama Allah Allah yake ya sallami mutumin yayi shigewarshi ciki.

   Ruwan daya d'ora harya tafasa, sai ya wanke shinkafa Shap Shap ya zuba ya bud'e taliyar itama ya zuba kad'an da nufin shi zaiyi musu shinkafa da taliya ne a had'e.

   A gurguje ya gama ya d'auro alwalar sallar magrib ya nufi masallaci.

 "Ya Allah ka dubani ka duba wannan baiwa taka kasa ba ciwon zuciyar bane ya tashi mata, Allah ka gani ni fak'iri ne, bani da komai sai abinda ka huwace mun, ina da cin yau bansan ba gobe tunda gobe taka ce kai ka barwa kanka sanin abinda zai wakana cikin ta, ya Allah kaba wannan baiwa taka lafiya, kayi mata maganin dukkan wasu matsalolinta na rayuwa, ka raba ta da wannan ciwo mai had'ari ga rayuwar ta".

   Ya k'arashe fad'a cikin raunatacciyar murya, mai nuni da zallar raunin shi a zahiri. 
   
   Cikin lokaci k'alilan ta kanainaye shi gaba d'aya cikin futar hayyaci da azabar ciwon da baisan ma daga ina yake tashi mata ba, gashi jikinta ba wani zafi sosai.

 "fatima".

 "kiyi shiru kar kiyi sab'o fatima in sha Allah bazaki mutu a cikin irin wannan haalin ba, insha Allah bazaki mutu da fushin iyaye a kanki ba, dukkan tsanani sauk'i na tare dashi, komai zai warware da ikon Allah, gaskiya zatayi halinta, mahaifiyarki da mahaifinki wata rana zasu gane gaskiya, a wannan lokacin da kansu zasu nemo ki, amma don Allah ki daina sa damuwa a ranki kinga kina da matsalar da bata son damuwa".

A duniya me kika tanadarwa gobe kiyama da har kike fatan ki tafi tun yanzu da wuri haka, tabbas ita mutuwa bata sallama kuma a duk lokacin da kwanan mutum ya k'are a duniya bazai k'ara ko dede da second ba sai ya tafi, kuma duk abinda ka shuka a duniya shi zaka girba ranar gobe k'iyama, to kinga ashe akwai babban k'alubalen rayuwa a gaban mu, tunda har bamusan result d'in mu ba tun a duniya balle mu gyara kura kuran mu, su kuma fareeda da doctor shuraim, bakya buk'atar yin dogon tunani da sunan nemo hanyar da zaki rama abinda sukayi miki, hak'ik'a musulmi na gari baya rama cuta da cuta, sai dai maye gurbin cuta da alkhairy, akwai hadisin da yake cewa, _wa'atabi'issayi'atil hasanati, tamhuha_

Daga bayanan da mai chemist d'in yayi mishi ya canko bama ciwon tane ya tashi ba sai dai ko wani abun daban, tunda wannan shine karo na biyu daya ga tayi irin hakan.

  Da sauri saurin shi ya nufo gidan.
 Lokacin daya shigo d'akin nata tuni tayi bacci. Sai ya ajiye ledojin daya shigo dasu a gefen katifar kawai ya futo.

    A gefen katifa ta zauna, shi kuma ya fuce parlor

Sai daya bata wasu mintuna masu tsayi sannan ya had'a mata tea ya nufi d'akin yana zaton zuwa yanzu ai ta shirya.

  Tana kwance a gefen katifar sanye da doguwar rigarta tun ta asalin wadda suka zo gidan da ita.

   Yana gama fad'in haka ya fuce daga d'akin.

Ta futo parlon cikin doguwar rigar ta d'aya daga wad'an da mus'ab abokin farouk ya siya mata, ta yane kanta da d'an yalolon gyalen rigar kasancewar ba sanyi a garin.

   Mama saratu ce ta fad'i haka cike da hassada da bak'in ciki.

_K'arfe 2:43 a k'asar Spain_. 

   Zaune yake saman sofa ya jingina kanshi a pillow haka idanun shi duka biyu a lumshe suke, parlou ne madaidaici daya k'awatu da kayan more rayuwa na alatu iri daban daban, baka jin motsin komai sai television dake ta faman b'ab'atu wadda girman ta ya kusa rabin bangon d'akin. Wani irin duba takeyi mishi kwayar idanunta cike da zallar kishi da bak'in cikin yadda ya ke kiran ta da sunan sofiyyah, bai san a duniya ta tsani jin sunan ba balle har a kai ga ana dangantata da mai sunan ma gaba d'aya.

 "bismillah zauna mana".

Ohhh mallaka ita dai mallaka kamar ki mallake mutum nima dai bansan yadda zan fad'a miki kai tsaye a hausa ba, amma dai mallaka a hausance zamu iya fassarata da ki kanainaye mutum da komai nashi, ya zama komai zaiyi saida shawararki, in kika ce yayi zaiyi, in kika ce ya bari ma zai bari kamar yaron goye".

   Jinjina kai arfah tayi kafun ta sake cewa, "Toh idan mutum bai sha maganin mallakar ba in kace yayi ba zaiyi ba?".

   Wani irin kallo rahama tayi mata kafun tace, "kema dai fatima da wata irin magana kamar bakisan haalin maza ba, ai namiji kina yin kamar kinayi ma ya Allah ya cika, yanzu ni kin ganni ba d'a ba ba komai ba amma wallahi in na tashi tun sallar asuba bana komawa bacci har lokacin da zai fita, kinga nice shara, wanke wanke, sannan ga aikin breakfast d'in shi, ke wata rana ma har ki gama dafawa yace bazai iya ci ba sai na sake mishi girkin, sannan duk da haka in banyi da gaske ba sai ya sake had'a mun da aikin shi na kanshi, humm Kedai Allah ya kyauta, kuma duk wannan abun d'an k'aramin kuskure da zakiyi wata rana sai mutum ya rufe ido yayi miki tatas ba tare da yayi la'akari da irin hidindimun da kike yini kinayi da shi ba, to wannan dalilin yasa mata da yawa suke kasa hak'uri su nemi maganin mallaka saboda zasu ji sauk'in abubuwa, ba cin mutumci ba wulak'anci".

   "Abin al'ajabi, Toh idan kuma ya kasance mijin ne yake yiwa matar duk wannan fa? Kenan yana nufin mijin ya mallaketa?" arfah ta fad'a da mamaki, don ita har ga Allah duk wannan dogon lissafin na rahama ba wani ganewa sosai tayi ba a kanta sai taji kamar reshe juye mujiya ne, to ai ita  farouk shi yake yi mata duk wannan.

  Ita kuwa rahama dariya tayi jin abinda arfahn ta fad'a.
  "wai anya kuwa fatima..... Kai wai watan ki nawa ma da aure?".

   "xa'ayi wata biyu yanzu"

  Ta fad'a bilhak'k'i da iya gaskiyar ta.

   "Toh kin gama kin rigani yin aure, ko dai har yanzu ana ci gaba daji dake ne amarya".

  Fuskar ta ta rufe tana d'an yin dariya. 

    "ai duk namiji yana da isa da mulki, wannan kam a jininsu yake duk yadda zakiyi bazaki iya raba su da wannan ba, kina zaune dede da ruwan wanke hannu ke zaki d'auko mishi, kuma in ya gama duk ki kwashe komai, to ta ina kuma kike tunanin namiji zai zauna yayiwa mace duk wannan? 
   In kika duba kwanon da yaci abinci ma ke kika d'auke k'arewarta ma, haba sai dai ko amarya amaryar ma na bata wata d'aya wallahi an gama na marmari, mu kuma mata duk matsalar mu rashin hak'uri ne, don me ma mace take yin aure? Shifa dukkan shi ibadah ce, idan kikayi ladabi kika bi mijinki sau da k'afa sai ki samu aljannar ki, kinga kin ribanci duniyarki da lahirarki gaba d'aya ta sanadiyyar aure".

   Shiru tayi yanzun kam ba tace komai ba, don in taci gaba da magana rahama zata iya b'aro jirgin su.
   
    Hira taci gaba dayi mata, ita dai nata sauraro da murmushi har zuwa lokacin da ta ga ya kamata ta tafi haka.

  Har k'ofar parlon ta rakota sukayi sallama ta tafi.

  Tana zuwa part d'in su tayi turus saboda ganin k'ofar parlon a bud'e

Page 31 _(thirty one)_



Tasan kuma farouk in yayi irin wannan futar ta sassafe ba dawowa yake ba sai yamma.

  A hankali ta d'aga labulen ta shiga dak'in da sallama.

  Yana tsaye jikin window inda takan tsaya a mafi yawan lokuta.
   Da mamaki ta kalle shi, shima kallonta yake yi fuskar shi da alamar tambaya.

   Sai ta samu kanta da jin nauyin yadda ya tsare ta da idon.

   A gefen k'ofa ta tsaya tayi k'asa da kanta tana wasa da yatsar hannun ta.
   "daga ina kike?" tambayar daya jefa mata kenan ba tare da shi kanshi ya shiryawa hakan ba.

    Ita kanta sai data ji wani banbarakwai a kanta, to su daba irin auren su rahama sukayi ba meyasa zai tambaye ta ma, sai ta shagwab'e fuska cikin k'asa da murya tace, "naje gurin rahama ne?".

Da mamaki yake ci gaba da kallonta kafun ya sake jefo mata wata tambayar kuma, "wacece kuma rahama? Kinsan wasu ne dama a garin nan?"

    Girgiza mishi kai tayi yadda ya had'e fuska lokaci d'aya sai take jin wata shakkar shi, "a gidan nan fa take, kuma itama tana zo mun"

   Sai da yaji gaban shi ya fad'i shi fa tsoron kar ta shiga sabgar matan gidan nan yake, yadda suke yin abu kamar y'an kansu, sunje auren su a gefe ko tsoron mazajen su ma basayi, rashin mutumci ba mace ba namiji kowa tata mishi sukeyi, har shi kanshi wata rana in yazo hucewa ko ya futo aikin sharar safe sun dinga yada mishi habaici da b'akar magana kenan? to ya kenan idan ta had'a kai da su itama ta zama y'ar cikinsu. 

 "wacece rahama kuma?"

Ya sake yi mata tambayar had'e da juyowa ya fuskance ta sosai yana mata kallon tsaf tun daga samanta har k'asa, sai da yaji wani abu ya soka mishi ganin irin shigar data futa da ita, sai yayi saurin lumshe idon shi yana sauraron amsar data ke bashi.

   "A gidan nan fa take, itace tazo lokacin da nayi rashin lafiya kwanaki".

   Har ga Allah bai wani gane wadda take nufi ba, sai ya d'auka ko mama saratu take nufi, take bacin ranshi ya sake ninkuwa, sai ya sake yin taku kad'an zuwa gaban ta ya nayi mata wani irin duba kafun ya soma magana, "yai miki kyau, wato duk abinda ya faru rannan a cikin gidan nan bai zamo miki darasi ba? Shine har kika iya wanke k'afa kika je inda suke kuma da irin wannan shigar, ina har nan suka shigo zasu yi miki duka Allah yasa ina nan na taka musu burki, shine yanzu zaki had'a kai dasu?", sai ya d'an ja baya yanaci gaba da kallon ta yana girgiza kai kafun ya sake yin magana cikin takaici, "good idan har zaki shiga cikin su, ni bazan hanaki ba sai dai duk abinda ya biyo baya karki kuskura kisa farouk a ciki ki rik'e wannan a kanki"

Yana gama fad'in haka bai kuma ce mata komai ba yayi shigewarshi kitchen.

  A gurin ta zauna tana sake auna maganganun shi a cikin ranta, me yake nufi kenan? Yana nufin gurin su mama saratu naje? Ko ko so yake yace me yasa na futa ban tambaye shi ba? 

   Take idanunta suka tara kwallah, sai ta mik'e kawai ta shige dak'in ta, kuka ta dinga yi akan fad'an da yayi mata da kuma fahimtar ta ta daya k'i yi, a ganin ta da gangan ya nuna bai fahimci abinda take fad'a ba kawai don yayi mata fad'a.

   Shi ko farouk abinda ya dawo dashi gidan ya gabatar ya sake fucewa zuwa aikin da yake gaban shi.

   Bata sake futowa parlon ba sai da yamma sosai, shi ma jin shiru ba taji motsin shi bane yasa ta futo, kitchen ta lek'a ta d'auko ragowar abin karin kumallonta taci, don yunwa ce tun dazu dama ta dame ta.
   Tana gama ci kuwa ta lallab'a tayi shigewarta dak'i harda hararar bargunan shi da yake kwana ita ala dole tana fushi dashi. 


 Farouk ranar bai dawo gidan ba sai after isha'i, don sai da suka gama kwashe duka yashin suka rarraba kud'in sannan kowa ya kama gaban shi.

    Tana daga cikin dak'in ta a kwance taji alamar shigowar shi. Sai data kalli k'ofar kamar zata ganshi sannan ta kuma zungura baki ta d'auke kanta.

   Yau kam a gajiye ya dawo lik'is, shiyasa bai shigo gidan ba sai da ya tsaya ya sama musu abinda zasu ci, ko zama baiyi ba ya shiga kitchen ya kunna gas ya d'ora ruwan zafin da zaiyi wanka.

   Ruwan yana d'umi kuwa ya juye ya shige ban dak'i.

   Bayan ya gama bai zauna ba ya had'a kayayyakin da zai wanke ya wanke.

  Ledar soyayyen dankalin hausa da awara daya siyo musu ya jawo ya d'auki nashi ya ajiye mata nata.

   Bayan ya gama duk abinda yake yi har ya kwanta ya tuna da dankalin ta da awararta, yasan ba lallai yanzu ta futo taci ba, amma a zaune take cikin dare zata tashe shi ta hana shi bacci da koke koken yunwa.

Sai daya had'a mata tea a cup yadda yasan zata iya shanyewa sannan ya d'auki ledar ya nufi dak'in ta.

 Kwan! Kwan!! ya mata  Knock, tana kwance saman sallaya daga idar da sallar isha'i tayi bacci sai da yanzu bugun k'ofar shi ya tashe ta.

    Bata ce komai ba, ta dai koma saman katifa ta zauna.

   Shima jin shiru sai ya d'aga labulen ya shiga da sallama.
     Sau d'aya ya kalle ta ya ajiye mata shayin da ledar a gefen katifar.

   Yana d'agowa yaji muryarta tace, 
    "nifa na k'oshi".

   Sai ya tsaya yana kallonta, "kamar ya kin k'oshi".

   Zunb'ura baki tayi ta juya mishi baya.

Murmushi yayi ganin abun nata na buk'atar sauraro sai ya durk'usa don shi kam ya gaji bazai iya tsayawa da k'afafun shi ba yadda ya gaji d'in nan.

   "Yanzu dai menene matsalar ki?"
   Ya fad'a yana sauraron amsar ta. 

    Kallon shi ta juyo tayi sai kawai ta fashe da kuka. Shi abin dariya ma ya bashi, amma gudun kada ya nad'i laifin da ba nashi, ko ya k'ara laifi kan laifi sai ya gimtse yace,

   "kuka dai? Kinga don Allah ki ajiye kukan nan naki ki fara fad'a mun abinda yake faruwa tukun, in ba haka ba kuma zanyi tafiya ta in kyaleki".

  Sanin hali a kace yafi sanin kama, tasan tsab zai iya aikata abinda yace, kuma ita tana son dole yasan ya b'ata mata rai, sai ta juyo ta fuskance shi tasa gefen d'an kwalinta tana share hawayenta cikin tab'ara da shagwab'ab'b'en muryarta tace, 

  "ba kaine d'azu kayi mun fad'a ba, bayan kasan abinda nake nufi".

   Kama hab'a yayi yana kallonta da mamaki, don shi harga Allah ya manta da wani abu daya faru dawowarshi gida d'azu, sai ya gyara durk'usan shi yana tambayarta,
  
    "to ni yaushe nayi miki fad'a? Kuma akan me?".

  Sake fashewa tayi da kuka, kai daji zaka san kukane na tsabar sangarta da neman magana.

  ''Wayyoh fatima kinsan fa na tsani kukan nan, Allah da gaske zanyi tafiyata in baki daina ba"

   Ya fad'a in a serious way.

  Sai ta nutsu kuma ta tsaya tana kallon shi.
   "ehem go a head ina sauraron ki".

   Gyara zama tayi hadda tankwashe k'afa sannan ta soma fad'in, "nifa d'azu ba su mama saratu nake nufi ba, wadda ta tab'a zuwa wata rana da nayi ciwon..... ciwon...." sai taji nauyin ta k'arasa yi mishi bayani.

 Amma kuma shi ya gane, tabbas wadda take nufi tana da nutsuwa sosai to amma duk da haka ya kamata ta kiyaye, kuma daman shi kanshi d'azun sai da yayi ta mamakin abinda zaisa har ta had'a huld'a dasu, yasan ko jin kanta bazai barta ba.

   Murmushi yayi yana kallon yadda tayi k'asa da idonta, shi kunyarta mamaki take bashi, gata dai a haka wayayyah amma ko a magana ba kowacce take iya fad'a mishi ba...... Daga kunyarta zaka san she's innocent bata san komai a kan waccen rayuwar ba, sannan wannan kunyar ana samun irinta ne kad'ai a gurin cikakkiyar budurwa da tasan abinda takeyi, ko anan ya sake gasgata sharri ne fareeda da shuraim sukayi mata wancen ranar.

A hankali ya bud'e bakin shi yace, "OK na gane, sai dai da izinin wa kika je gurin nata?"
   Ya fad'i maganar har lokacin fuskar shi a gintse, amma  fa a ranshi so yake ya razanata yaga tsoro a kwayar idanunta.

  Aikuwa sai gashi tarkon shi yayi kamu, don wuri wuri tayi cike da tsoro tace, "wai da gaske ne dole mace komai zatayi sai ta sanar da mijin ta? Inba haka ba kuma Allah ya k'ona ta a wutar jahannama da tafi ta duniya zafi?".

   Yadda tayi maganar cike da wauta da zallar k'uruciya sai da abun ya burge farouk.
   Sai ya zaro idon shi shima cike da mamaki yake tambayar ta, "waye ya fad'a miki haka?".

   Sai ta gyara zaman ta don dama akwai tambayoyi da yawa data kasa tambayar rahaman d'azu take son shi ta tambaye shi.

  "rahama ce ta fad'a mun d'azu da naje, kuma har abubuwan da mace zata yi ta samu aljannah ta fad'a mun".

   Yanzun kam kasa b'oye dariyar shi yayi har sai da ya dara kad'an, sosai yaji hankalin shi ya sake kwanciya da huld'ar ta da rahaman, saboda da alama zata k'aru da abubuwa da yawa da bata sani ba na zamantakewa.

  "haka ne abinda ta fad'a miki gaskiya ne".

  Shiru ta d'an yi kafun ta sake cewa, "to kuma har irin auren nan namu?".

Ya gane abinda take nufi amma sai ya share ya nuna mata kamar bai gane ba, saboda har ga Allah yana jin dad'in hirar tasu da ita, a hirar yake nazarin inda bakin zaren yake ya kamo shi, sai yace, "kamar ya? Wani irin aure kenan?".

  D'an zaro ido ta sake yi, "eh mana ko ka manta yadda akayi auren mune? ni da kai fa duka bamu san juna ba bama son juna, mun tsani juna, ka tsaneni nima kuma na tsaneka, to kuma sai ace duk abinda zanyi saina tambayeka?"

  Yadda tayi magana cike da wauta irin ta rashin sani da gab'unta sai da yaji gaban shi ya fad'i da kalmar Sun tsani juna, shi yaushe yace mata ya tsaneta? zuwa yanzu ya gane ba wani gane hausa ma takeyi sosai ba, ita dai kawai tana fad'in kalmomin ne ba tare ma da tasan ainahin ma'anar su ba.
  Amma kuma duk da haka sai da yaji ba dad'i da kalmar tsanar nan data fad'a sai yaji duk ta tsaye mishi a rai. 

   Sai gashi cikin seconds ta dagula mishi yanayin farin cikin hira da yake yi da ita cikin nishadi zuwa wani yanayi mara dad'i. 

  ''Kayi shiru baka ce mun komai ba" ta fad'a tana sake tsura mishi idanunta. 

  Sai yayi murmushin yak'e yace, "haka ne ni dake duka ba son junan mu muke ba, amma fa bawai yana nufin zakiyi komai yadda ranki yake so ba, shi aure dukkan shi yafi k'arfin wasa".

   "Toh amma kwanaki kace dai dai muke da masu zaune da kansu?".

Kai wannan yarinyar, shi fa yanzu hirar ta daina yi mishi dad'i kwata kwata, sai ya yunk'ura da nufin mik'ewa, itama mik'ewar tayi tana kallon shi,
     "Baka fad'a mun komai ba fa, kenan dole duk abinda zanyi sai ka sani?"
  Ta sake maimaita mishi irin waccen tambayar, ita dai kawai burin ta yace a'a ta samu freedom d'in da zatayi abunta ba tare da ta taka wuta ba kamar yadda rahama tace mata d'azu, don ita harga Allah tana tsoron wutar nan da akace mata tafi ta duniya fintinkau. Bazata manta wani lokaci da akayi gobara a anguwar su ba tazo hutu suka lek'a ta windown main parlour ita da fareeda suna kallo, taga ana futo da mutanen gidan duk sun k'one, ranar kwana tayi ba tayi bacci ba ta dinga kuka tak'i cin komai.

     Shima farouk tunanin ya tafi yi a ranshi, nazarin halayenta da dabi'unta yake, komai nata tana yin shi da zuciya d'aya ne, kuma kai tsaye ba tare da tunanin komai ba, sannan akwai duhun jahilci k'arancin ilimin addini da yasa take yin wani abun ma ba'a matsayin komai ba.

   Gyara tsayuwar shi yayi ya fad'ad'a fara'ar fuskar shi yace, "kinga yanzu dai ki sha shayin ki kafun ya huce".

   Ya k'arasa fad'a yana d'auko mata kofin shayin.

A sanyaye ta zauna gefen katifar ta karb'i tea d'in, tunanin gidan su da tayi yanzu yasa taji gab'ob'in jikinta duk sun yi sanyi, shayin ta soma sha yanayin fuskar ta yana sake sauyawa, a hankali kuma wasu hawaye masu d'umi suka soma biyo kuncin ta.

   Ganin haka sai farouk ya juya baice mata komai ba ya fice daga d'akin.
   

           ***********


Toh haka rayuwa taci gaba da tafiyar musu cikin nutsuwa da kwanciyar hankali, a hankali sauyi ya soma samuwa a zaman takewar auren su, rahama takan zowa arfah lokaci bayan lokaci, kuma takan wayar mata da kai a kan abubuwa da yawa da bata sani ba, duk da arfahn bawai tana nuna mata wata alama da zata gane komai bane, ita kam arfah tun daga lokacin bata sake zuwa part d'in rahaman ba, bata ma sake taka ko tsakar gidan ba, tun maganar da sukayi da farouk ta ke yin komai a d'arare, ita dai tsoron ta d'aya kada tayi abinda Allah zai k'ona ta a wutar jahannama.

    Alhaji usman kamar yadda yayi alk'awari hakan ce ta kasance, abokin shi yana dawowa ya kira farouk ya sanar dashi ranar da zai rakashi gidan mutumin, farin cikin farouk a lokacin gaza b'oyuwa yayi, yayi tasbihi yayi hamdala a wannan ranar har bai san adadi ba.
  
    Kwana biyu a tsakani Alhaji usman ya raka shi gurin mutumin ma'abocin kamala da nutsuwa, kallo d'aya da farouk yayi mishi yaji ya kwanta mishi a rai, shima kuma mutumin haka yaji a kan farouk.

      Jan hankali mai kyau ya yiwa farouk had'e da tsoratarwa, kafun daga k'arshe ya dank'a mishi amanar dukiyarshi.

    A motar shi ya d'auki farouk d'in har kasuwar, shagone babbah mai d'auke da kayayyaki na mata na milliyoyin kud'ad'e.

   Addu'oi sosai farouk yayi lokacin da ya shiga cikin shagon.

   Nasiha ya sake yi mishi sannan ya d'ora dayi mishi albishir d'in, idan ya tsaya bil hak'k'i yayi aiki tuk'uru zai yaye shi ya bud'e mishi nashi gurin.

    Shi farouk baima damu da a bud'e mishi wani guri ba indai zai samu abinda zai rufawa kanshi da matar shi asiri shikenan.

   Alhaji asheer bai tafi ba saida ya d'auko wani amintaccen yaron shi daga wani shago ya had'a shi zama da farouk don ya koyi yadda zai tafiyar da kasuwancin sa, zuwa lokacin da zai kware sosai a harkar sai ya tafi.

   Godiyar da farouk ya dinga yi har sai da alhaji asheer ya gaji da saurara ya tafi ya kyale shi. Shi kanshi sai da yaji tausayin farouk d'in a lokacin da alhaji usman yake fad'a mishi wai yana da aure, gashi yaron duk alamomin nagartaccen mutum sun bayyana tattare dashi, ya naji a jikin shi zai rik'e mishi amanar dukiyarshi kamar yadda usman ya kyautata zato. 

    Yinin ranar farouk duk maida hankalin shi yayi wajen karantar yadda yaron shagon yake tafiyar da costomers da kuma kasuwancin, abinda bai fahimta ba yakan tambaye shi.

    Da sannu da sannu farouk ya soma gane kowane kaya da farashin yadda ake siyar dasu, kunsan ance kowane mutum da irin baiwar shi, toh Allah yasawa farouk fikira da fahimtar komai nan da nan. 

Alhamdulillah zamu ce don yanzun kam rayuwa ta soma sauya mishi, shaddoji masu kyau alhaji asheer ya bashi kyauta kusan kala biyar, saboda kana harkar saida kayayyaki a irin wannan guri dole sai da shiga mai kyau saboda costomers, ita ma matar shi ya bata k'ananun atamfofi kala biyu.

    A lokacin sai farouk yaga kamar wanda suke zaune taren baiji dad'i ba, don take yanayin shi ya sauya, koda farouk ya sashi ya taya shi godiya gurin alhaji tab'e baki yayi.

    Da yake da wuri suke tashi a kasuwa, ranar bai dawo gida ba sai da ya biya gidan su salman bayan sun gaisa dasu gwaggwo da k'annen salman, kayan fruit ya siya musu masu kyau ya kai musu. Anan gwaggwo take taya shi murna da aikin daya samu. 
      
    Tare suka tafi da salman don ya rakashi gurin telan da zai d'inka mishi kayan, bayan sunyiwa gwaggwo sallama ta had'i shi da kayan gyad'a mai gishiri.

   Suna tafe suna hira inda salman yake shaidawa farouk bikin shi fa yana ta k'aratowa har an kusa kammala had'a lefe ma.
    Sosai farouk ya taya shi murna da fatan alkhairy, sunci gaba da hirar su cikin raha da barkwanci har suka k'arasa shagon telan.

   Simple d'inki za'ayi mishi ba aiki, nan akayi measuring d'in shi akayi mishi total na kud'in shi, ya biya rabi da sharad'in in an gama zai cika rabin.

    Har zasu tafi sai yaga rigunan mata an sak'ale su a anger, sai ya dawo ya tambaye su ko suna d'inkin mata?
    Telan ya shaida mishi bashi yake yi ba amma wadda take yi d'in k'anwar shi ce, in suna so sai ya kira musu ita a waya tazo suyi magana.

   Sai suka samu guri suka zauna aka kira musu ita, sunyi magana da salman kan d'inkin da kud'in da zasu biya, bayan sun gama ciniki ta buk'aci magwajin wadda za'ayiwa d'inkin.

   Sai lokacin farouk yayi magana, "ayi mata riga da zani kawai".

   Mai d'inkin ce tace, "to ai ko riga da zanin ana buk'atar magwaji dole".

    Shiru yayi yana tunanin kayan ta ma duka nawa, wata riga da take sak'ale a anger ya nuna kiyi mata kamar wannan kawai.

   "To shikenan ba damuwa" telan ta fad'a tana har had'a kayan.

   Suma sallama sukayi da y'an shagon suka d'auki tasu hanyar, a hanya ne farouk yake tambayar shi ko suna da islamiyyu na matan aure a unguwar?  

   "eh akwai wata ta y'an ahlusunna a bayan layin kuma take, matarka zaka sa?".
   Ya k'arasa yi mishi bayani da tambaya.

  ''Eh wai mafarkina ne na nan gaba, kasan a kace d'an adam da buri".

   Dariya salman d'in yayi yace, "to ai burin abune mai kyau kayi, kuma ko yanzu farouk kace alhamdulillah, don Allah ya gama lullub'eka har y'an yatsunka, sai dai ka dage da addu'a kawai kasan mutane wani zuciyar shi bata da kyau".
  Murmushi yayi yace, "insha Allah zan dage, na gode sosai aboki na gari".

   "Ah haba ba wani abu farouk, kai daga nan nasan hucewa zakayi ko?".

   "Eh wallahi na gaji sosai kuma da ina son zanje gidan alhaji usman mu gaisa, to kumaaa..... Ina ganin kawai gobe in Allah ya kaimu naje".

  "Toh sai Allah ya kaimun, nima zan d'an je na rage wannan gashin"

    Ya fad'a tana shafo gashin kanshi daya d'an taru.

   "OK Allah ya bamu alkhairy" farouk shima ya fad'a kafun suyi sallama kowa yayi nashi guri.

   Har ya d'auki hanyar gidan sai ya tuno da takardar data ajiye mishi d'azu daya shiga wanka, murmushi yayi yana tuno abinda ta rubuta a cikin takardar, shima kuma daman yana lura da kwana biyu kamar bata da lafiya.

   Sai ya koma chemist d'in anguwar ya siya mata abinda take buk'ata d'in, har yana tunanin ko ya siya mata wani abu? Sai kawai ya share don zai iya siya ma yakai mata tace ba taci. 

   Da sallama ya shiga d'akin cikin fara'a, tana tsaye jikin window as usual ta amsa mishi sallamar tana satar kallon hannun shi.

  Ledar ya mik'a mata, tasa hannu ta karb'a cike da kunya ta shige cikin d'akin ta da sauri, dama abinda take jira kenan tun d'azu, da bai zo yanzun bama da ba tasan yadda zatayi da kanta ba.

    Ledar hannun shi ya ajiye ya shiga cikin kitchen yana k'arewa komai kallo, komai yana nan yadda ya barshi har taliyar daya ajiye mata ta rana ba taci ba, kuma da alama yau bata shigo kitchen d'in bama don ba abinda akayi a ciki.

   Parlon ya dawo yana k'arewa komai kallo da yake akwai wadataccen hasken wutar lantarki, nan ma dai kamar kitchen d'in.

    Sai ya samu guri ya zauna yana nazarin ta inda zai soma gyaran gidan, yadda ya gaji d'in nan san samune yana dawowa ya tarar da ruwan wanka mai zafi, ko'ina fes yana tashin daddad'an k'amshi, ace ga abinci mai rai da lafiya.
   Sai ya saki sassanyan murmushi ya mik'e don gabatar da aikin dake gaban shi.

    Bayan ya gama komai sai da yayi wanka sannan ya zauna zaman cin abinci bayan ya d'umama cikin shi da tea mai zafi.

   Indomie ce dai ya tafasa musu, ya ajiye mata tata a kitchen d'in.

    Yana cin abincin wayar shi tayi ringing.

  Ko daya duba salman ne mai kiran nashi, d'agawa yayi ya kara a kumnen shi tare da yin sallama.

   Yana cikin yin wayar ta futo ta huce shi ta shiga kitchen, ba jimawa kuma sai gata ta sake futowa rik'e da plate d'in abincinta da tea a cup.

  Batace mishi ba shima baice mata ba, don y'an kwanakin ba ruwan wani da wani, kullum zai fita k'arfe 7 : 00 yana tunanin ma bata tashi ba lokacin, haka zai dawo da magriba ko bayan isha'i, amma bata tab'a tambayar shi ina yake zuwa ba, abu d'aya dai inta fahimci ya gama abinci takan futo ta d'auka a inda tasan yana ajiye mata ta koma cikin d'akin.

     Magana ko ta sannu bata had'a shi da ita, sai satar kallo shima sau d'aya shikenan zata d'auke kanta. A aikace yake ganin asalin bata son shin da ta fad'a, babu kulawarta ko d'aya a rayuwar da yake yi.

   Sauk'i d'aya dai daya samu, wani lokacin takan futo ta gyara parlon da kitchen.
     Shima kuma duk ranar da bata jin dad'in jikinta batayi, ko ciwon kai take ji kwanciya take laga laga wani lokacin ma tayi ta kuka.

   A d'an zaman da sukayi tare ya fahimci mace ce ita mai raki, da shagwab'a abu kad'an kuka, sai dai wani abu da yake bashi mamaki da ita, ko sau d'aya bata tab'a gajiyawa da cin kalar abinci d'aya ba kamar yadda shi yayi. 

    Tunani ya lula sosai har saida salman ya gaji dayi mishi magana ya kashe wayar shi sannan ya farga.

   Ajiye wayar yayi shima ya k'arasa kawar da abinda zai kawar yayi shimfid'a ya kwanta bayan ya kashe glove.



    _Gashinan na biyaku bashin har na rannan da ban samu damar cikashe muku ba_😍

Page 32 _(thirty two)_



Kamar yadda yake mutum mai himma haka yau ma tun asubar fari daya tashi bai koma ba.
   Zuwa k'arfe 7 tuni ya gama shiryawa ya fuce daga gidan bayan ya ajiye mata abincin karin kumallonta da abincin rana duka.

  Ya isa shago kuwa a kan lokaci, abokin kasuwancin nashi ma bai zo ba, kuma dama yana riga shi zuwa.


Ta b'angaren arfah kuwa ranar sai 11 da y'an mintuna ta tashi daga nannauyan baccin da take yi, mikewa tayi ta shige ban d'aki ta wanke fuskar ta tayi brush. 
  Kitchen ta shiga tana duba kan gas, ilai kuwa ya dafa mata ruwan wankan sai dai ya huce sai d'an d'umi kawai. 
   A haka ta d'auka ta juye ta shiga wankan, ko data futo shap shap ta shirya cikin doguwar rigar da rahama ta bata, ta dawo parlon donta Sawa cikin ta wani abu. 

   Yau ta gyara parlon da yake tana jin dama dama a jikinta, bayan ta gama anan parlon dai taci gaba da zama, wani littafin farouk data gani na addu'oi hausa da larabci ta d'auka ta soma dubawa. 

   A parlon ta yini ranar gaba d'aya bata koma d'akin ba, tana son taje ta duba rahama da kwana biyu bata shigo mata ba, tun ranar data zo take ce mata bata jin dad'in jikinta bata sake zuwa ba, to amma kuma ai bata tambayi farouk ba balle.

     
         ***********


 Da sannu rayuwarsu taci gaba da tafiya cikin Sabon sauyin da suka samu, farouk yana samun rufin asiri sosai, sai dai yadda yake rayuwarshi da haka yanzun ma yaci gaba dayi babu abinda ya sauya, munafukan y'an gidan su har sun fahimci ya samu sauyin aiki, musamman ranar da suka ganshi ya futo cikin sabuwar shadda d'aya daga wad'an da ya kai d'inki, yana ta baza k'amshin sassanyan turaren shi, tun irin wanda yake amfani dashi a gida, yanzun ma ya nemo ya siya.

    Ita kanta daya dawo sai da ta sake kallon shigar dake jikin shi, yayi kyau sosai haka shaddar da d'inkin duka sun karb'e shi, bata dai ce mishi komai ba ta shige d'akin ta ta bashi guri.


     Ledar daya shigo da ita ya ajiye ya d'auko tata ledar d'inkin daya amso tun kusan sati biyu da suka gabata, yasan bata gani ba tunda yasan bata shiga hurumin da a nata ba.

   Yana son ya kyautata mata, yana son ya siya mata wani abu itama, to amma yasan ba shi da kud'in da zai iya yi mata gwaninta, ya k'iyasta yadda zai siya mata koda irin turaren da take amfani dashi a gida ma, amma ina abin bame sauk'i bane, sai ya siyo mata wani daya gani a kasuwa shima mai dad'in k'amshi ne, yasan watakila zata ji dad'in shi.

   Turaren yasa mata cikin ledar kayan d'inkin da y'an kud'i ko zata buk'aci wani abun, don yasan ba zata tab'a tambayar shi ba a halin yanzu.

   Kud'in dai ba yawa dubu biyu ne, (niko nace ina laifi)

   Sai daya soma neman izinin ta ta hanyar yi mata sallama a bakin k'ofa, zaune ta mik'e tana amsa sallamar tashi, sai ya d'aga labulen ya shiga a gefen katifa ya ajiye mata ledar kayan, baice mata komai ba itama ba tace ba amma a zuciyar ta Allah Allah take ya futa ta duba ta ga abinda ya kawo mata.
    Har ya juya zai futa sai idon shi ya sauka akan littattafan shi da yake siyowa da d'aya da d'aya, kuma dama shi ya siyo sune saboda ita, sai yayi murmushi kawai ya fuce daga d'akin.


 Ledar ta d'auko ta soma kiciniyar bud'ewa, atamfofi ne ta gani guda biyu duk a d'inke riga da zani zani da d'an kwali, sai man shafawa Stella, da kayan ciki innerwears, ita kunya ma taji da taga kayan, to shi da baisan magwajin taba taya yayi duk haka.

   Sai taji tana son ta gwada kayan taga ko zasuyi mata dai dai, hadda rufe k'ofa saboda kada taje ya shigo babu zato.
   Abinda bata sani ba shi bama ya gidan, ya tafi ganin kayan lefen salman da aka gama had'awa.

   Komai yayi mata cif cif, musamman d'inkin rigunan sun zauna a jikinta.
     Koda yake wannan batayi mamaki ba kamar yadda ya iya canko no pant da bra🙈 d'inta a dai dai.

    A hankali ta soma cire kayan, ta kammale su a ledar da suke, sai lokacin taga turare da kud'i.

    Sai ta sake zama dirshan tana k'iyasta yadda ya kasance mai son kyautata mata a koda yaushe, to yanzu su da ba y'an gari ba, ina ya samu ma kud'in daya siya mata duk wannan? Toh ai ba wannan ba tun daga abincin da suke ci kullum ya kama ta ta soma nazari
   _(kunji fa sai yau hankalin arfah ya kai inda muke tunani)_

    Sai taji jikinta yayi sanyi ta koma gefe tayi jigum tana wasu sababbin tunane tunanen a ranta, k'arshe sai ta rasa makama akan kowane tunani da zatayi, tunda tasan shi ba mutumin banza bane. 

   A gidan su salman kuwa, kaya sunyi kyau masha Allah akwai uku da kid, bai takura kanshi ba komai yayi shi dai dai k'arfin shi. Farouk yana zaune a rumfar gwaggwo an jere mishi akwatunan a gaban shi.
    Daga haka yaga komai batare daya bud'a ba don shi ba iya ganin lefe ma yayi ba, ko na k'anwar shi khadija a haka ya gansu.

   Gwaggwo ce ta shigo d'akin a lokacin da yake k'ok'arin mik'ewa, sai ta tsaya tana fad'in, "a'a farouku to ai baka bud'e ba?".

  Murmushi yayi yace, "a haka ma na gani gwagwwo Allah ya sanya alkhairy yasa abokiyar arzik'in shi ce".

   "To ai shikenan" gwaggwo ta fad'a tana k'ok'arin maida akwatunan inda suke shi kuma yayo waje yana kiran salman.

    "Ba dai har ka gani ba?"
    Salman d'in ya fad'a yana kallon farouk da mamaki.

  Kafun yayi magana gwaggwo ta futo tana fad'in, "ya dai kalli akwatuna".

Murmushi yayi yana sake sadda kanshi k'asa yace, "a hakan ma na gani Allah ya sanya alkhairy". 

 K'anwar su salman ce ta futo da atamfa a hannun ta tace, "ga atamfar ankon da muka futar ko zaka yiwa matarka kaima".

   Daga hannun ta ya kalli atamfar, ta kuma yi mishi kyau kalar ta fara ce sai zanen manyan ganye green colour shima.

    "nawa ne kud'in?" ya tambaya.

   "dubu uku da d'ari biyar ne". Ta fad'a mishi.

  Salman ya kalla yace, "kuma bikin zai kai yaushe?".

     Kallon gwaggwo salman d'in yayi, sai tace, "ehh to mu da sati hud'u mu keso asa in an kai kayan, to amma kasan ba lallai asa shi hakan ba".

    "in dai zai kai sati hud'un har na samu kud'in da zan siya mata insha Allah".

   Murmushin jin dad'i yarinyar tayi don sukam suna so suga matar shinnan, ko itama tana da kirki kamar shi?.

   Y'an kud'i ya ajiyewa gwaggwo yace, "ga wannan ba yawa gwaggwo". 

    "kai dai baka gajiya farouk, gashi yau ba muyi gyad'a ba balle akaiwa y'ar tawa, da har yanzu tak'i zuwa mun, ni na d'auka da tare ma zaku zo".

   "insha Allah zata zo miki gwaggwo, tunda ga bikin salman nan dole ai zata zo kodon shi".

     "Hakane toh Allah ya kawo ta da alkhairy".

   Daga haka sukayi sallama ya futo daga gidan shi da salman, suna tafe suna d'an hirrarrakin su akan abinda ya danganci sha'anin bikin, abunda yake na shawara yakan baiwa salman d'in duk dashi bikin shi ba irin na kowa bane, anyi shi bagatatan ba wani shiri balle yasan yadda abun yake.

  A kan layi sukayi sallama kowa yayi nashi guri.

    Yauma ya cinye lokacin shi a waje duka, hakan yasa ya tafi musu da abinda zasuci ba sai yayi girki ba.

    Wajen k'arfe goma ya shiga gidan tuni tayi bacci sai hasken fitilarta don har yanzu bata kwana a duhu.

    Shima daya samu yayi wanka baibi takan abinci ba ya kwanta sai bacci.

        ************

Da asubancin ranar bayan ya dawo masjid ta futo daga d'akin ta sanye da zunbulelen hijab d'in ta, a jikin k'ofar d'akin ta tsaya tana tunanin ta inda zata soma tambayar shi.

  Kallo d'aya yayi mata ya d'auke kanshi yaci gaba da muraji'ar karatun shi.

Bata da zab'in daya huce ta koma gefe ta zauna har zuwa lokacin da zai gama.

    Ta jima zaune shiru tana sauraron sautin daddad'ar muryarshi da yanda yake fidda kowane harafi cikin kwarewa.

    Sosai ya lula da ita duniyar shaukin sauraron muryarshi.

    Duka muraji'ar ta minti 30 yayi ya d'ora da azkhar d'in sabah. Mik'ewa yake son  yi don ya d'ora musu abin karin kumallo, sai dai ya fahimci kamar akwai magana a bakin ta.

   Sai ya d'an saurara yaji ko zatace wani abu, sai dai har suka shafe adadin wasu mintuna bata bud'e bakin ta don tace dashi wani abu ba.

     Ganin haka sai shi ya gyara zaman shi ya fuskance ta yace, "barka da safiya hajiya fatima, ina fatan babu wata matsalar dai ko?".

    Sai ta girgiza kanta ta kuma yi shiru kamar ba zata ce wani abu ba kafun da kyar ta iya bud'e bakin ta tace, "dama.... Daman... Daman ina son zanje naga rahama, kwana biyu bata zo mun ba".

    A ranta ba abinda taso tambaya ba kenan, to amma abinda zata tambaya d'in haka kawai sai taji yayi mata nauyi, shine a k'arshe ta b'uge da tambayar zuwa gurin rahama, daman tana so ta tambaye shi.

   Shima ta b'angaren shi shiru yayi yana sake mamakin al'amuranta cikin zuciyar shi, kenan tunda yayi mata maganar nan bata sake futa ba? Yayi mamaki gaskiya, ashe tana da sauk'in kai haka? Kuma zata tsoraci Allah ta kiyaye dokokin shi? Sai yaji k'arfin gwiwar ya sanya ta a islamiyyah yasan zata amfana da abinda zata karanta sosai.

   Sai ya mik'e tsaye a lokacin da zai shige kitchen d'in yace, "zaki iya zuwa".

    Wani sanyi ne taji ya kwaranya a ruhinta, da farko da taji yayi shiru ta d'auka bazai barta bane, har ta soma wani tunanin daban sai kuma taji ya amince.

    Sai ta mik'e a nutse ta shige d'akin ta ba tare data sake cewa komai ba.

    Allah Allah ta dinga yi ya futa taci abinci tayi wanka ta gama y'an aikace aikacenta ta lek'a rahamar, fatan ta d'aya Allah yasa dai ba jikin bane. 

   Sai da rana tayi  sosai farouk ya futa ita kuma ta futo tayi abinda zatayi. 

    Zuwa lokacin da hantsi ya d'aga ta gama shirin ta tsab cikin d'aya daga uku ukun kayan ta, ta shafe jikinta da mai sai kyalli fatar ta take, d'an kishin gid'a tayi da nufin ta d'an huta saboda wani bacci bacci da yake fisgarta, aikuwa sai gashi bacci yayi awon gaba da ita. 

Ba ita ta farka ba saida aka kwala kiran sallar azahar da yake suna kusa da masallaci, duk lokacin da aka kira sallah kamar a cikin d'akinta haka zataji. 

  Bathroom ta fad'a ta d'auro alwala ta shimfid'a sallaya ta kabbara sallah. 

   Nan danan ta har had'a abinda ta iya ta duddungura, _(don wannan sallah ta arfah bata da maraba da adungure)_
   
    Bayan ta idar har ta yafa gyalen rigar sai ta tuna da fad'an da farouk yayi mata rannan akan k'aramin gyalen, sai ta zunbula k'aton hijab ta d'inta da tun tana jin nauyin shi har ta saba, wata rana har bacci take yi dashi a jikinta. 
     
Tana futowa tayi turus ganin farouk zaune a parlon, bai futa ba kenan? Ko kuma dawowa yayi, mtss! Taja dan k'aramin tsaki a ranta tana tunanin ko meye ma nata na damuwa da al'amuran da suka shafe shi, rayuwar shi ce fa kuma matsalar shi, to ita meye nata ma a ciki. 
    Sai tayi hucewarta ta barshi da bin bayan ta da kallo. 

   Lokacin data shiga d'akin rahama, tana kwance k'asan carpet tayi laga laga da ita, zama tayi a d'arare tana tambayar rahaman, "ba dai jikin bane?". 
   Da kyar ta iya bud'e bakin ta kasancewarta mace mai k'arfin hali tace, "wallahi ai da sauk'i ma". 

  Sai ta zaro ido tace, "yanzu auntie rahama a haka kina nufin da sauk'i?". 

Gyad'a mata kai tayi a lokacin da take shirin Mik'ewa zaune. 

   Cike da tausayawa arfah tazo ta taimaka mata tana ta fama jera mata sannu ta mik'e zaune. 
  Da ka kawai take iya amsawa sai uban yawu da ya taru bakin ta. 
   Duk jikin arfah a sanyaye yake, sun d'anyi shiru kafun arfahn ta tambaye ta, "kuma kinje asibiti? Me yasa basu baki gado ba?". 

   Murmushi tayi ta yunk'ura ta kewaya bayan vantillation d'in dake parlon ta zubar da yawun bakin ta ta dawo ta zauna. 

     "munje sunyi mun duk abinda ya dace, irin ciwon namu ne idan ka kasa jurewa to kullum zaka zama kana hanyar asibiti, har sai likitocin sun gaji da kai". 

    "Wane irin ciwo ne haka auntie rahama", arfah ta fad'a cike da tsoro, don ita har ga Allah tsoron ta d'aya kada ya zamana wani mugun ciwo ne ya kama rahaman. 

Murmushi rahama tayi ta d'auki dabino tasa a bakin ta don ta tsaida yawun dake yink'urin cika mata baki, arfah ta mik'awa ragowar dabinon tace, "bismillah dabino fatima". 

     Girgiza mata kai tayi, sai rahaman tace, "au bazaki ciba kenan? Ko kema bakya iya cin abunda masu laulayin ciki sukaci". 
   Sai tayi murmushi tana sake gyargyad'a mata kai, haka kawai taji gaban ta ya fad'i lokacin da rahama ta ambaci kalmar laulayin ciki, take ta tuna duk abinda ya faru da rayuwar ta ya faru ne sanadiyyar sharrin laulayin ciki da akayi mata. 

    Rahama ta lura da yanayin data shiga, sai ta bud'e baki da nufin tayi mata magana, aikuwa amai kamar jira yake yi ta bud'e baki yace salamu alaikum, nan fa ta shiga kyalaya shi don ta kasa ma yin kwakkwaran motsi bare ta taimaki kanta. Arfah da duk ta rud'e ta rik'e ta tana faman jera mata sannu, da kyar ta zage ta taimaki rahaman har ta samu aman ya lafa ta rakata toilet, tazo ta gyara gurin. 
   Inda Allah ya taimaki arfah tana gama goge carpet d'in wata y'ar uwarta tazo, ita ta k'arasa aikin. 

  Ranar arfah koda ta koma d'akin su jikinta duk a sanyaye, data motsa sai ta tuna da rahama da yadda take shan wuya, sosae take tausayin rahamar har zuciyar ta. 

Lallai zama uwa ba abune mai sauk'i ba.

Page 33 _(thirty three)_



  Ranar yini tayi da tunanin rahama a ranta, abinda kuma yafi tsaya mata a rai shine aman data ga tana kwararawa ba alamun sauk'i bare sassauci, sannan ga abubuwa iri iri na halin masu laulayi masu ban tausayi, ranar hatta farouk sai daya fahimci akwai sauyi tattare da yanayin ta.


       *************


Rayuwa taci gaba da cud'a musu, yayinda sauye sauye suka dinga wanzuwa a zaman nasu ba tare dasu kansu sun sani ba.
    Arfah kullum sai ta tambayi farouk taje duba jikin rahama, duk da in taje ba wani abun take iya tsinana mata ba amma takan zauna tare da ita na tsawon wani lokaci, sosai take jin jiki har y'an gidan su suna tunanin su tafi da ita gida tayi jinyar a can, mijin ta yace shi sam bai yadda ba, dalilin hakan yasa aka bata aron k'anwar ta budurwa ta zauna mata har zuwa lokacin da zataji sauk'i. 

   K'anwar tata tana da kirki itama kamar na rahamar, wani lokacin idan jikin rahaman da sauk'i takan zauna suyi hirar su data shafe su ta y'an uwan taka, ita dai arfah bata iya tsoma musu baki sai dai tayi shiru tana jin tausayin kanta data rayu kwallin kwal ba yaya ba k'anwa, sai yaya fahad, shi kuma namiji ne bako wace hira zata iya yi dashi ba, musamman yanzu ta sake wannan karatun.

  Kuma dama ita har yanzu ba wata hira take iya yi mai tsayi da rahama ba, mafi yawan lokuta takan zo har ta tafi ba suji kwakkwaran kalma daga bakin ta ba haka bata cin komai da zasuyi, su suna ganin kamar fulako ne, ita kuma tun asalinta dama ba ko ina take iya cin abinci ba, sannan har yanzu akwai cimar da bata tab'a ci ba, a irin zuwan da takeyi ne wata rana rahama taga kanta a tsefe, aikuwa tasa k'anwar ta tayi mata kitso suna ta santin gashin nata, don mai kitson har zolayarta ta dinga yi, wai zai kitsu kuwa? Ta ganshi irin na larabawa da Indian, ko itama Indian ce? Ita dai kawai murmushi tayi. 
 Kalba akayi mata madaidaita aka tufke mata shi a k'eya. Sai taji dad'i sosai ta har had'a ya nata ya nata tayi part d'inta dama yamma tayi. 


   A gefe d'aya kuma business d'in farouk yana ci gaba da gyarawa cikin amincewar ubangiji, sosai farouk yake sake samun gogewa ta mu'amula da mutane daban daban a kasuwa, ya fahimci abubuwa da yawa tattare da abokin kasuwancin shi na daga kyashi da hassada, musamman idan alhaji asheer yazo yana dama dama da farouk d'in, su a ganinsu sun sha gaban kowa a kusanci da alhaji asheer, ko alkhairy zai yi takan su zai soma kuma nasu yana fin na kowa duba da irin k'ok'arin da suke mishi, kuma suna da gaskiya da rik'on amana, sai gashi farouk yazo rana d'aya yana neman ya doke su ta kowane fanni, kama daga lokacin da yazo zuwa yanzu komai alhaji asheer zaiyi musu kai d'aya da farouk yake musu, har ma a wasu lokutan yakan k'arawa farouk da wani kason wai ya kaiwa matar shi.

   Wannan dalilin shine ummul'aba'isin daya haddasa tsana da k'iyayyah mai tsanani tsakanin su da farouk, har ta kai yanzu in yazo shago abokin kasuwancin shi baya iya amsa sallamar shi, haka idan aka kawo sababbin kaya suka tafi babban shagon da duk yake babban reshen nasu shagunan, ko magana ya yiwa y'an shagon su abokin kasuwancin nashi su basa amsa shi, sai ragowar da Allah bai basu mugun hali irin na hassada da kyashi ba, _kunsan Allah ya rarraba mana halaye, wani mai nisan hankali wani kuma daman yana shuka rayuwarshi ne bisa doron son zuciyar shi, Allah ka ganar damu gaskiya_

Gashi wani abu sai Allah ya saka mishi nasibi, sai ya zamana kayan shagon su suna riga duk na sauran shagunan tafiya, wannan dalilin yasa alhaji asheer sake janshi a jikin shi.

    Wani makircin da nura ya soma gwadawa, bayan sun tashi daga shago da yamma sai bai tafi gida ba, da yake alhaji asheer yana gari sai ya nufi gidan shi kai tsaye.

A sitting room bayan sun gama gaisawa da alhajin sai ya soma kawo sukar da yazo da ita cikin kwarewa da makirci.
    Akan wai farouk kullum baya zuwa shago da wuri, da yana tunanin yadda zai fad'awa alhajin sai dai yana tsoron kada alhajin yaji haushin farouk d'in har ya d'au wani mataki da bazai yiwa farouk d'in dad'i ba, shiyasa ya sameshi ya soma yi mishi magana a karo na ba adadi Amman bai sauya ba to shine yaga ya kamata alhaji asheer d'in ya sani, saboda illar da abinda yake yi zai haifar a nan gaba idan ya tafi nasu shagon, costomers duk zasu daina zuwa tunda baya futowa akan lokaci, kaga kenan ya kore su a tak'aice.

Tunda ya soma wannan maganar alhaji asheer yayi shiru baice mishi komai ba, yanayin yadda yayi maganar yasa alhaji asheer ya yadda da abinda ya fad'a tabbas kuma bai d'auka na makirci bane, sai dai a ranshi uzurin da yayi mishi, watakila wajen wahalar neman abun hawa ne yake yin late d'in, wannan kuma laifin shine amma yanzu nura yayi mishi tuni a kai. 

   Sai yayiwa nuran godiya ya kuma bashi tabbacin zai yiwa tufkar hanci, daga k'arshe ya kawo ihsani mai yawa ya baiwa nuran kamar yadda ya saba.

   Koda nuran ya futo sosai ya dinga farin ciki ganin makircin shi yayi tasiri a gurin alhajin.
   Abinda yasa ya k'ulla sharrin late kuwa saboda yasan yadda muhimmancin zuwa shago da wuri yake, musamman a gurin alhaji asheer, akwai wani yaron shi kwanaki saboda zuwa a makare da wasa da aiki ya kore shi. 

    Bayan kwana biyu dayin maganar nura da alhaji asheer sai gashi yazo shagon da rana bayan sun idar da sallar azahar.
    Bayan sun gaishe shi cikin mutunta juna sai ya nemi farouk da yazo zaiyi mishi wata rakiya.

    Sosai nura ya fad'ad'a fara'ar fuskar shi a tunanin shi daga haka shikenan kuma farouk an tafi, shi kuma in yaso sai alhaji ya bar mishi shagon shi kad'ai yaci gaba da juya shi, kunga kenan ya sami ci gaban da yafi wanda yake ciki yanzu. 

Baya yiwa farouk magana amma da zai tafi yau sai gashi hadda su yi mishi a dawo lafiya😁

    A motar alhaji asheer kuwa suna tafe a hanya yake tambayar shi ko me yasa baya zuwa shago da wuri?

   Sosai yaji tambayar tazo mishi a bazata saboda kullum kafun takwas yake zuwa hasalima shi yake bud'e shagon.
   Amma duk da haka sai baice komai ba a tunanin shi ko yana nufin ya dinga sammakon futa fiye da yanda yake yi ne yanzu, saboda haka sai ya bada hak'uri yace kuma insha Allah zai dinga futowa da wuri.

  Wannan magana sai ta sake yiwa alhaji asheer dad'i har yaji yaron ya sake kwanciya a ranshi, ga nutsuwar shi da hankali da a kullum suke k'ara saka shi jin zuciyar shi ta sake aminta da farouk d'in.

Kai tsaye y'an mashina sukaje, ya kira wani mutum a waya, ba jimawa kuwa sai gashi yazo cikin girmamawa ya gaishe da alhaji.

Tare suka shiga gurin farouk yana biye dasu a baya cikin ladab.
    Alhaji asheer ne ya dubi farouk yace, "ka zab'ar mun guda d'aya a ciki mai kyau".
Duddubasu ya shiga yi d'aya bayan d'aya kafun ya zab'o Lifan companion mai kyau yace, "alhaji ina ga wannan ai yayi kyau ko?".

    Futo da mashin d'in akayi suka koma gefe suka d'anyi magana shi da mutumin sannan yazo ya mik'awa farouk mukullin mashin d'in yace, "na kane saboda ka dinga zuwa aiki akan lokaci ba tare da ka samu delay wajen neman abin hawa ba da safe".

   Satoto yayi yana kallon alhaji asheer cike da mamaki, ko a ranshi bai kawo shi zai siyawa wannan mashin d'in ba sabo dal haka.

  Sai ya durk'usa a gaban alhajin ya bud'e baki da nufin yayi mishi godiya amma sai ya kasa, saboda kukan daya taho mishi.

   Kama shi yayi ya mik'ar dashi yana fad'in, "haba farouku meye abun kukan kuma? Duk ragowar abokan aikin ka nina siya musu, kaine kad'ai na sha'afa har ka kai wannan lokacin baka da abin hawa, don Allah ka daina yin kukan nan ni jinka nake kamar d'an uwana na jini"

    Sosai farouk ya dinga kukan da bai san a muhallin daya kamata ya ajiye shiba, farin ciki ko bak'in cikin duk wannan ci gaban yana zuwa mishi ne a lokacin da ummien shi tayi nesa dashi.

   Da kyar ya tsaida hawayen shi ya shiga kwararo godiya da addu'a, har saida alhaji asheer d'in ya dakatar da shi da fad'in, "ya isa haka don Allah, godiyar ta isa, ina ganin tare zamu koma can kasuwa ka barshi gurin i'smail saboda xa'ayi maka sabis d'in shi da kyau, in yaso in kun tashi da yamma sai ka biyo ka d'auka".

   Bakin shi kasa hak'uri yayi a lokacin da alhaji asheer ya gama bayani, yaci gaba da binshi da addu'oin fatan alkairi, har sai da yaga yayi gaba sannan yabi bayan shi a hankali.

     Abin ba k'aramin al'ajabi yaba nura ba, da yaga sun dawo tare kuma cikin farin ciki farouk d'in ya shigo shago, sai ya dinga binshi da harara da kallon banza a kaikaice.
  _(dama ita hassada haka take, daga lokacin daka soma yiwa mutum hassada daga lokacin zai soma yin gaba kuma bazai tab'a dawowa baya ba har abada, kafun ka Ankara sai kaga yayi maka nisan da baka isa ka kamo shi ba, kunga dai abinda nura yayi, amma a k'arshe sai ya zama kamar wata tunatarwa yayi ga alhaji asheer. Allah ka gyara mana zuciyoyin mu ka raba mu da tsatsar zuciya)_

Ranar kamar yadda suka yi da alhaji asheer yana tashi daga aiki ya biya ya taho da Lifan d'in shi sabo dal.

      Cikin nutsuwa da kwanciyar hankali da kuma zallar farin ciki ya nufo gidan, lokacin da ya shigo sakatoto mutanen gidan sukayi suna kallon shi cike da mamaki, ko bi ta kansu baiyi ba ya haura dashi barendar d'akin su ya ajiye.

Lokacin daya ajiye mashin d'in arfah tana tsaye jikin window kamar kullum, itama da mak'urar mamaki take kallon shi ta glass d'in windown, har sai da ya shigo d'akin sannan ta juyo tana kallon shi, shima kallonta yake ido cikin ido yana so yaga reaction d'in ta.

   Sun kalli junan su 4 some seconds kowa da sak'on daya ke isarwa ga d'an uwan shi, kafun arfah ta d'auke idonta zuwa ga kallon mutanen dake sabgogin su a tsakar gidan ta cikin window.

    Shima huce ta yayi ya ajiye ledar da take hannun shi, yana sake jinjina mata a ranshi, Lallai tana da k'arfin hali, bai tab'a tunanin yadda taga mashin d'in nan ba zata tambaye shi ba'asin komai ba, sai gashi ta fuske abun ta, murmushi yayi a zahiri yana tunanin duk zai fanshe wannan halin ko in kulan da take nuna mishi, ba dai duk akan rashin soyayyah bane? To shi kuma yayi mata alk'awarin sai yasa taji irin abinda yake ji a kanta, yaga idan zata iya sharewa.

    Ita ko dama jiran dawowar shi take, tuntuni take son taje taga jikin rahama, to kuma bata tambaye shi ba lokacin da zai futa.

  Sai ta juyo ta kalle shi a sanyaye kafun ta bud'e bakin ta cikin salon maganar ta da a yanzun take sake dilmiya farouk cikin yanayin sake k'aunar ta da begen ta tace, "ina son zanje gurin rahama".

   Sai daya lumshe madaidaitan kwayar idonun shi sannan ya bud'e bakin shi cikin mutuwar jiki yace, "wai me kike zuwa yi d'akin rahamar nan ne?".

    Sai tayi shiru ta maida kanta k'asa ba tare da tace dashi komai ba.

   Kyale ta yayi yayi shigewar shi kitchen yabi ta vantillation zuwa toilet don ya d'auro alwala, ko da ya futo tana nan inda ya barta tsaye, shi kuma ya fuce zuwa masallaci.

   Lokacin daya dawo tabar gurin, sai ya zauna saman daddumar shi ya tsiyaya tea ya soma sha a hankali, sai dai baifi kurb'a biyu yayi ba ta sake futowa sanye da k'aton hijab, zama tayi daga can nesa dashi tace, "zan iya tafiya".

   Banza yayi da ita na adadin wasu mintuna kafun ya yi mata magana, "na tambaye ki me zaki je yi mata baki ban amsa ba".

   Shanye b'acin ranta tayi ta sake yin k'asa da muryarta sosai tace, "bata da lafiya ne".

  Sai yanzu ya kalle ta, itama shi take kallo cike da b'acin rai tana jiran taji abinda zai ce.

    "kusan satin ki hud'u kina zarya a d'akin ta, kenan duk a sati hud'un bata da lafiya?".
   Idonta ne ya ciko da hawaye, a ganin ta saboda rashin mutumci ya keyi mata haka, wato don yaji ance in ta futa bada izinin shi ba zata shiga wuta shine zaiyi mata haka...... 
    Sai ta soma yin kuka still kuma idonta a kanshi, ko k'iftawa bata iya yi, wani irin kuka takeyi mara amo bare sauti, shi ma kallonta yake da mamakin yadda hawaye yake shatata kamar an kunna famfo, ba tare da bakin ta ya motsa ko yanayin fuskar ta ya sauya ba.

    A hankali ta mik'e ta shige d'akin ta ba tare da ta ce dashi uffan ba, kwanciya tayi rub da ciki kan katifar ta fashe da wani irin kuka mai cin rai.

    "sauyawa yake, a kullum sauyawa yake, baya fahimta, baud'ad'd'en mutum ne bashi da dad'in zama, ammie kin cuceni, kin gama da rayuwata.......... "
    Duk cikin harshen larabci take wannan maganar kamar tab'ab'b'iya tana kaiwa katikar da take kai duka da duka hannuwanta biyu.

   Farouk da yake tsaye daga jikin k'ofa hard'e da hannuwan shi a k'irji yana kallonta, k'arasa shiga yayi ya zauna gefen katifa yana kallon yadda take wurgi da pillow da duk wani abu da yake kan katifar.
    Sai kuma ta sake kifa kanta kan katifar tana sake fashewa da wani sabon kukan.

   Kallon ta yake cike da tausayawa rayuwar ta data ginu a kwaikwayon rayuwar nasara da basu san Allah ba, exactly yadda tayi haka ya gani a wani American firm da dad'ewa, inda yarinyar ta dinga b'ari da kayan da suke jere a dressing morrow nata k'arshe sai gashi tana ta futo da kayan ta na sawa tana sake wurgi dashi, duk da sunan b'acin rai. Toh sai gashi yau yaga y'ar musulmi da take da irin wannan dabi'a
    
    Jelar kalbar kanta da akayi mata yabi da kallo data sauka har gadon bayan ta, kasancewar da hijab d'in da d'ankwalin tuni sunyi nasu guri. Gashin kanta ma'abocin santsi da d'aukar hankali ya soma kashe mishi ido.

    D'auke kanshi yayi daga kallon zubin halittar gashin ta, ya furzar da iska mai huci daga bakin shi, sannan ya sake dawo da duban shi kanta ya soma fad'in, "hak'ik'a iyaye suna da matuk'ar tasiri a rayuwar y'ay'an su, idan muka d'auki uba, uba yana da y'ancin da zai yanke duk hukuncin da ya ga ya dace da y'ar shi ko d'an shi, kuma duk d'a na gari zai kasance mai yin biyayya ga wannan umarni yana so, ko baya so muddin yana so ya gama da duniya lafiya. Toh idan muka dawo b'angaren uwa kuwa, Allah (S. W. T) ya fifitata sama da uba, domin saida yace abi uwa sau uku, kafun yace abi uba sau d'aya, sannan aka sa aljannar y'ay'a ta kasance a k'ark'ashin k'afar uwa, duk wanda yake sab'awa mahaifiyarshi to ki sani makomarshi wuta, idan kinga aljannar mace tabar k'ark'ashin k'afar mahaifiyar ta to ki k'addara tayi aurene, shine a sannan zata dawo k'asan k'afar mijin data aura, shi kuwa namiji aljannar shi ba zata tab'a gusawa daga k'afar mahaifiyarshi har sai ya bar duniya".
  
   Shiru yayi yana sake jin wani abu a k'asan zuciyar shi, maganar da yayi a kan uwa yanzu ta tab'a zuciyar shi sosai, kuma take ya tuna da tashi mahaifiyar da a kullum yake kwana da ita yake tashi da ita. 
    Sai yaja dogon numfashi yaci gaba da fad'in, "bansan abinda ya had'a ki da mahaifiyarki ba, bansan girman laifin ki a gurin taba, hakazalika bansan itama dalilin daya sa ta yanke miki irin hukuncin nan mai tsauri ba har ya shafe ni. Abinda na sani kawai koma meye bai kamata ki dinga jifan ta da irin wad'annan munanan kalaman masu tsauri ba, amma fa a matsayin ta na uwar da tayi silar zuwan ki duniya kyauta daba abinda zakiyi ki biyata anan duniya, sai dai addu'a kawai to kinga ashe kuskure kike tafkawa mai girma mai fad'i, kin ganni nan duk abinda ya faru dake nima ya faru dani, sai dai ko da wasa ban tab'a jin haushin abinda su kayi mun ba, hasalima a koda yaushe ina binsu ne da Kyakykyawar addu'a da fatan alkhairy a duk inda suke, saboda girman darajar su a idona. Yanzu a k'arshe kaddara ta riga ta had'a auren mu ba tare damu kanmu munsan abinda yake b'oye a bayan auren ba. Ina mai farin cikin fad'a miki ki rungumi kaddarar ki da hannu bibbiyu, ki ajiye duk wani daci da bak'in ciki da kike ji game da iyayen ki , mu fuskanci abinda yake gaban mu ni dake, mu samowa kan mu maslahar, muyi tunani da kwakwalwarmu mu gano shin menene alak'ar da take tsakanin iyayenmu? Me yasa k'awar ki tayi mana sharri ni dake? A ganina wannan shine abinda ya kamata mu maida hankalin mu akai ba shiga damuwar wasu ko maida ita tamu ba.






   _na fad'a wani uzuri dazu gashi ban yi muku edit ba sai yanzu Allah ya bani iko cika wannan aekie_
