_In dedication to my lovely ones_🥰




Page 52 _(fifty two)_



Shubaila tana zaune kusa da autynta a parlon auntyn, tayi kwalliyarta mai kyau cikin atamfar ta super data samu d'inkin daya dace da ita, ta d'an rame kad'an watakila saboda azumi 30 na ramadhan da aka gama jiya. Kallo d'aya zakayi mata kasan cewa tana cikin matuk'ar damuwa fuskar ta ba walwala ko kad'an.
  
    Auntyn ta (matar abbanta) da take zaune daura da ita ce, cikin nuna kulawa da soyayyah irin ta uwa da d'a ta dube ta sosai cikin kwantar da murya tace, "kina jina shubaila, ni bawai ina nufin miki ki rabu da farouk lokaci d'aya bane, abinda nake so dake shine kiyi tunani mai kyau da kwakwalwar ki, daga lokacin da akayi maganar auren ku dashi zuwa yau wace kalar kulawa kika ga yana baki, wane muhimmancin kika samu a cikin rayuwar shi? Shin da gaske yana sonki kamar yadda kike son shi? Ko kuwa ya karb'e kine saboda girman mahaifinki a idon shi? Wallahi shubaila jinki nake tamkar y'ar dana durk'usa na haifa a cikina, da zaifi a rayuwa ki auri wanda yake sonki fiye da wanda ke kike son shi, a ganina zaifi kulawa dake, idan kika duba yaron nan mubarak yana da nutsuwa, hankali kuma yana da rufin asirin shi, mijine irin wanda y'an matan yanzu suke mafarkin samu, don wallahi wata yarinyar ta aure shi kwanbo zakiga tanayi ita ta auri mai kud'i, ga gida ga mota mai tsada, sannan bashi da wata matar sai Yadda kika so zakiyi da abinki, shi kuwa farouk fa, yana da matar shi da yake so wadda har ke yake jaddadawa yana sonta, haba shubaila kiyi tunanin goben ki mana, da rayuwar da zakiyi k'undinbala ki runtuma ciki". 

     Tunda auntyn ta soma magana shubaila tayi shiru tana sauraronta, duk abinda ta fad'a gaskiya ne babu son zuciya ko d'aya a ciki, sai dai ita fa Allah ya sani tana son farouk bata damu da duk wani abu da zaiyi mata ba muddin zai rik'e ta a gidan shi ba wulak'anci da tozarci, matar shi kuma ba ruwanta da soyayyar da yake yi mata, don a ranta tayi imanin duk ranar data shiga gidan shi zata koya mishi soyayyar ta saboda mai yiwuwa waccen matar tashi bagidajiya ce mara wayewa, ita kuma alhamdulillah da wayewar ta, haka ta iya zamananci soo ita bata da matsala da duk wannan wuyarta dai ayi auren.

  Nannauyar ajiyar zuciya ta sauke sannan ta d'ago ta dubi auntyn nata da murmushi a saman fuskar ta, "ba damuwa aunty insha Allah zanyi tunani akai".
    Itama murmushin tausayin d'iyar tata tayi tace, yauwa Allah ya zab'a miki abinda yafi alkhairy a rayuwarki"
   Cikin jin dad'i ta amsa addu'ar auntyn a zuciyar ta, mik'ewa auntyn tayi zata duba abbansu da yake bacci ita kuma ta kwanta saman 3 seeter.
    Bata jima da kwanciyar ba wayar ta ta d'auki ring, kamar a mafarki taga sunan my future husby na yawo a screen d'in wayarta, da hanzari ta d'auki wayar ta kara a kunnen ta, cikin zak'uwa da son jin muryarshi.
   "ina kofar gidanku!" ya fad'a a tak'aice.
   Da sauri ta futa daga parlon zuwa bedroom d'inta, sai data duba fuskar ta a mirrow ta gyara abinda ya lalace a kwalliyarta sannan ta yafa wadataccen gyalenta ta futo.
    Kasa d'auke idonta tayi a kanshi lokacin data futo daga cikin gidan su, yayi mata kyau sosai cikin shigar shaddar shi, salman ne ya katse kallon k'urillar da take yiwa abokin shi da bai san ma tazo ba yana can yana chat da matar shi da basa gajiya da juna ta hanyar yin Gyaran murya da fad'in, "a'a amarya barkanki da futowa".
    Murmushin daya k'ara mata kyau da futo da nutsuwarta tayi, cikin salon maganar ta da muryar d'aukar hankali tace, "sannunka mijin auntie sarah fatan kayi sallah lafiya".

   "lafiya alhamdulillah ya mutanen gidan naku fatan dai suna lafiyar su".

   "Duk suna lafiya", 
Shiru ya sake biyo baya kafun shubaila ta katse shirun nasu da fad'in, 
"ku shigo daga sitting room mana duk da naga abokin naka kamar hankalin shi yana wani guri bai lura da futowa ta ba".
   Da sauri ya rubutawa arfah bye ya had'a da emoji na heart da d'aga hannu, ko jira ta gani bai yiba ya rufe datan ya k'araso inda take da takunshi na nutsuwa da nuna cikar kamala.
   "Afwan naga futowarki to na tsaya k'arasa wani d'an uzurine".

    "OK ba wani abu yanzu ka k'arasa ne?".

   "Eh ba damuwa"

Daga haka ta nufi cikin gidan su kuma suka mara mata baya

Bayan sun zauna a sitting room d'in gaisawa sukayi a nutse farouk yayi mata barka da sallah tare da fatan anyi sallah lafiya.
   Farin cikin da shubaila tayi a wannan lokaci bashi da iyaka, tayi murna taji dad'i da zuwan farouk d'in na musamman kuma takanas gurin ta don yayi mata barka da sallah.
     Bayan sun nutsu salman basu guri yayi don suji dad'in tattauna abinda ya shafe su.
    Gyara zama farouk yayi, sannan yayi gyaran murya ya soma magana cikin nutsuwa, "kamar yadda na sanar da alhaji tun lokacin da yayi mun maganar auren ki, haka yanzun kema zan sanar dake, ni dai kamar yadda kika sanni sunana farouk, kuma an haifeni a garin yola, na girma a garin kaduna tare da mahaifina, mahaifiyata da k'anne na mata guda biyar, iyayena har yanzu ban rufe shekara hud'u da rabuwa dasu ba, kuma a halin yanzu a wannan garin bani da kowa dana had'a wani abu dashi na dangantakar jini in kika d'auke matata, bance miki bazan koma ga family na ba, ko yanzu na gano inda suke zan koma garesu, sai dai auren ki kawun salman ne zai zo karb'a mun nan da 2 weeks, idan har kin amince dani a yadda nazo miki to ina maiyi miki maraba da samun farouk fiye da yanda kike zato".

   Kanta a k'asa yake shiru tana sauraron shi har ya gama, cikin yadda da duk abinda ya fad'a da kuma zallar soyayyar shi da k'aunar shi da suka cika zuciyarta ta amince dashi a yadda yake d'in, sai dai fa tace, "to amma Idan babu damuwa zan so nasan yadda ka rasa iyayen naka, b'ata sukayi ko kaine ka b'ata ka kasa tuna inda zaka same su?".
    Daman a shirye yake da wannan tambayar tata, don haka sai yace, "wannan wani abune sirrina daba wanda zan iya fad'awa amma fa kiyi hak'uri".

   Shiru ta sake yi kafun ta sake jefa mishi wata tambayar cikin d'ar d'ar, "har matarka ma bata san da hakan ba?"
     Wannan tambayar kam tazo mishi a bazata, shiyasa amsar daya bayar ma ta kasance ba shiryayya ba, "na fad'a miki nida matata abu d'aya ne, bi ma'ana nine ita itace ni, sannan babu wani sirrin rayuwata da bata sani ba a halin yanzu".
    Sam farouk bai san irin katobarar da yayi ba saida yaga baiwar Allah ta zuba mishi ido.
   Bai tunanin gyara zancen shiba, saboda abinda ya fad'a gaskiya ne, kuma akace magana zarar bunu.
  "Nima kenan zan samu matsayi irin nata bayan mun kasance k'ark'ashin inuwa guda?"
   Shubaila ta fad'a idonta a kanshi.
    Bai bata amsa ba sai tsare ta da ido da yayi har saida ta sake maimaita tambayar ta, murmushi yayi yace, "ina fatan haka hajara".
   Murmushi itama tayi amma fa a ranta matar nan tashi ta tsaya mata a karon farko, har taji ta zak'u data ganta taga abinda yasa mijinta baya iya b'oye soyayyar ta a gaban kowa.
   Basu sake d'aukar lokaci ba yayi mata sallama bayan ya ajiye mata barka da sallar ta, har bakin get ta rako shi inda salman ke zaune tana complain shida abokin shi ko ruwa basu sha ba, salman ne ya dinga dariya yana fad'in, "me kike ci na baka na zuba muda zamu zo wata rana har parlour mu bararraje abinci sai mun ture"
     D'an b'oye fuskar ta tayi da gefen gyalenta tana murmushi.
   Har zasu tafi suka lura da motar alhaji usman, sai suka tsaya don su gaisa dashi.

    Shubaila ce ta jagoranci sanar mishi da zuwan su, su kuma suka sake zaman jiran shi a sitting room, cikin kunya data fara shiga tsakanin farouk da tsohon ubangidan nashi suka gaisa sukayi mishi barka da sallah.


   Ko bayan sun futo daga gidan shi, gidan alhaji asheer sukaje shima suka gaishe shi, anan nema suka d'an d'auki lokaci har sukaci abinci sukayi sallah, don abincin da basu tsaya sunci bama had'a su zaiyi dashi.
  
Lokacin da suka dawo gidan gwaggwo anyi sallar isha'i tuni, sun tarar da gidan tsit duk su ameenatu sun gama dadalmayarsu sun tafi, haleematu dai bata samu damar zuwa ba, dama tunda su kaga la'asar tayi suka fudda ran zuwan ta.

 Da sallama suka shigo tsakar gidan salman a gaba farouk yana take mishi baya, gwaggwo tana zaune a tsakar gida da y'ar redion ta gefe tana sauraron labarai arfah kuma na gefenta rungume da ni'imatullah da tayi bacci a jikinta, sarah kuma ta tafi zubo musu abincin dare.

    A gefan tabarmar duk suka zauna da yake babbah ce, gwaggwo tun kafun suce komai ta soma fad'in, "ina nan ni kad'ai ina mita, kai farouku ka daka ta salman kuka shige cikin gari tun d'azu matar shi take hamma gata a gefena, itama y'ar albarka sai cewa nake ta kira shi tana cewa kuna hanya yanzu zaku zo, ai wallahi da jira nake in gama sauraron labaran nan in rakata gidan da kaina"

   Duk dariya sukayi har arfah da take gefenta kuwa, salman ne cikin dariya yace, "haba gwaggwo don rigima mata da mijinta kya rakata ku bar mijin?".
   Dak'uwa tayi mishi da hannu, "karb'i nan dan gidanku! Naga duk ba kaine kaja shi yawon barbad'a cikin gari ba".
    Wannan karon gimtse dariyar su duk sukayi, daga nan ba wanda ya sake cewa komai sai salman da yayi k'asa k'asa da murya yadda farouk ne kad'ai zaiji abinda zai fad'a, "gwaggwo tana zaton nina jaka yawo alhalin tafiyar taka ce gaba d'aya".
 
   Wannan karon saida hak'oran farouk suka bayyana waje.

    Daga nan sallama suka yiwa gwaggwo da sarah data zubo abincin dare har dasu, hak'uri dai suka bata saboda dare da yayi musu kuma a gida sunce suna da abincin su da sai su tafi da wannan.
   Da wannan hujjar suka gamsar da mutanen gidan duka suka d'auko hanyar su bayan gwaggwo ta had'a su da kayan gargajiya masu yawa.

    
 
     @@@@@@@@@@@



Washe garin ranar bayan ta gama duk abinda take yi na aikin gida, kwalliyarta tayi mai kyau cikin less mai kyau mai tsada, farouk ya tafi kasuwa tun safe dama hutun nashi na kwana d'aya ne kacal.
   Tana zaune a dak'in ta tana muraji'ar karatun ta na makaranta ta jiyo kamar hayaniya na tashi a tsakar gidan nasu, tasan dai bazai huce halin y'an gidan na akuyanci ba da basa gajiya.
   Sai bata saurari komai ba taci gaba da karatunta don inda sabo ta saba da halin su.
    Jin abin da tayi yak'i ci yak'i cinyewa sai tayi tunanin ta lek'a ta window.
   Gidan ya cika taf da mak'ota da masu rabon fad'a, saboda yawan mutane ma ba zata iya tantance da Wanda ake fad'an ba, zuge window tayi saboda jin hayaniyar data soma yi har tsakar kanta, tuncan Allah yayi ta mace mai son lumana, bata son hayaniya sam.
   Tana shirin tura k'ofa wata mata ta shigo da sallama hannun ta rik'e da y'ar k'aramar yarinya da ba zata huce 3 years a duniya ba.
   Saroro arfah ta tsaya tana kallon matar da fuska kadaran kadahan, k'arasa shigowa hajiya husna tayi cikin y'an seconds ta tafi nazarin ina tasan wannan yarinyar.
    "Lafiya kuwa?"
  Arfah ta fad'a ganin matar na shirin cuso kanta cikin dak'in ta kai tsaye bayan ita bata santa ba.

"Yi hak'uri baiwar Allah nasan baki sanni ba ko, gurin zainab nazo ta k'arasa yimun lalle na na jiya da ba'a gama ba abdussamad yazo d'auka na, to kuma saina tarar da gidan naku a hargitse, naga kece kad'ai bakya cikin rigimar tasu da alama kinsan abinda kike yi shiyasa nazo zan d'an huta na juya".

    Kad'an arfah ta d'an saki fuskar ta saboda harga Allah bata fiya son abinda zai had'a shirginta dana mutanen gidan ba.

   Gurin zama ta nuna mata, matar ta zauna hadda ajiye gelenta da alamu tana da saurin sabo.
   Complain ta dinga yiwa arfah na halin su zainab da basa iya zama haka kullum cikin bala'i da rashin zama lafiya.
   Ita dai arfah ido ta zuba tana sauraron ta iya kaci dai tayi murmushi, sannan haka kawai taji matar ta kwanta mata a rai, kwata kwata matar ba tayi kalar munafukai ko wani hali na daban ba, a'a ita kawai mutumce mai fad'ar duk abinda yake dai dai da wanda ba dai dai ba.
     Ita ma hajiya husna haka kawai take yiwa arfah kallon sani a wani guri duk da har yanzu ta kasa tuna inda ta santa, kuma sosai taji ta nutsu da ita shiyasa har ta dinga yi mata hira haka
  Data jima arfah har abinci ta kawo mata ita da y'ar k'aramar y'ar ta da take kira da sunan mammie.
    Tun suna jiyo hayaniyar y'an gidan har suka ji shiru k'urar ta lafa. Sallah hajiya husna tayi kusan tare da arfahn, daga nan kuma mijinta yazo tayi mata sallama da godiya tace kuma duk ranar da zata dawo zata shigo mata su gaisa.

   Har tsakar gidan arfah ta raka su haka siddan hadda yiwa y'ar ta kyautar chocolate mai dad'i.

Ita kuwa hajiya husna da tazo taga abinda yake faruwa a gidan da farko, sai taji gara kawai ta yanke alak'ar ta da wad'annan mutane masu hali irin akasin na mutane, to amma ganin wannan fatimar da tayi yanzu sai taji lallai tana son taci gaba da zuwa ko don ta tuno abinda take son tunowa.

        
              ************
  

Sati d'aya da sallah arfah ta gama had'a duk bayananta kuma ta gama jin duk abinda take so taji game da shubaila, ranar wata Litinin ana i gobe zata koma makarantar suta islamiyyah, da misalin k'arfe 3 na rana, shiryawa tayi cikin wasu arnan riga da sket na material mai tsada da suka tsaya a jikinta kamar an zana surarta ta ciki, akwai gyale mahad'in kayan da bata tab'a yafawa ba yau ta yafa ta saka takalminta hill da jaka mahad'in kayan. 
   Idan ka ganta zaka rantse ba tayi aure ba kamar irin matasan y'an matan nan masu ji da y'ammatanci. 
     D'aurin da tayi ya baiwa gashin gaban kanta da wanda tayi parking tsakiyar kanta damar futowa, yana ta shek'i da d'aukar ido. 
  
Tun kwana biyu kafun wannan ranar take istigfari da neman yafiyar ubangiji akan abinda zatayi d'in. 

   Yau kam duk matan gidan su binta sukayi da kallo cikin mamaki da al'ajabin shigar tata ta yau. 
   A tsaitsaye suka gaisa kamar koda yaushe in zata futa tayi sallama ta futo, yau kam tasha kallo don kafun ta k'arasa bakin titin anguwar su idanun mutane sunyi mata yawa, hakan yasa ta saka wani glass d'inta daya sake futo da k'urewar wankan nata. 
   Napep ta d'auka drop ta bashi Address na anguwar su shubaila, kuma har k'ofar gidan ya kaita kasancewar alhaji usman mahaifinta ba b'oyayye bane, mutum biyu suka tambaya aka basu tabbacin nan ne gidan. 
   Bata sallami mai napep d'in ba tace ya jirata tana futowa nan da 30 mint. 
    Da sallama ta shiga gidan bayan tayi addu'ar samun nasara a zuciyar ta

 _kunjifa mutuniyar 🤔 hadda addu'a akan gabatar da mugun k'uduri na lalata aure_😂
     
  Gyalenta ta mayar iya kafad'a d'aya ta dinga kwala sallama a harabar gidan nasu. Aunty ce ta bud'e k'ofar parlon ta futo da mamaki tana kallon bak'uwar balarabiyar da suka samu a gidan nasu. 
    Sun gaisa a tsaitsaye kuma auntyn ta karb'e ta faram faram har da yi mata iso parlon ta. 
     Bayan ta zauna gabatar mata da drinks tayi, wannan karramawar da mutuntawar da akayi mata sai da zuciyar ta tayi rawa, fargabar abinda zatayi ya shige ta har saida taji kamar ta juya ta hak'ura, sai kuma wata zuciyar tace da ita, to ke da ba cin mutuncin su kika zoyi ba kina k'ok'arin kare martabar auren kine, da wannan gurb'ataccen tunanin da kishi ya jagoranta taji ba gudu baja da baya. 
   "Amma fa ban gane bak'uwar daga ina take ba"
   Auntie ta fad'a tana kallon bak'uwar fuskar. 
   Fad'ad'a fuskar ta tayi kad'an tace, "eh nazo neman hajara shubaila ne" 

   "Allah sarki toh y'ar makarantar suce kenan? "
  Girgiza kai tayi tace, "a'a amma idan tazo ita zata sanni maybe" 
   
   Kamar auntie tace bata nan sai kuma taga bari dai ta kira shubailan k'arshen ta kamar yadda ta fad'a ita d'in ta santa. 
    Tana kwance tana bacci auntie ta taso ta, tace taje parlour tana da bak'uwa. 
   Ita ma dai da mamaki ta nufo hanyar parlon don ganin bak'uwar tata. 

   Saida gaban ta ya fad'i da taga fuskar wadda take zaune da sunan bak'uwarta, kamannin farouk tsantsa ta gani a fuskar ta. 
  Take tayi tunanin duk inda ta futo laa shakka jinin shice, k'arasa shiga parlon tayi ta zauna kujerar da take kusa da arfah har lokacin ta kasa d'auke idonta a kanta, kama ta gaske take gani irin ta farouk, in aka d'auke banbancin skin colour, ita ta kasance fara ce sol shi kuma bai k'arasa hasken taba, haka hancin su da shape na fuskar su duk iri d'aya. 

   D'ago kanta tayi daga kallon screen na wayar hannun ta data kasance ta farouk, da kyakykyawan murmushin ta cikin hoto ya cika screen d'in wayar gaba d'aya. 
(wayar ma fa sato ta tayi lolll!) 
    Glass d'in idonta ta zare don shubaila ta k'are mata kallo da kyau. 
   Wani irin juya ido tayi sannan cikin sassanyar muryarta mara amo tace, "sannunki y'an mata, daga ni dai babu tambaya kece hajara, ko ince shubaila, an haife ki a anguwar zoo road dake garin kano kuma kin taso anan, sannan kinyi makarantar islamiyyar ubaiyu bin ka'ab har zuwa matakin sauka, b'angaren boko kuma kinyi ilimin boko tun daga matakin secondary har zuwa collage of health science, kina da kwalin amma bakya aiki, and u ar also an artist kina harkar Zane Zane, kuma kina aikin had'a snacks tare da autien ki ko ince mamanki, a tak'aice dai kece wadda farouk zai aura right" 
   Shubaila Cikin dakiya da mamakin yadda ta santa ta wassafo ta tsaf tun daga farkon ta har kawo yau tace, "eh nice, amma wacece ke?" 
    Wani miskilin murmushi arfah tayi, daya kusan tafiya dasu saboda kyawunta daya futar muraran ta kalli auntie da itama ta tsura mata ido taji abinda zata ce tace  
   "ni dai sunana fatima jafar jauro baffi, kuma na zone takanas gurin ki shubaila don nayi miki fashin bak'i akan jafar ibraheem jauro baffi daya kasance miji ga arfah, idan kika ga arfah zakice farouk twin bro d'inta ne saboda tsananin kamar da sukeyi, hakan bawai don they are related by blood kad'ai ba, a'a sai don tsantsar soyayyar da suke yiwa juna, farouk ya yiwa arfah alkawarin ba zai tab'a son wata mace bayan ita ba, kamar yadda baiyi mata alkawarin bazai yi mata kishiya ba, waccen maganar ta  nuna mun bashi ne ya ganki da kanshi yace yana soba a lokacin daya bani labarin zai auren ki, sannan farouk da arfah abu guda ne haka sirrin juna ne su babu abinda d'aya yake iya b'oyewa d'aya, ba nazo nan don nayi miki barazana akan ki rabu dashi ba, a'a na zone don na baki kad'an daga labarin matar shi kisan da sani kada bayan kin shiga ki dawo kina ganin kamar ya kasa yi miki adalci ko matar shi ta shiga tsakanin ku, indai har soyayyah da k'auna suna raye to babu wata mace da zata rayu a zuciyar farouk sai arfah".
 
    Wata irin doguwar ajiyar zuciya auntie da shubaila suka sauke kusan a tare, bayan sun gama sauraron bayanin bakinta tsaf. 

   Shubaila Cikin tattara dukkan nutsuwarta ga arfah tace, "kenan yanzu ke arfah ta turo ta fad'a mun wannan maganganun? Saboda ita ba zata iya fuskantar mace kamar ni da kanta ba, kuma me wayar farouk take a hannun ki, a dunk'ule meye alak'ar ki dashi?"
Wani murmushin ta sake yi tace, 
    "Ki d'auke ni a matsayin k'anwar shi kuma k'awar arfah, sannan duk wad'annan maganganun bawai ina yi miki sune don barazana ba, wannan kad'an daga abinda yake gundarin gaskiya kenan". 
    "Gaskiya ko son zuciya?" 
 Auntie ta tambaye ta ido cikin ido. 
   Ajiye gyalen ta tayi a gefe, ta mik'e tayi taku biyu a gaban su tace, "naga alama kunfi son komai dallah dallah, tabbas na yarda da maganar farouk, daya cemun ya karb'e kine saboda mutuncin mahaifinki, amma fa ban fad'i haka don cin fuskar ki ba, sai dai yanzu ina son ki yiwa kanki alk'alanci tsakanin gaskiya, shin duk namijin da yake da mace kamar ni, kina ganin zaiso wata macen cikin sauk'i kuwa da radin kanshi? Inba an biyo ta irin waccen hanyar da akabi taki ba" 

    Wani irin damm! Taji zuciyar ta buga, tunda arfah ta soma magana bata ji wani abu na tashin hankali ko tsoro ba sai da tace itace matar farouk, kuma da gaske su d'in abu d'aya ne kamar yadda ya fad'a itama ta fad'a, tunda gashi har ya fad'awa matar shi ita d'in tayin auren ta akayi mishi, take yanayin ta ya sauya idonta ya ciko da hawaye, amma fa a zuciyar ta duk da haka ba taji ba zata iya auren farouk ba.... 
   Ga kuma arfah a gaban ta tsaye tana ganin abubuwan da kowane namiji yake buk'ata da burin samu a gurin matar auren shi na daga kyau fuska da jiki. 



    


    _Toh arfah Allah dai yasa a futo da k'afa🤪_

*Mareeyeart lawal*💞



_In dedication to my lovely ones_🥰




Page 53 _(fifty three)_



Auntie ce ganin shubaila tayi suman zaune ta mik'e ta tsaya dai dai da yanda arfahn ta tsaya cikin son yin hob'b'asa tace, "owk wato ke nan har wata mace ce kenan?, toh lallai kin kwafsa domin duk wata mace mai kyau ko akasin haka abar so ce a gurin mijin ta kuma zata zo mishi dai dai da ra'ayin shine, ke kina da kyau zahiri, amma bamu san ya d'and'anon yake bad'ini ba! Toh kinga ashe kowace mace da irin baiwar da Allah yayi mata, idan kin fita da kyaun fuska ba lallai ki fita da daraja ba, kuma ma ki dubi hajara duba na tsanaki ki gani koda bata kaiki kyau ba, Allah yayi ta mai kyau dai dai nata ke kanki ba zaki nuna mata komai ba, sannan auren farouk da hajara ba fashi ki zuba ido inda rai da numfashi....... ".

    Murmushi arfah tayi duk da taji abinda ya dagula lissafinta har yaso wargaza d'an k'aramin k'arfin gwiwarta, amma sai ta danne, gyalenta ta d'auka da jakarta da wayoyin su ta sake kallon su d'aya bayan d'aya tace, "kiyi hak'uri auntyn hajara zan miki gyara akan maganar ki guda d'aya, shi namijin da yake zaune da mace shine yafi kowa sanin yadda d'and'anon yake, kuma za'a gane haka idan ya auri wadda bata kaita daraja ba, domin za'a ga rik'on sakainar kashi! Na barku lafiya",
   
  Har tayi gaba sai ta juyo ta kalli shubaila da take zaune har lokacin tana binta da kallo. 

 "amarya hajara I'm welcoming u to farouk's residence, k'aunar arfah, mijin da akayi shi domin mace d'aya tak"

Taku biyu tayi ta tsaya sakamakon damk'ar gefen kafad'arta da akayi ta baya, ta juyo da wani irin yanayi tana kallon auntie da take dubanta da tsantsar fuskar b'acin rai. 
  "Fatima arfah! Shin baki san akwai macen da tafi k'arfin rik'on sakainar kashi a gurin d'a namiji ba? Ko baki san akwai wadda duk rashin kyaun ta darajar ta da k'ask'ancinta zata rayu tamkar sarauniyar saboda darajar gidan data futo zai d'aga nata, kinsan kuma shubaila zata kasance a sahun gaba idan kan maganar kud'i ne, mahaifinta ya raine cikin gata ba irin rayuwar garau garau shinkafa da manja ba! Yanzu an samu miya za'a d'aga hanci". 

   Take fuskar arfah ta d'inke d'if kamar Allah bai tab'a halittar murmushi a samanta ba, yau zasu sa ta rab'i abinda ta tsani ta rab'a kanta dashi tun bayan rabuwarta da iyayen ta, zasu sa ta nuna musu asalin wacece ita ko don suyi saurin gyara kuskurarren tunanin su. 

   "Ko zan iya ganin wayarki shafin kina IG? Or twitter" 
   Arfah ta tambaye ta har lokacin yanayin fuskar ta bai sauya ba. 

Ita kuwa auntie da murmushin samun nasara tace, "nafi yin komai ta system d'ina"
"Abu d'aya kenan" arfah ta fad'a a tak'aice

 d'auko mata system d'in tayi ta mik'a mata ta kuma zuba mata ido taga yadda zatayi, 

Abin mamaki sai da auntie ta tsorata da taga yadda take operating system d'in. 
     Searching tsohon accnt d'inta tayi inda Allah ya taimaketa wani baiyi highking ba, nan danan komai nata ya soma bayyana, sai dai duk wasu abubuwan a kulle suke saida tayi tunani mai tsayi sannan ta tuna password d'in, wanda tana sawa nan take komai nata ya bayyana, to amma fa ta manta sam bata posting pic enta a kowanne shafin yanar gizo nata. Ita kuma tafi buk'atar su ganta zahiri. 
  Sai ta sauya akalarta zuwa na mahaifinta, maybe anan zasu iya ganin ta. 
   

 mik'awa auntie system d'in tayi tace, "fatima jafar jaura baffi, alhaji jafar shine mahaifina basai na tsaya yi miki dogon jawabi akan wanene shiba, amma kici gaba da search ki ga komai da kanki, kad'an daga abinda zan fad'a miki a kaina shine, ni tunda nake ban tab'a sanin menene garau garau da kike fad'a ba saida na diro garin ku kano, kina magana akan irin gatan da shubaila take dashi, wanda ni a gurina gatan ta irin na shinkafa da miya ne da naman kaji, idan aka danganta shubaila da arfah, tazarar da take tsakanin su takai nisan dake kano da China, kinga zuwa a k'afa bazai zamo mana abu mai sauk'i ba". 

     Tana gama yin bayanin ta Ko sauraron su bata tsaya yiba ta juya ta fuce daga cikin parlon da sassarfa, sai data sauke ajiyar zuciya ta saisaita yanayin ta, ta kuma yi hamdala ga Allah daya tak'aita abin bai kai ga mari ko duka ba, don ta fahimci k'iris ya rage matar baban nan tata takai mata hannu, hanyar barin gidan ta nufa gaba d'aya bayan ta gyara yafen gyalenta.
   Tana futa ta shige napep, shi kuwa dama a k'agare yake ta futo su huce, baiyi jira kona second ba yaja napep d'in suka tafi.
  

     Suna tafe tana neman yafiyar ubangiji akan futowar da tayi da irin wannan shigar ba tare da mijinta ya sani ba.
   Tana cikin tsaka mai wuyar nan kuma wani mutumi ya dinga buga musu horn, cikin tsoro da hard'ewar harshe tace da mai napep, "kar ka saurare shi kayi sauri muje kawai"

    Shi kuwa mutumi da naci madadin ya hak'ura sai ya dinga binsu a baya har anguwar su.

  Wani k'arin tashin hankalin farouk ta tarar zaune kan machine a k'ofar gidan su, da kyar ta futo daga napep d'in zuciyar ta tana faman harbawa, banda ya ganta da juyawa zatayi in anjima ta dawo, to amma inta juya taje ina? "Ya subhanallah Allah ka futar dani".
   K'arasawa inda yake ta somayi kamar an buge mata gabobin jiki.
    Tana shirin bud'e bakin ta wannan mutumin ya k'araso gurin su shima, "y'an mata barka dai".

    Wani irin dum du dum taji a kirjin ta kamar an buga mata durom, har ta rasa ma yadda zatayi a lokacin, "magana nake baiwar Allah kinyi shiru?". 
    
Sai ta samu kanta da kallon farouk da kai tsaye ba zata iya tantance a yanayin da yake ba. 
   "Y'an mata yana magana" ya fad'a yana kallonta shima. 
   "Yauwa d'an samari da alama k'anwar kace ita d'in, naga she's soo classy amma"

    "Hum" shine abinda farouk ya iya fad'a ba tare daya sake kallon kurar data debo mutumin ba, idon shi har lokacin akan arfah kyarrr.
    Ita kam hucewa kawai tayi ta barshi a gurin, da hanzari mutumin ya yink'ura zai bi bayan ta farouk yayi saurin dakatar dashi, "ba k'anwata bace ita d'in matata ce".

     Tun da mutumin yaji haka bai sake yin ko tari ba ya juya ya shige motarshi ya bata wutaaaa.


   Tana bud'e k'ofa ta dora hannu aka tana tunanin yadda zata iya wanke kanta a gurin wannan bawan Allah.

    Ba taji ko k'arar machine d'in shi ba sai ganin shi tayi kawai ya shigo dak'in ko sallamar bai tsaya ta amsa ba ya mik'a mata hannu yana wurga mata wani mugun kallo, "bani wayata".

  Arfah cikin inda inda da kare kanta ta soma fad'in, "wallahi ban san shiba..... Ban....!".
D'aga mata hannu yayi da sauri 
   "Babu ruwana da abinda yake tsakaninki dashi, kinsan shi ko baki sanshi ba duk ke ya shafa, abu d'aya kawai na sani babu matar aure mai mutumci da tasan ciwon kanta da zatayi kwalliya irin taki ta futa titi, idan tayi haka kuma bata isa ta hana wanda tayi domin su yabawa ba, to kinga ashe dama kin shiryawa hakan, don haka ni kawai ki bani wayata...... ".

   Kuka ta sanya mishi ba tare data bashi wayar ba kuma.

"Kinsan Allah ranki zaiyi mugun baci idan baki futo mun da wayata ba"

   "Zargina kake farouk! Kana zargin zan iya yin wani abu don naja hankalin wasu mazan kaina bayan da igiyar auren ka a kaina?"
   Ta fad'a da muryar kuka.

   Zama yayi a gefe ya sake kallonta tun daga sama har k'asa, kafun cikin jinjinawa yace, "humm! To me yayi saura kuma? tunda har zaki iya tsallakewa ki futa babu izinin mijinki?".
   "Innalillahi wa'inna ilaihi raji'un! Nice yau kake zargi haka? Ko ka manta ni d'in wacece? Farouk anya kana hayyacinka kuwa...... "

    Kinga kar ki janyo mun hankalin mutanen gidan nan suyo mun nan dama kinsan k'iris suke jira damu, ni nace miki ba abinda ya shafeni da rayuwar duk da kika ga zakiyi, kuma inba kama kai ba kinji nace akwai wani abu tsakanin ku, wayata ce nace ki bani kuma bani da matsayin da zaki banin kalas".

   Yana k'arasa fad'ar haka ya shige bedroom ya bar mata parlon.

  Ko ba komai yaji sanyi a ranshi don bawai yana zarginta bane dama, kawai don ya huce takaicin abinda tayi mishi ne, yanzu damuwarshi d'aya ina taje! Kuma meye dalilin da yasa ta d'auke wayar shi ta b'oye, yasan dai haka nan ba za tayi duk shirin nan ba, dole akwai wani abu da take shiryawa, sannan d'azu yana hanyar shi ta dawowa gida daga kasuwa, shubaila ta kira shi tace tana son ganin shi daga nan zuwa gobe, Allah yasa dai ba abinda yake zargi bane.

    Kayan jikin shi ya rage ya shiga toilet ya watsa ruwa, ya d'auro alwalar sallar la'asar data huce shi bai samu yayi ba.

Yana futowa yaganta zaune a gefen gado ta had'a kanta da jikin bango tana kuka, Allah ya sani baya son jin kukan nan nata sam amma fa dole ya d'auke kanshi a wannan karon don ya kawo gyara cikin al'amuran zamantakewar su. Tayi haka yau taji dad'i, idan bai d'auki matakin daya dace ba ta samu hanya kenan nan gaba koda izinin shi ko babu idan abun futa ya kama futar ta zatayi. 
  Sannan ita har yanzu bata san tayi laifi ta bada hak'uri ba, madadin haka sai ta hau fushi. 

    Kaya marassa nauyi ya sanya a jikin shi kamar bai san da wanzuwarta a dak'in ba.
   Bayan ya idar da sallar ma kitchen ya koma ya duba ko ta dafa abinci, Allah ya taimakeshi kuwa akwai ragowar abincin data rage na raana sai ya zubo a plate ya dawo parlour.

Ita Kuwa a dak'i tana shirin d'aukar aniyar fushi wata zuciya tayi saurin kwabarta, "ke da kike da wancen hark'allar meye na d'aukar fushi inba sake jajib'owa kanki wani laifin ba, gwara ki gaggauta bashi hak'uri ku d'in ke wannan b'arakar tunda koba komai ai kece mai laifi. 
  Da wannan tunanin tayi na'am. 
    Yana cin abincin ta futo, ba kuka takeyi ba wannan karon jikinta a sanyaye dai.

   Zama tayi a k'asa wajen k'afafunshi ta sadda kai sosai cikin sanyin jiki dana murya ta soma fad'in, "kayi hak'uri tabbas ni mai laifi ce a gurin ka, to amma na futa ne bisa wani kwakkwaran dalili, shi kuma mutumin tun a hanya yake bina ban kula shiba shine ya biyo ni har nan ni ban ma sani ba, amma kayi hak'uri insha Allah abu kwatankwacin haka bazai sake faruwa ba nayi maka alk'awari"

    Tun data soma magana farouk ya zuba mata ido yana alajabinta, itace yau da karb'ar laifin ta hadda bada hak'uri? Lallai akwai wani abu a k'asa, to amma bari yayi mata afuwa ai komai zai futo kuma dai ta bashi hak'uri, 

   Murmushi yayi yace, 
 "thank God kin gane kuskuren ki da wuri cikin sauk'i, amma Don Allah ki dinga kiyayewa, ni kaina ba jin dad'i na bane ace ina d'aga miki murya"

   Cikin jin dad'i ta mik'e ta koma kusa dashi ta manna bakinta a kumatun shi, kiss tayi mishi both dama da hagu, ta karb'e plate d'in hannun shi ta d'iba cokali guda ta kai bakin shi. 
   Rik'e hannun ta yayi yana girgiza mata kai, ta fahimci abinda yake nufi, sai ta ajiye cokalin gefe ta d'iba da hannun ta ta soma feeding nashi. 
   Rabi cin abinci rabi soyayyah har aka kammala, wayar shi ta d'auko mishi ta bashi, ya karb'a ya ajiye ta gefe cikin tattara duk hankalin shi gareta yace, "baby ina sane baki fad'a mun inda kika je bafa?". 

   D'an yamutsa fuska tayi tace, "amma kasan dai ba zanje inda bai kamata ba kuma ba zanyi abinda bai kamata ba ko?".

     "Ehhh to bana da tabbas har sai naji tukun amma fa idan matsayina ya kai na sani"

   D'an shagwob'e fuska tayi, tayi narai narai da ido cikin shagwab'ab'b'en muryarta tace, "wannan hausar naka! har yanzu kana son saka shakku akaina, bayan kasan duk duniya bani da kamar ka a halin yanzu, ni dai mubar maganar nan kawai don ko meye ma zakaji nan da kwana d'aya ko biyu".

    Kwata kwata bai yarda da ita ba, amma shi bai cika son abinda zasuyi ta maimaita magana d'aya ba, don haka sai ya share ya d'auko mata wata maganar daban.

   Toh Kusan tare suka k'arasa yinin su har zuwa dare kuma suna tare, don arfah bata bari ta muskuta daga jikin shi ko nan da can ba, ko sallar magrib bata yadda ya futa masjid ba tare sukayi jam'i, dalilin ta kuwa bata son yaji aika aikar da tayi a yau saboda har yanzu bata shirya hujjar da zata kare kanta ba idan yabi ba'asi.

    Haka shubaila tayi ta kiran shi yana silencing wayar har ta gaji ta rabu dashi, saboda a wannan lokacin ya dad'e da d'aukar hanyar barin duniyar da muke zuwa mai cike da d'unbin soyayyah da shaukin matar shi da take kashe shi da salon soyayyar ta zazzafa a yau mai tsayawa a rai da zuciyar wanda ake yiwa.


               **********


A takaice farouk bai samu lokacin had'uwa da shubaila ba sai washe garin ranar bayan ya taso daga kasuwa, ko gida bai koma ba saboda yasan in ya koma futar zata iya yi mishi wahala.

    B'angaren shubaila kuwa tun bayan futar arfah kuka ta dinga yiwa auntien ta sosai, bata k'ara tsorata da nisan da arfah tayi mata ba saida auntie ta dinga shiga tana futa a Internet wajen nemo wacece arfah, tabbas alhaji jafar jaura baffi mahaifinta ne kamar yadda ta fad'a, sannan babban mai kud'in d'an kasuwa ne daya mallaki dukiya mai tarin yawa, haka yayi popular sosai tsakanin kaduna, katsina da kano, sannan tayi katari da wani pic en arfah guda wanda aka d'auke shi a katafaren main parlon na gidan su lokacin da tayi birthday kuma yayi note a k'asan pic d'in kamar haka, _"happie birthday to my darling daughter! Ur are unbelievably precious to me, and I hope you realize dat u are my everything, may your birthday be filled with splendor and love"_❤️

  Jinjina kai auntie ta sake yi a karo naba adadi tana sake k'arewa pic in kallo da komai na jiki, a tsaye take sanye da expensive clothes fuskar ta ko powder bata jin akwai amma duk da haka tayi kyau mai d'aukar hankali, banbancinta da arfah ta yanzu shine wannan tafi y'ar kiba kad'an, ita kuma ta jikin pic en tafi fari da aji amma duk itace.

    Ajiye wayar tayi ta zubawa shubaila ido da har yanzu alamun rud'u basu rabu da fuskar ta ba, tasan duk ganin arfah da tayi ne kuma ya haddasa hakan da bud'e musu aiki da tayi kafun ta tafi.

   Dawowa kusa da ita auntie tayi ta dafa kafadar ta, cikin son ganin ta kwantar mata da hankali ta soma magana, "kada kiyi saurin mik'a wuya shubaila, kad'an kenan daga matsalolin kishiya kika gani soo sai kin zama jaruma, sannan har kullum abinda nake so kisa a ranki shine, shi kike so, shine naki ba ruwan ki da ita ko duban matsayin ta, tabbas duk abinda ta fad'a gaskiya ne, ko daga yanayin hausarta mara futa yadda ya kamata zamu gano hakan, da ganin ta tana son mijinta sosai, shima kuma bai baki a rufe ba yana son matar shi kwarai, amma kiyi tunani da kanki, ni zan shiga kitchen yau kam ki huta".
   Auntie tana gama fad'in haka ta huce ta barta nan zaune.

   Jingina tayi da makarin kujerar da take kai, tana tunanin duk maganganun da arfah tayi.

  Ranar ko abincin dare bata iya ci ba saboda wani k'arin takaicin na k'in d'aga wayarta da yayi a daren ranar. Ta sake tabbatar da maganar arfah data ce farouk mijin mace d'aya ce tak! Wato yana tare da matar shi bashi da lokacin ta ma.


  Washe garin ranar ta tashi sukuku ga ciwon kai na rashin samun wadataccen bacci, auntie fad'a ta dinga yi mata akan ta cire komai daga ranta daga d'an wannan abun duk zata Sawa ranta damuwa salon ta Jawowa kanta wani ciwon haka siddan.

    Toh da sauk'i don ta d'an saki jikinta har tasa ameer ya  d'auko mata takardun zane zanen ta, tana yi yana tayata da surutun gidan su auntie da sukaje yawon sallah.


  Tayi tsammanin farouk zai kirata in ya futo kasuwa da rana sai kuma taji shi shiru.

Shi kuma bai kirata bane saboda bai san mai zaice mata ba, ta buk'aci ganin shi Jiya bai samu dama yaje ba, sannan ta jera mishi almost 7 missedcall, yana ganin zuwan shine kad'ai abinda yafi dacewa a lokacin.


   Misalin k'arfe biyar da rabi na yamma ya isa anguwar ta su, sai kiran shi kawai ta gani, tana picking yayi mata magana, kamar koda yaushe a takaice, "ina k'ofar gidan ku".

   Da mamaki tabi wayar da kallo, gefe d'aya na zuciyar ta kuma farin ciki ne ya mamaye ta.

  Sai ta mik'e da hanzari ta shige dak'in ta gudun kada yayi ta jiran ta.


   _Allah sarki soyayyah 💔dama ita haka take, ta makantar ta kurumtar wani lokacin har ta haukatar, Allah ka raba mu da son maso wani_

Page 55 _(fifty five)_



 Arfah da farouk zaune gaban teburin likita sun maida hankalin su gare shi kacokan suna dubanshi a lokacin da yake kora musu bayani kamar haka, "bisa ga dogon nazari da zuzzurfan bincike da nayi na gano cewa matarka tana d'auke da ciwon...........".

   Sai kuma yayi shiru tare da sunkuyar da kanshi yana girgiza kanshi alamun tausayawa ga wannan patient da take zaune gaban shi, cikin zullumin abinda ka iya zuwa yazo.

   Jin maganar da likita ya d'auko kuma sai duk ta sake tsurewa tana duban likitan da fuskar ta ta tausayi inda tace, "doctor na shiga uku na, dama nasan wani mugun ciwon ne ya shige ni, ni kuma kaddara ta kenan nayi ta rayuwa cikin cututtuka".

    Sai ta kife kanta a jikin teburin ta fashe da kukan da dama ya dad'e gab da mak'oshinta, kuka take yi farouk na kallonta kamar yayi kukan shima inda yake bata baki da ta tsaya tukun suji k'arshen bayanin likitan.
   Sai ya sake maida dubanshi sosai ga likitan yace, "don Allah likita ka taimaki rayuwar wannan bayin Allah da suke da cin yau suna neman na gobe a gurin Allah subhanahu wata'ala, ka fad'a mana cewar matata tana cikin k'oshin lafiya kuma babu wani ciwo da yake damunta........".

    Jikin likitan a sanyaye matuk'a ya soma magana cikin tausaya musu, "na dad'e banga al'amari irin naku ba kaida matarka, amma a farko ku gafarceni akan abinda nayi muku, bansan da cewa akwai wani k'alube cikin rayuwarku na k'ak'ani k'ayi da rayuwa cikin mawuyacin halin ciwo ba, da tun asali bazan soma yi muku irin wannan wasan ba".

   Da sauri arfah ta dubeshi jin abinda ya fad'a a k'arshen maganar shi,  "yesss! Mrs Umar farouk ina goron albishir d'ina"

   Kallon juna sukayi a tare duk fuskokin su d'auke da bak'on yanayi, "Don Allah likita ka fad'a mana abinda kake son fad'a tun kafun zuciyoyin mu su kaiga bugawa mu huta da wannan rayuwar".

   Murmushi mai kyau da K'arfafa gwiwa likitan yayi musu yace, "ba wani ciwo ne yake damun matarka ba umar sai yaron cikin da yake jikinta na tsawon wata hud'u".

  "Allahu akhbar! Allahu akhbar!! Allahu akhbar!!!" wannan kalmomi farouk ya maimaita a bakin shi har sau uku cikin matuk'ar farin cikin da bai tab'a riskar kanshi a ciki ba tsawon rayuwar shi, ashe dama haka zama uba yake? Ashe haka mutanen da Allah ya nufa da samun y'ay'a suke shiga tsananin farin ciki, wayyo Allah kashe ni don dad'i.
    Irin sambatun da farouk ya dinga yi kenan a cikin zuciyar shi yayinda kwayar idon shi ke tsaye akan matar shi abar alfaharin shi.

   "abinda ya bani mamaki daku duka shine cikin wata hud'u jikin matarka amma ba wanda ya sani daga kai har ita, yanzu banda Allah yasa taji motsi ya takura ta tsawon kwanaki daba abinda zai kawo ku har sai tazo haihuwa, garin ya kuka zama careless haka?".

    Arfah da tayi suman hucin gadi saboda jin abun da tayi kamar a mafarkan ta data sabayi, zamowa tayi tamkar robot ta kasa kwakkwaran motsi sai bin su da ido kawae da take yi.
    Farouk ne yayi k'arfin halin yiwa doctor bayanin dalilin da yasa basuyi zaton ciki bane, kad'an daga ciki bata kasance cikin mutane masu isashshiyar lafiya ba, ma'ana tana da yawon ciwoce ciwoce, toh yayi tunanin idan ta samu ciki abin zai ninku, sai gashi ko tashin zuciya bata tab'a yi da sunan laulayin ciki ba, balle a kaiga su amai da y'an kwad'aye kwad'aye na masu ciki, hasalima shi lafiya yaga ta dad'a, sannan duk abinda ba taci a baya yanzu tana ci sosai.

   Bayani likita ya d'ora mishi da yanayin yadda kowanne ciki yake zowa mace, majority wani cikin yana bin yanayin mace ne, sai dai akasarin mata sunfi yawan laulayi, sannan dama ba yadda ubangiji baya sassauya alamuran shi, gashi yanzu ta samu sassauci sab'anin tunanin su shida ita da suke ganin kamar zata dawwama cikin ciwo ne.

   Shawarwari doctor ya basu daga k'arshe kan yadda za'a kula da ita da cikin dake jikinta, da kuma irin abubuwan da zata dinga ci don d'orewar ingantacciyar lafiyar ta data babyn dake tare da ita, kafun daga k'arshe ya fad'a mata lokacin da zata dawo ayi mata scanning da auna cikin. 
    Sai da suka zo zasu tafi ne farouk ya fargar da arfah ta dawo cikin cikakkiyar nutsuwarta.

    Suka yiwa doctor godiya suka fuce daga office d'in, shi dai likita murmushi yayi a ranshi yana jinjina wauta irin tasu kamar wasu y'an fari, wato da ace wani ciwon ya lik'a mata da shikenan duk sun shige ita da mijin.

   
   Farouk kam basu huce gida ba har saida suka biya suka siya duk magungunan da aka rubuta musu, ya kuma lodar matar kayan ciye ciye irin wanda likita ya bada shawarar ta dinga ci, lokacin da suka je gida sune k'arshen shiga aka rufe gidan gaba d'aya saboda dare daya soma yi.
    Suna shiga tsakiyar parlour farouk ya jawo ta jikin shi ya rungume ya soma sauke mata zazzafan kiss mouth to mouth yayinda ya d'ora duka hannuwan shi a cikin ta,
    Shafa cikin yake kamar yayo waje da abinda ke ciki gaba d'aya yaga gudan jinin shi.
   
    Sai daya gama budurin shi tsaf sannan arfah ta zube kan carpet ta fashe da kuka mai ban mamaki a gurin farouk, sai ya koma gefe kawai yana kallonta da alajabin kukan na meye, shida ya d'auka saita fishi farin ciki da samuwar cikin amma sai baiga alamun farin ciki ba ko d'igo a saman fuskar ta.

  Da matuk'ar mamaki farouk ya soma yi mata magana da tambayar, "da gaske bakiyi farin ciki da cikin jikin ki ba arfah?".

    A sannu a hankali ta soma girgiza mishi kai, tare da share hawayenta cikin disashshiyar murya kuma tace, "saboda nice nafi kowa iya butulci, sam ba kukan wani abu nakeyi ba saina tsoro! Tsoron kada ya zam cewa duk abinnan da muka ji mafarkine, tsoron kada ina tsaka da wannan daddand'an baccin da mafarkin ka tashe ni kace in tashi lokacin sallah yayi, yaa farouk ka gaya mun shin da gaske ne ina d'auke da cikin d'anmu ko y'ar mu da zan haifa nan da watanni k'alilan"
   Sai ta sake fashewa da wani Sabon kukan kuma.

    Sosai farouk ya zage yana rarrashinta da tausasan dad'ad'an kalamai har ya samu ta dakata da kukan nata haka.

   Ai idan mukace wad'annan mutum biyu sun runtsa in banda bacci barawo kwarai munyi k'arya, tarin farin ciki, tarin kwanciyar hankali da samun abunda suka dad'e suna mafarkin samu.

   Wata irin riritawa da kulawa ta musamman farouk yake baiwa arfah dungurun gum a cikin wannan sati, yayinda ita kuma take narke mishi da salon shagwob'a kala kala.

     Duk abinda batayi a baya ba yanzu takeyi da taimakon fuskar data samu daga gurin farouk da sam baya iya ganin laifin ta.

Cikin abinda bai huci watanni biyu ba arfah tayi wani irin kyau na dauk'ar hankali,haka cikin jikinta ya sake d'an tasawa yayi gwanin sha'awa, a yanzu makaranta kawai take zuwa amma dede da shara farouk baya yadda tayi in yana gida, ko girkin dare sai ince yanzu kusan tare sukeyi idan ya dawo. 
Kayan baby kuwa tun washe garin ranar farouk ya soma siyo su yana tarawa, yana nan ya cika b'angare guda da kayan baby da mamarta, kuma har lokacin bawai ya gama siyowa bane. 




    A yauma kamar yadda ya saba ya tashi sassafe ya d'ora mata ruwan wanka, yayi mata breakfast ,shara da wanke plate. Tana kwance bayan ta futo wankan ko kwakkwaran  motsi bata son yi farouk ya shigo da d'an k'aramin plate na abincinta ,hannunshi d'aya kuma ruwan tea ne daya Sha kayan k'amshi sai tururi yake. 

    Zama yayi a gefen gadon yasa hannu ya tab'a gefen wuyanta, "Kai baby jikinki fa akwai alamun zazzab'i....."

   Mik'ewa tayi tana yamutsa fuska ta karb'i cupin shayin hannunshi ta kurb'a. 
    Da sauri ta matsar da cupin gefe ta zuro k'afafunta Suka tsaya k'asa, "yau bana jin dad'in jikina"

   Da sauri farouk ya ajiye plate d'in abincin k'asa yace, "taso mu tafi asibiti ayi checking d'inki kinsan fa daga irin ciwukan nan ne sai kiji an haihu". 

Da wani irin hanzari arfah ta juyo ta dubeshi, "haihuwa kuma dear! Wace irin haihuwa kuma! Ni wallahi har kasa gabana ma ya fad'i, yanzu idan na haihu me na haifa kenan?"

   Dafe kanshi yayi yace, "oohhh! Afwan wallahi hankalina ne yake kan naga kinyi haihuwar nan lafiya an huce gurin, amma dai duk da haka dauko hijab d'inki muje gurin doctor ya duba mun ke". 

   Cikin y'ar shagwob'a tace, "Don Allah ka kyaleni da yawon asibitin nan, kana gani fa rannan wata nurse har da jana gefe tayi mun naseeha akan na dinga daurewa ciwo ba daga naji ciwon Kai na kwaso jiki nayo asibiti ba, ai dama me ciki ance bata rabo da irin wannan y'an ciwoce ciwocen, nasan da nayi bacci anjima zan warke yanzu ya maganar tafiyar taka Legos?"
   
   Farouk kam shiru yayi yana nazarin sharhe sharhenta ba don ya gamsu da abinda ta fad'a dai ba kawai ya kyaleta, "toh amma kici abincin nan tukun sai muyi maganar tafiyar"

    Plate d'in abincin ya Miko mata ta karb'a ta Soma ci kad'an kad'an don daima ya tsareta ne da bazata ci ba cox ita ba wani yunwa takeji ba. 
     
Bayan ta gama cin wanda zata iya ci acikin abincin, cupin shayin ta d'auko bisa umarnin farouk ta Soma Sha. 
    "Yanzu idan akace in kinje tsohon gidanku zaki had'u da mahaifinki zakije?"
  Cakkk ta dakata da kurb'ar ruwan tea da takeyi, ta d'ago kanta ta dubeshi lokaci d'aya yanayin fuskarta ya sauya, tayi shiru tana kallonshi. 

   "Kinji abinda nace baby!ni a ganina duk abinda zasuyi miki bai kamata ki k'ullace su ko ki rik'e su a ranki ba,ko ba komai iyaye sunfi gaban wasa  sannan a duniya babu wani abu da zaisa kiji haushin su ko kiga laifin su, saboda in kika duba suma abai bai aka basu abin, a ganina tsananin sonda suke miki nema ya haddasa Suka gwammace su nisanta dake akan su dinga ganinki a gaban su da cikin shege, kuma ni kaina a lokacin Saida duniya tayi mun zafi, na dinga jin haushin ki da ganin laifin ki, Saida na gano komai daga baya sannan....... Suma kansu yanzu nasan suna can cikin nadama da tunanin inda zasu sameki, kiyi tunanin mai kyau da kwakwkwalwar ki fatima, iyaye kome zasu yiwa d'ansu ba zai tab'a yin fushi dasu ba, domin duk duniya bashi da kamarsu, kuma har ya mutu bazai tab'a iya biyansu abinda sukayi mishi ba, lokaci yaja, ba shekara d'aya ba ba biyu ba, magana ake ta shekaru kusan uku rabuwar ku, ya kamata ko baki sansu ba zuwa wannan lokacin ki yafe musu haka, balle kuma iyaye.... Iyaye fa fatima". 
    
    Arfah cikin kuka shab'e shab'e take kallon farouk yanzu, maganar abinda ya shiga tsananin ta da iyayen ta abune Sam da bata son tunashi, balle har wani yayi mata magana a kan shi. 
    Shima duk jikinshi a sanyaye yake, saboda bai tab'a samun kwanciyar hankali da rayuwarshi ba tunda ya rabu da mahaifiyar shi, mahaifinshi da k'annen shi. 
   Mintuna uku sun gifta tsakanin su a haka. 
    Hawaye yake sharewa irin Wanda take sharewa, abinda yafi d'aga mata hankali kenan, duk maganar da farouk yake gaskiya ne, to amma tana tsoron abinda zai biyo bayan zuwan nasu garesu, kada fa taje su sake maimaita mata abinda sukayi mata a can baya, tabbas sukayi haka ta tafi ba zata sake rab'ar suba har abada......

    Share hawayenta tayi taci gaba da kurb'ar shayinta cikin nutsuwa a hankali har ta gama, shiru ya sake biyo baya a tsakanin su kafun wayar farouk tayi ring, na y'an mintuna ya d'aga wayar bayan ya gama jin sak'on kuma ya ajiyeta gefenta, "tafiyata ba zata yiwu yau ba, bansan kuma rana ba, saboda wanda zanje gurinshi ance mun baya k'asar". 

   Haka kawai arfah taji ajikinta tana son sanin Wanda farouk yake maganar zai je gurin shin nan, don haka sai ta samu bakinta da tambayarshi, "waye shi wanda zaka gurin shi?"
     Shiru yayi yana nazarinta kafun ya sauke ajiyar zuciya yace, "wani babban mutum ne d'an kasuwa, amma meyasa kika tambaya?"

   Cikin basarwa arfah tace, "ba komai I just want to know"

   "Ok ni yanzu zan huce kasuwa ina fatan anjima zaki sha magungunan ki, and yau ki hak'ura da makarantar nan zan kira mallam salis na bashi uzuri". 

   Gyad'a mishi Kai kawai tayi ya k'arasa y'an abubuwan da zaiyi ya dauki wayoyin shi da mukullin machine ya sumbaci cikinta da goshin ta yayi mata sallama. 
     "Allah ya tsare, Take care of yourself dear". 

    "Insha Allah take care of yourself too"

   Yana gama fad'in haka ya d'aga mata hannu yayi gaba saboda yaso ya haura lokacin futar shi ta ka'ida. 
     Bayan futarshi arfah ta jima tana tunanin abubuwa tun daga farkon auren su har zuwa yau, tayi iya nazarinta don ta gano yadda farouk ya d'auke ta amma ta kasa d'arawa daga matsayin matar shi ta aure, babu wani abu mai kama da soyayyah da take hange, ko da akwai alamun ya damu da rayuwarta, to ai itama ta damu da rayuwarshi, kuma yana kulawa da ita irin yadda take kulawa da shi. 
    Toh aikuwa in haka ne ya kamata ta rufe babin nan ta ajiye a gefe ta barshi zuwa nan da wani lokaci. 
   
     A ranar misalin k'arfe biyu na rana bayan tayi baccinta ta hantse tayi sallah ta d'ora girkin abinda zataci na rana, mammie ta shigo da gudu ita da d'an zainab, da dariyar ta ta k'arasa kusa da arfah ta tsaya, shi kuma abokin wasan nata ya gudu, arfah da fara'ah sosai ta rungume yarinyar a jikinta tana tambayarta umminta. 
   "Ita tace wai kizo" yarinyar ta fad'awa arfah. 
   Y'an magana suka ce gaida mai gaisheka ko bazai amsa ba, hajiya husna bata tab'a zuwa gidan ba tazo mata ba, kuma tana nuna tana sonta kamar tuntuni ta dad'e da saninta ko irin suna da dangantakar nan saboda haka sai bata k'i amsa Kiran nata ba. 
   Chocolate ta d'aukowa yarinyar irin wadda farouk yake kawo mata saboda yara, sannan ta sanya hijab ta kamo hannun yarinyar suka futo. 

   Hajiya husna tana zaune a saman varrendar d'akin zainab an zane mata k'afarta da jan lalleh. 
    Yau na farko saboda mutumcin matar ta taka k'afarta a arean wad'annan mutane, itama hajiya husna da fara'a ta tarye ta tana yi mata sannu, a gefen varrender ta zauna suka gaisa dasu zainab da mama saratu da take zaune kofar d'akin ta ita da nabeela da wata k'anwar nabeelan da tayi aure. 

   Gaisawa sukayi da matar cikin mutuntawa tana kallon su fauziyyah suna zund'enta da tab'e baki. 
   Ita dai bata damu ba su sukayi asara da kullum basu da aiki sai gulmar mutane.

    "Ina zaune a d'aki mammie tace kina kirana?" 
   Arfah ta tambayi matar. 

  "Eh wallahi kinga wai yunwa takeji, shine nace in kina da ragowar abinci don Allah ki bata". 

   "Laah! Ba damuwa hajiya ina da abinci sai wanda yayi mata ma, taho muje na baki kinji mammie". 
  Arfah ce me yin wannan magana cikin fara'a tana kama hannun mammie. 

   Fauziyyah da take zaune sai taga kamar arfah donsu tayi wannan maganar, saboda haka kafun hajiya husna tace komai tayi zaraf tana fad'in, "zainab kinji bariki, su oh'oh saboda yanzu an samu rice and stew za'a goranta mana, to dad'in ta dai munsan yadda aka zo kuma munsan daga inda ake, ba tsiya ba arzik'i ga ba asali, don tunda muke a gidan ga bamu tab'a ganin ko kare yazo don ya duba suba". 

   Har arfah ta Soma tafiya sai tayi cak ta tsaya, mutanen nan bata San me suke so da ita ba a gidan nan. 

   Mama saratu da take gefe tasowa tayi ta matso, kafun wani yayi yink'uri tsakanin arfah, mama saratu da hajiya husna zainab ta shek'e da dariya inda ta d'auke zancen da fad'in, "ki bari kawai zainab nima abinda nake gani kenan an baro koriyar miya ta kafi zabo da gishiri an samu gidan miji har ana yi mana tak'ama da gadara yooh Allah mun tuba astagfirullah ina arzik'in yake? Mema suke dashi har yanzu". 

    Wata dariyar suka sakeyi saboda tsabar hassada ta rufe musu ido sun manta da hajiya husna da kashedin ta. 

    Ita kuwa zuba musu ido kawai tayi tana al'ajabin rayuwa irin tasu kullum cikin bala'i da neman bala'i, inba maseefa akayi dasu ba sam basa jin dad'i. 

   Arfah dawowa tayi da baya cikin zuciyarta tana jin ya kamata yau taba mutanen nan amsa koda sau d'aya ne. 
    Wani irin kallo tayi musu na shanye takaici, cikin nutsuwa da sanyin muryarta mara amo tace, "kun dad'e kuna yimun abubuwa a gidan nan ina kyale ku, bawai kuma don kunfi k'arfina ko bani da amsar baku ba ko tsoro, kun kirani da mitsiyaciya, mara asali y'ar k'auye sau ba adadi don kuji dad'i a ranku da zuciyarku kun k'untata mun, sai dai a yau ina son kusan cewa ni d'in ba irin yanda kuke tunani bace, inda k'afata ta taka har ku mutu ba lallai kuje ba, banda k'addara da take iya bin tuwo ciki da ko inuwata sai dai ku hanga daga nesa,  don ko a mai goge mun takalmi abbina bazai d'auke ku aiki ba, saboda haka ku saurarawa rayuwata haka........"

  Tana gama yin maganarta taja hannun mammie sukayi gaba, suka barsu saroro suna binta da kallo. 

   Hajiya husna kuwa question mark ta lik'awa duk maganganun da arfah tayi, ta kuma yi musu kyakkyawan ma'ajiya a kwakwkwalwar ta. 

   Basu samu amsar bata ba har ta shige d'akinta, hajiya husna ce cikin kasa kyalewa tace, "me yasa bakwa iya hak'uri da neman rigima ne, ku baiwa zuciyoyinku hak'uri akan duk abinda kuke ji, kamar yadda kuka kure ta ta gaji ta fad'a muku ita d'in batayi kama da yadda kuke zato ba, don Allah nidai da wannan nake rok'onku daku gyara halayenku, ku zauna da kowa lafiya, wannan rayuwar ta duniya da bata da tabbas meye na k'ullatar wani ko wata a kanta?"

  Duk shiru sukayi kamar naseeharta ta shige su, nan kuwa duk abinda ya maidasu taitayinsu maganar arfah ce, suna tsoron kada fa abinda take fad'a haka yake?. 
    
    A ranar da yamma mama saratu ta shigo yiwa arfah sallama bayan ta nemi yafiyar arfah akan duk abinda ya gudana tsakanin su, nan ta d'ora da bata labarin dalilin tashin nasu saboda duk y'an gidan sun sani itama saboda bata shiga shirgin mutane ne shiyasa, abinda yafi tsayawa arfah shine wai nabeela ce tayi cikin shege kuma anyi anyi ya zube ya nace sai ya tona asirin abinda uwarshi ta dad'e tanayi ta hanyar zuwanshi duniya. 

   Arfah sosai ta tausayawa mama saratun ta kuma jimanta musu, data tashi tafiya ma ta d'auki dubu uku ta bata tace sa had'a suyi kud'in mota

Farouk ranar bai dawo gidaba sai daya samu tabbacin lokacin da alhaji jafar zai dawo Nigeria, kusan watanni uku masu zuwa, kuma guy d'in ya bashi tabbacin za'a shigar da appointment d'inshi kafun zuwan lokacin. 

Cikin farin ciki farouk ya kamo hanyar gida, yana jinshi kusa daf da cikar burinshi, sai yake jin ma kamar ya jawo watanni ukun su dawo gobe. 

    Arfah zaune shiru cikin assasawa kanta damuwa da damuwar wani farouk ya dawo, ko magana baiyi mata ba Saida ya soma gaisawa da babyn shi, hadda bashi labarin kasuwa. 

_ku kujifa kamar wanda suke gani😄_

    Bayan ya nutsu ne ya fahimci yanayin da take ciki, yasan tabbas da lafiyarta ba zata kyaleshi shi kad'ai yana maganar nan ba tareda ta taya Shiba,yana fatan dai Allah yasa ba jikin bane, shi dama har ya futa hankalinshi bai kwanta da yanayin daya barta ba, shiyasa d'azu a kasuwa daya samu faragar hidimar mutane ya kirata, kuma ta sake tabbatar mishi da tana lafiyarta, amma yanzu a daren nan zasu zo su tafi taga likita. 

   Bai tsaya tambayarta ko yin shawara da ita ba ya d'auko mata hijab dinta ya shiga sanya mata, ita abin ma dariya ya bata. 

   "Baby taso mu tafi ni hankalina zai kwanta ne kad'ai idan muka dangane da likita". 

  Cikin mamakin maganarshi ta d'an zaro ido tace, "Kai da wannan daren? nifa ina lafiyata don Allah ka bar maganar likitan nan inba so kake ka Nemo min wani ciwon ba ni nace maka fa lafiyata qalou".
    Cikin son tabbatar da abinda ta fad'a ya soma dudduba jikinta yana jin yanayin temperature na jikinta, "babu zafi ko d'aya a jikinki amma meye yasa duk jikinki a sanyaye?". 
    Farouk ya fad'a yana dubanta shima cikin marairaicewa 
    "Tunane tunanen duniya mana" ta fad'a tana k'ok'arin mik'ewa, saurin mayar da ita zaune yayi da hannun shi yace, "me zaki tashi kiyi kuma bayan gani a zaune? Ki fad'a mun damuwar me kike sakawa a ranki bayan kinsan tunani babbar illah ne ga rayuwarki"

   "Insha Allah zan kiyaye" ta fad'a cikin kawar da wancen zancen tace, "to ya kake abban babie ya kasuwar". 

    "Eh to dazu kam ba lafiya ba amma yanzu dana ganki qalou najini nima lafiya qalou, kinsan lafiyata bata cika full sai in kina lafiyarki"

 Murmushi tayi tace, "hakane kam, yanzu dai na dafa maka ruwan wanka sannan yau dai sai dai kayi hak'uri dani nayi girki........".

Page 54 _(fifty four)_



Farouk shiru yayi bayan shubaila ta karanto mishi tambayar, "shin yasan matar shi tazo gurin ta?", yasan dama za'a rina, tun Jiya tunanin shi yake bashi gidan tazo, sai ya rasa abinda zai fad'awa shubaila a lokacin, gashi ta tsare shi da idanunta da suka sauya colour tana son taji ta bakin shi.

   Ganin ba shida niyyar cewa komai sai ta gyara zaman ta zuwa sake fuskantar shi inda ta Soma magana cikin nutsuwa, "kayi hak'uri nasan zaka ji ba dad'i na fad'a maka abinda matarka mafi soyuwa a gareka tayi, to sai dai ba nayi haka da nufin had'a ku rigima ba, a'a sai don kaji ummul'aba'isin abinda zai kawo k'arshen alak'ar mu......."

   Da hanzari ya d'ago kanshi ya kai duban shi gare ta, hawayenta take sharewa da gefen gyalen rigar ta, sai yaji shima zuciyar shi ta karye, saboda bai tab'a tsammanin zata yanke irin wannan hukuncin farat d'aya ba.

   Ci gaba da magana tayi bayan ta sake k'arfafawa kanta da kanta gwiwa, "ina ganin zuwan arfah ya kasance alkhairy gare mu baki d'aya,kada na barka a duhu, arfah ba zagina tazo tayi ba, haka bataci mutunci na ba, amma ta tuna min abinda tunanina bai tab'a tunowa ba, domin ta sanadiyyar zuwan ta na fahimci wasu abubuwan daka kasa fad'a mun da bakin ka, sannan daga kwayar idonta na karanci tanayi maka ninkin son da nake yi maka, kayi hak'urin dai a karo na biyu kuma ka gafarce ni akan kurakuraina, amma lokaci yayi daya kamata na daina yaudarar kaina a kanka, sannan a k'arshe kada ka shiga. rud'ani akan yadda zaka ganar da mahaifina, nida kaina zanyi mishi  bayani yadda zai fahimta, inayi mai yi muku fatan alkhairy a duka rayuwarku, ka tayani addu'a Allah ya bani mijin da zai soni tsakani da Allah kamar yadda kake son matarka".

    Tana gama kora jawabinta ta huce zuwa cikin gidan ta barshi cikin taraddadi, da aikin kiran sunanta, dafe kanshi yayi da hannuwanshi duka yana fad'in, "baby why! Why! Baby kin had'a mun aiki, kin zubar mun da k'ima ta a idon mutanen da suke ganin mutumci na". 
 
 Mik'ewa yayi cikin hanzari ya d'auki mukullin machine d'in shi da wayar shi.

    A mugun fusace ya fuce daga cikin gidan.

 Hajiya husna ce zaune kusa da mai gidan ta abdussamad a katafaren parlon shi, magazine ce a hannunshi yake dubawa inda ita kuma take yanka mishi fruit a bowl. 

    Sunyi shiru kowa da inda tunanin shi ya tafi a tsakaninsu, kafun husna ta katse shirun nasu da fad'in, "abban suhail ni kuwa a gidan gyaran jiki da lallen da nake zuwa sai nake ganin wata yarinya mai kama da matar alhaji jafar balarabiyar nan".

Ita daba Nigerian ba ina taga dangi anan balle a kiga wani cikin danginta mai kama da ita, she's Egyptian and she don't have any one related by blood here" 

    Cikin tabbatar da abinda ta fad'a tace, "of course ina ganin yarinya mai kama da ita a gidansu zainab, kuma kafun na fad'a maka sai dana Soma tabbatarwa ta hanyar duba family pictures kamar matar yaya jafar da yarinyar yayi yawa sosai"

       Wannan karon dariya yayi saboda yasan maybe kawai tunanin tane ya had'a mata kamannin, y'ar jafar d'aya ce a duniya kuma a yadda jafar yayi kud'i yanzu yasan ba abinda zai had'a y'ar shi da rayuwa a irin muhallin da take fad'a, saboda haka don ya gyara mata gurb'ataccen tunanin ta sai ya dube ta da kyau bayan ya karb'i bowl d'in data ke mik'a mishi. "Kina jina husna, kinsan kud'in da jafar yayi kuwa yanzu?  ko waye kai a garin nan indai ba masu muk'ami ba sai kayi wata da watanni kana neman hanyar da zaka ganshi ka tattauna dashi baka samu ba, ina ganin dai ba fatima kika gani ba Asma'u husna ki kara checking". 
    Y'ar dariya tayi tace, "shikenan abban suhail tunda baka yarda dani ba watarana zan kawo maka ita har gida sai ka gani da idanun ka". 

   Murmushi yayi shima yace, "ko kuma kafun nan Nina Kaiki har gidansu ki ganta ba".  

   "Toh shikenan bari dai muga wanda zai riga wani tsakanin mu". 

    Daga haka suka rufe babin wannan hirar suka kamo wata. 
   

     
         @@@@@@@@@@



Satittika sunci gaba da shud'ewa har izuwa watanni har gashi yanzu ana maganar kusan watanni uku cif harda d'oriyar kwanaki uku akai. 
   Abubuwa da yawa sun faru cikin wad'annan watanni, ciki kuwa hadda shigar arfah watan haihuwarta, haka albishir d'in had'uwar alhaji jafar da farouk a washe garin ranar ne, kuma an tabbatar mishi da zai samu ganinshi yana dawowa a washe garin ranar da zaije, farouk shiri mai kyau yayiwa arfah na haihuwa da kuma had'uwar ta da mahaifinta, a lokacin yake so kuma yayi mata bazata da soyayyar shi zazzafa da bayyanar da ita ya zame mishi abu me nauyi kamar dutse. Yayi matukar k'ok'ari da dannar ranshi wajen yak'i da soyayyar daya keyi mata a ranshi har kawo wannan lokacin, rufin asiri kuwa ta gurin kasuwanci ba abinda zamuce sai alhamdulillah, domin kuwa a yanzun ya mallaki abubuwa da yawa harda y'ar madaidaiciyar mota saboda yawan zirga zirgar garuruwa da yake yawan yi, ranar daya kawo wannan mota arfah murna farin ciki har kamar tayi me, ba don nauyi da tayi ba da saitayi driving da kanta daga farkon layi zuwa k'arshe da sunan d'ani 


    A daren ranar da wuri farouk ya kwanta saboda sammakon tashin da zaiyi, arfah kam cikin dare ta kasa bacci saboda mararta da take tsira mata tun rana sannan ga kumburin da k'afafunta Sukayi sosai, ga yawan fad'uwar gaba. Saita sauko daga saman gadon ta shiga bathroom ta dauro alwala ta Soma gabatar da nafilfilinta, a haka shima farouk ya farka ya mara mata baya, ko bayan sun gama sallolin nasu basu sake kwanciya ba, sai gyangyad'i da arfah takeyi kanta gefen kafadarshi tayi shiru tana sauraron yadda jikinta ke karbar ciwon marartata kad'an kad'an. 
    Farouk bayan ya shafa adduar shi Kiran sunanta yayi da kwantaccen sauti, "fatima". 

   D'ago kanta tayi ta dubeshi da idanunta ba tare data amsa ba, shima gyara zamanshi yayi ya soma magana da fad'in, "da gaske bakya jin ciwon komai a jikinki? Bana son nayi tafiyar nan na barki cikin halin ciwo, idan har kinsan baki da lafiya na d'aga tafiyar sai kin warke". 

     Murmushi tayi a lokacinda take kallon kwayar idonshi ba tare da tace komai ba. 

    Shima baice ba sai ci gaba da mayar mata da martanin kallonta da yake yi, ji yake kamar ya futo mata da zuciyarshi ta ganta taga yadda ta mamaye ko ina kota fahimci irin yadda yake sonta da jin kewarta har ta cikin ruhinshi.  
     Abubuwa da yawa yakeji game da tafiyar nan tashi, sai dai yana addu'ar Allah ya kaishi lafiya ya dawo dashi lafiya itama ya rabata da cikin nan lafiya. 
      K'ak'k'arfar ajiyar zuciya ya sauke bayan ya lumshe kwayar idonshi ya sake yin k'asa da muryarshi yace, "yanzu idan akace kin haifi mace wane suna kike ga ya dace a saka mata?". 
    Shiru tayi na d'an lokaci kafun ta bude bakinta da kyar tace, "sunan mahaifiyarka"
   Sosai yaji wani abu ya shige shi da ta fad'i haka amma sai ya shanye ya d'ora mata tambaya ta biyu, "idan namijine fa?"
    "Sunanka" ta fad'a mishi directly. 
    Murmushi yayi still idonshi a kanta ya sake gyara zamanshi kafun yace, "meyasa ba zaki saka sunan mahaifinki ba idan ya kasance namiji?" 
     "Zan saka mana nan gaba idan na sake haifar wani yaron" 
    Murmushin dai har yanzu yake ci gaba dayi mata ya fahimci ta d'an sauko da taimakon naseehar daya keyi mata lokaci bayan lokaci ba gajiyawa don haka sai ya d'ora da maganarshi inda  ya sake fad'in, "kina tunanin zamu ci gaba da rayuwa tare har ki haifa wasu yaran dani wanda zasu ci sunan iyayenmu?". 
  Wani irin kallo yanzun takeyi mishi ba tare data bashi amsa da komai ba, matso da fuskarshi yayi daf da tata ya sumbaci saman idonta, wanda ya tilastata lumshe idon ba tare data shirya ba, "maddam wannan kallon baiyi tsauri ga mijinda bashi da mata ba kuwa? Ina ganin ya kamata a d'an sassauta mun magana mukeyi fa indai ba so kikeyi duk abinda zaki fad'a yabi ta bayan kunne ba" 
Sai lokacin ta d'an d'ago ta dubeshi, ta sake yin k'asa da idanun nata again. 
    "Ya kamata kazo mu kwanta haka saboda gobe zakayi sammako, kuma kasan duk lokacin da zakayi irin wannan tafiyar in bamuyi da gaske ba sai ka makara anxo ana ta kiranka". 

   D'an basarwa yayi yace, "Ni kuma ban gaji da hira da matata bane, akwai abubuwa da yawa da nake son taji daga bakina to amma naga kamar ita bata son ta sani d'in,to babu damuwa dai nasan zaki sansu very soon insha Allah, sannan ni inason idan kin haifi mace kisa mun sunanki, idan namijine kuma kisa mai sunan mahaifinki". 

   Yana gama yin maganarshi ya d'aga ta cak ita da cikin ya d'ora ta akan gado, ya tsaya bayan ya ajiyeta yana fad'in,"wannan babyyy!! Ai saiku karya mun baya,anya kuwa ba twins bane computer ta gano d'aya?, har lokacin ta kasa yin komai sai binshi da ido kawai da takeyi, "na fayi gargadi akan wannan kallon inba so ake a karb'i tukuicinshi a cikin daren nan ba, dama nayi missing kwana da kwanaki" 

  Farouk ma'abocin barkwanci keyin wannan maganar yana k'ok'arin hawa gadon shima, k'afarta ya d'ora saman cinyarshi ya soma massaging kafafun a hankali a hankali, lumshe idanunta tayi ta d'an kishingida kad'an, tun tana iya jinshi da sauraron maganganun shi har wani bacci mai d'an karen dad'i ya sake awon gaba da ita. 


    Lokacin data farka farouk ya fuce tuni, sai wani abu data gani a hannunta da wani d'an k'aramin papper da yayi rubutu a jiki guda biyu. 
   Da sauri ta mik'e zaune ta wattsake idanunta ta Soma duba takardar farko wadda yayi rubutu kamar haka, _"I know many person's say dey love you, but only few can actually prove it, I fight with you, I shout at you, I do misbehave, maybe I even hurt you a lot, but I can't live without you, i wish we are destined to be together forever..........."_

    Arfah ta karanta takardar nan, ta juya ta yafi sau uku a hannunta amma ta rasa yadda zata fassara ko auna maganganun shi gaba d'aya, ganin ba zata fahimci komai a ciki ba sai kawai ta bud'a d'ayar takardar inda yayi short note shima a jiki, 

 _"kiyi hak'uri na barki yau kina ta bacci har rana ba tare da na tasheki sallar asubah ba, bazan iya jure tashinki daga baccin ki mai dad'i ba, amma ki gafarceni, sannan ga pin no na ATM d'ina don Allah in kinji ciwo ko baki duba kowa da komai ba ki dubani da yadda kika d'auke ni a ranki da zaciyarki kije asibiti tare da gwaggwo, ina fatan abinda zan dawo miki dashi a yanzun zakiyi alfahari dani ko rana gobe kiyama, kiyi hak'uri! Kiyi hak'uri! Kiyi hak'uri!! Bansan sau adadi nawa zan maimaita miki wannan kalma ba, a karshe ba Lagos na tafi ba Abuja na tafi"_. 

     Ajiye takardun tayi ta mik'e don gabatar da sallar asubah da ta makara wajen yi a yau ba tare data tsaya yin dogon nazari ko bin ba'asi ba. 

   Bayan ta idar da sallah wayarta ta d'auko ta kira no farouk saboda duk maganganun shi sun jefa ta a duhu dund'um, ya d'aga amma iskar mota fuuu fuu batajin ma abinda yake fad'a da kyar dai taji abinda yace a k'arshe kafun ya kashe wayar, "zan kiraki"


    Koda ta futo parlor tayi mamakin ganin yayi duk ayyukan daya lak'k'abawa kanshi tunda ta samu cikin nan hadda girki ba wanda ya bari, kenan farouk bai koma bacci ba tun wannan farkawar da sukayi, Zama tayi a gefe saboda a yau bata jin cin komai ko yunwar ma sam bataji sai ciwo da yake addabar rayuwarta. 


             @@@@@@@@@



   Hajiya husna tsaye jikin motar mijinta hannunta rik'e da key d'in mota tana danna waya da d'aya hannun nata kuma, lokaci zuwa lokaci kuma ta kan d'aga idonta ta dubi kofar futowa daga cikin gidan nasu. 

    Ta d'an jima tsaye kafun abdussamad ya futo cikin Shirin shi, kafun ya k'araso husna ta k'arasa ta tarye shi da pic in arfah data faki ido ta tura a wayarta bayan ta d'auki hankalinta tun kwanaki, matsala d'aya dai bata da wanda take ita d'aya duk cikin hotunan sai tare da mijinta, bisa ga dole ta tura wanda sukayi da mijin nata. 
   Yau dai ga pic d'in yarinyar nan da nakeyi maka magana a kanta wata da watanni, yau idan ka kaini kar ka tafi sai ka ganta zahiri, zanyi dabara na futo maka da ita plzz". 

   Amsar wayar yayi ba tare daya kalli pic en ba ya k'urawa matar tashi idanu, ya rasa wannan dalili na asmau da takeson lallai saita jona mishi ta jonawa kanta wata yarinya da sunan y'ar gidan alhaji jafar, yarinyar da yaji kwanan nan ashe tun kwanaki ana rad'erad'in ta b'ata sama da shekaru biyu ba'a san inda take ba, watakila ma ta gudu wata kasar ne, tunda yayan masu kud'i ba hankali Suka cika ba, an Tara musu kudi har sun rasa yadda zasuyi dashi. 
    "Don Allah abban suhail yau dai ka tsaya kaga yarinyar nan na tabbata zaka yadda da abinda nake fad'a"
      Murmushi yayi ya mik'a mata wayarta yace, "ba damuwa husna yau dai zamuje naga yarinyar nan da kike ta maganar ta"
   Cikin happy ta kewaya mazaunin driver ta zauna, shi kuma ya zauna a gefenta bayan ya bud'ewa mammie gidan baya, 
   "Wato yau ni d'an gata ne tunda zanje naga mai kama da y'arki"

   Murmushi tayi tace, "humm abban suhail Allah yasa kada reshe ya juye da mujiya kaji shock in kaga abinda nake fad'a maka". 
    Dariya kawai yayi donshi jin duk maganganun nata yake kamar tatsuniya. 

   Har suka k'arasa babu wanda yace da d'an uwanshi kanzil, sai tarin farin ciki daya bayyana a fuskar husna har ya hana bakinta rufuwa, hakan yasa abdussamad kasa barin kallonta duk bayan wasu mintuna saiya juya ya kalleta. 


        @@@@@@@@@@@



Ita kuwa arfah tana zaune har zuwa wannan lokacin ta kasa nutsuwa, burinta kawai ta samu kira daga farouk da tabbacin ya sauka lafiya, sai dai gashi har kusan rabin rana babu kiranshi, ga ciwonta daya lafa d'azu yanzu sai sake tsananta yake, ga fad'uwar gaba da wani irin bak'on yanayi data riski kanta a ciki da bata San abinda ya assasashiba. 

    Ta shiga d'akinta zuwa parlor ta futo yafi sau shurin masaki, so take taji kira daga gareshi sai ta kira gwagwwo ta rakata hospital taje taga likita saboda ciwon nan ya soma yi mata zafi har yana neman yafi k'arfin jurewarta. 
   Ta shiga bathroom ta futo kenan a tsorace wayarta tayi ring, sai ta d'auko wayar da sauri ta duba, sunan farouk data gani yana yawo akan screen d'in yasa ta saurin picking kiran without any waste of time. 
    Tana karawa a kunnenta ko sallamar da tayi ba'a tsaya amsawa ba aka soma isar mata da mummunar sak'on da bazai tab'a gogewa a cikin dodon kunnenta ba, sak'on daya zamo tsanin rugujewar duk wani farin cikin rayuwarta a karo na biyu. 
    "Maddam kece wadda mai wannan wayar yayi magana da ita last, yanzu haka muna magana dake daga iyakar kaduna da Abuja inda suka samu accident motarshi ta kama da wuta babu abinda ya tsira sai wayar nan data fad'o da kuma brief case......"

  Ai ba'a kai karshen wannan mummunar waya da ita ba ta yanke jiki ta fad'i k'asa ba numfashi. 


     _Baya kad'an_.


Da misalin k'arfe shida na safiyar ranar alkhamis d'in farouk ya gama shirin shi cikin yadin daya sha d'inki irin na matasan wannan zamanin ya tsaya da kyau a jikinshi, hula yasa da takalmi ya fesa turaren shi mai kamshi, jakar kayanshi ya d'auko kala biyu da mukullin motarshi, har ya kammala wannan shiri arfah bacci takeyi sadidan, goshinta ya sumbata da lips dinta yadda ba zata tashi ba a hankali da sauti k'asa k'asa yace, "I will miss you". 

   Daga haka ya d'auki fallen paper biyu yayi mata d'an rubutu a jiki ya nufi hanyar futa yana waigenta, harya futa ya sake dawowa da baya ya d'ora hannunshi akan cikinta yayi mata addu'o'i sannan ya sake fucewa. 

    Bai tsaya bata lokaci ba ya kira guy d'in da zaiyi mishi jagora Kai tsaye zuwa ga P. A d'in nashi dake da Zama anan garin Abuja, shi kuma guyen yana zaune a Lagos ne amma yana hanyarshi ta zuwa Abujan shima a ranar dai. 

     
    Yayi neesa sosai don har ya kusa futa daga kaduna Kiran arfah ya riske shi,ya d'aga amma baya jinta don haka sai ya bata uzurin zai kirata, a hanyar futa wajen gari ne yaga kamar y'an container na abinsha kuma baya raba d'ayan biyu za'a iya samun recharge card a gurinsu, Allah ya taimakeshi ya samu catin sai dai yana shiga cikin motar wata mota tayi shut da motarshi wayar hannunshi ta dako tsalle ta fad'o waje ita kuma motar ta kama da wuta. Mutanen da kusan komai ya faru akan idonsu sukayo caaaaa suna salati da sallallami saboda bai dad'e da barin gurin suba wannan accident d'in ya faru kamar almara kamar a mafarki


   Su kansu ma'aikatan da aka kira tsabar firgicin da Suka shiga ne yasa Suka mance shaf da abinda ya kamata suyi har sai bayan wanda ya fad'awa arfah sak'on ya katse wayar sannan ogansu ya ankara da abinda yayi, aikuwa ya balbale shi da masifa akan abinda yayi. 

   Shidai hak'uri kawai ya bayar tunda har aikin gama ya riga ya gama. 



  _Allahu akhbar! Dama ita rayuwar duniya haka take, yau kaine gobe ba kaine ba, kuma kullunafsin zaa'ik'atul maut, a yau farouk ya amsa kiran mahaliccinmu, ga arfah kuma kwance bata numfashi,sannan ko meye alak'ar husna, abdussamad da fatima arfah?_. 

  
    
*_Yanzu zaku shiga asalin labarin ahali d'aya, ku dai ku kasance tare da👇_*
   *Mareeyert* 💞 taku
