Page 57 _(fifty seven)_



Abinka da rayuwa ba ruwan wani da wani a gidan, a k'alla Saida arfah tayi cikakken minti goma sha biyar kwance bata numfashi ba tare da wani ya sani ko ya ankara a gidan ba, har saida abdussamad ya kawo husna ta shigo cikin gidan, da yake tafiyar kusan ta arfahn ce gaisawa kawai tayi dasu zainab ta nufi part d'in arfahn Kai tsaye, sai dai yanayin data ganta a ciki ya tsoratata har bata san lokacin da tayi kanta da gudu tana faman Kiran sunan taba, ganin babu alamun rai ko inda yake motsi a jikin ta sai tayi hanyar futa daga gidan da gudu gudu, inda tabar abdussamad tsaye jikin motarshi yana k'arewa gidan da husna matarshi ta kawo shi da sunan wai taga jinin sofiyyah a ciki kallo. 
   A kid'ime tayo inda yake tana yi mishi magana a rikice, "ta mutu! Yarinyar da nake fad'a maka ta rasu abdussamad gata can bata ko motsi......". 

   Jijjigata abdussamad yayi don ta dawo cikin cikakkiyar nutsuwarta yana fad'in, "ki kalle ni sosai Asma'u wacece ta mutun?". 
     "Yarinyar mana abban suhail!!! Yarinyar da nake fad'a maka fa......". 

     Ta k'arasa fad'a tana fashewa da wani irin kuka mai ban tausayi, shiru yayi kawai yana kallonta ya rasa ma abinda ya kamata yayi, shi dai har yanzu bai tabbatar da yarinyar da take gani jinin jafar bace, balle har ya kaiga fahimtar abinda take magana yanzu a kai. 

    "Kazo muje abban suhail bata da kowa a garin nan sai mu, muje ko hospital mafi kusa ne mu kaita plzzz......"
    Husna ce meyin wannan maganar tana rik'o hannun abdussamad cikin rashin sanin abinyi. 
     Binta yayi har zuwa k'ofar gidan sannan ya coge yace, "husna ki soma nema mun iso tunda gida duk matan aure ma shiga babu neman izinin su haka?"
 
     Hucewa tayi zuwa cikin gidan, ko second goma batayi ba kuma ta sake dawowa tace, "zaka iya shigowa yanzu". 

   Ita ta Soma yin gaba yana biye da ita a baya har zuwa cikin d'akin arfahn, har lokacin tana kwance babu numfashi, ita ta soma d'ago ta sannan abdussamad ya k'arasa shima ya durk'usa yana kallon fuskarta. 
    "Da gaske kuwa husna takeyi fatiman ce! Abin mamaki abin al'ajabi da kuma saka mutum shiga rud'ani, ko rantsuwa yayi ba zaiyi kaffara ba duk inda wannan yarinyar ta futo jinin jafar ce, kuma dai jafar kowa yasan y'ar shi d'aya ce Fatima, to idan kuwa hakane meya had'a fatima da rayuwa a irin wannan muhallin? Bayan jafar da sofiyyah suna raye basu mutu ba, kuma arzik'in su yana nan bai raurawa ba, wannan dama wasu tarin tamboyin nashi zai samu amsoshin sune kad'ai daga bakin ita wannan yarinya da take kwance, to amma ta yaya? Ita da husna tace ta rasu shima kuma gashi yaga shaida don babu inda ke motsawa a jikinta". 
     "Ya kamata mu kaita asibiti ko za'a samu abinda yake cikinta a raye....."
  Husna ta fad'a a lokacin da ta shiga duba mukullin d'akin nasu. 
   Ita ce cikin tashin hankali kuma ita take iya bada shawara akan yadda za'ayi, sab'anin abdussamad daya kame a guri d'aya yana ta jujjuya maganganu da yawa a cikin ranshi. 

   Shine yayi k'arfin halin d'auko ta ya nufi hanyar futa d ita a hannunshi kamar jaririya.
    Duk matan gidan mik'ewa tsaye sukayi suna kallonsu da mugun mamaki, sai kuma jikinsu yayi sanyi har aka fuce da ita daga gidan babu wanda ya iya cewa ko kanzil. 

     Yana zuwa kai tsaye a gidan baya ya kwantar da ita husna ta shiga kusa da ita ta zauna, shi kuma ya shiga mazaunin driver . 
     Da gudu yaja motar ya futa daga layin cikin k'ok'ari da son ceto rayuwar wad'annan bayin Allah guda biyu, _ita da kuma abinda ke cikinta_ yayi iya yinshi wajen ganin sun isa asibitin mallam aminu Kano a d'an tak'aitaccen lokaci. 
   Allah ya taimakeshi akwai wani abokin shi a emergency ya kira shi aka zo aka d'auke ta a gadon marassa lafiya aka shiga bata taimakon gaggawa. 
    Duk sun kasa Zama daga husna har mijinta, banda kuka ba abinda takeyi, ita ta dad'e da fudda rai arfah ta mutu, shiyasa a yanzu burinta kawai shine a samu a ciro abinda ke cikinta da sauran numfashi,  hatta mammie da take yarinya bata san abinda ake ciki ba kuka takeyi ganin umminta na kuka. 

   Alhamdulillah likitoci sun gano cewa bata mutu ba amma fa duk da haka tana risk, ko rayuwa ko mutuwa, gashi abinda yake cikinta neman hanyar futa yakeyi amma ba zata iya haihuwar da kanta ba, dole sai dai ayi mata operation in less than 1 hour a cire yaron ko yarinyar, idan ba haka ba za'a iya rasa su gaba d'aya. 

    Lokacin da doctor ya shaidawa su husna wannan mummunar labarin hannu ta d'ora aka kawai ta rushe da ihu, gani take arfah ta mutu tuntuni abinda ke cikinta ma ya mutu rufa rufa kawai sukeyi musu. 
    Abdussamad ganin zasuyi biyu babu, ga baisan yadda zai samu mijinta ba, ita kuma wadda ta sani ta kasa aikata komai sai kuka sai ya nufi inda take don ya nusar da ita halin da ake ciki. 
    Sai dai duk yadda yaso ta shiga hankalinta tayi mishi cikakken bayani abin ya faskara, har saida ta fusatashi ya d'aga mata murya a cikin mutane, "an fad'a miki Fatima bata mutu ba ana bukatar za'a yi mata CS ne urgently, ke kuma kin zauna anan zaki k'arasa kasheta da wannan kukan naki da bansan ma'anarshi ba, a halin yanzu babu soyayyar da zaki nuna mata wadda tafi kiyi mata addu'ah, ki kuma fad'a mun waye mijinta na nemo shi yasa hannu ayi mata abinda ya dace......". 

     Shiru tayi tana share hawayenta, ita kanta abinda takeson tayi mata d'in kenan toh amma she can't hold her tears, cox ita ce kad'ai tsanin da zata cika burin abdussamad na shekara da shekaru da yake dashi tun kafun auren su da ita, yanzu idan akace ta mutu ai duk komai ya k'are musu, abdussamad kullum tsoratata yake da maganar ganin jafar wai yafi ganin sarki ma wahala......

  "Asma'u waye mijinda take aure?"
    Ya tambayeta yana kallonta. 
    "Nima ban san shi ba"
Ta fad'a jikinta a sanyaye. 
     "Ya Salam!"
  Abdussamad ya fad'a yana dafe kanshi da duka hannuwanshi. 
    Ya jima shiru kafun ya sake d'agowa ya dubeta tunowa da wani abu da yayi  kuma sai yace da ita, "bani pic d'in Fatima na d'azu da kika so ki nuna mun". 

  Ba musu ta d'auko wayar ta shiga ma'ajiyar hotunanta ta mik'a mishi. 
  Karb'a yayi a dai dai kuwa idonshi ya sauka akan wani hotonsu da sukayi tare da farouk sunyi ankon shadda, selpie ne ya d'auke su ta kwantar da kanta a kafad'arshi tana dariya shi kuma ya kalleta, hoton ya k'urawa ido yana ganin wani abu kamar a mafarki, "lallai alk'awarin Allah baya tashi, Umar farouk ne mijin nata?" 
   Sai ya juyo ya dubi husna yace, "husna wannan shine mijin nata kin tabbata?". 
   "Shine nidai a wayarta na turo duk tare sukayi kuma.... Amma me yake faruwa ne, anyi wani abun ne? Naji kana wata magana"

    Sake jinjina kanshi yayi ya mik'a mata wayarta, shap ya manta da wani batun halinda ake ciki ya lula duniyar tunanin abinda ya faru shekaru ashirin da d'oriya. 

    A haka doctor ya sake dawowa inda suke ya tambayesu ko mijin nata yazo. 
    "Bamu San inda zamu sameshi ba likita...."

  "To kai ya kuke da ita ne?" 
Doctor ya tambaya
   "Y'ar *yayana* ce" abdussamad ya fad'a mishi kai tsaye. 
   
    Toh tunda babu mijinta babu iyayenta Barr kai ka wakilce su mana tunda y'ar kace ai babu matsala, don bakusan risk d'in da take ciki bane". 
    "A inane zan saka hannun?"
   Ya tambaya bayan ya mik'e tsaye, tare suka tafi da doctor zuwa office d'inshi Suka bar husna zaune tana tsammanin warabbuka abinda zaije yazo. 
 
    

                *************


Alhamdulillah zamu ce tunda likitoci sunyi operation sun ciro santalelen yaro mai kama da mahaifinshi kamar an tsaga kara. 

   Ita kuma mahaifiyar suka sake rufawa a kanta saboda har yanzu sun kasa samun yadda suke so daga gareta. 
     Hamdala kawai husna da abdussamad sukeyi a lokacinda aka kawo musu yaron likitoci sun gyare shi tsab gwanin sha'awa. 

  
     _After two days_


Kasa jurar ganin arfah nayi cikin mawuyacin hali bayan an cire abinda ke cikinta, hakan yasa na koma gida na zauna har sai bayan kwanaki biyu na sake komawa. 

   Da sallama na shiga amenity na AKTH, da hajiya husna na soma cin karo zaune rungume da jariri a hannu tana ta kallon fuskarshi ko ido ta kasa k'iftawa, a gefenta kuma wasu yarane guda biyu duk maza, d'ayan zai kai a kalla shekara tara, d'ayan kuma shida, sai mammie da take zaune kusa da abbanta daya had'a kai da gwiwa yayi shiru tana ta faman zuba mishi surutu. 

   Kwance a gadon marassa lafiya kuwa arfah ce take bacci, ta rame sai Karan hancinta daya sake futowa zirrr da hasken fatarta. 
    Ramar da tayi dole inka ganta saika tausaya mata mai karatu. 
    Bacci takeyi sadidan na dole wanda likitoci suka sussurk'ud'a mata allura suka kirkiro mata shi koda bata shirya mishi ba. 

    Shiru yaci gaba da wanzuwa kamar babu kowa a d'akin har na kusan k'arin minti 30.
    
    Kukanta da maganganun data somayi cikin bacci shi ya d'auki hankalin su duk sukayi kanta, idonta a rufe yake rufff haka jikinta babu inda yake kwakkwaran motsi sai hannunta da takai saitin zuciyarta. 
    Fuskarta a yamutse take haka ruwan hawaye yana biyowa ta kuncinta a hankali yana sauka, magana takeyi k'asa k'asa wadda saida abdussamad ya saka kunne sosai sannan yaji abinda take fad'a.  "kada ka tafi....... Idan ka barni nima mutuwar zanyi........ Farouk ina sonka don Allah ka zauna tare dani........"

  Abinda take ta maimaitawa kenan a fatar bakinta, da sauri husna ta mik'awa abdussamad yaron ta tafi ta kirawo doctor, gudun samuwar wata matsalar. 

 Ko daya zo ya ganta Ya fad'a musu babu wata matsala, kukan da batayi bane takeyi yanzu, kuma shine kad'ai zai zamo sauk'i a gareta, insha Allah zata farka cikin hayyacinta, sai dai yana da kyau a lallab'ata ta shayar da yaronta saboda madara kad'ai ba zata iya gamsar dashi shiba dole yana buk'atar d'umin jikinta. 
    
     "Insha Allah doctor za'ayi yadda kuke so"
  
   Daga haka sukayi sallama ya fuce daga d'akin. 
  "Abberh ita wannan d'in wacece?". 
    Suhail ya tambayi abban nasu bayan ya gama k'arewa arfah kallo. 

  Kamo hannunsu abdussamad yayi yace, "auntyn kuce kuzo muje gida ai kun ganta, in kukayi sallah sai ku dinga yi mata addu'ah ko". 

   Suhail ne ya sake cewa, "toh abberh ita d'in meye sunanta ne?"
    "Fatima ku muje tambayar ta isa haka...."
   Ya dakatar da surutun su saboda su kyaleshi yaji da abinda yake damun shii tukun. 

    Kusa da husna ya matsa jikinshi a sanyaye bayan ya sake kallon fuskar yaron yace, "asmah da gaske mahaifin yaron nan ya rasu fa, jiya da dare ban koma gida ba Saida na biya police station na karb'i wayarshi da briefcase daya futa dashi...... Innalillahi wa'inna ilaihi raji'un, dukkan mai rai mamaci ne, Umar ya mutu a lokacinda yake gab da samun cikar burinshi, ni yanzu damuwata d'aya Fatima da jaririn nan, nasan zaki kula dasu yadda ya kamata amma duk da haka ki kula saboda kinsan a yanayin da take tashi......."
     Yana gama yin maganar ya juya ya fuce daga d'akin rik'e da hannun su suhail yana k'ok'arin b'oye hawayenshi. 

   Ita kanta husna kifa kanta tayi jikin k'arfen gadon ta saki siririn kuka na tausayin arfah da yaron data haifa, bata san farouk d'in nan ba hasalima bata tab'a ganinshi ba, amma mutuwarshi ta shiga ranta daram ta zauna ta yadda ta kasa mantawa da lokacinda ake sanar dasu ya samu accident har yanzu tana jin zancen a cikin kunnenta. 
     Abinda ya faru kuwa shine, bayan an ciro jaririn an samu kan arfah kad'an sai sukayi tunanin su kira farouk d'in a waya su sanar dashi halinda ake ciki, husna da kanta tayi tattaki zuwa gidan, tana shiga parlon bata sha wahala wajen nemar inda wayarta take ba ta ganta kife a k'asa inda arfah ta fad'i. 
    Abin duk yazo musu da sauk'i saboda wayar ba security ko d'aya a kanta. 
   Sai data dawo hospital sannan ta kira shi, bayan sun gaisa da police d'in daya d'aga wayar, yaso yaji dangantakar su da mai wayar, inda ba b'ata lokaci abdussamad ya karb'a yayi musu bayanin d'an yayan sane. 
     Da yake wannan d'in mai hankaline ba irin wanda ya kira arfah ba, sai daya soma yi musu kalamai masu kwantar da hankali sannan ya sanar dasu yadda accident d'in ya faru, a k'arshe dai anan sukaji ummul'aba'isin tashin labourn arfah babu shiri da kuma fad'awarta cikin mawuyacin hali, irin wannan sak'on da sukaji yanzu ta samu a lokacin itama. 
    Su kansu sun shiga shock, tun daga ranar husna take kuka har yanzu bata daina ba, duk lokacin data kalli arfah ta kalli jaririn sai taji zuciyarta ta karaya, har sai ta zubar musu da hawaye. 

      Dama haka rayuwar duniya take, duk yadda zakayi baka Isa ka gujema k'addarar kaba, a washe garin ranar abdussamad yayi k'arfin hali ya karb'o wayar shi da briefcase d'in kamar yadda Suka fad'a zasu aiko dashi zuwa kano tunda  shi d'in yana da Zama ne a can. 




   _kuyi hak'uri jama'ah ba laifina bane da nace farouk ya rasu, a'a haka salon labarin yazo, ai a rayuwa ba komai ne kake so kuma ka rayu tare dashi ba, kuma da farouk ya mutu sai akace rayuwar arfah ma ta kare? Ai har yanzu akwai sauran ruwa a kaba, abu d'aya zakuyi mata as her followers shine ku tayata karb'ar k'addarar ta da hannu bibbiyu ku mara Mata baya don ganin yadda zataci gaba da rayuwarta nan gaba_


_Da wannan nake cewa Allah ya jik'an Umar farouk, ku dai kuci gaba da kasancewa da *Ahali d'aya* don ganin yadda wannan k'ulli zai kwance ga wani nan ma kuma ahalinsu d'aya_. 

 
_Kuyi hak'uri a satin nan ma muna da biki, mu tara ko zuwa ko Sunday ne, bagode bissalam_

Page 59 _(fifty nine)_



 Ya auna ya shek'a ya juya ya duba yaga tambayar tata ita kad'aice maslaha, sai ya sake gyara zamanshi yana fuskantarta yace, "Fatima ina son nasan abubuwa da yawa game dake, kamar labarin rayuwarki bayan kun dawo 9ja da kuma matakin karatunki, da yadda ma kika auri farouk d'an k'anin abie d'inki bayan sun raba hanya tsawon shekaru basa tare, suka kasance manyan abokan gabar juna kuma mak'iya, ina fatan dai hakan bazai zama matsala ba...?".
     Shiru tayi bayan ta gama sauraron abinda ya fad'a, ita kanta tana son taji abinda ya raba iyayensu ya tarwatsa Ahali guda suke rayuwa a mabanbantan gurare tamkar basu da kowa. 
    "Babu damuwa uncle ni kaina ina son naji yadda ahalinsu abbie ya rushe, kuma mahaifinta tunda ka santa shin bata da dangi ne?". 
   Murmushi abdussamad yayi yace, "zan baki tarihin komai amma kafun nan ina sauraronki....". 
 "Toh ni dai naci gaba da karatuna a wata private boarding school dake Abuja, bayan na gama kuma Abbie ya nema mun addmision a SOAS University dake London (England) a Bloomsbury dake central London  inda na Soma karantar accounting and finance, Ina level 2H end of year holiday ya same mu na dawo gida hutu, anan ne k'addarar data had'ani da farouk ta Soma......... " 
    Bata iya k'arasa maganar ta ba tayi shiru tana jinjina nauyin maganar da zata fad'a a ranta, a yanzu komai daya danganci farouk bason jinshi ko tunashi takeyi ba, saboda a duk lokacin da ta lula tunanin shi mai zurfi takan dawo da mutuwar shi sabuwa dal a zuciyarta.

    "Ehen! Ina sauraron ki fatima"
   Uncla ya fad'a yana kallonta. 
   Ci gaba da bashi labarinta tayi tun daga kan yadda fareeda ta dinga kitsa mata makirci har abinda yayi sanadiyyar had'uwar ta farouk da taimakonta da yayi, da yadda ammie ta yanke mata hukunci cikin fushi ba tare da bin ba'asi ko zuzzurfan bincike ba. 
    Daga nan ta d'ora da bashi labarin bayan tahowarsu garin kano da tarin alkhairan da farouk yayi mata a rayuwa bata b'oye musu komai ba. 

     Duk shiru sukayi a lokacin da takai aya a dai dai inda ta samu mummunar sak'on mutuwarshi. 
    Tausayinta da ya zame musu d'abi'a bayan kallon duk wani motsinta a gidan suka had'u da al'ajabi cakud'e da mamakin yadda komai ya faru da ita kamar a firm ko rubutu, da gaske ashe ana iya samun mutum mai irin wannan sadaukarwar da kuma soyayyar, lallai dole arfah ba zata tab'a manta da farouk ba, domin ya nuna mata halacci na gaske da a cikin maza y'an halak ma samun irinshi sai an tona. 
   Idan wani ne zai iya yin nashi guri ya barta da wahala amma sai baiyi ba, ya juri sanyi, zafi, ruwa da iska duk don kawai ya nemo abinda zai rufa mata asiri ko bai yiwa kanshi ba, ko zai kwana da yunwa kuwa, a zamansu babu wanda ya furta yana son d'an uwanshi a fatar baki, amma a aikace sun nuna asalin soyayyah, ma'anarta, da yadda ake sadaukarwah. Dama kalmar ina sonki/ina sonka bai kamata ta tsaya kad'ai a fatar baki ba. Domin tabbatarwa yana da kyau a gani a aikace. 

   Gyaran murya abdussamad yayi bayan d'aukar lokaci mai tsayi shiru sannan ya ce,
    "Toh dama haka rayuwa take, duk abinda mutum ya shuka a rayuwarshi khairan au sharran wata rana shi zai girba, k'addarar ki, abinda ya faru da rayuwarki duk munsan abune rubutacce daga indallah, kuma alk'awarin Allah baya tashi, kamar yadda ammienki ta alk'awartawa farouk ke tun kina cikin showel d'inki kamar sadauki shuraim gashi ubangiji ya cika wannan alk'awari, Fatima a irin rayuwarda kika taso da yadda kika tafi da tsarin rayuwarki gaba d'aya farouk bai Isa ya rabi ko inuwarki ma ya tsaya ba balle...., toh amma da yake babu wani abu daya gagari ubangiji sai gashi ya mallaka mishi ke kun zauna tare k'ark'ashin inuwa guda matsayin ma'aurata. Fatima Ni bansan irin rayuwar da kikayi ba, amma nasan duk inda yaya jafar yake a lokacin kuma ko yanzu zan fad'a miki inda yake,  idan naso ma zan kaiki har can gurinshi, sai dai abu d'aya yasa na kasa nemanshi duk tsawon wannan shekarun, duk da tarin alkhairan da yayi mun a rayuwa, dalilin kywa baya rasa nasaba da rikicin cikin ahalinmu, Amma a yanzu anzo geji, ta sanadinki komai yazo k'arshe, zan nemo jafar na dank'a ki a hannunshi bayan kin soma karatu a jami'ar da nake nema miki addmision, saboda nima ina son kulawa da rayuwarki ta dawo hannuna keda sadauki.". 

   Cikin wani irin yanayi tace, "uncle bana son ganin shi, a y'an kwanakin da suka gabata da naseehar farouk daya ke yimun kullum ba gajiyawa naji ina son nasan inda suke tabbas, naji ina son na nemo su ko Allah zaisa su gane gaskiya komai ya huce, sai dai yanzu da farouk ya tafi ba tare da shi ya had'u da nashi iyayen ba duk da yadda yake matukar sonsu da kewarsu sai naji ni na sare, uncle farouk ya tafi iyayenshi suna fushi dashi akan abinda yake ba haka ba, kuma ya tafi ba tare da yaje garesu sun gane gaskiya ba. Uncle  taya kake tunanin zan koma ga nawa iyayen bayan ni dashi duk tare muka tafi da fushin su akanmu, shin ban sauke nashi hak'k'in ba ni da nake raye na sauke nawa? Idan nayi haka ai kamar naci amanarshi ne saboda naga k'asa ta rufe mishi ido koh......".
    Sai ta kasa k'arasa maganarta saboda hawayenda take ta k'arfin halin dannewa ya kai gejin da bazai rik'u ba. 
    "Yana da kyau ki had'u da mahaifinki kuwa? Saboda yana can cikin kewarki da mawuyacin halin rashinki da rashin sanin inda zai sameki, a kwanakin baya can naga hotunanki suna yawo a media hadda alk'awarin kud'ad'e masu nauyi ga duk wanda ya samo ki, Fatima kisawa zuciyarki salama ki fahimci mahaifinki a dai dai, ina da tabbacin abinda aka fad'a miki akanshi ba dai dai ba ne, ko kinsan a halin yanzu shi kad'ai yake rayuwarshi.......? Mahaifiyarki data korekin sun rabu tun bayan kwanaki kad'an da tafiyarki". 

     Magana take sonyi amma kuka ya hana mata damar haka, sai girgiza kai da takeyi kawai. 
    Shima abdussamad girgiza mata kan yake irin yadda takeyi mishi, "Fatima mahaifinki bashi da kowa sai ke idan har baso kike ya k'arasa kaiwa k'asa ba ki fahimce shi ki fahimci gaskiya don Allah, Ni na fahimci duka uzururrukan ki, ki Soma zuwa gareshi kafun a samo inda mahaifin farouk yake.

Cikin muryar kuka yanzun take fad'in, "uncle don Allah kabar maganar nan saboda farouk ba zan iya yi yadda kake so ba, Ni kaina ruhina da zuciyata duka suna gareshi amma ina son na fara sanin inda ummie da baffan farouk suke tukun, so nake na Soma sauke nauyin shi kafun na sauke nawa nauyin wannan shine abinda nake buri, sannan na dad'e inaji a jikina zan iya gyara waccan rusashshiyar alak'ar duk da bansan abinda ya rusata ba, maganar makaranta ma don Allah kabarshi, I'm now hopeless, komai dake cikin wannan duniyar ya sire mun", 
   "Yana da kyau ki farfad'o kuwa kisan cewa ke har yanzu a raye kike, idan Allah ya k'addara zaki rayu nan gaba sama da shekara talatin a duniya sai kin cika wannan wa'adin sannan zaki barta, to kinga ashe kina da sauran ruwa a kaba". 
Kuka takeyi sosai saboda uncle ya gama soso Mata inda ya dad'e yanayi Mata kaikayi, cikin muryar kukan dai da rauni a muryarta taci gaba da fad'in,
  "Uncle please wannan labari Sam ba mai Dad'in ji bane, na rayu 4more than 30 years doing what...... Don Allah ku kyaleni da rayuwata haka idan ba haka ba kuma zaku wayi gari wataran kuga babu ni a cikin gidanku.......". 
    
    Murmushi hallau dai yayi duk da ya tsorata da furucinta na zata gudu tabar mishi gidanshi, kuma yasan zata iya, "wannan shine kad'ai abinda kike so? Kinyi alk'awarin zaki je ga mahaifinki idan har iyayen farouk sun karb'e ki?". 
   "Tabbas nayi alk'awari uncle". 

"Toh shi kenan mamana ni nayi alk'awarin zan nemo miki baffan farouk duk inda yake a fad'in duniya, amma abinda nake so ki fahimta da karatun ki shine, zaki rage yawan tunani da lokacin jira, idan kuma har yanzu bakya so d'in shikenan sai a kyake maganar karatun kawai. maganar gyara b'araka kuma ki daina tunaninta don tuni wanda sukayi b'arakar sun dad'e da d'inke ta cikin k'iyayyah da rashin sani....."

  Bata fahimci yaren nashi sosai ba amma ta gane rabin abinda yake nufi, 
   Shuraim da yake bacci a bayanta ne ya farka yana ta tsanyara kuka, dole ta sauke shi ta maida shi kafad'a tana jijjigashi. 
     Tashi yayi bayan ya mik'a mata kud'i masu yawa ya nufi side d'inshi. 

   Kud'in ma anan ta barshi tayi dakinta sai auntie husna ce tabi bayanta dasu. 

   

                *************


Kwana biyu a tsakani uncle ya d'auke ta da yamma ya k'arasa yi mata shirye shiryen duk daya kamata. 
     Kusan komai yi mata za'ayi saboda yana da hanya mai kyau ta b'angaren ilimi. 

     Tun daga lokacin da uncle abdussamad ya yi mata magana akan mahaifinta yaji dalilinta ya tattara maganar mahaifinta ya ajiye a gefe, ya shiga neman inda zai samu ibraheem mahaifin farouk, gashi tun kwanaki da dad'ewa yaji labarin suna gari d'aya da jafar, yanzu kuma an bincika mishi baya anguwar kuma duk layin babu wanda yasan inda ya koma. 

     Toh cikin wata biyu kwarara addmision d'inta ya futo, inda ta samu gurbin karatu a jami'ar bayero dake Kano. 

    Rana ta farko data fara zuwa makaranta ta tabbatar da duk a iya zamanta a garin kano bata ga komai ba, yanzun taga asalin yadda ake rayuwa a k'asarta da karatu mai wahala. Basuyi karatu ranan ba hakan yasa suka tashi da wuri, jira na minti biyar cikakke batayi ba ta samu napep d'in da zata koma gida, anan ne kuma akayi drama saboda auntie husna ce ta kawo ta d'azu, yanzu kuma da zata koma sai bata San yadda zata ce sunan anguwar ba. 
    Gashi wayar da uncle ya kawo mata tsabar bata damu ba a gida ta barta, sai kawai ta sallamu me napep d'in ta sami gefe guda ta tsaya, ga shuraim da yake bayanta sai mutsu mutsu yakeyi, ita dai a ranta addu'ah takeyi kada ya tashi yanzu don batasan yadda zatayi dashi ba, ga gajiya ga yunwa ga uwar jaka, uwa uba ga yaro. 

  Addu'ar ta bata karb'u ba kuwa don kukan da bata so d'in ne ya fashe dashi. 
     Ajiyar Jakarta tayi a k'asan wata bishiya ta sauko shi ta soma kiciniyar bashi ruwa, sai dai yaro kamar yasan abinda akeyi yak'i karb'a sai kukan da yake ta tsalawa. 
     Mayar dashi bayan tayi ta shiga jijjigashi hannunta rik'e da jakarta tana faman zare ido da tunanin yadda zatayi da rayuwarta. 
     Duk wanda yazo hucewa sai ya kalleta saboda yadda tayi kamar bak'uwar bafulatanar da tazo daga jeji a gurin, duk wannan wayewar, duk wannan ajin da gayun a halin yanzu babu su a tattare da ita. Gashi kaf mutanen da suke huceta a gurin babu wanda ya tsaya don yaji abinda ke faruwa da ita sai wasu rukunin y'an mata da har sun huceta suka dawo suna tambayarta, "me yake damunta ki sauke shi mana idan baya son goyon". 

   Da wani irin yanayi akan fuskarta ta dubesu kamar zata ce wani abu sai kuma tayi shiru, suma basu sake ce da ita k'ala ba sukayi gaba suka barta a nan. 
   Ganin lokaci nata ja babu auntie husna babu labarinta sai ta Soma tunanin yadda zatayi in auntie bata zo d'aukar ta ba, a take rahama da jama'ar gidansu suka fad'o ranta, ita har mantawa take da rayuwar wad'annan bayin  Allah ma, ko ya suke, ko sunsan abinda ya sameta? Shin ina gwagwwo tasu salman? Da auntie Sarah, ameenatu da haleematu, duk bata san ko sunji rasuwar farouk ba. 
    Allah sarki rayuwa ita kuma a halin yanzu bata son tuna ko son duk abinda ya danganci farouk da abinda yazo ta sanadiyyar shi, tana tsaka da y'an tunane tunanen nan shuraim ya sake tsanyarewa da wani sabo kuma gigitaccen kuka. 
     Wannan karon had'a kanta tayi da bishiya kawai tana sauraron sautin kukan yaron. 

   Kamar daga sama taji muryar uncle a bayanta ya kirayi sunanta, "Fatima!". 
    "Na'am Uncle". Ta fad'a da sauri tana juyawa bayanta don ta duba. 
   Shine a tsaye bayanta kuwa, wata irin ajiyar zuciya ta sauke da sauri ta d'auki jakarta ta nufi motarshi, a take kuma ta shiga karyata kanta da kanta akan barazanar da tayi na guduwa ta bar gidan uncle d'in. 
     Da hanzari ta bud'e mazaunin kusa da driver ta zauna, shikuma ya bud'e driver seat. 
   Sauke shuraim tayi daga bayanta da kukanshi yasa uncle tunanin ko bashi da lafiya ne. 
    Ita dai bata San ya zatayi da rayuwarta ba don haka sai kawai ta kife kanta ta fashe da kuka. 
   "Yaaa Salam Fatima kuka kuma? As a mother u have to be very strong". 
    "Uncle I'm tired with dis lyf komai ba dad'i I don't even know what to do, nima kawai gwara na tafi kamar yadda farouk yayi.....". 

     "A'a Fatima meyasa da iliminki kike son yin magana ta jahilai, Allah subhanahu wata ala yace, dukkan tsanani sauk'i na tare dashi, toh kinga ashe kina gab da samun sauk'i, don Allah kici gaba da hak'uri da rayuwarki har ki cinye wannan jarrabawar data sameki....". 

     Kuka taci gaba dayi bata ce dashi ko kanzil ba har ya d'auki hanyar hospital, zuwa yanzu shuraim ya daina kukan sai ajiyar zuciya da yake saukewa rungume a k'irjinta. 
    Sai da uncle yace "Bismillah muje ko" sannan ta d'ago kanta taga inda ya kawo su, "me zamuyi a hospital kuma"
   Ta fad'a da mamaki bayyane a saman fuskarta. 
    "Muje a duba sadauki mamana ko wani abune yake damunshi". 

      "Babu abinda yake damunshi uncle ni na sani kawai rigimace, don Allah mu koma gida na tsani asibiti wallahi"
    Ta fad'a kamar zatayi kuka cikin damuwa. 

  Shima bai sake ce da ita komai ba ya juya kamar yadda takeso. 
    Tun a harabar gidan taci karo da husna da taji karar motarsu ta futo ta taryeta tana fad'in, "thank God an sameki lafiya arfah, da hankalina har ya tashi fa, mukayi ta kiran wayarki nida abban suhail baki yi picking ba shine fa ya tafi ya duba ko lafiya?". 
    Mik'a mata shuraim tayi ba tare da tace komai ba ta nufi hanyar d'akinta, bin bayanta kawai tayi da yaron da ya Soma alamun yin kuka. 
   Lokacin data shiga harta daura towel bayan ta sunce rigar jikinta tana Shirin danna kai bathroom, "don Allah tsaya kiji da yaron nan mamana kinsan yana buk'atar ki". 
    Bata yi musu ba ta dawo da baya ta karb'e shi ta d'ora a kan cinyarta. 
     Cikin sanyin murya tayi magana ganin auntien nata zata fuce, "auntie kiyi hak'uri na bar wayar a gida kuma na kasa gane address na gidan nan naku, ba don Allah ya kawo uncle ba da bansan yadda zanyi ba".
    "Ayyah ba komai muma bamuyi tunanin hakan ba, mun d'auka tunda da waya ba zaki rasa muba, amma nasan uncle d'inki zai d'auki mataki a kai saboda gaba, tunda zuwa makarantar yanzu aka fara". 
    Ai kamar jira takeyi auntie ta dire ta d'ora hannunta d'aya aka ta fashe da kuka kamar y'ar yaye, "na shiga uku auntie kice da uncle wallahi ba zan iya yin makarantar nan ba, yau d'aya da naje saida naji ni kamar ban dad'e da rabuwa da phsychiatric doctor ba nayi can, auntie don Allah ku tausaya mun ga yaro ga jego ga jinyar zuciya ta da har yanzu bata gama warkewa ba". 

    Dariya da tausayinta taji duk a lokaci guda, sai ta kasa futa ta dawo kusa da ita ta zauna cikin muryar rarrashi tace, "kiyi hak'uri arfah! Rayuwa dukanta y'ar hak'uri da juriya ce, na tabbata zaki iya duka babu abinda zai gagareki ke dai kawai kiyi addu'ah Allah ya dafa miki......". 

    Tana k'arasa yi mata maganar ta tashi ta nufi hanyar futa, saboda wannan kukan na Fatima ta fahimci ba me k'arewa bane. 


           @@@@@@@@@


    Toh arfah cikin sati guda da soma zuwanta bayero University inda take karantar, (BA mass communication) ta futa hayyacinta tayi wujiga wujiga, mai napep guda abdussamad ya ajiye mata yake jigilar kaita da dawo da ita ko da Yaushe. 

    Yanzu tun safe idan ta farka bata sake zama zata shiga kujiba kujiba har dare, sosai ta maida kanta busy da ayyukan da suka wajaba a kanta da Wanda ma ta wajabtawa kanta, wannan busyn yasa bata samun damar tunane mai yawa, da dare kuma ta gaji bata da lokacin tunani tana kwanciya sai bacci. 

    Sauk'inta ma ba kullum take shiga makaranta ba saboda har yanzu karatunsu bai soma zurfi ba, suna first semister ne.



   _tom naji mutum kusan biyu suna tambayata labarin mutanen da sukayi zaman lafiya dasu, idan baku manta ba husna da abdussamad sun d'auke arfah cikin wani yanayi na mutu kwakwai rai kwakwai, kuma husna tuntuni take son yanke alak'ar ta dasu zainab d'in saboda halayensu marassa kyau da take kyamata, saboda arfah ne taci gaba da jurar Zama dasu da halinsu, yanzu kuma ta samu abinda take nema bana tunanin zata sake komawa garesu, sannan ai arfah har yanzu bata gama dawowa cikin cikakkiyar nutsuwarta ba, muyi hak'uri mu jira ko nan gaba salon rayuwarta zai sauya? Sannan maganar takaba da idda wata hud'u da kwana goma ne, takaba kwana arba'in, iddah wata uku, to amma idan zaku tuna arfah tayi haihuwar afuja'atan ne a lokacinda taji sak'on rasuwar mijinta, wanda hakan ke nufin bata da iddah a kanta sai takaba,  kwanakin takabarta kuma sun huce ta a gadon asibiti cikin yanayin ciwo, kuma me ake buk'ata da me takaba, kame kai da yawan ambaton Allah, da kiyaye shiga wajen nishad'in biki da harkar shargalle, Ni a ganina duk a cikin abubuwan dana lissafo babu wanda arfah ta shiga cikin a lokacin_

   _Amma Allahu ta'ala a'alamu, shi ilimi kogi ne bansan ba ko abinda na sani da wanda kuka sani daban daban ne_.

 Da wani irin firgici yanzun ma ta farka a gigice tana kiran sunan farouk!  
  Husna ajiye yaron tayi ta nufe ta ganin har ta soma ciccire drip da yake jikinta.

"Wasu lokutan sai naji kamar na jawo ranar da zaki haife mun abinda yake cikinki na gani", "Kai amma baby in kika tashi haifuwa tare zamu haifi abinmu a d'aki don bazan yadda Sam wani k'ato ko k'atuwa su kalle mun sirrina ba". Irin wad'annan kalaman nashi dama wasu da dama ne suke yi mata yawo a lokacin da take kallon fuskar yaron, sai dai tunda abdussamad ya shigo taji gabanta ya yanke ya fad'i, a duniya mutum uku ta tab'a gani kenan masu kama da abie d'inta sosai, kuma bata raba d'ayan biyu suna da relation da mahaifinta, mahaifin farouk, wannan d'an dattijo data tab'a bigewa da mota, sai wannan mutumin da batasan daga inda yazo ba, bata san yadda akayi ma ya santa ba, sannan meye ma takamaiman alak'ar su da mahaifinta shine har  yau har yanzu bata sani ba. 

   Bata d'auke idanunta a kanshi ba har ya k'araso inda take ya ajiye manyan ledojin daya shigo dasu. 
   "Sannu Fatima! Ya jikin naki?"
    Da kyar ta bud'a bakinta saboda kwarjinin da yayi mata ne ma ta amsa shi, "da sauk'i"

Yaron da yake kwance a gefenta ya dauka yace, "husna ta d'auki yaron nan kuwa bansa yau?". 
   "Eh yanzun nan ma ta ajiyeshi gab da zaka shigo". 
   Stool ya jawo ya zauna yana fuskantarta yace, "wane suna kike ganin ya kamata a saka mishi?".

   A lokacin arfah sai bata San yadda zata fassara abinda taji a ranta ba, yau gata ga wani d'an uwan mahaifinta, hajiya husna ashe matar uncle d'inta ce, shiyasa matar take sonta duk lokacin da taje gidansu sai ta shigo mata. 

    She can't hold her tears at that moment, tayi kuka tayi kuka har saida idonta ya kafe babu hawaye, su kansu husna sai da suka tayata koka ma rayuwarta wannan karon. 
  A ranar abdussamad yayiwa yaro khudba da sunan Umar farouk ganin bata da wani zab'i ko raayi akan sunan yaron. 

  Sunci gaba da kula da ita cikin soyayyah da nuna tsantsar kulawa har zuwa lokacinda ta d'auki wasu kwanakin, jikinta yayi sauk'i kam amma saboda gudun kada ta tafi wata matsalar ta taso likitoci suka rik'e ta har zuwa lokacinda zata samu cikakkiyar lafiya da nutsuwa irin wadda suke so. 
    Yayinda ita kuma kullum cikin neman maraba take da zaman asibitin. 

K'annen husna da mutanen da suke zaune lafiya duk sunzo sun dubata sunyi mata sannu, haka su suhail kullum cikin nacin a kaisu suga baby suke tunda abbansu yace musu itama auntie suce.

      Lokacin data tashi tafiya  part guda husna ta bata abdussamad ya shirya mata d'aki ita da jariri Umar farouk. 

Tunda tazo gidan batayi magana da kowa ba, yini take a d'aki wani lokacin a kwance ma, tun yaran gidan na mararin je mata har Suka daina, wani lokacin ko aikensu mamansu tayi gurinta sukance su basa son zuwa saboda bata kulasu bayan kuma ance ita d'in auntien suce. 
    Hak'uri husna ta kan basu kawai tace auntie bata jin dad'i ne amma inta warke zata you hira dasu. 
     Tun husna tana ganin abin a matsayin rad'ad'i na halin data tsinci kanta a ciki harta soma tsorata da abin, saboda a mafi yawan lokuta zataje ta zauna mata 4 more than 1 hour amma banda ina yini ko ina kwana babu abinda yake sake had'a su, abinci ruwa wanka duk sai an umarceta, idan ba haka ba kuma zata yini batayi ko abu guda a ciki ba, idan kuma aka sakata zatayi babu ko musu. 
     Abu na biyu da ya d'aga hankalin husna shine, yaron Sam babu wata shak'uwa ko soyayyah a tsakanin su, tana treating d'inshi tamkar d'an da aka bata ta horar, kusan bata shayar dashi sau uku a yini sai uwar madara  da ake yini dama mishi, idan ba kuka yayi ko Kashi ko fitsari ba babu ruwanta da d'aukar shi ko rab'a shi da jikinta don yaji d'uminta sosai, idan husna ko abdussamad sukayi Mata magana ko nasiha ta yini tana kuka, duka sun kasa fahimtar yadda zasu yi mata da rayuwarta. 

     Da abin ya damu husna sai taje gurin asalin likitan data zauna kark'ashin kulawarshi bayan anyi mata CS ta fad'a mishi duk abinda yake faruwa, y'an tambayoyi yayi mata game da patient d'in, bayan ya bincika kuma ya gano duk ba wata matsala bace, amma suyi k'ok'ari kada ta dawwama a haka, su bari a shawarce data d'anyi watanni yaronta yayi wayo su had'a ta da busy yadda ba zata samu damar yin wani kwakkwaran tunani ba, balle ta samu wata matsalar daban. 
    Da wannan shawarar husna tayi na'am har ta dawo sukaci gaba da Zama hankali kwance. Kulawa mai kyau irinta uwa take baiwa arfah bilhak'k'i da iya zuciyarta duka, aikuwa sai gashi yaron yayi kyau a cikin watanni biyu kacal da haihuwa ya futo kamar d'an wata hud'u. 
      A lokacin abdussamad ya shirya musu d'an kwarya kwaryan bikin suna wanda ya kashe musu kud'i ita da yaron sosai, raguna biyu ya yanka na rad'in suna y'an uwan husna sukazo suka soya aka rarrabawa jama'ah sadaqa. 

    Ranar arfah tunda ta fahimci abinda ake nufi ta kintsa kanta da wuri ta shige bedroom ta kulle kanta da key, da husna tayi knocking da kyar ta bud'e mata, "ba zaki futo ku gaisa da bak'i suga baby ba?". 
     Bata ce da husna komai ba ta juya ta d'auko musu yaron ta mik'a musu da duka komanshi, kafun husna tace wani abu ta maida k'ofar ta ta rufe, haka dai ta tattara ta kyaleta Suka ci gaba da sabgoginsu, cikin y'an uwanta duk wanda ya tambayi mai jego takance musu tana can a kwance bata jin dad'i ne. 
     
     Kwana biyu da yin wannan taro abdussamad ya kira ta part d'inshi. 
     Ba tayi musu ba ta yane kanta da gyale taje. 

   Husna tana zaune lokacin da suhail yayi mata jagora zuwa gurin abban nasu, a k'asan carpet ta zauna a d'arare ta Soma gaishe dasu d'aya bayan d'aya. 
     Mutanen kirki masu zumunci basu sauya Mata ba ko kad'an, suka amsa ta cikin faram faram da kulawa. 
    Bayan sun nutsu abdussamad ya kira sunanta cikin nuna kulawa. 
     Bata amsa ba amma ta d'ago ta kalleshi, "kinsan abinda yasa na kiraki?". 
   Ya d'ora da maganarshi, girgiza mishi kai tayi, yace, "da kyau! daman kiran ki nayi saboda ina so nasan ko akwai wani abu da kika zaba ma rayuwarki ko kika shirya ma kanki da kike da ra'ayin yi?". 
     Nan ma girgiza mishi kai tayi. 
    Gyara Zaman shi yayi yaci gaba da fad'in, "tom kin yarda da duk hukuncin dana yanke miki dai dai da rayuwarki zaki karb'e shi hannu bibbiyu Kenan?". 
     Gyad'a kan dai tayi, shi kam bai damu ba yaci gaba, "shikenan kije kawai zan nemeki nan da kwana biyu, amma anjima zan turo a d'auke ki photo husna zatayi miki magana idan mai photon ya iso zaki iya tafiya". 

    Har ta yink'ura sai kuma ta koma tazauna kanta a k'asa jiki lakwas tace, "uncle! Auntie kuyi hak'uri da yadda nake yi muku a gidan nan, ni kaina ba'a son raina nake misbehaving haka ba ba yadda zanyi ne, tun asali haka rayuwata take farouk shine ya sauya ni, na zama faram faram mai zaune lafiya da kowa, na koyi rayuwa cikin farin ciki da farantawa mutane, yanzun kuma daya kasance babu shi na kasa na saba da wannan rayuwar, sai in dinga ganin kamar bani da sauran abinda ya rage mun a duniya, farin cikina, jin dad'i na da komai nawa ya tafi tare da farouk, waccan rayuwar ba tawa bace ta farouk ce, kuma yanzun daya tafi ya dawo da asalin arfah bayan ya d'auke tashin sun tafi tare, a k'arshe ina son ku fahimci cewa har yanzu ni a idona farouk bai mutu ba, ya gudune yana rayuwa da arfahn shi matarshi wadda ya sauya da irin tsarin rayuwarshi.........."


    Sai ta kife kanta a jikin hannun kujera tana mai fidda wani sautin kuka mai cin rai da tsayawa a zuci. 
     Duk shiru sukayi cikin tausayinta suna kallonta, babu wanda yayi yink'urin rarrashinta cikinsu har tayi kukanta mai isarta ta mik'e ta fuce musu fuuuuuu
     
    Ranar mutuwar farouk sabuwa dal ta dawo mata, haka ta yini duk bayan wasu mintuna sai tayi kuka, ji take kamar ta bishi itama ta huta da wannan rayuwar.

Tun daga wannan ranar ta sauya tsarin rayuwarta da yaronta, yanzu da kanta take kula dashi da soyayyah, kafun auntie husna tazo ta had'a ruwa a heater ta wanke shi irin yadda taga husna tanayi mishi, haka zatayi share share, ta shiga har kitchen kuma ta had'a wanke wanke wasu lokutan har breakfast tana taya auntie husna suyi tare, duk da ba hira sukeyi ba amma husna tana jin dad'i a hakan ma, bawai kuma don tana tayata aikin bane, a'a saboda taga ta d'an saki jikinta ne ba kamar kwanakin da suka gabata ba.

      Abdussamad da husna Dad'in da sukeji a wannan lokacin yana da yawa, a k'alla dai yanzu ai an sameta ba kamar da ba, duk da bata huce hour d'aya take yin nata guri, mammie ce dai ta Zama kusan y'ar d'akinta, don takanas ta shiga d'akinsu ta kwashe kayan mammie tas ta mayar part d'inta.

    "Me akayi masa ne? Nasan Umar farouk sadauki ne baya kukan banza". 
    Uncle ya fad'a yana ajiya jakar daya shigo da ita. 
   Murmushi tayi tace, "sannu da zuwa uncle".

     "Ta shiga ciki zatayi wanka"
    Ta fad'a tana k'ok'arin goye shuraim a bayan ta.  Plate ta d'auko ta zuba mishi drinks ta Kai mishi, "nagode daughter amma dai a dinga kular min da abokina don Allah a daina barin shi yana kuka".

   " A'a Yaushe ka dawo abban suhail?". 
 
      "Yanzu ba jimawa".

Cikin girmamawa tace,
    "Lahh uncle ai ya mayi bacci ban sani ba ai".

Page 60 _(sixty)_



 Toh abdussamad bincike yasa akeyi mishi mai wahala akan baffan farouk, sai dai har yanzu babu duriyar shi haka ba'a san inda za'a sameshi ba, duk inda suka tambaya magana d'aya ce ake fad'a musu, ya tashi kuma babu wanda yasan inda ya koma. 

    Dole daga k'arshe suka hak'ura da binciken in ya samu hutun k'arshen shekara zai je da kanshi ya gani. 

    Watannin shuraim shida a duniya ya fara koyon zaman, zaman da saida auntie husna ta nuna mata yadda ake yiwa yaro sannan, har yanzu rainonshi bai sauya zani ba, rabi ta shayar dashi rabi kuma ta bashi madara, sai ruwa. 
   A yanzu da karatunta ya soma nisa ma in auntie husna tana gida barshi take a gurin ta taje ta dawo, saboda yaron Sam baya son hayaniyar mutane, idan taje dashi makarantar ma baya tab'a bari ta nutsu tayi concentrating akan abinda ya dace a lokacin ba, ga higher institution basa son ana shigar musu da yara hall. 
 
    Kwana biyun nan ne ma ta soma tunanin yadda zatayi taga auntien tata kamar itama ta kanta takeyi.

Yauma kamar kullum bayan ta idar da sallarta ta asuba, shuraim da kullum kusan tare suke tashi ta d'auko ta kaishi bathroom don ta shirya shi sannan ta d'auki mammie da take magagin bacci ta soma yi mata wanka, tun daga kan d'akinta ta soma shara har zuwa parlon k'asa na gidan daga k'arshe ta dire a kitchen, bayan ta gyara ko'ina kiciniyar had'a breakfast ta soma. Ta had'awa mammie tea ta ajiyeta a gefe tana sha tana ta faman yi mata surutu, ita dai tana aikinta tana bata amsa jifa jifa.

    Da sallama ta shigo d'akin yaran tana fad'in, "yau nayi late kiyi hak'uri ummina na barki da hayaniyar yaran nan ko?".

     "Humm ki bari kawai duk bana jin dad'in jikina y'an kwanakin nan, ina tunanin in zaki futa school anjima na biku ku saukeni nida shuraim a asibiti".

    Tare ya futa da yaran bayan sun kammala ita kuma suka ci gaba da Zama anan parlour auntie tana fad'a mata yadda gidan yayi shiru gwanin dad'i da suka tafi makarantar, tattaunawa sukayi akan yaran da dramar su inda sukayi ta dariya musamman rikicin saddiq da suhail, saboda wani lokacin mammie miskila ce bata fiya shiga shirginsu ba. 

     K'arfe 10:00 dai-dai na safiyar ranar suka gama shirinsu na futa kusan a tare, sai da suka soma sauke auntie husna a hospital sannan suka huce, kamar yadda ta fad'a kuwa yau bata bar mata shuraim ba dashi ta tafi, sai dai a daddafe suka dawo gida sai kuka yakeyi duk ya rikitata, tana shiga gidan ta ajiyeshi akan kekenshi ta soma rage kayan jikinta. Ko kafun ta futo daga toilet ya soma gyangyad'in bacci tuni, d'aukar shi tayi ta kwantar akan katifar su itama ta kwanta kusa dashi tana lallab'a shi, daman tun a school tasan bacci yakeji kawai yak'i yine saboda kar ya barta ta zauna lafiya, ta rasa gane kan wannan aiki irin na shuraim, baya son mutane kwata kwata inba mutanen gidan ba. 

     Da magriba husna bayan ta raka bak'inta k'awayen Zahra, biyowa sukayi ta d'akin arfah donsu duba ta, sunji shigowarta d'azu daga baya kuma sunji ta shiru ko motsinta babu, bacci sukeyi ita da shuraim sadidan, mammie da ta dawo school tuni tana assignment a gefe har tana yi musu gargad'i, "mommy bacci takeyi kuyi magana a hankali kada ku tasheta, jiya da dare basuyi bacci ba ita da sadaukin abberh". 

Murmushi husna tayi kawai ta fuce daga d'akin, Zahra cema ta tsaya zolayarta, bata jima da futa ba itama ta farka, suka tashi kusan tare da yaron, alwala ta d'auro shap shap ta tada sallar magrib data kusan huceta. 
   Da hijab d'in sallar a jikinta ta d'auki shuraim ta kamo hannun mammie sukayo parlour, "sannu da hutawa auntie Fatima, d'azu ai mun shiga kina bacci mammie hadda yi mana warning d'in kar mu tashe ki". 
   Murmushi kawai tayi a lokacinda Zahra k'anwar auntie husna ke yin wannan magana. 

     "Auntie barka da gida ya kike ya jikin naki? Na dawo d'azu a gajiye shiyasa ban shigo miki ba". 
   "Ayyah ni na sani ai, musamman da kika k'i barmun shuraim yau". 

   Yamutsa fuska tayi tace, "kuma wallahi yauma haka ya hanani sak'at a makaranta". 

   Mik'a hannu husna tayi ya tafi gurinta da sauri yana b'angale mata baki. "da gaske yau ka hana ummie karatu a makaranta?....". 
    Husna ta fad'a tana d'aga shi sama tana yi mishi wasa, yayinda shi kuma yake ta kyalkyala mata dariya. 
    Abinci tasa suhail ya kawo mata k'asan plate dai dai wanda zata iya cinyewa, sannan ta maida dubanta ga Zahra tace, "auntie Zahra ko? Yau dai Allah ya had'a mu gani ga takwarata yaushe a garin?". 
    D'an harararta tayi tace, "sai yanzu kika ganni naga kina futowa ni na soma yi miki magana amma kika share ni saida kika gama magana da auntien ki". 

    Marairaice mata tayi tace, "ayyah sooo sorry mie takwara kinsan a komai ance iyaye gaba, kuma mun rabu d'azu bata jin dad'i shiyasa na soma jin lafiyarta but I'm really sorry". 

    Cikin sakin fuska yanzun ma ta sake cewa, "ke nifa da wasa nakeyi miki, Soo ya makarantar naji aunty Asma tace mun kina zuwa BUK ko". 

   Dafe kanta tayi da hannunta d'aya tace, "ba sauk'i makarantar nan fa....". 
   A tare husna da Zahra suka sanya mata dariya, "wane course suka baki?". Zahra ta tambayeta cikin muryar dariya. 
   Plate d'in abincinta ta karb'a a hannun suhail sannan tace, "wani course ne mai shegen wahala in fad'a miki, Bismillah kuzo muci abinci"
   A'a takwara lunch going for dinner wannan sai ke d'in, Ina jinki wanne ne?".
    "Mass communication mana" ta fad'a tana mik'a lomar abinci bakinta. 
   "Kai takwara masscom d'in ne wahala?". Zahra ta fad'a tana yi mata kallon mamaki, 
   "Kinga Zahra wannan takwarar taki ba son karatun nan takeyi ba har yanzu, naga da accounting ta soma inaji tana ba uncle d'inta labari kwanaki, shi baiyi mata wahala ba sai wannan don neman magana". 
   Marairaicewa tayi sosai tace, "Allah auntie nafi jin wahalar wannan akan wancen lokacin, saboda yanzun nauyi ya soma hawa kaina nima". 
   Dariyar dai suka sake yi gaba d'ayan su. Ita kuma taci gaba da cin abincinta saboda bil hak'k'i da iya gaskiyarta take maganarta.

    Cikin sigar tausayin kanta tace, "alhamdulillah uncle". 
    "Masha Allah, amma don Allah ki dinga kunna wayarki saboda tsaro, ba dad'i ayi ta kiranki switch up". 
 Cikin girmamawa tace, "Insha Allah uncle". 

  Daga haka ya haura sama auntie husna tabi bayansu. 

    Itama mik'ewa tayi ta d'auki mammie da tayi bacci jikin auntie husna da zata tafi ta barta a nan. 
   D'akinta ta kaita ta gyara mata gurin kwanciya ta tashe ta ta sauya mata kaya zuwa riga da wando na bacci, sannan tasa tayi addu'ar kwanciya bacci. 
     Bata sake futa ba saboda shuraim uncle abdussamad ya haura sama dashi, bayan tayi sallar isha'i wayarta ta kunna ta saita sabon sim d'in da aka sa mata a ciki wanda ke d'auke da contact d'in mutum biyu kacal. Uncle, da auntie. 
    Daga nan ta soma operating system d'inta sabuwa dal da aka kawo mata cikin kwanakin saboda makaranta. 

  Tana nan zaune Zahra ta lek'o yi mata sallama saboda d'aukarta da mijinta yazo yi zuwa masaukin su. 
    Sunyi sallama a kan sai zuwa gobe in Allah ya kaimu zata dawo musu gidan.

   A hankali rayuwar arfah taci gaba da tafiya a gidan abdussamad jauro baffi cikin sabon salon sauyin daya zowa rayuwarta, kulawa ta musamman matar da mijin suke bata da zuciyarsu guda, tun a lokacinda husna taje asibiti aka shaida mata shigar sabon ciki jikinta bata sake zama lafiya ba, tana son wannan bata son wancan, kasala, yawan bacci da saurin fushi abubuwa dai iri iri wanda arfah ta sani game da masu ciki dama wanda bata tab'a sani ba. 
   Kusan duk ragamar ayyukan gidan hannunta suka dawo, kuma bata tab'a gajiyawa ba, zatayi hidimarsu taje makarantar ta ta dawo ta d'ora da kula da y'ay'an uncle d'inta rigimmamu, abu d'aya daya gagareta ta d'auki wata y'ar dattijuwa ke kula dashi a duk lokacin da zata shiga lectures to shuraim ne, yaron ya kwashe duka yanayin uwarshi dana ubanshi tun yanzu, baya son mutane Sam a halittarshi inba mutanen gidan daya saba rayuwarshi dasu ba, ko iya mai rainon shi saida aka kai ruwa rana sannan ya soma yarda da ita. A yanzu karatun arfah ya soma nisa wahalar da take kira da baki tazo mata a aikace, duk ta rame sai uban hanci da tulin gashi da yak'i zuciya ya tafi nashi guri duk da yadda mai shi takeyin buruskulle dashi, ba kitso bare saloon, za dai ta wanke shi ta shafa mai ta taje ta maida abinta ta k'ulle fak'at. Tunanin farouk kuwa a kowacce rana alk'awari ne sai ta tuna shi ko irin rayuwar da sukayi tare, wani lokacin tana aiki ita kad'ai zata dinga yin murmushi ko dariya, wani lokacin kuma tasha kukanta har ta gode Allah, nadamar da takeyi ba y'ar kad'an bace, kuma babu abinda yake saurin sata kuka kamar inta tuno yadda ta rayu da soyayyar farouk na tsawon shekaru amma har suka rabu bata furta tana son shi ba, abin nan ya tsaya mata a rai fiye da komai, shine ma abinda yafi damunta a yanzun. 


Kamar yadda abdussamad yayi mata alk'awari yana samun hutun shi na k'arshen shekara ya shirya da kanshi da taimakon wanda yake yi mishi bincike a kan ahalinsu gaba d'aya, a tsohon gidan da baffan farouk ya tashi abdussamad yayi parking motarshi, iya bincikensu layin tunda farko har k'arshe basu samu abinda suke so ba, inda baffa ya koma bayan ya bar nan anguwar ya gagsre su samu da gaske. 
   Jiki a sanyaye yaci gaba da tsayuwa ya kasa barin anguwar daga k'arshe ma sai ya samu k'ofar gidan baffan ada ya zauna ya zabga uban tagumi. 
   Ahmad abokin su farouk daya zo gidan su gaishe da iyayen shi bayan ya taso kasuwa, ya dad'e yana kallon abdussamad da nazarin shi, sosai yake ganin kammannin shi da baffan su farouk, su kansu sai suce kusan tafiyar baffah da iyalanshi ba tayi musu dad'i ba, mutane na gari masu kyakkyawar zuciya, son zaman lafiya da lumana. Sai dai duk da sunyi kewarsu musamman aboki na gari farouk basu tab'a zurfafa bincike akansu ko neman inda suka koma bare suce ga inda suke. 
   Bayan yayi alwalar sallar magrib, k'arasawa yayi kusa dasu yayi musu sallama, mik'a masa hannu sukayi ya karb'a sukayi cikakkiyar gaisuwa da addinin Islam ya tanada. "Nasan baku sanni ba, nidai sunana Ahmad kuma ni abokin farouk ne kusan tare muka taso dashi a wannan anguwar, naji kuna tambaya ne akan inda baffa ya koma, toh gaskiya kamar yadda duk wad'an da kuka tambaya suka fad'a muku babu wanda yasan inda suka koma kaf fad'in anguwar nan, sai dai ni na tab'a ganin shi kwanakin baya can yaje gidan wani mutumi a anguwar da gidana yake, shima mutumin kamarku haka yake sai dai yafi ku d'an manyanta haka, yana da kirki kamar baffa ga manyantaka, a anguwar mu duk wanda yayi ba dai dai ba yakan kiramu ya gyara mana, yana jinmu kamar y'ay'an shi don mu yadda y'ay'an shi suke kiranshi baba haka muma muke kiranshi...". 
  Wata irin ajiyar zuciya abdussamad ya sauke kamar ya samu abinda yake nema ya d'aga hannu sama tun kafun Ahmad ya k'arasa kai zancenshi k'arshe yana fad'in, "alhamdulillah! Allah mun gode maka, meye sunan shi mutumin d'an samarie?". 
    "Ehhh to gaskiya Ni bansan takamaiman asalin sunan shiba kamar yadda na fad'a maka dai muna kiran shi da baba, to amma ku d'in don Allah meye alak'ar ku da su farouk, kuma mu munsamu labari a lokacinda baffa ya tashi, wai farouk ne yayiwa wata yarinya y'ar masu kud'i cikin shege babanta ya kulleshi shine sanadiyyar barin su anguwar bagatatan haka duk mukaji". 
   
      Jikin abdussamad ne yayi sanyi lakwas, duk wannan abin da yake faruwa ya manta da cewa farouk ya rasu mashi sam, ya rasa dalilin da yasa har yanzu mutuwar farouk ta kasa barin ranshi, ko don saboda yana kallon arfah ne?..... Shima bai sani ba. 
Hankie yasa ya d'an d'auke siririn hawayen da yake shirin turo kanshi waje daga idonshi, "yanzu ka taimaka mana da ruwa muyi sallah sai mu k'arasa tattauna abinda ya dace daga baya". 

Ahmad bai ko musa musu ba ya shiga gidansu ya futo musu da ruwa a buta. 
    Kusan shi yayi musu jagora zuwa masallacin anguwar inda suka sauke farali. 
    Bayan sun futo basu ce dashi ba shima baice dasu ba, har suka rok'i alfarmar ya shige musu gaba idan babu damuwa har anguwar tasu gurin mutumin. 
   Haka sukayi wannan tafiya ta k'agara yana machine suna binshi a mota. 
   A dai dai k'ofar gidan mutumin suka tsaya, abdussamad ya futo yana k'arewa tsoho kuma ragargazajjen gidan kallo, "nan shine gidan kenan" abokin abdussamad ya tambayi Ahmad don ya tabbatar, "eh shine bari musa yaro ya kira muku shi ko?". 
    Da sauri abdussamad da jikinshi ya gama yin laushi yace, "ba damuwa tunda munga gidan ma dawo gobe da safe sai muyi magana ido na ganin ido, Kai dai mungode Allah ya saka da mafificin alkhairy....". 
    
  "Ba wani abu! Kuyi hak'uri amma baku bani amsar tambaya ta bafa?". 
    Shiru abdussamad yayi kanshi a k'asa kamar ba zaice komai ba sai kuma ya d'ago ya dubi Ahmad d'in, "toh abinda ya faru a lokacin gaskiya labari ne mai tsayi da yake buk'atar cikakkiyar nutsuwa da lokaci, amma in briefly zanyi maka bayanin kad'an daga abinda baku sani ba saboda abinda kayi mana, farouk yayi aure da y'ar wan mahaifinshi ne a lokacin da baffan shi ya siyar da gidansu suka tafi, kuma auren ne yazo da d'an turka turka toh amma da yake ramin k'arya k'urarre ne bada jimawa ba gaskiya ta futo, Ni da mahaifin farouk uwar mu d'aya ubanmu d'aya, yanzu haka matar shi da d'anshi suna gidana saboda Allah yayi mishi rasuwa shakara d'aya da y'an watanni baya sanadiyyar mummunar had'arin mota......". 

D'if Ahmad ya d'auke wuta cike da mamaki yana kallon abdussamad, "kana nufin farouk ya rasu yanzu baya raye a doron duniya.....". Sai kawai ya fashe da kuka kamar k'aramin yaro. 

   Duk sai ya karyawa abdussamad gwiwa yaji kamar shima ya fashe da kukan, cikin k'arfin hali da juriya had'e da jarumta ya shiga cikin mota shida Mansoor abokin shi yaja suka bar layin. 
    Ranar abdussamad a masaukin da akayi mishi gidan Mansoor kasa bacci yayi, sai yanzu yake tunanin ta yadda zai iya kallon idon yayanshi da matarshi ya fad'a musu d'an su guda d'aya namiji tilo da suke matukar so da ji dashi ya mutu baya duniya, ya shekara d'ai d'ai har Sha wani abu rabonshi dasu, bai tab'a neman su ko son yaje inda suke saboda zumuncin Allah ba sai yanzu ya nemeso da wannan mummunar labari abakinshi, lallai abin abin ayi duba a kanshi ne. 
     Shi kuma tsakani da Allah ba don komai ya kyale musu rayuwar suba sai don baya son ya tsulluma cikin rigimarsu har ya shigarwa wani tsakanin su, kuma a lokacin yaji ciwon abinda sukayi dukkannin su bisa doron son zuciya da biyewa abinda matansu suke so. 
    Shiyasa shima ya yanke irin hukuncin da sauran y'an uwansu suka yanke kowa ya kama gabanshi don a zauna lafiya.

     Haka husna tayi ta jera mishi missed called yana kallo amma yak'i d'agawa duk da yadda yake son jin muryarta da yadda ta yini. 



 A ranar Sai muce kusan baccin shi rabi da rabi ne.  K'arfe Tara da rabi ya shirya tsab cikin shaddarshi data amshi jiki, ko karya kumallo ya kasa, yace da abokinshi Mansoor ya bari suje su dawo tukun. 

   Dole Mansoor ya bishi yadda yake so suka koma anguwar su Ahmad ta jiya. 

  A dai dai k'ofar gidan jiya yauma sukayi parking, suka futo daga cikin motar suka jingina da jikin motar suna neman yaron da zasu aika yayi musu sallama da mai gidan. 
    Suna nan tsaye wani yaro ya futo da wasu irin yagaggu kuma yagalgalallun uniform zai tafi makaranta. Abdussamad zuciyarshi ce ta tsinke a lokacin da ya k'arewa yaron daya futo kallo, sai dai bai yi k'asa a gwiwa ba ya tari yaron yace, "yaro babanka yana gida?". 

    "Eh" yaro ya bashi amsa. 
   "Yauwa toh don Allah shiga kace ana sallama dashi". 
   Yaro da saurin shi ya tafi don ya sanar wa mahaifin shi kiran da wad'annan y'an gayun matasan masu kud'in sukeyi mishi. 

 Bai d'auki lokaci ba ya futo yace, "ance yana zuwa". 
   Cikin jin dad'i abdussamad ya d'auko 5h ya mik'awa yaron, da farko k'in karb'a yayi har saida ya takura mishi sannan. 

   Yana tsaye ya zurawa k'ofar gidan ido yana jira yaga wanda zai futo daga cikin gidan, duk maganar da Mansoor yakeyi zuwa wannan lokacin ya daina ganewa sai zuciyarshi da take sake tsananta bugu da hucewar kowacce dak'ik'a. 
     Suna a haka wani bafulatanin dattijo ya futo sanye da wani kod'ad'd'en yadi fari daya Sha wanki har ya gaji ya nuna gajiyawarshi a fili ta hanyar tattattarewa da cukurkud'ewa. 
     Wani irim damm! Zuciyar abdussamad ta buga a lokacinda idon shi ya shiga cikin na mutumin. 

    Kamar wanda aka ja da magnet haka ya nufi mutumin ba tare daya masan abinda yakeyi ba har zuwa gab da mutumin, sannan cikin rawar murya da karkarwar baki yace, "bah bah!".

Page 61 _(sixty one)_



 "Yaya sulaiman kana nufin kaine wanda suke kira babah?". 

   Mutumin da ba wasu shekaru masu yawa yayi a duniya ba tsabar wahalarshi ce ta k'ara mishi shekarun, shanye komai yayi daga kan fuskarshi ya kalli abdussamad tun daga sama har k'asa yace, "mallam waye kai?". 

   Da matuk'ar zallar mamaki abdussamad yayi turus yana kallon mutumin da jinjina kalmar data futo daga bakinshi, ko a mafarki ba zai yadda zai ga d'an uwan nashi yace bai gane shiba sai gashi a zahiri ya furta hakan da bakinshi. 
     "Nine fa abdussamad! Abdussamad k'anin ka yaya sulaiman...... Abdussamad da kuka......". 
    Da sauri ya d'aga mishi hannu cikin katse mishi hanzari yace, "don Allah mallam dakata, abdussamad kake kowa? Daman kasa a kirawoni daga cikin gidana saboda kawai ka dinga jaddada mun sunanka ko me?".
    "Yaya sulaiman nine fa abdussamad k'anin ka, da gaske kana nufin baka gane niba?". 
    Ba wasa a fuskar mutumin yace, "wallahi idan baka kama hanyar kaba zan tara maka mutane, meye alak'a ta da kai da zaka dinga kirana yayanka, to ni ba sunana sulaiman ba, mallam yunus nake". 

     Yana gama yin maganarshi ya koma cikin gidan ya bar abdussamad nan sake da baki, Mansoor ne ya k'araso kusa dashi ya dafa shoulder d'inshi cikin kulawa da shiga rud'ani yace, "abdussamad wai me yake faruwa ne? Kasan shine dama? Ai daka tambaye shi inda baban farouk d'in yake kawai". 

   "Ba zaka gane ba Mansoor wannan d'in mafa yayanmu ne, shine babban yayanmu kaf". 
    Shi kanshi Mansoor dafe kanshi yayi yace, "wannan damalmala ta familinku da yawa take, to wai duk meye ya raba kawunan ku haka kuke rayuwar ku daban daban, ka tabbatar shi d'in kuwa ko kuma wani ne yayi maka kama dashi". 

    Gini ya daka da hannunshi yana mai yin nadama a zahiri da cikin zuci, "wata matar yayarmu ce wallahi ta tarwatsamu kowa ya kama gabanshi, kuma wannan mutumin Mansoor ko mutuwa nayi na dawo zan rantse maka babu musu duk inda ya futo jini d'aya ne yake yawo a jikin mu nida shi". 

     Duk shiru sukayi suka kasa matsawa daga k'ofar gidan, har cewa Mansoor yayi suje sa dawo anjima amma yak'i, gani yakeyi kamar shima zai gudu ne idan yaje kafun ya dawo, jikin shi yayi sanyi yayi laushi yayu tub'us. Ganin irin k'ask'antacciyar rayuwar da jinin shi wanshi matsayin ubansu yakeyi ta talauci da wahalar rayuwa, koda shi ba kud'i ne dashi ba amma yana da rufin asiri dai dai gwargwado da zai iya taimakawa. 

    Duk wanda zai shiga ya futo daga gidan idonsu a kanshi, banda keta shari'a da tuni abdussamad ya shiga cikin gidan da kanshi. 
    Wasu matasa ne suka zo suka ajiye napep, sukayi musu sallama suka shiga cikin gidan, bayan wasu mintuna suka sake futowa still suka gansu a inda suka barsu d'azu, har sun huce zasu tafi na bayan ya dawo yazo gurinsu yace, "yae! Malam lafiya kuwa?" 

   Kallon yaron abdussamad yayi da kyau ya ga kammannin yayan nasu muraran da yaron sannan yace, "lafiya qalou muna son magana da mallam ne"

   "Shamsu" ya kwalawa d'an uwanshi kira. 

   Tahowa yayi gurin su shima yace, "yae! Naji ka kirani".
    Wad'annan mutanen ne suke neman su kawo mana raini, don Allah da muka shiga me baba yace da muka tambayeshi su d'in ko yasan da zamansu?". 

   "Cewa yayi shima tun d'azu haka ya gansu". Wanda aka kira da shamsu ya fad'a. 
   "To kunji da kunnenku don haka sai ku kama gabanku tun kafun yanzu na tumurmusa ku anan gurin". 
     Mik'ewa tsaye abdussamad yayi hannuwanshi duka cikin aljihun shi ya kalli cikin idonsu ba tsoro ko d'ar yace, "Ni d'an uwan mahaifin kune sulaiman, sunana abdussamad ko baku sanni ba nasan kun tab'a jin sunana a gurin babanku, na zone don muyi magana dashi amma yak'i saurarata sam, Ni kuma nayiwa raina alk'awarin bazan bar k'ofar gidan nan ba har sai ya saurare ni yaji uzurina da abinda nazo dashi".

    D'an damn sukayi, suka kalli juna suka sake kallon mutumin daya Kira kanshi da suna abdussamad, da gaske yana kama da baban nasu kuma fa, sannan suna jin sunan abdussamad da yawa ma a bakin mahaifin su, to amma shida kullum yake addu'ar Allah ya had'a kan y'an uwan shi me yasa zai k'i sauraron wannan yanzu da yazo?   

    Babban ne a cikinsu yace yana zuwa, hanyar shiga cikin gidan ya nufa suka kusan yin karo da baban nasu kuwa shima zai futo. 
    Juyowa yayi baban yana biye dashi yana tambayar, "kuda kuka futa aiki meya dawo daku kuma?". 

   Bai ce dashi komai ba har suka futo k'ofar gidan gaba d'aya, abdussamad yana ganinshi ya tafi da hanzari har yana tuntub'e ya durk'usa a gabanshi ya rik'e k'afafun shi da duka hannuwanshi yana fad'in, "don Allah yaya sulaiman kar ka hukuntani ta haka, tabbas nasan ni mai laifi ne babbah a gurinka, na cancanci kowanne irin hukunci daga gareka amma don Allah kar kace baka sanni ba.......". Sai ya fashe da kuka kamar k'aramin yaro. Y'ay'an sa da suke tsaye daura da inda yake har suna rige rige gurin tambayar, "baba da gaske baka san shiba?". Girgiza musu Kai yayi, shamsu yace, "to amma yace mana shine abdussamad k'anin ka fa". 

     "Kaga shamsudden, Ina aiki kace mun zaka tafi neman halaliyar ka?". Yaron ya gyad'a kai, "toh maza ka tafi abinda zai fissheka". 

   Matsawa sukayi amma sai suka kasa tafiya, ga abdussamad durk'ushe har lokacin yana kuka ya rik'e kafar baba tamajau yak'i saki. 
     Mansoor dai yana daga gefe yana kallon su. 
   "Kai mallam zo mana" ya kira Mansoor da ke gefe. 
    K'arasawa yayi kusa ya d'an russuna a gabanshi yana sauraron abinda zaice, "wannan abokin naka amma daga gidan mahaukata ka d'auko shi ko?". .
    Shiru Mansoor yayi cikin jinjina girman laifin abdussamad a gurin wannan bawan Allah yace, "ayi hak'uri yallab'ai yazo ne don ya gyara kuskurenshi". 
    Shiru ya sake biyo baya a k'alla na wasu cikakkun dak'ik'u goma, ga malam sulaiman ya rasa yadda zai yakice abdussamad a k'afarshi, gashi mutane sun fara taruwa suna kallonsu, ga masallaci an tada sallah zai ja ya rasa jam'i. 

    Wani tunani yayi a zuciyarshi sannan ya sauke ajiyar zuciya cikin taushin murya ya soma magana, "y'ay'an ka nawa yanzu?". 
     Da sauri ya share hawayen shi da gefen rigarshi, bai ko kula da abinda yayi ba yace, "uku yaya...". 
    Girgiza kai yayi yace, "amma shine har yanzu baka girma ba?". 
    Abdussamad bai San lokacinda murmushi ya sub'uce mishi ba, ya d'ago da saurin shi ya rungume yayan nashi, kusan a tare suka fashe da kuka. 
     Su shamsu dai suna tsaitsaye suna kallon su. "Toh kukan ya Isa haka, shamsudden deb'o mishi ruwa a buta ka kawo mishi". 
   Ba musu yaran suka tafi suka kawo musu ruwa a rub'ab'b'un butoci ko murfi babu. 
     Alwala suka d'aura aka kawo musu dadduma k'atuwa sukayi jam'i har su shamsudden da naseer da suka nace ba zasu tafi abinda ya dace dasu ba. 
    Bayan sun idar da sallar shiru ya sake ratsawa kafun malam sulaiman yasa a kawo musu kunun tsamiya da matarshi takeyi na siyarwa, da wake da shinkafa da aka dafa na gida. 
   Abincin su a tsabtace yake, kwanukan dai gasu sunsha wanki amma babu ko d'igon datti a jiki, daga abdussamad har Mansoor basu nuna komai ba kamar yadda basu ji komai ba suka wanke hannuwansu suka soma cin abincin. 
    Bayan sun gama aka kawo musu ruwa mai sanyi na randa sai k'amshin k'asa ke tashi suka Sha.  

   Bayan sun nutsu malam sulaiman yayi gyaran murya yace, "Ina sauraronka abdussamad ya akayi mai ya kawo ka?". 
   Cikin jin kunyar kanshi ya sadda kai k'asa ya soma bashi labari kamar haka, "bayan barina gida adamawa yola, yaya jafar ya d'auki nauyin karatuna kasan a Cambridge dake babban birnin England, wadda daga makarantar zuwa gidanshi na can ba nisa sosai, amma ni ina zaune a school hostel ne inda nake karatun law, bansan komai daya faru tsakanin kuba sai da Rasheed ya bani labari ta waya. Tsoron da naji a lokacin sai bansan wanda zan goyi baya ba, hakan yasa na yanke alak'a ta da kowa na cikin familyn mu har yaya jafar da farko kuwa, daga baya naji labarin cewa ya dawo k'asar England asalin gidan shi na nan, yaje har makaranta nemana amma duk hanyar da bazan had'u dashi ba Saida nabi, a lokacin na d'auka da y'an buge bugen mu da mukeyi na d'alibai y'an wata k'asa zan iya k'arasa d'aukar nauyin karatuna, sai dai Kash karatu a k'asar waje ba kamar karatu a Nigeria ba, duk yadda nake tunanin yaya jafar yana kashe kud'i abin ya zarce tunani na, dole daga k'arshe na neme shi naje gareshi, kuma bai nuna min komai ba ya karb'e ni da hannu bibbiyu ya ci gaba da hidimta mun shida matarshi, a lokacin y'ar shi d'aya ce Fatima. Bayan lokaci mai tsayi a lokacin Ina had'a  Masters d'ina ya tattara yana shi yana shi ya komo Nigeria, bayan ya bar mun kud'i tsugugu da zasu isa na k'arasa karatuna ba tare da nasha wahala wajen nemar wani abun ba, a lokacin har address d'in gidan da ya koma ya bani, to gaskiya butulci d'aya dana yi mishi shine juya mishi baya da nayi duk da tarin alkhairan da yayi mun a rayuwa, Ni kuma dalilina shine matsalar dukkanta daga gurinshi ta b'ullo duk kun juya fuskarku taya ni zan jone dashi kuma?  Ko bayan na kammala karatuna na futo da Masters degree na cikakken lauya mai zaman kanshi, ban tsaya yin aiki a k'asar da ba tawa ba na tattaro na dawo gida Nigeria garin kano, sannan ta hanyar wannan Mansoor d'in na dinga bin diddigin rayuwar da yakeyi duk ba don komai ba sai don naji ko Allah zaisa naji ya gane gaskiya kun koma da zumuncin ku, sai dai kullum mummunar labarin d'aya ne, a haka kuma na samu labarin yaya ibraheem da yake zaune anguwarshi kusa data yaya jafar d'in shima, tun dana dawo daga England ban tab'a tunanin komawa gida ba ko dede da second, kullum tunanina yana kaiwa yana komowane akanku, nayi aure da shekaru kusan sha d'aya yanzun, mahaifin wannan abokin nawa shine yaje ya nema mun aurenta a hannun k'anin mahaifinta, (da yake mahaifinta ya rasu) nan ya d'ora da badu labarin aurenshi da husna tun daga farko har k'arshe........ Sai daya dire aya sannan ya shiga labarin Fatima da farouk. 
    "A shekara d'aya baya wata sark'a ta sark'alo y'ay'an mutum biyun nan wato yaya jafar da yaya ibraheem, Umar farouk d'an gidan yaya ibraheem da Fatima y'a d'aya tilo gurin yaya jafar". 
    Shiru yayi yaja ajiyar zuciya mai tsayi sannan yaci gaba da basu labarin abinda ya faru kamar yadda Fatima ta fad'a mishi, har zuwa yanzu da take zaune a gidanshi da shuraim d'anta, sai dai ya b'oye musu rasuwar farouk saboda har yanzu bai shirya fad'a musu wannan labari da bakinshi ba. 
     Ya fad'a mishi yadda sukayi da fatima da binciken da aka soma yi mishi akan baffan farouk,  har zuwa yadda suka same shi a k'arshe. 
    
     Hamdala yayi a lokaci d'aya kuma yayi kabbara, "dukkan yabo da godiya sun tabbata ga Allah subhanahu wata'ala sarkin da babu wani sarki a gabanshi ko bayanshi, tun ba'a je da nisa ba gaskiya ta futo ga shi kowa ya ganta, duk mai hankali idan yayi duba da kyau zaiga sofiyyah da khubrah sun girbi abinda suka shuka ne, kuma kamar yadda sofiyyah ta yiwa farouk alk'awarin Fatima gashi Allah ya cika alk'awarin shi a lokacin da sukayi hannun riga kowa ta kama gabanta, sai dai maganar neman ibraheem tabbas yazo mun kwanakin baya, sai dai abinda ya kawo shi ta'aziyyar rasuwar yaro na babba daya rasu kwanaki yazo yayi mun ya tafi, Ni kaina bansan yadda akayi yasan inda nake ba kuma bai yadda nasan inda yake ba, ya nuna min nadamarshi a fili kuma yace zai dinga zuwa lokaci bayan lokaci har khubrah da yaran ma zai kawo mun su, to amma tun daya tafi bai dawo ba har yanzu, watakila akwai abinda ya d'auki hankalin shi, tunda bai bani labarin abinda ya faru tsakanin shi da jafar ba, baya ga haka ni na had'u da fatiman a kwanakin baya can kafun faruwar wannan sark'a tasu, na samo d'an abinda zan rufawa kaina asiri ta taho tana gudun ganganci da mota ta bige ni har tayi sanadin d'an abincin namu, nan ya k'arasa shaida musu yadda sukayi da ita a lokacin......". 

    _flash back_

Idan zaku tuna a farkon pages na Ahali d'aya arfah ta taho tana gudu a mota ta bige wani d'an dattijo, har ta d'auki kud'i ta kai mishi ya zubar Mata da abinta a gurin ya bata sak'o ta kaiwa mahaifiyarta, toh shine wannan mutumin da yake magana da abdussamad yanzu. 
     Sun sake jinjina girman k'udirar ubangiji mai yin yadda yaso a lokacin da yaso. 

     Basu tafi ba saida ya shigar dasu cikin gidan suka gaisa da matanshi, a cikin su babu wadda ta shaida abdussamad lokaci d'aya sai da malam sulaiman yayi musu cikakken bayani, sai duk suka d'auki salati da sallallami suna tafa hannu. 
    Yaran gidan manya da k'anana duk saida suka zo suka gaisa da abdussamad in aka d'auke wanda suke gidan aure mata. Su shamsudden da naseer kuwa kasa d'arawa sukayi ko nan da can har saida yace musu zai koma masaukin shi sannan sukayi mishi rakiya, bai zo da kud'i masu yawa ba amma duk da haka sai da ya ajiye mishi y'an canjin jikinshi sannan ya tafi. 
   Ya tausayawa rayuwar da yayan nasu yakeyi sosai daya shiga cikin gidan, sai duk yaji haushin kud'in da yake nema don basuyi mishi amfani ba ko kad'an, tunda dai ba zai iya taimakon d'an uwanshi da bashi dashi ba. A daren ranar sukayi waya da husna ya shaida Mata komai, amma ya gargad'e ta kan karta fad'awa arfah tukun ta kyaleta kawai. Ita kanta tayi mamaki da jin wannan labari da abdussamad ya dad'e yana mafarkin shi.
   
     Ranar ita kanta batayi bacci sosai ba saboda farin ciki, dama ga cikinta ya tsufa ko baccin ma ta kwanta ba dad'i. Sai kawai ta mik'e ta d'auro alwala don ta mik'a buk'atunta na alkhairy ga Allah subhanahu wata'ala mai kowa mai komai. 
    _husna macece ta gari irin wadda addini yayi umarni da'a aura, duk abinda abdussamad yakeso takan fishi son abun, haka abinda baya so ta tsane shi kenan har gaban abada_. 

   A tak'aice abdussamad bai dawo garin Kano ba saida ya gama daidaita tsakanin shi da yayan nashi da kyau, ana i gobe zai tafi ya d'auki naseer a motar Mansoor suka shiga suka lodo kayan abinci masu yawa, ya siya musu kayan sawa kowa a gidan kala bibbiyu da uniform na makarantun yara da yaga duk sun yayyage, lokacinda suka kawo kayan gidan malam sulaiman kuka ya dinga yi wiwi yana shiwa abdussamad albarka, y'ay'an kansu mamaki sukayi tayi da suka ga ashe da suna da y'an uwa masu kud'i da zasu taimaki rayuwar su amma suketa yin rayuwa cikin wahala da tagayyara, har anayi musu gori a gari, suna zaune ba kwakkwarar sana'a ba karatu mai kyau, sai neman kud'i da yawon tallace tallace. 
     Ranar da zai tafi kud'in daya bashi saida ya dawo da rabinsu yace sunyi yawa, abdussamad yace, "kada ka d'auki wannan a matsayin komai insha Allah wahalar ka tazo k'arshe, daga yanzu ba zaka sake yin rayuwa cikin tagayyara da wulak'antacciyar rayuwa ba". 
    Da zai tafi ya nemi alfarmar su yadda ya tafi da shamsudden yaga muhallin shi ya kwana biyu sai ya dawo, babu damuwa ko d'aya akan fuskarshi ya amince da alfarmar da yake nema. 
(Shi kuma abdussamad yayi hakane saboda yaja yaron yaji inda karatun su ya tsaya yasan yadda zai sama musu tudun dafawa da zasu tsira dashi nan gaba)

      _Kano Nigeria_

Arfah zaune a saman tree seeter cusion idonta sakaye da farin glass tana duba wani littafi, sanye take da doguwar riga ash colour data d'aura gyalen rigar a kanta, har yanzu tana nan yadda take jikinta babu wani sauyi na alamun kwanciyar hankali a tare da ita. 
     Shuraim daya kai a k'alla kusan shekara d'aya da y'an watanni yanzu yana kwance a gadon bayanta ya zuro kanshi ta wuyarta yana faman jera kiran sunanta kamar karatu da gwarancin bakinshi da baya fudda harafin kalmomin dai dai, "Auntie! Auntie!! Auntie!!! Auntieeee". 
    Yaja k'arshen sunan nata kamar zai fashe da kuka. 
    Juyar da kanta tayi ta kalleshi tace, "Ya ilahil alameen, shuraim me kake son inyi maka ne wai?". 

    Hannunshi ya nuna mata yana kallon cikin idonta da shagwob'ab'b'en fuskarshi kamar yayi kuka. 

  Bata gane abinda yake nufi ba don haka sai ta shareshi taci gaba da karance karancenta. 

   Wata irin k'ara daya kwalla saida tasa ta d'an zabura ta dubeshi cikin d'aga murya tace, "shuraim! Allah jikinka zai gaya maka yanzun nan idan baka saurarawa rayuwata ba........".
