Page 62 _(sixty two)_



 Kuka yaron ya sanya yana kallonta a storace, Auntie husna da take aikin taryar mijinta a kitchen futowa tayi jin ihun yaron, dama tun safe ta fahimci ummin nashi a sama take, shiyasa ma yau bata tsaya sauraron taba take ta sabgoginta. 
  
    Don Allah Fatima kiba yaron nan nono ya kyaleki, kinsan dole tunda ba yayeshi kikayi ba ko me zaice sai ya had'a da nonon saboda shine abincin shi daya dogara dashi sauran duk karere ne". 

     Hararar yaron tayi kamar shine yayi mata maganar ta tana ta faman kumbure fuska kamar tayi kukan itama, hannunshi da yake ta k'ok'arin zurawa a rigarta ta rik'o ta juyo dashi zuwa kan cinyarta, banda auntie husna data tsatsareta da ido da kyaleshi zatayi ta fuske, don ita harga Allah ta soma gajiya da wannan shayarwar, "astagfirullah" tayi saurin fad'a kuma a ranta tunowa da tukuicin da Allah yace zaiyiwa mai shayarwa rana gobe kiyama. Allah S. W. T yace zai gina mata gida a aljannah. 
     Dafe kanta tayi har ya gama shan iya na gurbin cikinta ya Soma k'ok'arin sauka daga kan cinyarta. 
    Gyara wuyan rigarta tayi ta soma tattare tarkacenta zata bar parlon. 
    Har ta d'auki hanya ta jiyo ana buga k'ofar parlon, su suhail basa nan saboda inba juma'ah da weekend ba basa zama a gidan yini suke a makaranta. 
    Har auntie husna ta futo sai arfah ta ajiye tarkacenta tace, "Bari na duba auntie". 
     "Ok ba damuwa". Itama husnan ta fad'a ta juya kitchen don kammala aikinta. 

      Gyalen kanta ta ware ya Zama rolling sannan ta bud'e k'ofar. 
    Wani bafullatanin saurayi taci karo dashi wanda a k'alla zaiyi shekara ashirin da bakwai zuwa da takwas a duniya, murmushi yayi mata saboda a tunaninshi itace matar gidan ya d'an russuna yace, "auntien mu ina yini". 
   Batare data saki fuskarta ba ta amsa da, "lafiya qalou". 
    Dai dai lokacin abdussamad ya k'araso gurin, da sauri ta saki fuskarta tace, "sannu da dawowa uncle, dama yanzu nake tunanin sai yaushe zaka dawo?". 
   
    Murmushi mai kyau yayi a kan fuskarshi yace, "eh dole kice haka mana tunda har yanzu kina nan da d'abi'ar ki ta rufe waya". 
    D'an sadda kai k'asa tayi ta basu guri su huce tace, "I'm sorry uncle"
Dai dai zai saka k'afarshi cikin gidan yace Mata, "idan ban sanki ba ko? Ai ni yanzu na gama haddace halinki mamana". 
 Murmushi kawai tayi tana sake jin k'aunar uncle d'in nata har zuciyarta, jinshi take kamar mahaifinta daya haifeta, da farko tsayawa shamsudden yayi a bakin k'ofa har saida uncle yayi mishi magana sannan yabi bayan shi. Yana gaba shamsudden na binshi a baya haka suka shiga gidan. 

    Ita kuwa arfah Saida ta rufe gidan sannan ta biyo bayansu. 

Da husna suka soma cin karo ta futo daga kitchen tana dakon k'arasowarsu, ta nufi inda abdussamad yake da hanzari zata karb'i jakar hannunshi sai taga bashi kad'ai bane ta dawo da baya. 
    Gurin Zama ta nunawa shamsudden saman kujera, bai zauna ba ya zauna k'asan carpet cikin ladabi ya gaisheta, ta amsa shi itama cikin faram faram da sakin fuska. 
    Ko kafun arfah ta shigo husna ta cika su da drinks kala kala, wanda tayi da kuma na kwali masu sanyi. 
     Shuraim yana cinyar uncle yana tayi mishi gwaranci, arfah ta had'a y'an tarkacenta ta nufi hanyar d'akinta.  Shi dai shamsudden binta da kallo kawai yayi a ranshi yana tambayar kenan kawun nasu mata biyu gareshi? Toh amma meyasa ita waccen bata da fuska kamar wannan mai cikin? Tukunna ma a wace k'asar larabawa ko Indian ya samota, koda yake akace kud'i k'are magana, indai da kud'in ka ba inda ba za'a baka mata ba,toh amma ai d'azu kamar uncle yaji ta kirashi.  
     Duk shi kad'ai yake maganar nan a cikin zuciyarshi. 
    Da kyar yasha ruwan roba uncle abdussamad ya nuna mishi wani d'aki da k'ofar shi ta futa harta harabar gidan yace ya shiga abinda babu ya yiwa husna matarshi magana yanzu ta kawo mishi, da toh kawai ya amsa ya mik'e ya shiga d'akin, su kuma suka haura sama. 


         *******         ********


A daren ranar bayan yaran gidan sun taso school duk had'uwa sukayi a parlour suna ta bawa abbansu labarin abinda ya faru da baya nan. 
    Shi dai yana ta sauraron su yana tayasu a wani abun, bayan husna ta gama had'a dinner Zama tayi kusa da mijin nata tace, "abban suhail abinci is ready ko zaka kira d'an yaya sulaiman d'in ya futo naga tun d'azu daya shiga bai futo ba ma". 

    "Eh suhail shiga wancen d'akin ka kirawo yaya shamsudden". 
    Suhail ya mik'e hadda gudu gudunshi ya nufi d'akin da abban nashi ya nuna mishi. 
   "Ya kamata ki kira arfah ma yana da kyau tazo a gabatar mishi da kowa". 

   Ya k'arasa fad'a yana kallon Husna, mammie ta tura ta kirawota. Dai dai lokacinda suhail ya futo shamsudden rik'e da hannunshi yana ta faman zuba mishi surutu. Yanzun ma  a k'asan carpet ya zauna ya sake gaishe su gaba d'aya, sun amsa shi suna tambayar shi gajiya da bak'unta, inda yayi murmushi kawai. 
   
      Abdussamad ne yace mishi don Allah ya tashi daga k'asan nan ya saki jikinshi duk d'aya ne fa. Dole dai ba don yaso ba ya tashi ya zauna kan kujerar, a ganin su yaro baya zama sama babbah ma a sama, tunda suke a gidansu basu tab'a zama kan kujera babun su ma ya zauna akan kujerar ba, amma sai yaga su nan gidan ba ruwansu, koda yake abunka da boko. 

    _nikam nace ai baka ga boko ba tunda baka rayu a gidan jafar jauro ba_

    Abdussamad yana gabatar mishi da kowa na gidan arfah ta futo rik'e da shuraim da yak'i bacci har lokacin, sanye take da zunbulelen hijab hakan ya b'oye asalin kayan da suke sanye a jikinta. 
    Kusan a tare suka kalle ta banda shamsudden da kanshi yake k'asa, uncle ne ya mik'awa shuraim hannu, "a'a sadauki ba kayi bacci ba har yanzu?". 
    Gurin uncle d'in yayi ita kuma ta zauna kusa da Auntie husna. Yaron ya nunawa shamsudden yace, "wannan sune kad'ai baka sani ba a wannan gidan, Umar farouk kenan d'an Fatima da farouk dana baka labarin su a kaduna". 
     D'agowa yayi ya kalli kyakkyawan yaron da kamannin uwarshi suka kusan rinjayar na ubanshi yanzu, sai kuma ya juya kamar mai tsoro ya dubi mahaifiyar yaron, magana suke tayi da yaran gidan kuma hankalinta yana kansu sosai baya jin ma tasan abinda suke ciki. 
     Abinci husna ta mik'e da nufin zuzzubawa, arfah tayi saurin hanata ita ta karb'i aikin don tayi, bayan tayi saving kowa komawa tayi ta zauna ba tare da ta zuba nata ba, "ya baki zuba ma kanki abincin ba?". 
      "D'azu naci abinci bana jin yunwa Auntie". 
   Daga haka ba wanda ya sake ce da ita komai suka d'ad'd'auki abincin su, abdussamad ganin shamsudden ya kasa sakewa sai yace yaje zasu aiko mishi da abincin. 
    Kamar jira yakeyi kuwa ya koma inda ya futo. 
    Bayan tafiyarshi saddiq aka sa ya bi bayanshi da abincin, ita kuma abdussamad yayi mata bayanin dangantakar su da saurayin, shiru kawai tayi ta lula dogon tunani kafun can ta nisa tace, "uncle dama familinku kuna da yawa ne?" 
    "Eh to mu tara ne cif a gun mahaifiyar mu d'aya ya rasu yanzu akwai rayayyu takwas kenan". 
     Abin ya sake bata mamaki tace, "kada na dame ka da tambaya ni da ku uku na sani, kai da baffan farouk sai Abbie d'ina, yanzu kuma kace mun baban wannan shima d'an uwan mune yayanku ne, kaga an samu hud'u ina ragowar hud'un suke kenan?". 
     "Murmushi kawai yayi yace, d'aya ne yake rayuwa anan garin a cikin hud'un amma sauran ukun suna had'e ne a yola, shima daga baya naji labarin ya koma da iyalanshi can da zama". 
     Jinjina kai tayi kamar ba zata sake ce wani abu ba sai kuma again tace, "toh amma ina mamanku da babanku suke? Suma suna can yolan kenan? Sannan meyasa Abbie iya rayuwa bai tab'a zuwa gurinsu ba? Kuma mahaifin farouk ma na fahimci haka ya rayu ba ruwanshi da zuwa gidan su, kamar ni haka farouk bana jin shi ma yasan su". 
    Yanayin fuskar uncle d'in nata saida ya sauya kamar yadda nata yanayin ya sauya a wannan karon jikinshi yayi sanyi, yaji rauni a d'an k'arfin gwiwar daya Soma samu, "zanyi k'ok'ari na baki tarihin mu wata rana dai, sannan Ina nan akan nema miki baffan ki fa". 
     "Nagode uncle Allah yasa a dace". 
     "Ameen ya Allah! Allah yayi miki albarka mamana". 
     Da ameen ta amsa mishi ta kamo hannun shuraim sukayi gaba. 

    
    Kwanan shamsudden uku a gidan abdussamad ya shirya komawa gida, bayan yaji duk labarin da yake son ji d'in, irin wahalar rayuwar da suka Sha yasa ko secondary school shi kad'ai ne ya kamalla a gidan amma duk sauran k'annen shi karatun kakarewa ya keyi a dawo gida a zauna ga wahalar rayuwa ga rashin abinyi, duk wani mutum a anguwar y'ay'an shi suna tasowa yake kaisu kasuwa ko su d'ora da karatu amma su haka sukayi zaune su uku ba abunyi, har tarbiyyarsu ce taso gurb'ata saboda zaman banza, da kyar da taimakon addu'ah da naseehar babansu suka dawo hanya, shine fa babansu ya shiga ya futa ya samo musu tukin napep haya faces su keyi shida naseer k'anin shi suna Kai balance duk sati, shi kuma yayansu dama yana zuwa shagon d'inki kafun Allah yayi mishi rasuwa sakamakon ciwon ciki mai tsanani na dare d'aya. 
    Abin gwanin ban tausayi, shi yanzu abdussamad yana son taimakon su suci gaba da karatu amma lokaci ya k'ure musu, shamsudden almost 28 years a duniya in ya maida shi makaranta ai ya maida shi baya, yana ganin naseer da yake 26 zai yiwa ciku ciku ya tafi ko A. B. U ne, to shi kuma ance bai gama secondary school bama duk da shi takaddun makaranta abune mai sauk'in samu a gurinshi, to amma shi kafun ya gama had'a degree ya bawa shekara talatin baya abin duk saiya rincab'e mishi, dole daga k'arshe ya shiga fafutukar nema wa ko d'aya a cikinsu ne inda zai dinga d'an lallab'awa a kasuwa in yaso shi naseer sai yaci gaba da aikin napep har zuwa lokacinda d'an uwanshi zai kafu ya jawo shi jikinshi su tafi tare. 
     Shamsudden ya koma gida da nufin zai tattara ya dawo gidan abdussamad din din din nan da sati biyu inda zai soma neman kud'i idan har baban nasu ya amince kamar yadda sukayi da abdussamad a waya. 
    Cikin hukuncin ubangiji baban ya amince kuwa, da yake abdussamad yana da mutane y'an kasuwa baisha wahala wajen sama masa inda zai rab'a ba. 

    Kusan manyan abubuwa sun faru masu yawa cikin hutun wata d'ayan daya d'auka a gurin aiki, ciki kuwa hadda haihuwar auntie husna, inda ta sami y'ar ta mace mai kama da abbanta, dangi duk sunzo yi mata barka hadda wad'an da basu tab'a taka gidanta ba  don sai a lokacin iyalan malam sulaiman suka ga muhallin abdussamad. 
 
    Ranar da sati ya kewayo yarinya taci suna ruk'ayyah. 
     
     Farin cikin da wannan Ahali suke ciki Allah yayi yawa dashi, ji suke kamar su Zama tsuntsaye su Nemo ragowar y'an uwansu su had'e. 
     
     Abu d'aya da abdussamad ya b'oye musu har yanzu shine rasuwar farouk, zuwa lokacin ko shamsudden yana zaune a gidan da tambayar a ranshi, yana son yaga farouk d'in nan amma tunda yazo gidan ko labarinshi baya ji anayi, sannan alamu sun nuna arfah tana zaune a gidan ne din din din har makaranta ma take zuwa kamar ba matar aure ba. Koda yake duk wannan abin ba abinda ya kamata ya dame shi bane sai ya watsar dashi gefe ya fuskanci aikin neman kud'in shi. 
      

              @@@@@@@@@


_Bayan shekaru biyu_. 


   Abubuwa da yawa sun faru cikin shekaru biyun nan na dad'i da akasin haka, na farko karatun arfah yayi nisa sosai kuma yanzu ta maida hankalinta tana jin Dad'in karatun nata ba kamar da ba, haka har islamiyyah ta shiga ta asabar da lahadi ta d'ora da karatun islamiyyarta, shuraim yayi wayo har ya shiga makarantar Qur'an memorization tasu suhail, babu laifi zamuce don arfah ganin anyi shekaru ta d'an ajiye komai a gefe amma bawai ta cire daga ranta kwata kwata bane.
     Yawan masoyan da suke b'ulb'ulo mata yanzu abin duk shi ya dameta, a makaranta, a hanya, dede da bak'in uncle sai ta samu masoyi sai dai in basu kyalla ido sun ganta ba.  
   Abinda yafi komai damunta kuma yanzu shine uncle ya soma tuntub'arta da maganar aure. 
    Da farko ta nuna mishi itafa ba wani aure da zatayi, yayi tayi nata fad'a kuwa shine daga baya sai wata dabara ta fad'o mata don su zauna lafiya sai tace mishi "tana son ta daidaita tsakaninta da mahaifinta bayan ta had'u da baffan farouk ne tukun". 
      Da wannan babban dalilin nata shima ya ajiye komai a gefe ya ci gaba da fuskantar abinda yake gabanshi. 

     Ta b'angaren shamsudden komai yana tafiyar mishi yadda ya kamata, kuma yana samun rufin asiri dai dai gwargwado, yana waya da mutan gidansu time after time, haka kullum idan ya tafi kasuwa baya dawowa sai dare, sai ya kasance tsakanin shi da mutanen gidan baya huce gaisuwa da karb'ar abincin dare kona safe wani lokacin. 
    Juma'ah ne kawai baya futa kasuwa, kuma da yake har lokacin bak'o ne shi a garin baya zuwa ko ina, sai dai ya yini a gida su suhail su yini su kuma takura mishi da magana, musamman shuraim da tasu tazo d'aya sosai, yana son yaron akwai wayo ga surutu, a gidan sai yayi wata bai ga arfah da idon Shiba amma duk abinda take ciki in shuraim ya shiga d'akin shi saiya zayyane mishi. 

      A yauma kamar kullum ta dawo daga makarantar ta a gajiye, tana tafe wani soko a fad'arta yana binta a baya, sanye take da doguwar rigar k'irar Saudi Arabia brown, tayi rolling da gyalen rigar sannan ta kawo wani babban gyalen ta d'ora a sama, sai Jakarta ta hannu me d'auke da kud'in ta na transport da wayarta, sai uban handout data rungumo, duka yanayinta ya nuna gajiya muraran. 
     Ko kallon mutumin ba tayi ba ta shige cikin gidansu data tari sa'a yau ta same shi a bud'e. 
     Ko Zama batayi a parlor ba ta fad'a bedroom d'inta. 
    In less dan 30 mint ta shirya cikin wata doguwar rigar mara nauyi, kanta ko kallabi babu ta futo ta shiga kitchen, abinci ta deb'o a plate ta d'auko ruwa ta dawo parlon ta zauna. 
     Ta soma cin abincin kenan taji an shigo parlon da sallama, bata d'ago ba saboda tasan ko muryar waye, d'an zamanta a gidan ta karanci yanayin shi tsaf, haka labarinshi baya k'arewa a bakin shuraim. 
    D'an tattaki yayi ya k'arasa shigowa parlon ya zauna a kujerar da take d'an nesa da tata, ledar maganinshi ya ajiye a gefe kafun yace, "Auntie faaa Ina yini?". Kamar yadda yaji yaran gidan suna kiranta. 
     Bata d'ago ba kanta a k'asa ta amsa mishi da, "lafiya qalou kana lafiya?". 
    "Lafiya alhamdulillah". 

  Shiru ya sake biyo baya, shi yana danna wayarshi ita kuma tana aikin zura abinci a baki, a haka husna ta sauko ta samesu, cikin fara'a tace, "a'a Yaushe kuma kika dawo?". 
     Murmushin daya k'awata fuskarta tayi tace, "ban jima da dawowa ba Auntie ina ruk'ayyah?". 
    Tana bacci a d'aki, husna ta fad'a tana Shirin Zama a d'aya daga kujerun parlon. 
    "Sannu da gida Auntie". 
    Shamsudden ya fad'a bayan ya d'an russuna mata. 
    "Kai za'ayiwa sannu shamsudden ya jikin naka?". 
    "Da sauk'i na warke ma zance". 
    "Toh Allah ya k'ara sauk'i". 
    Ta fad'a itama, "kaci abinci kuwa?". 
   Yamutsa fuska yayi yace, "bar abincin nan Auntie yanzu ba shiga zaiyi ba".  
    "To aikuwa ciwo ba zai tafi ba in baka cin abinci shamsu". 
   "Bari anjima in shuraim zai ci Sai muci tare". 
    Dariya tayi tace, "ah da gaske dai ba abincin zaka ci ba". 
    Shima d'an dariyar yayi. Sunci gaba da hirar su shida auntie husna, arfah duk tana sauraron su amma tak batace ba har ta kammala cin abincinta ta d'auki plate d'in zata mayar kitchen. 
    "Kamar wani yana jiranki a waje kuwa". 
    Shamsudden ya fad'a kamar bada ita yake maganar ba. 
      Sai lokacin ta d'ago kanta ta dube shi, tunda yake a gidan bata tab'a yi kishi kwakkwaran kallo goma irin wannan na ido cikin ido ba, babu laifi yana da kyau dai dai nashi, Shiba fari ba shiba bak'i ba kalar fatarshi tsaka tsakiya. 
   "Saka yayi ka fad'a mun" ta tambayeshi fuska ba wasa, shima tamke fuskarshi yayi tamau yace, "a'a na ganshi ne a waje lokacin dana zo shigowa gida har muka gaisa dashi". 

   "Toh kuma sai aka ce maka ni yake jira?". 

   "Allah ya huci zuciyarki Auntie fa naga kin soma d'aukar zafi". 
    Kanzil bata ce mishi ba tayi hucewarta tana jin haushin shi a ranta, ta tsani shishshigi wa rayuwarta, shi kuma ta fahimci yana da karambani shiyasa bata shiga shirginshi a gidan take rayuwarta a d'aki. 

   Shima tab'e baki yayi bayan ta fuce ya d'auki maganinshi yayiwa husna sallama ya shige d'akin shi, ita dai husna Tana kallon ikon Allah kawai. 



    A washe garin ranar da daddare abdussamad ya kirawota har part d'in shi saboda akwai muhimmiyar maganar da yake son zasu tattauna da ita

_In dedication to my lovely ones_🥰




Page 63 _(sixty three)_



 Da sallama ta shiga d'akin cikin takunta na nutsuwa, yana zaune a saman kujera ya tankwashe k'afafun shi yana shan fruit salad. 
      "Uncle gani" ta fad'a bayan ta durk'usa a gabanshi, "mamana ki zauna sosai mana".
     Ba musu ta gyara zamanta k'asan carpet d'in kanta na k'asa. 
    "Labarin nan da kike sonji yau zan baki, sai dai Ina son kiyi mun alk'awarin zaki nutsu ki fahimci yadda komai yake, kuma ba zaki ji haushi ko ki sake k'ullatar iyayenki ba,har ni kaina kada ki k'ullace ni arfah". 
    Bata kawo komai a ranta ba banda tunanin yadda za'ayi ta k'ullace su daga jin labari, don haka sai ba b'ata lokaci tace, "insha Allah uncle". 

     Ajiye d'an k'aramin bowl na hannunshi yayi ya fuskanceta sosai kafun ya soma magana da fad'in, "kamar yadda na fad'a miki mu asalin fulanin wani gari ne a cikin Nigeria mai suna adamawa yola, mahaifin mu jauro yuseep da mahaifiyarmu mai sunanki duk haifaffun nan cikin garin ne, tun asalin asali kowa yasan tushen kowa, sunyi aure a irin aurenda akeyi a zamanin da na had'i ba tare da an tsaya la'akari da ko suna son junansu ba ko basa so. 
    Allah da ikon shi bayan auren sai soyayyah mai k'arfi ta shiga tsakanin su kuma, a tarihi ance tunda suke basu tab'a fad'a har ta koma gidansu da sunan yaji ba, dai dai gwargwado yana k'ok'arin kyautata mata itama haka, Allah ya azurtasu da samun y'ay'a d'ai d'ai har guda tara duk maza a shekaru k'alilan da aure, baban shamsudden sulaiman shine babban wanmu sai yakub, harun, Isma'il, sannan mahaifin ki jafar, mahaifin farouk ibraheem, sannan Hafiz da shu'aib, sannan ni abdussamad da k'anina Salman wanda Allah yayiwa rasuwa, yanzu haka zancen da nakeyi miki indai ba yau wani ya rasu cikin wad'an da na lissafa miki ba dukansu suna nan da ransu, mahaifiyarmu bata tab'a haihuwar mace ba, babanmu ya k'ara aure a lokacinda yake da y'ay'a biyar a duniya, matar baffanmu mai suna harira tunda tazo gidan rayuwar gidan ta sauya, duk wannan soyayyar dake tsakanin iyayenmu ta shiga ta futa ta zama almakashin data datse igiyoyinta. 
     Ya zamana itace komai a cikin gidan, komai sai abinda tace ko take so za'ayi, amma duk da haka sai innon mu taci gaba da hak'uri ta shanye komai. 
    Dukkannin mu mahaifin mu bai kyale muba kullum da safe zamuyi karatu dashi, idan rana tayi kuma yayyenmu zasu tafi kiwon dabbobi. 
    A haka rayuwarsu ma zance ta dinga tafiya tunda mu ba'a ma maganar mu muna yara k'anana lokacin. 
     Zuwan karatun boko cikin d'an kauyenmu sai ya kawo Cece kuce da mabanbantan maganganu, ya zamana kowa da irin kallon da yake yiwa boko a garin, a lokacinda mahaifinmu ya fahimci y'ay'an sa manya sun fara zuwa makarantar boko hankalinshi tashi yayi, ya kama su ya zane musu jiki ya kuma gargad'e su inna harira tana zuga shi, wannan dukan da akayi musu sai ya Zama katanga tsakaninsu da karatun, sai dai jafar kullum sai ya sulale yaja hannun ibraheem k'anin shi sun tafi, ranar da mahaifin mu ya gane fushin zuciya yayi yace almajiranci zai kaisu, sukayita kuka da kyar dai aka shawo kanshi ya hak'ura. 
  Sai dai sati guda da daina zuwansu malaman makarantar sukayi tattaki suka zo har gida kan dalilin daina zuwan yaran makaranta. 
     Nan fa yuseep jauro ya dinga maseefa da farko ma yak'i saurarar su, su kuma basuyi zuciya ba suka zauna har suka fahimtar dashi abinda ake nufi da ilimin boko, tun daga lokacin sai bai sake kyamatar ilimin boko ba ya bar y'ay'an shi suke zuwa makarantar boko, yayi kunnen uwar shegu da zugar Inna lami da maganganun mutanen gari. 
    Karatun su yayi zurfi musamman jafar daya fi kowa kwazo a yaran garin, hakan yasa daya gama primary malaman suka kawo shawarar a kaishi boarding school ta wani local government dake garin kano, nan ma malam yuseep jauro k'in amincewa yayi har saida aka kai ruwa rana sannan ya yarda da sharad'in sai dai ya tafi tare da d'an uwanshi wai ko ya b'ata a duniya ai zaiga jinin shi. 
     Haka dai aka fi k'arfin kowa suka tafi secondary school d'in nan. 
    A tak'aice a can mahaifinki da mahaifin farouk sukayi secondary school kuma kusancin zaman boarding school da suka samu yasa tasu tazo d'aya sosai, suka tashi kamar gawurtattun abokan juna, komai d'aya zaiyi sai tare da d'an uwanshi, mutane har d'auka suke ko twins ne. 
    Toh mahaifinki ya samu nasarar samun scholarship ta hanyar gamnan jihar daya d'auki nauyin karatun wasu daga d'aliban abroad sai ya zamana har dashi, an rarraba su k'ashashe daban daban shi kad'ai ya samu kanshi a Egypt. 
      Da kyar ya iya tafiya yabar k'anin shi Ibrahim a lokacin, haka innarmu itama dai bata so tafiyarshi ba amma saboda kara yakana da alkunya irin ta mutanen da ko a fuskarta bata nuna komai ba, Inna harira kuwa hassadarta a fili lokacinda wannan babban ci gaba ya zowa wannan Ahali. 
   Tayi zuga tayi famfo amma a gurin baffanmu duk a banza, kinsan akace zakaran da Allah ya nufa da cara............

    Jafar ya had'a degree d'inshi na farko a cikin shekara hud'u kacal, yayi nufin komawa k'asar shi da nasarar daya samo sai dai wani abokinshi ya kwad'aita mishi yin aiki tare da campanyn mahaifinshi alhaji abbu, wanda suka kware wajen futarda takalma iri daban daban masu kyau da inganci, abinda jafar ya karanta daban amma sai gashi ya samu aikin wani abun daban kuma. 
    Kafun wani lokaci ya soma aiki a companyn abbu shahararren balaraben mai kud'i da akayi ittifakin asalinshi ba d'an k'asar bane ma zuwa yayi, ta sanadiyyar nutsuwar jafar kwarewa a aiki da kuma tsayawa gaskiya alhaji abbu ya jashi jikinshi kusa kamar d'an shi ibraheem da yake abokin shi. 
     A lokacin jafar bai b'oye ma y'an gidansu komai ba, kuma yana taimakonsu da abinda yake samu a k'asar, saboda tun a lokacin k'asar tana da rufin asirinta sama dana k'asar mu. 
    
     Kwatsam sofiyyah ta dawo karatu daga America, ranar data sauka airport ibraheem da jafar suka je taryota a ranar soyayyar juna ta shiga zuciyarsu gaba d'aya. 
    Hakan yasa duk hanyar da zata had'a su da juna sai sunbi har Allah yasa suka soma mutumci a tsakanin su, jafar bai nuna mata yana sonta ba saboda harga Allah yana ganin tafi k'arfin shi a komai na rayuwa. 
    Sai dai ita soyayyah akace ba ruwanta da duk wannan, bata saurarawa taka tsantsan d'in suba Saida taga ta keta zuciyarsu biyu ta shiga tayi kane kane a ciki. Soyayyah suke mai k'arfi da basa iya ganin kowa da komai inba junansu ba, a gidansu sofiyyah ba wanda ya sani haka jafar ma ba wanda ya sanarwa har Allah yasa dubunsu ta cika. 
   A ranar da yayan mamanta yazo daga America don a tsaida maganar aurensu tunda ta kammala karatunta, a ranar ta daka tsalle ta dire tace tana da wanda takeso, su kuma iyayenta suka ce bata Isa ba, saboda ana haihuwar ta akayi mishi alk'awarin ta kuma su basa alk'awari su karya. 
    Toh duk yadda suke d'aukar abun sai sukaga ya huce da tunaninsu, duka, izaya, tijara kala kala sai dai duk basu sa sofiyyah ta sauko daga kan bakanta ba, daga k'arshe sai mahaifinta ya sauya shawara ya nuna mata ya amince ta kira musu saurayin nata ayi magana saboda su so suke tayi aure tunda ba abinda take a nan d'in. 
    Bata kawo komai ba cike da wautar k'uruciya ta kira jafar tace a gidansu ana son magana dashi. 
   Lokacin ya gama waya da d'an uwanshi kenan inda yake mishi albishir d'in matarshi ta haihu an samu namiji, yayi farin ciki ya taya kansu murna take anan ya zab'a ma yaron suna Umar farouk. 
    Yana ajiye wayar ne sofiyyah ta kira, yayi picking cikin farin ciki ta sanar dashi yazo gidan ba tare data yadda yasan abinda yake faruwa ba. 
    
    K'asa da minti arba'in yazo gidan nasu. Saida gabanshi ya fad'i a lokacinda yaga duk mutanen gidan da bak'in fuska sun taru a babban parlon gidan suna dakon isowarshi. 
    Su kuma iyayenta madadin su fahimci abun a yadda yake sai suka fahimce shi a bai bai, wato sai suka d'auka cin amanar su yayi ya hure mata kunne ya raba tsakaninta da wanda zata aura, a dalilin haka suka yanke mishi tsattsauran hukunci take, suka koreshi aiki daga companyin su, suka yi mata aure dashi irin aurenda tayi miki k'ask'antacce, duk abinda yake account d'inshi suka d'ebe saboda sunce dole saiya biya su duk irin kud'in da suka kashe a kanta haka al'adar aurensu yake, lastly suka koreta babu su babu ita har abada, kada ma ta sake jinsu a matsayin iyayenta. 
     Tana kuka ta bi mijinta don ta gwammace tabi jafar akan ta zauna tare dasu ta rayu da zab'insu. Haka tabar mamarta, babanta, yayarta (mahaifiyar Fahad) da kuma yayanta ibraheem sai little sis d'inta mai shekaru goma lokacin a duniya. 
    Sun zauna a k'asar kafun su Sami abinda zasuyi kud'in jirgi ya koma famylin shi, saboda har gida ibraheem yayanta yazo yayi mishi warning kan ya tattara yana shi yana shi ya bar musu k'asa inba haka ba kuma zai k'are rayuwarshi a sijin. 
   Jafar yasan halinsu sarai zasu iya yin abinda yafi haka tunda suna da kud'i da d'aurin k'ark'ashi a k'asar. Kuma shima sun tunasar dashi asalin shi, lokaci yayi ai daya kamata ya koma ga nashi ahalin haka.  Lokacinda suka shirya tafiya, sofiyyah sawa tayi tayi yase ticket har d'an yayarta ba tare da sanin yayar tata ba, wadda ita kad'ai ce bata juya mata baya a famylin suba a lokacin. 
   Ranar da zasu tafi da kanta taje makarantar su Fahad tayi magana da me makarantar akan zata tafi gida dashi akwai abinda yake faruwa akeson ganin shi urgent. 
   Matar bata kawo komai a ranta ba saboda tasan yadda sofiyyah take da mamanshi, kuma a wasu lokutan ita take kawo shi makarantar ma.
    Wannan shine dalilin kasancewar Fahad a Nigeria tare daku a gidanku. 

      Sun diro Nigeria zuwa ga asalin jafar, inda anan ne sofiyyah ta raina kanta, domin duk d'an abinda jafar ya samu a companyn babanta basu barshi da komai ba, haka a Nigeria ma bai tsira da komai ba sai gidan da ibraheem yasa ya siya a cikin gari, inda ya ajiye matarshi a part guda, ita kuma data dawo suka sauka a part guda. 
     Satinsu biyu da dawowa Allah yayiwa mahaifinmu rasuwa, mukayi kuka muka shiga damuwa k'arshe muka hak'ura muka bishi da addu'ar samun rahamar ubangiji. 
    Matar babanmu Inna hareera bata bar gidan ba duk da bata tab'a haihuwa a gidan ba a cewarta tayi shekara d'ai d'ai har Sha tare dasu yanzu kuma saita barsu, haka inno mahaifiyarmu bata damu ba ta kyaleta suke zaune tare bayan k'iri k'iri tana nuna mata bak'in ciki da rufin asirin da take samu ta gurin y'ay'a, a lokacin manyan yayyenmu tunda kan yaya sulaiman har zuwa kan yaya Hafiz sunyi aure ko shu'aib ma anyi mishi baiko da wata y'ar makwabtan mu. 
    Ni kuma ina makarantar kwana secondary anan cikin gari. 
   Sosai muke rayuwarmu cikin farin ciki da d'an kwarya kwaryar famylin mu da mukayi creating. 
    Kusan matansu duk na gida ne in aka d'auke mahaifiyarki da khubrah maman farouk. 
    Jafar ya ci gaba da neman kud'in shi da y'an kud'in daya ranta a hannun d'an uwanshi abokinshi, kafun wani lokaci sai gashi ya sake maida abinda ya rasa a k'asar Egypt. 
   Toh matsala ta farko da aka soma samu daga gurin mahaifiyarki ne, ita ta soma zuwa da rarrabuwar kawuna, tana son wannan bata son wancen, duk a dalilinta na k'in talaka, bata son talaka su kuma dangin jafar a lokacin duk talakawa ne. 
   Tunda khubrah ta fahimci take takenta taja jikinta da ita da yaranta, sai dai akace abun ka da yarinta duk lokacinda farouk ya futo ba inda yake yi direct sai part d'inta saboda Fahad da yake kusan kamarshi a lokacin. Duk lokacinda yaje kuma zata jashi a jikinta ta bashi wannan ta mishi wancan, bil hak'k'i tana son yaron mamanshi ce bata so. 
    A wani lokaci da muka had'u a garinmu ana hidimar bikin yaya shu'aib ana hira haka nake zolayarta har cewa tayi indai ta haifi y'a mace saita bawa farouk aurenta. 
    Take anan khubrah ta juya harshe tace Allah ya sauwak'e har abada babu abinda d'an ta zaiyi da jinin maseefa, nan fa fad'a ya kaure sukayita fad'i in fad'a da yarenda ba kowa ne yake jiba a gurin, inda daga k'arshe khubrah ta zage ta tsaf ta goranta mana yadda ta zab'i miji ta bar iyayenta don asara. A ranar duk wani wulak'anci da rashin mutumci da mahaifiyarki tayi mata Saida ta fanshe. 
   Ita kuma sofiyyah abu d'aya ne yafi tsaya mata a rai har ta dinga kuka a gaban mutane, wai ta zab'i miji ta bar iyayenta don asara. 
   Tun daga lokacin ta sake lasar takobin wulak'anta rayuwar khubrah muddin tana da rai da numfashi saita nuna mata ita d'in tafi k'arfin komai a gurin mijinta, kuma tana da power da ikon taka duk Wanda raso da d'aurin k'ark'ashin shi wannan mijin.  
   Lokacinda suka fad'awa mazajensu abinda ya faru a gidan biki duk cikinsu babu wadda ta sami goyon baya, hakan yasa suka barwa ransu abin. 
    Jafar yaci gaba da kasuwancin shi yana taimakon dangin shi da k'anin shi da suke zaune muhalli d'aya. 
    Yayinda rashin haihuwar matarshi yake ci masa tuwo a kwarya, a lokacin khubrah tana da y'ay'a biyu Khadija da farouk, yaya sulaiman kuma yana da yara uku, sauran yayyanmu da baki sansu bama sun soma tara iyali. 
    A shekara ta shida da auren mahaifinki na kammala secondary school d'ina, nan ya d'auki nauyin karatuna a England inda na soma karatun low mai wahala da cin kud'i, amma bawan Allahn nan bai tab'a gajiyawa ba. 
    Na tafi na bar ruguntsumi Kashi Kashi a yola ciki hadda mummunar furucinda Inna hareera tayi akan mahaifiyarmu, wai ta fahimci tana yi mata gani gani saboda tana da y'ay'a a ciki hadda mai arzik'i wanda ya kaita makka, to insha Allah watarana sai ta wayi gari y'ay'an nan duk sun barta. 
  Inno bata ce mata komai ba ta d'auki kwaryar nononta ta shige d'aki ta barta anan. 
     
    After lyk a month 

 Silar rugujewar komai ta faru a lokacinda rikici mai k'arfi ya shiga tsakanin sofiyyah da khubrah, wanda har yayi sanadiyyar da mahaifiyarki ta kai k'arar khubrah, ba tare da bin ba'asi ba aka jefa khubrah a cell aka rufe, tunda suke rigimar nan ibraheem bai tab'a cewa komai ba sai a wannan lokacin, ya dinga bin kan mamanki yana rok'on ta taimaka tasa police su futo da matarshi tunda duk rigimar ta family ce ba sai an wani je gurin hukuma ba, a lokacin burus tayi dashi taja k'afarta ta shige d'aki ta barshi anan. 
      A ranar yayi ta kiran jafar, shi kuma yana cikin uzuri bai samu damar d'agawa ba, sai a washe gari da duk suka had'u a station, karo na farko da ran ibraheem ya b'aci yaji ba dad'i akan yayan nasa saboda a gabanshi yayi waya da lowyen shi yace a tsare mishi matar har sai yazo. 
   Shi kuma fa baisan ko wace mace bace, kawai sofiyyah ta fad'a mishi a bai bai wata y'ar iska ta shigo har gida taci mutumcinta ba tare daya bincika wacece ba saboda sonda yake yiwa matarshi ya bada wannan umarni. 
    Lokacinda ya dawo khubrah satinta uku a gidan gyaran hali, abu d'aya da yayi daya fahimci wadda yasa aka rufe sawa yayi a futo da ita. 
   A lokacin ne ran ibraheem ya b'aci har sukayi fad'i in fad'a tsakanin shi da d'an uwan nashi, tun suna rigimar a tsakaninsu har manyan yayyansu suka shiga. Inda anan take wasu suka bawa matar jafar rashin gaskiya, shi kuma yayi fushin zuciya yace dama shi yasan sun tsani matarshi ba tun yau ba, shi kuma tunda ta zab'e shi akan iyayenta yanzu ya soma Zama da ita, kan ya rabu da ita sai dai su ya rabu dasu. 
     Nan fa rikici ya koma tsakanin su, ido rufe ba tare da tunanin mahaifiyarmu da bata da kowa sai muba suka tarwatse kowa ya kama gabanshi, da alk'awarin su da had'uwa har abada, a ciki har da me barin wasiyyar ko mutuwa yayi wani yaje kan gawarshi cikin y'an uwanshi bai yafe musu ba. 
    Sati biyu da yin haka jafar ya tattara matarshi da Fahad suka koma England, inda aka haife ki kenan". 

Shiru yayi yana dannar hawayen idonshi yana mai sake tsananta jin haushin kanshi da rayuwarshi,

Husna da basu San lokacin data shigo parlon bace tayi tsam ta d'auko hankie ta mik'a mishi, bai karb'a ba ya rik'e hannuwanta duka yana fad'in,
 Nayi kuskure! Nayi kuskure husna! bamu tab'a tunawa da ita ba, mun gaza fahimtar girmanta da girman halaccin da tayi na haifo mu kyauta zuwa wannan duniyar, mun zab'i mu nisanta kanmu da ita duk da ba tayi mana laifin komai ba, ta wani fannin ma har gwara su yaya ibraheem da jafar tunda su an samu matsala ne dasu har abinda ya faru ya kasance, Amma ni kuwa fa, kawai yanke hukunci nayi ba tare da kwakkwaran dalili ba, na barta tsawon shekaru har na manta ma ina da ita kotana raye ko ta mutu ma ban sani ba husna, kaicona! Kaicona da shiga wannan rud'in rayuwar da har ya rud'e ni na kasa tuna komai daya dace koya kamata dani". 

 Kuka yakeyi iya k'arfin shi abinda husna bata tab'a gani a tare dashi ba tsawon shekarun da suka kasance tare. Itama jikinta a sanyaye ta sake matsawa kusa dashi ta kwantar da kanta a gadon bayanshi tana share hawayenta, rintse hannunta ya sake yi gam yana kuka yana jujjuya kanshi. 
  Ita kanta arfah jiki a salub'e ta kamo hanya ta soma saukowa daga step gabobin jikinta kamar an buge mata su. 

  Ko lura da shamsudden da yake tsaye rungume da shuraim batayi ba har saida ta kusan hucewa ta gabanshi sannan yayi gyaran murya yace, "Auntie fa! Ga shuraim fa". 
  Tsayawa tayi ba tare data juyo ba ta share hawayen idonta tace, "ka barshi ya kwana a gurinka kawai". 
     "Kin San bazai yadda ba kona barshi cikin dare zai saka rigimar sai ya taho gurinki". 
    Jikinta a mace yake kuma ahalinda take ciki na tashin hankali ba zata iya d'aukar shiba, saboda haka sai ta nuna mishi hanyar shiga d'akinta tace, "shiga ka kwantar dashi". 
   Da mamaki yake kallonta yana mamakin furucinta a lokacinda ta juyo suna fuskantar juna idonta a k'asa, jira take ya ajiye yaron sai ta sami damar shiga d'akin itama. 
   "Kina ganin ya kamata na shiga d'akin ki haka Kai tsaye". 
    Cikin k'osawa da kalolin nemar maganar shi a gidan tace, "bani nace maka ka shiga bane? Nace ka barshi a gurinka kace gashi gashi, nace ka kaishi kuma ka tsaya kana wani ja inja, ni kuma na gaji bazan iya d'aukar shi ba, in yadda nace d'in baiyi maka ba kayi yadda kake so kawai"
 
   Ko jiran abinda zai sake fad'a ba tayi ba ta huce cike da takaicinshi ta barshi a gurin. 
   Bata yi burki a ko'ina ba sai a parlon ta inda ta zauna saman doguwar kujera ta fashe da kuka mai ciwo, tana jinjina girman ta'asar da mahaifiyarta tayi, anya wannan Ahali zasu iya yafewa mamanta kuwa, ta raba kan zumunci ta raba y'ay'a da mahaifiyarsu, a k'arshe ta bar dangin mijinta cikin talauci da wahalar rayuwa, yayinda suke zaune cikin wadata, iya kud'in da suka b'arar mata daga haihuwarta zuwa yau ba tare da kwakkwaran dalili ba ya isa su fudda danginshi daga k'angin yunwa da tagayyarar rayuwa, meyasa ammie ta zab'i ta zama marar Imani haka saboda son zuciya?.

Page 64 _(sixty four)_



 Ta sake yin kuka a ranar irin wanda ta dad'e batayi ba a rayuwarta har kamar ma ba zata daina ba, shamsudden har ya shigo ya kwantar mata da shuraim bata sani ba tana ta kuka kanta a k'asa. 

       _Washe garin ranar_

Kamar kullum tunda ta tashi sallar asuba bata koma ba ta shiga hidimar gyare gyaren gida da shirya su shuraim da mammie. 
   Zuwa k'arfe bakwai saura suka futo cikin shiri, shuraim yana gaba yana ta zuba mata surutu, ita dai duk ba sauraron shi ma takeyi ba, ta nufi dinning area inda Auntie husna ta shirya breakfast rik'e da hannun mammie. 
   A nan suka had'u dasu suhail da suka futo suma cikin shiri, bata iya cin wani abu kwakkwara ba ta d'an tsakura ta tashi, yau ita zata huce dasu ta ajiye su itama ta huce tata makarantar. Har ta tafi yau bata had'u da d'aya cikin Husna ko Uncle ba, a gurguje suka ajiyesu a napep ita kuma sukayi gaba da mai napep d'in. 

       Kwana biyu da yin maganarsu da uncle bata ganinshi a gidan, hakan yasa yau data taso school ta nufi sassan auntien don tayi magana da ita, ta soma taka stairs ta had'u da auntien tana saukowa. 
    Tsayawa tayi har ta k'araso inda take, "barka da rana Auntie, ina Shirin zuwa miki kina saukowa". 
  "A'a to ko mu koma saman ne?"
   "A'a Auntie dama hawa saman akwai wahala". 
   D'an dariya husna tayi suka k'arasa saukowa tare. 
    A d'aya daga kujerun dinning suka zauna suka sake gaisawa, kafun ta soma fad'awa husna abinda take son fad'a matan. "Auntie wai uncle yana gari kuwa?".
   D'an Jim tayi don tasan dama dole zata tambaya kafun tace, "ya je wata seminar Lagos amma munyi waya dashi insha Allah gobe zai dawo". 
    "Ok Allah ya dawo dashi lafiya"  
   Ta k'arasa fad'a k'asa k'asa sakamakon shigowar shamsudden parlon nasu. 
    Gefen kujerar da take kai ya tsaya ya  soma gaisawa da Auntie husna, tsam ta tashi zata bar gurin, har ta soma yin gaba shamsudden yace, "Auntie Fatima barka da yamma". 
   "Lafiya". Ta fad'a kawai a hagunce tayi hucewarta. 
   Girgiza kanshi yayi ya sake dawo da dubanshi ga Auntie husna yace, "matar uncle kunyi waya da uncle kuwa?". 
    Tace, "eh d'azu ma da safe har yake shaida mun suna hanya gobe". 
    "Ya fad'a miki shida waye zasu zo goben?". 
    Girgiza mishi kai tayi tace, "a'a yace is a surprise sai yazo, nifa tunda ya tafi bai bani labarin komai ba har fargaba nake da naji shi shiru har haka". 
    Murmushi yayi yace, "toh bari nima nayi shiru da bakina....". 
    Harararshi husna tayi tace, "Kai shamsu haka zamuyi dakai?". 
    D'an dariya yayi yace, "in na fad'a miki yanzu  Auntie ai ya dawo ba surprise ba kenan, sannan ai kema ba kya so na lalatawa uncle aiki ba ko?". 
    Sake girgiza kai tayi tace, "ai shikenan". 

   Zama yayi a kujerar da arfah ta tashi yace, "yauwa Auntie nifa akwai abinda nake son tambayarki game da auntie Fatima". 

    "Ehem fad'i tambayarka kai tsaye ina jinka". 
    "A labarin da uncle ya bamu yace arfah tayi aure da d'an k'anin babanta, toh Amma ni tunda nake zaune a gidan nan tsawon shekaru biyu ban tab'a ganin shiba, kuma dai ko makaho ya kwana biyu a gidan nan zai gane bata yawo da auren kowa a kanta, shine idan babu damuwa nake son naji me yake faruwa da ita ne, sannan meyasa idan ta ganni sai ranta duk ya b'aci, Auntie na fahimci arfah ta tsaneni a gidan nan 4 no reason". 
   Ajiyar zuciya mai tsayi Auntie husna taja kafun ta nisa tace, "toh ni dai duk a wannan al'amarin ba abinda zan iya cewa sai ka tambayi uncle d'inka shi kad'ai yake da amsar wannan, sannan kamar yadda ka fad'a arfah bata yawo da auren kowa, kuma mu kanmu a gidan nan mafi yawan lokuta uzuri muke mata, abinda take yi maka ba wai tsana bace ko k'iyayyah......". 

    "Tsana ce Auntie! Tsana ce k'iyayyah ce! A duk lokacinda na kalli cikin kwayar idonshi, Ina iya ganin wani bak'on yanayi da yake dannewa da b'oyewa a ranshi, idan har zan ci gaba da ganin wani abu bak'o a tare dashi sab'anin na y'an uwan taka to baza mu tab'a zama lafiya da juna ba". 
    
    Arfah takai k'arshen zancen a dai dai lokacinda ta gama shigowa cikin parlon gaba d'ayanta. 
    Duk dubanta sukeyi baya ma husna da take mamakin abinda taji tana fad'a. 
   "Ki fad'a mishi gaskiya Auntie yadda nakeyi muku daban da yadda nakeyi mishi"
   "Lab'e kikeyi mana ne?". Husna ta fad'a ba fara'a akan fuskarta ko d'igo"  
  Girgiza kai arfah tayi alamun a'a tace, "kema kinsan abinda bazan tab'a yi ba ne Auntie tunda ba hali na bane, na zo shigowa na d'auki wayata dana manta naji yana fad'in wai na tsane shi, maganar ta dakeni ta yadda na kasa ci gaba da d'aga k'afafuna har saida naji amsar da kika bashi".   Ci gaba da girgiza kai tayi kafun taci gaba da magana, "Auntie mijina ya mutu ku daina b'oye musu? Sai dai abinda nake son kowanne saurayi ya sani farouk ya tafi tare da duk wani farin cikin rayuwata, farouk ya tafi da soyayyar dashi ya Gina abarshi dama gaba d'aya shiyasa har gaban abada bazan tab'a jin ko d'igon  son wani bayan shi ba...........". 
    Yadda ta gama yin maganar cikin d'aga murya haka taji zuciyarta tana azalzala da son futowa kowa yaga abinda ke cikinta ko sa gasgatata, da sauri ta juya zatayi d'akinta shamsudden daya ke tsaye ya nufeta yasha gabanta da hanzari ya tsaya. 
   "Babu wata soyayyah da take mutuwa muddin gangar jiki tana raye, farouk ya mutu wannan kam na yadda, amma maganar kice baki da sauran zuciyarda wani zai samu gurbi ya rayu a ciki k'arya ce, da zaki bawa wani d'an Adam dama? Da kin raina waccen soyayyar da kike tak'amar kina yiwa farouk ita tun kafun aje da nisa........." 
    Bata bari ya rufe bakinshi ba ta d'aga hannu da nufin wanke shi da wani lafiyayyen mari, sai dai karaf Auntie husna ta rik'e hannunta, "kada ki Soma gwada wannan d'anyen kuskuren arfah......". 

    Tsayawa tayi kawai tana kallonsu d'aya bayan d'aya a yayinda hawaye suke ta ambaliyar sauka daga kwayar idanunta. 
    Cikin d'acin rai da k'unar zuciya ta nufi d'akinta a guje, tana shiga bedroom ta murza key ta fad'a kan katifa tana risgar uban kuka. 
     Abinda ba zata tab'a iyawa ba kenan, abinda ba zata tab'a aikatawa ba muddin tana motsi da numfashi a doron duniya, ba zata iya soyayyah da wani mutum ba farouk ba? Hakan ma ai kamar sab'o ne. 
    Ranar kamar mahaukaciya haka tayi filla filla da komai na d'akin tana sambatu cikin futar hayyaci, Babu irin bugun dasu shuraim basuyi mata da Auntie husna ba amma taki bud'e k'ofar. A halinda take ciki a lokacin bata buk'atar kowa a kusa da ita. 
    Baci! Basha! Sallah ma da kyar ta iyayi haka ta kwana a d'akin ita kad'ai, duk wasu memo's da take rubuta irin adadin yadda take son farouk a ranar Saida ta futo dasu, raba dare tayi tana karantawa tana sake jadadda kowacce kalma da iya gaskiyarta. 
    
     



     _Washe gari_ 



Kiran sallar farko ta tashi daga d'an baccin daya samu nasarar d'aukar ta a ranar, lallab'awa tayi ta shiga bathroom da yake cikin d'akin tasa ruwa a heater tayi wanka ta d'auro alwala. 
    Sai da tayi nafiloli sannan ta maida sallar asubah. 
    Bata iya komawa baccin ba saboda matsanancin ciwon da kanta yakeyi da sarawa. 
    Hakan yasa gari yana yin haske ta lalubi doguwar rigar less ash colour da gyale ta d'auki handa bag d'inta ta zura takalmi, yaran duk basu tashi ba kasancewar weekend, gidan tsit sai Auntie husna da take ta kwarabniya da kwanuka a kitchen uban zance yana ta faman zuba mata surutu. 
    Inda ta bar wayarta jiya ta soma lalubawa sai taga an mik'o mata wayar, karb'a tayi ta d'ago sukayi 4 eyes da Auntie, da kyar ta iya saisaita yanayinta tace, "Ina kwana Auntie?". 
    "Fatan kin tashi lafiya?". Ta tambayeta itama. 
   K'asa k'asa da murya tace, "lafiya Lou". 
   "Anguwa zaki da sassafe haka?" 
     Auntie ta tambayeta ganin har ta d'auki hanyar fucewa daga parlon. 
    Juyowa tayi tace, "Eh zanje asibiti bana jin dad'i". 
    "Wane asibiti yau weekend?"
     "Eh zan Kira doctor fu'ad in naje asibitin shi" ta fad'a a k'agauce. 
     "Ok Tom Allah ya tsare ya bada lafiya". 
   Husna ta fad'a kowa ta nufi hanyarta. 
    Harta d'ora hannunta a handle d'in k'ofar shuraim da yaji maganarta ya futo rik'e da mug a hannu yace, "Auntie ina zaki tafi ki barni kuma?". 
   Cikin b'acin rai ta dubeshi,  "inda ka aikeni" 
      Ajiye mug d'in yayi ya nufota yana wuwwula k'afa, "please Auntie don Allah yau kije dani tunda rannan da Mamie kika tafi kuma kinyi mun alk'awari pleeeaseeeee". 
     "Will you shut up ko sai nazo na Zane ka a gurin".  Ta daka mishi tsawa tana maka mishi harara. 
   Auntie husna data barsu a gurin ta shiga kitchen ce ta futo tana fad'in, "a'a kukan me shuraim kuma yakeyi?" 
     "Ummie wai ba zata je dani ba....." 
    Ya fad'a cikin muryar shagwob'a da kuka. 
    "Haba arfah yayi miki rakiya mana nan da asibitin doctor fu'ad dai?"

    Shiru tayi kamar ba zata ce komai ba, wannan shine abu na k'arshe da bazai tab'a shiga tsakanin ta da husna ba, wato ta sakata yin abu ta k'iyi yi, don haka saita dawo da baya ta zauna kan kujera ta dubeshi yana ta tsallen murna tace, "sai kazo muje ka cire kayan baccin nan ko dashi zaka?". 
    Cikin farin ciki yace, "Eh Auntie yaya shamsudden ma ai muna futa gym dashi a haka......"

   "Ba zaka bar wannan shegen maganar ba kenan?" Ta sake had'a rai tana kallonshi bayan ta fad'a. 
   Da sauri ya mik'e yayi part d'in nasu itama ta Mara mishi baya. 
   Auntie husna kam komawa tayi kitchen tana girgiza kai, ita dai har yanzu bata san ranar da arfah zata girma da rigingimun taba. 
   
    Sharp sharp tayi mishi wanka ta shirya shi cikin riga da wando na English wears da Suka yi matuk'ar mishi kyau. Shiya rik'o mata jakar Suka futo tare, sallama suka sake yiwa Auntie husna sannan suka futo, napep ta tare ta fad'a mishi inda zai kaisu.
   Ba suyi cikakken minti talatin ba suka Isa hospital d'in ta sallameshi. 
    Tafe take rik'e da hannun shuraim da duk abinda ya gani saiya tambayeta, duk daba amsa take bashi ba amma bai fasa tambaye tambayenshi ba. 

    Saida Suka shiga reception sannan ta kira no fu'ad d'in. 
    Bayan sun gaisa ya gama zolayarta ta shaida mishi tana asibitin shifa, "aikuwa kinyi sa'a ina asibitin, don akwai wani patient d'ina da sukazo tun daga gombe matsalar brain disorder ne toh alhamdulillah yaji sauk'i ma ras matsalar da suke tunani abune daga zuciyarshi ba wai kwakwalwarshi ba, shine nake son na gama dasu na huce gida, to kuma gaki ma kinzo Allah yasa dai kin taho min da fura da nono ko shayinku na larabawa?". 
     D'an murmushin yak'e tayi tana hararar wayar cikin k'arfin hali tace, "uhm sai kazo dai kawai doctor". 
    Daga haka ta kashe wayarta gudun ma kada ya sake rik'e ta da wani zancen, doctor fu'ad uban zance kamar shi ya haifi shuraim d'inta, daga tambayar shi ya tsayar da ita da labarin wani patients d'inshi ko me ya dameta dasu ma oho mishi. 
    Tana kallo wayarta tana ring ta jefa ta jaka don da kowanne motsi ko magana kanta sake d'aurewa yakeyi kamar kwakwalwar kan ta futo waje a huta. 

   Tana nan zaune after some minute wata nurse sanye da fararen kaya tazo ta tambayeta, "kece fatima jafar da kike jiran doctor fu'ad?". 
    Gyad'a Mata Kai kawai tayi. 
   "Ok follow me" nurse d'in ta fad'a. 
   Bin bayanta sukayi ita da farouk har office d'inshi. 
   Ta bud'e musu suka shiga ita kuma ta huce, a d'aya daga resting chairs da suke office d'in ta kwanta don ba zata iya zaman ba. 
    Bayan wasu mintunan nurse d'in ta sake dawowa da take away guda uku da tea plask sai cups tsabtatattu, ajiye musu biyu tayi a gabansu d'aya kuma takai tebur d'inshi. 
    Arfah tasan kad'an daga kirkin fu'ad kenan, bai huce sai biyu data tab'a zuwa ganinshi akan yawan ciwon kan da take yawan yiba sai wannan, amma yana treating d'inta kamar y'ar uwarshi ta jini, ita saninta dashi ma ta dalilin wata course mate d'inta ne, a wata rana da bataje makaranta ba saboda ciwon kai, Washe gari da take tambayarta ko lafiya bata zo jiyaba suna da test, nan ta shaida mata tana fama da ciwon kai ne. 
    A take ta bata shawarar taje ta ganshi kwararren likitan kwakwalwane, akwai wata yayarta da take fama da mental problem shi suke kaita take gani yanzu taji sauk'i sosai. 
    Haka kurum sai arfah taji hankalinta ya kwanta har taji zuciyarta ta aminta taje, ranar data Soma ganinshi da fulatanci ya tambayeta ko me yake damunta, amma saita nuna mishi ita bata jin yaren duk da taji shi Sarai tunda Abbie yakan yara mata ai, ganin haka sai yace to Arab ce kenan, nan ma tace a'a, sai yace aikuwa bazai yiwu ba dole ke bafulatana ce y'ar uwata ko Arab. 
    Ita kuma arfah rawar kanshi ce tayi mata yawa shiyasa taki sakin jiki dashi karsu Sami wani kusanci, shi kuma tun daga lokacin ya koma kiranta bafulatana Arab. Duk lokacinda tazo saiya tambayeta fura da shayi, a cewarshi in ba'a samu d'aya ba za'a samu d'aya.  
    Take away d'in ta bud'ewa shuraim ta mik'a mishi don tasan shi maybe zaici ita kam bata jin zata iya cin komai. 
     Sake komawa tayi ta kwanta tana nazarce nazarcenta. 
     A haka wani b'arawon bazataccen bacci yayi awon gaba da ita. 
     Shuraim ya d'an cakuli wanda zai iya ci a ciki ya ajiye, ya shiga kewaye kewayen shi a office d'in yana yima komai dallah dallar bayani, a haka har ya fahimci bacci maman nashi take ya saci jiki ya fuce daga office d'in.

    Inda Suka baro d'azu ya koma ya samu wasu mutum biyu suna zaune a gurin, na farko ya durk'usar da kanshi rabin fuskarshi d'aure da hankie, sanye yake da shadda milk, k'afarshi rufe cikin takalmin fata k'irar Gucci, hannunshi kuma d'aure da agogon fata shima mai tsada da zobunan azurfah masu kyau. 
    Gashin kanshi ma'abocin kyau sai d'aukar ido yake an saisayeshi sama sama. Shuraim ya kewaya su yafi sau shida, musamman kujerar da guy d'in nan yake zaune, ganin haka sai wanda yake kusa da mutumin yace, "ya dai boy kana neman wani abune?". 
   Cikin kyakkyab'e fuska kamar zaiyi kuka yace, "na ajiye wayata anan d'azu da muka zauna nida Auntiena yanzu kuma na dawo ban ganshiba". 
   Tayashi dubawa mutumin yayi yace, "kaga dai gashi na duba maka amma ban ganshi ba Ina tunanin ba anan ka barshi ba ka dai duba wani gurin". 
   "Allah ni anan na barshi sai dai idan kun b'oye zaku yimun irinta yaya shamsudden". 
    Abun sai ya matuk'ar baiwa mutumin mamaki yace, "yaro da gaske nakeyi bamu gani ba fa, mu da bamu sanka ba ta ina zamuyi maka irin wasan yayanka?". 
  Cikin wata shagwob'ar yace, "Uncle ni sunana farouk! Ba yaro ba, Abbah yana kirana sadauki, ummie ma haka, ita kuma Auntiena tana kirana da shuraim tace so take na Zama mahaddacin alqur-ani kamar mai sunan". 
    Sosai maganar yaron ta baiwa mutumin dariya ya shigayi kuwa babu k'ak'k'autawa. 
   Guy d'in da yake durk'ushe a gefe sai lokacin ya d'ago ya kai kallonshi ga wannan yaro uban zance da wayo kamar d'an aku. Saida gabanshi ya fad'i a lokacinda idonshi ya sauka akan yaron, farouk! Shuraim! ya maimaita sunan a fatar bakinshi ba tare dama yasan yayi hakan ba, shuraim kuwa jin ya fad'i sunanshi duka biyu sai ya k'araso gabanshi yayi tsayuwa irinta matasa yace, "kaima idan kanaso zaka iya kirana da wani sunan daban, saboda a makarantarmu.......". 
    Shiru yayi yana kallon kwayar idon guy d'in da shima shi yake kallo kafun ya kai bakinshi saitin kunnenshi yayi magana cikin k'asa k'asa da murya, "a makarantarmu auntien mu tana kirana da brainy". 
   Murmushi guy d'in yayi ya matsa mishi kusa dashi yace, "zauna Mr brainy don nima sunan da zan kiraka dashi kenan". 
    Zama yayi kamar dama yasan mutumin yace, "meyasa?". 
   K'asa shima yayi da muryarshi ya fad'a mishi, "saboda shi yafi dacewa dakai". 
   Murmushi shuraim yayi yace, "zaka iya Zama abokina kaima?". 
   "Me zai Hana?". Guy d'in ya fad'a. 
    Shiru shuraim yayi yana kallon guy d'in da har lokacin rabin fuskarshi yake rufe kafun ya sake zaro wani zancen, "toh amma har yanzu baka fad'a mun sunanka ba? Kuma ma fuskarka a rufe take bansan kamannin kaba". 
  Lumshe idonshi yayi guy d'in yana jinjinawa wayo da baseerar yaron, irinsu bature yake kira da gifted! Y'an baiwa tun daga haihuwa. 
    Ni sunana Muhammad, ya fad'a sai kuma yayi shiru kamar mai tunanin wani abu kafun ya dafe kanshi da duka hannuwanshi. 

    Ita kuwa arfah cikin barci taji kamar maganar mutane haka sama sama, sai ta bud'e idanunta tana kallonsu daga kwance ba tare data motsa ba. 
   Doctor fu'ad ne da wata mata suke yin magana matar sai hak'ik'icewa takeyi. 
    Haba doctor, yanzu a k'alla kusan wata guda kenan yana yi mana maganar abinda babu shi bamu sanshi a tare dashi ba kuma ace yana cikin cikakken hankalinshi? Kai kasan wahalar da muke sha tare dashi a duk lokacinda matsalarshi ta motsa, zai yini ya kwana bai kalli kowa ba, baiyi magana da kowa ba wallahi har tsoro nake kada daga haka wani abu mummuna ya faru dashi kuma, shiyasa na takurawa Honorable Saida ya siya mana ticket muka taho gurinka don kawai musan meye matsalar sai a samu hanyar yin maganinta, Kai kuma kace mun yanzu wai ba wata matsala bace"
   "Calm down hajiya ba wani abu na tashin hankali bane Ina ganin he's about to go back to his normal sense, daga yanzu zuwa kowanne lokaci zaku dinga ganin bak'in abubuwa a tare dashi". 
    Numfashi mai tsayi taja sannan tace, "Ina fatan haka likita, yanzu yana Ina ma Muhammad d'in?". 
  Da sauri arfah ta mik'e zaune tunowa da shuraim da tayi itama, shegen son yawonshi da shishshigi yasa bata fiye futa dashi ba, yanzu sai ya had'a mata zumuncin dole da mutanen da bata sani ba. 
     "Sorry Fatima I keep you waiting, na d'an shiga uzururruka shiyasa kika jini shiru". Doctor fu'ad ya fad'a  a lokacinda ta mik'e zaune tana gyara yafen gyalenta. 
    Murmushi tayi mishi tace, "ba damuwa likita". 
   Matar da take tsaye gabanshi ta dubi arfah da take ta dub'i dub'in neman shuraim a office d'in. 
    "Akwai abinda kike nema ne?". 
   "Aaah! Shuraim nake nema ko ka ganshi". 
  
    "Okay tare kuka zo?". Doctor fu'ad ya sake tambayarta. 
    "Eh" ta fad'a a tak'aice tana shirin bud'e k'ofar office d'in, duk bin bayanta sukayi suna addu'ar Allah yasa yana cikin hospital d'in ba waje yayi ba. 
     Cikin sauri da sassarfah take shiga lungu da sak'o tana dubawa da kiran sunanshi su kuma suna biye da ita. 

     A reception ta tsaya inda ta ganshi dai dai lokacinda yake warware hankie d'in fuskar Muhammad yana dariya har ya wareshi gaba d'aya. 
     "Yeah! Naga fuskarka" ya fad'a cikin farin ciki. 
   Shi kuma Muhammad yaja mishi kumatu yace, "mai wayo wai wa yake koya maka abubuwa?". 
   Ya bud'e baki zai fad'i sunanta yaganta tsaye ta zuba mishi ido tana kallo da fuska murtuk. 
     "Sorry Auntie" ya fad'a k'asa k'asa cikin marairaicewa yana zamowa daga saman kujerar zai nufeta. Juyawa shima Muhammad yayi don ganin wannan auntien da duk rabin hirar shuraim tata ce, a dai dai lokacinda idonsu ya fad'a cikin na juna unexpected, take suka shiga musayar kallo ba tare da dukkannin su sun shiryawa hakan ba. 
    Hajiya ce ta nufeshi da azama tana fad'in, "Muhammad dama nan ka taho?". 




_Kuyi hak'uri na tafi ba ko sallama, abubuwa sunsha kainane sosai Ina fatan munyi azumi lafiya mun gama lafiya, fatan Allah ubangiji ya karb'i ibadun mu ya samu a cikin y'antattun bayi inayi muku barka da sallah tare da fatan kunyi sallah lafiya_.

Page 65 _(sixty five)_



 Ko kafun ta k'arasa gareshi kwakwalwarshi ta gama jirkicewa, abubuwan da yake ta son tunowa tsawon lokaci suka Soma dawo mishi daki daki, sai ya d'ora hannunshi a saman kanshi kawai ya rik'e kan yana ambaton sunan Allah. 
    Ita kuwa arfah cikin kid'ima gigita had'e da razana ta Soma nuna shi da hannunta, ta kasa yin maganar ma sai motsa baki kawai amma ba murya. Ganin haka sai doctor fu'ad ya tambayeta, "Fatima kin sanshi ne?". 
    Sai a lokacin muryar tata ta futo ta kira sunan shi da k'arfi kamar wadda take yin magana da wani a nesa da ita. "farouk". 
    Muhammad bai San lokacinda ya d'ago ya sake dubanta ba, ya mik'e tsaye da nufin zuwa gurinta ko sauraron maganar mum d'inshi ma bayayi, sai dai taku biyu ana uku ya yanke jiki ya fad'i k'asa sumamme. 
   Ba b'ata lokaci duk suka nufeshi sai dai ko kafun suje arfah ta rigasu ta Soma jijjigashi tana faman kiran sunanshi, "farouk, farouk ka tashi ka tashi don Allah dama ni nasan baka mutu ba kana raye, ka tashi mu tafi gidanmu muci gaba da rayuwarmu cikin farin ciki mai d'orewa..........". 
    Sai kawai ta kife kanta a kirjinshi tana jan numfashi ta sake fashewa da wani sabon kukan.
    Hajiya ce da tayi saroro ta dubi likita fu'ad ta sake duban arfah tace, "ke kina cikin hankalinki kuwa? Doctor ko itama tana da mental case ne? Wannan fa d'ana ne kuma sunan shi Muhammad ba farouk ba, sannan bai tab'a yin aure ba ta Ina ma ya sanki shida yaune karon farko daya tab'a taka k'afarshi Kano..... Doctor fu'ad kayi mata bayani.....". 
   Murmushi fu'ad yayi ya durk'usa kusa da ita yace, "zo muje office muyi magana a nutse yadda zaki fahimta fatima". 
    Da wani irin yanayi a fuskarta ta d'ago ta dubeshi tace, "kana nufin na tafi na bar mijina anan doctor? Bayan wahalar da nasha tsawon lokaci Ina nemanshi da kewarshi? Ai wallahi in kaji mai rabani da mijina anan gurin sai mutuwa......". 
   Yanzu kam hajiya cikin fusata da b'acin rai tayi mata magana, "keee! Ki kama kanki tun kafun na mance da lalurarki na sab'a miki, na fad'a miki wannan yaron d'ana ne babu abinda yake had'a shi da mata balle ke ya had'u dake, doctor ku taimaka mun ku fara bashi taimakon gaggawa dubi fa kamar baya numfashi.....". 
    
    Nurses doctor fu'ad ya kira Suka zo Suka d'auke shi da kyar saboda arfah data kanainayeshi a lallai itafa mijintane Babu abinda zai rabasu, ana tafiya dashi kuwa taku d'aya biyu ana uku itama ta yanke jiki ta fad'i. 

   Nan fa itama akayi kanta, shuraim kam sai kuka yake yana Kiran sunanta. 

      _A asibiti after some hours_

   Tana zaune a tsakiyar gadon da aka kwantar da ita tana ta faman kuka duk ta cire d'ankwali da ribboms d'in kanta sai uban kuka takeyi dama gyale tuni yayi nashi guri, doctor fu'ad yau ya had'u da tashin hankali kamar me azumi ko breakfast bai samu dama yayi ba, ita tana nan ta hana kanta da kowa sukuni akan lallai Muhammad mijintane, yayinda shi kuma yake kwance d'aure da igiyoyin allurar bacci amma lokaci bayan lokaci sai ya fad'i, "a Nemo ta". 
    Ya kasa fahimtar komai shi, yayi tambayar duniya hajiya tace su basu tab'a ganin me kama da ita ba ma, kuma shi kanshi shaida ne tunda shine likitan Muhammad tsawon shekaru the only and beloved child of Mrs honourable. 

   Yanzun ma rarrashinta yake ta famanyi, so yake ya lallab'ata ta tattara ta bar mishi asibitin zuwa gida ko ya samu nutsuwar lura da wancen majinyacin idan ya tashi. 
    Suna tsaka da wannan matter hajiya ta turo k'ofar ta shigo, da sauri arfah ta dire daga kan gadon tun kafun ma ta k'araso ta nufeta ta durk'usa  gabanta ta rik'e k'afafunta, "Don girman zatin Allah, don isar sa da kwad'aitakar sarautarsa ki taimaka mun da mijina, hajiya farouk shine farin cikina shine komai na, na rabu da farin cikina, iyayena da komai na jikina saboda shi, saboda na rayu tare dashi nayi hak'uri da rayuwa cikin uk'uba da bahaguwar rayuwa da bansan akwai irinta a wannan duniyar ba saboda shi. ....... Hajiya Ina son shi, Ina k'aunar shi da duka zuciyata fiye ma da yanda zan fad'a, da haka nake rok'on ki don girman Allah ki dawo mun dashi gareni.......". .

    Cikin tausayi yanzun hajiya take kallonta, yarinyar ta matuk'ar bata tausayi musamman data tuna yadda soyayyah take a gurin y'an mata da samarin wannan zamani, more especially wanda suka rayu cikin turawa sukaga yadda suke rik'e alk'awari da muhimmancin da suke baiwa soyayyah a rayuwarsu. Arfah batayi mata kama da fitinannun yara ba, sannan batayi mata kama da yarinyar da ta futo cikin wahalar rayuwa ba, to amma tana tunanin anya zata iya bar mata Muhammad d'inta da take dashi kwaya d'aya tilo yanzu a duniya ta aureshi, musamman duba da lalurorin shi, gashi a cikin wannan shekarun wata sabuwar shak'uwa da soyayya ce take sake shiga tsakaninta dashi, bata son abinda zaisa ya gusa daga kusa da ita ko nan da can, to taya ma zata amshi tatsuniyar gizonta na Muhammad wai mijin tane. 
   Ita duk ba wannan bama batayi rainon d'anta tsawon shekaru da kulawa don ta barwa wata shi watarana ba, tasan matsalar Muhammad ciki da bai, a duniya tana zullumin irin matar da zai aura ko zata iya kula dashi yadda ya kamata......
    Durk'usawa tayi a gabanta ta d'ora hannunta akan ta cikin muryar rarrashi ta soma mata magana da lislama, "tsawon shekara nawa kuka zauna tare dashi da aure?". 
     Kamar a mafarki taji tambayar don haka cikin farin ciki tace, "shekara kusan uku.....".
     "Okay to zaki iya nuna mun wata sheda ko wani abu da zai nuna ki tare dashi, ya kuma nuna tabbacin maganarki?". 
   Da sauri ta nuna shuraim da yake bacci tace, "gashi can ..... Wannan shine babbar hujjahta ta farko, Wallahi hajiya wancen yaron jinin sane d'an shine". 
    "Ikon Allah" hajiya ta fad'a a ranta, a zahiri kuma sake gyad'a kai tayi tace, "zamu duba daga baya idan ya dawo hayyacinshi, amma yanzu Ina son hujja ta abinda ya had'a ku tare, kamar pic enda kukayi tare ko wani abu nashi da kike dashi shima yake da irinshi yanzu a jikin shi". 
   Shiru tayi ta tafi nazari, hakan yasa hajiya tace a ranta, anzo inda zan kamaki yarinya, a wannan zamanin da aka maida hoto d'abi'a ai bakyace mun bakya yiba musamman ku matasan wannan Zamanin. 
    Ita kuwa arfah tunani ta dinga yi na rabonta da wani abu nashi ko wanda ya shafe shi, tun daga lokacin da mummunar sak'on mutuwarshi ya
 risketa, duk wasu hujja gareta ta barsu a lokacin,sai yanzu take ganin kuskurenta na share duk wasu mutane da sukayi zaman mutumci a lokacin, matan gidansu, su gwaggwo da iyayen gidanshi, lallai bata da wata hujjah cikakkiya a hannu in ba'a gurin suba, to amma ita data sharesu tsawon lokaci taya yanzu zata iya tunkararsu, wato don amfanin su yazo mata koh?  Da ta samu abinda takeso a gurinsu kuma ta koma inda ta futo......
    "Wayyoh Allah!" Ta fad'a a fili lokaci d'aya kuma ta dafe kanta da hannunta d'aya tana jin yadda yake tsananta Sara mata, duk abin nan dauriya kawai takeyi. 
    "Ina saurarenki y'an mata" matar ta dawo da ita cikin hayyacinta ta hanyar fad'in haka. 
   Arfah d'ago kanta tayi ta dubi doctor fu'ad da yake Shan tea yana kallonsu, murmushi yayi mata yace, "idan banci komai ba zan iya fad'uwa Fatima cox na lura dis your case.....". 
    D'auke kanta tayi daga kanshi don ba abinda ya dameta da wanzuwar shi a gurin ma tunda ba taimakonta yakeyi da komai ba, dubanta ta mayar ga hajiyar tace, "duk wata hujjah da kike so daga gareni akwaita sai dai babu ita tare dani a halin yanzu, amma idan babu damuwa ki biyoni muje na gabatar miki da komai ki gani da idonki, sannan idan kin gani kiyi mun alk'awarin zaki dawo mun dashi muci gaba da rayuwa tare". 
   
    Murmushi mai kyau matar tayi tace, "bank'i ta taki ba y'an mata sai dai Ina son kisan cewa ni bazan iya barin Muhammad shi kad'ai a hospital in biki ko nan da k'ofar get ba, sai dai a shawarce kije kizo mun da duk hujjar taki nan, nayi miki alk'awarin zan tsaya ki kona kwana goma ne bazan tafi ba har sai kin dawo, sannan kika zomun da gamshashshiyyar hujjah a take zaku tafi tare da Muhammad". 
    Duk da hukuncin matar yaso yayi mata tsauri amma jin alk'awarirrikan da tayi mata sai taji sanyi a zuciyarta har taji zata iya yin kasada ta amince amma bisa sharad'in doctor fu'ad zai kasance a tsakiya. 
    
     Bayan sun gama gindaya sharuddan su, hannun shuraim ta kamo ta wanke fuskarta ta maida gyalenta kamar yadda tazo suka futo ita da shuraim da yaci bacci yau. 
    Sai dai bata iya tafiya ba har saida ta sake lek'awa ta windown d'akin da yake ta ganshi. Kamar yadda doctor ya fad'a bacci yakeyi Wanda a k'alla zai iya kaishi hour biyar zuwa shida nan gaba, kuma ko ya farfad'o yanzun bazai yiwu su tafi dashi gida a ranar ba, garkuwar jikinshi tayi weak zai tsaya 4 at least 2 dayz kafun su huce, wani sanyi ne taji ya kwaranya a ruhinta, musamman data sake tuna alk'awarin doctor fu'ad inda yace, "kamar yadda ta fad'a nima nayi miki alk'awarin ko nan da can ba zan bari su matsa ba har sai kin dawo......".

        _Gidan uncle abdussamad_

   Shamsudden daya d'auki uzuri a kasuwa ne tsaye tsakiyar parlon yana ta faman jera kiran wayar arfah, sai dai tayi ringing harta katse ba'ayi picking ba, kusan karo na ba adadi kenan da suke ta jera Mata kira shida Auntie husna, cikin damuwa ya zauna a hannun kujera yace, "Auntie kin tabbatar kuma da wannan layin take amfani?". 
    Ita kanta auntien cikin wani yanayi take cewa, "wallahi shine sim d'inta, ga abban suhail yana gab da k'arasowa kuma sai sake jadadda mun yake na tabbatar ta dawo kafun ya k'araso ni yanzu bansan ma ya zanyi ba....". 
   Ajiyar zuciya mai nauyi shamsudden ya sauke yace, "kuma kince tare da shuraim ta tafi?". 
    "Eh nina takura mata ma ta tafi dashi". 
    "Toh aikuwa ki kwantar da hankalinki Auntie don ba inda zata d'ara maybe akwai abinda ya rik'e ta a hospital d'in ne, kuma matsalar ma don kince bakisan asibitin ba baki San sunan shiba da sai inbi bayanta yanzu". 
    
    "Hum ka bari kawai wauta ce kam ai nayi ta sai dai nace Allah ya futar dani". Husna ta fad'a tana nufar dinning inda zata k'arasa aikinta. Shima shamsudden d'akin shi ya koma. 
 
    Matsawarsu da mintuna k'alilan taji horn d'in mota, sai kuma taji su suhail da suke varrendar suna ihun abberh oyoyo. 
    Gabanta saida ya fad'i ta nufi d'akin arfah da sauri ta d'auko key ta kulle shi ta b'oye a saman window ta nufo parlour. 
    Turus tayi tana bin fuskokin su da kallo d'aya bayan d'aya, a cikinsu babu wanda bata sani ba a hoto sai dai wannan shine karon farko data tab'a ganin su zahiri. 
    Da sauri ta k'arasa shiga parlon fuskarta Washe da fara'a tace, "barkanku da zuwa maraba". 
     Cikin takun nutsuwa suka shigo parlon d'aya bayan d'aya suka samu guri duk suka zauna, abin kamar a mafarki ga y'an uwa hud'u duk a had'e, jafar, ibraheem, sulaiman da mijinta da bakinshi yak'i rufuwa yau. 

    Husna saboda farin ciki komai jera musu ta shiga yi har saida Yaya jafar yace, "ko abincin gidan duka zaki kawo ne?". 
     Murmushi tayi kawai, sai a lokacin Suka gaisa, shamsudden ma ya futo cikin happie Suka gaisa da babanshi da sauran y'an uwan baban. 
     Sai lokacin husna ta gane bazatar da abdussamad ya shirya yi mata kenan, shiyasa ya sata ta shirya abinci kaka_kala. 
    Jafar kam hankalinshi duk yana kan abu d'aya ne, wato farin cikin shi hasken idaniyarshi d'iyarshi guda tilo fad'imatu arfah. Wato me karatu Idan kaga yadda wannan bawan Allah mai kud'i da fad'a aji ya dawo zaka mugun tausaya mishi, ya rame kamar Wanda ya shekara yana jinya baya ko iya d'aga hannu, sannan shekarun shi sun futo ba kamar da da hutu da kwanciyar hankali Suka b'oye ba. 
     Abdussamad ne yace da husna, "Husna ina mai sunan mama ne?". 
      Sai lokacin hankalinta ya dawo jikinta, ashe tare da mahaifinta zasu zo shiyasa yake ta jaddada ta tabbatar bata d'ara ko nan da can ba, wayyoh Allah yanzu ni da wane idon zan iya duban wannan mutumi ince ta futa tun safe har yanzu bata dawo ba, ai d'auka zaiyi tasan ze zo ta gudu don kar ta had'u dashi, inkuwa yaji haka to tabbas sai dai a kira likitanshi ya futa dashi don zuciyarshi zata iya yin bindiga. 
     "Husna Ina tunanin ki ya tafi Ina magana". 
    Abdussamad ya fad'a cikin d'aga murya, murmushi ta k'ak'alo a saman fuskarta ta saci kallon shamsudden da shima ya kame yana tunanin yadda auntien zata futa. 
    "Tana d'aki tun jiya tak'i bud'ewa ba yadda bamuyi da ita ba nida shamsu tun safe". 
    Ajiyar zuciya ya sauk'e a b'oye, a zahiri kam cewa yayi ashe abinda su suhail Suka fad'a mana gaskiya ne. 
     
    Alhaji jafar girgiza kanshi yayi yace, "har yanzu baby bata girma da irin shagwob'e shagwob'en nan ba". 
    "Dama tun a gida tanayin haka kenan?". Ibraheem ya tambayeshi, murmushi mai kyau yayi don a duniya ba abinda yafi sashi farin ciki kamar a dinga yi mishi hirar baby, nan ya dinga basu labarin abinda yake halayenta da d'abi'arta data fi zame mata jiki, banbancinta da da a yanzu k'alilan ne. 
    Sunci gaba da hirarsu duk da zuwa wannan lokacin jafar ji yake kamar yayi tsuntsuwa yaje yaga yanda ta dawo, (abu biyu ne basu sani ba, haihuwar shuraim da tayi da kuma rasuwar farouk, saboda halin kara da yakana kuma na ibraheem har lokacin bai tambayi labarin d'anshi ba) har saida jafar ya tuna ashe fa tana da aure yanzun, sai ya maida dubanshi ga abdussamad yace, "toh amma ya mijin nata yakeyi idan tayi irin wannan fushin? Yana Ina ma d'an nawa ya kamata ace shima yau bai futa kasuwa ba ya tsaya mun ganshi, rabonshi da mahaifinshi kusan shekara biyar zuwa shida, Ni kuma rabon dana ganshi kusan 23 years......". 
    Duk tsuru_ tsuru sukayi kamar marassa gaskiya ko wanda sukayi silar mutuwar tashi, gashi duk sun tsare su da ido suna kallo, abdussamad ne yayi k'arfin hali don husna ta kasa ko kwakkwaran motsi ma, "Wato husna yauma Saida ya futa kasuwa ko?". 
   Ya k'arasa fad'a yana tambayarta, murmushin yak'e tayi tace, "eh amma yace da wuri zai dawo". 
    
    Duk shiru sukayi kowa da abinda yake tunani a ranshi, shikam shamsudden kasa jurar sauraron wannan k'aryayyaki yayi ya kama hanyar d'akin shi, yana tafiya su suhail Suka shigo da gudu saddiq rik'e da ball yace, "abberh wannan abokin naka me kirki yazo yace mu Kira mishi Auntie fa". 
     Da sauri husna ta kamo hannunshi ta mik'e tana fad'an, "Ni bana son sakarcin banza da wofi komai Kai sai kayiwa mutane shirme". 
    Suhail ne yace, "Allah ba shirme bane haka ya.....  ". 
   "Dallah rufe mun baki kaima d'an uwan d'ayan zo muje sama ku sauya wasu kayan duk kun b'ata wannan". 
     Ta fad'a cikin katse musu hanzari tayi saman, tana jin Yaya jafar yana fad'in ya za'a daka musu tsawa haka ku fara bincikawa mana kafun ku k'arya tasu, bata ji abinda abdussamad ya ce mishi ba ita dai tayi sama rik'e da hannun su.
     Abdussamad futa yayi bayan wasu mintuna ya sallami abokin nashi ya dawo. 
    Mahaifin farouk ne yace, "toh abdussamad ita waccen ta kulle a d'akin haka zataci gaba da Zama ne? Ace tun jiya tana rufe ko abinci bata ci bafa kenan?". 
      "Ai da bari nayi ku Soma cin abincin tukun ku nutsu nasan tana jin muryar Yaya jafar ma zata futo".
    Girgiza musu Kai jafar yayi a lokacin da duk suka kalleshi don jin ta bakinshi, "bana jin cin abincin nan kuci kawai". .

     Dafa kafad'ar shi sulaiman yayi yace, "amma ka rage sawa kanka damuwa haka don Allah, tun da muka had'u kake a haka har yanzu babu walwala ko guda a tare dakai, kasani tuni kawai zanyi maka komai rubutacce ne daga indallah daga mu harkai babu wanda zai iya sauya k'addarar shi.....". 
     
    Murmushi ya k'ak'alo akan fuskarshi yace, "kada ku damu da yanayina stress ne kawai so nake da komai yayi settling naje naga doctor junaid". 
   Duk shiru sukayi suna kallonshi cike da tausayawa. 
    Abdussamad ne ya mik'e saboda ya fahimci muddin farin ciki biyu na rayuwarshi bai samu ganin d'aya ba haka zasuci gaba da ganinshi. 
    Har ya Soma tafiya jafar d'in ya biyo bayanshi Suka nufi part d'in tare. 
    Da farko knocking Suka soma, jin shiru yasa abdussamad soma kiran sunanta, nan ma dai shirun ne ya biyo baya, hakan yasa mahaifinta ya Soma yin magana da kanshi, "babyy! Open de door please ko bakya son had'uwa da Abbie d'inki ne? Babyy please come closed to your daddy and see how he miss you..... Koda yake nasan Mani mai laifine a gurinki, ba zaki so ganina ko jin murya taba......".

     Abdussamad ne yace, "kada ka tafi.... don Allah Ina ganin kamar bacci takeyi, amma zanyi amfani da spare key na wajena in bud'e ta".

Page 65 _(sixty five)_



 Ko kafun ta k'arasa gareshi kwakwalwarshi ta gama jirkicewa, abubuwan da yake ta son tunowa tsawon lokaci suka Soma dawo mishi daki daki, sai ya d'ora hannunshi a saman kanshi kawai ya rik'e kan yana ambaton sunan Allah. 
    Ita kuwa arfah cikin kid'ima gigita had'e da razana ta Soma nuna shi da hannunta, ta kasa yin maganar ma sai motsa baki kawai amma ba murya. Ganin haka sai doctor fu'ad ya tambayeta, "Fatima kin sanshi ne?". 
    Sai a lokacin muryar tata ta futo ta kira sunan shi da k'arfi kamar wadda take yin magana da wani a nesa da ita. "farouk". 
    Muhammad bai San lokacinda ya d'ago ya sake dubanta ba, ya mik'e tsaye da nufin zuwa gurinta ko sauraron maganar mum d'inshi ma bayayi, sai dai taku biyu ana uku ya yanke jiki ya fad'i k'asa sumamme. 
   Ba b'ata lokaci duk suka nufeshi sai dai ko kafun suje arfah ta rigasu ta Soma jijjigashi tana faman kiran sunanshi, "farouk, farouk ka tashi ka tashi don Allah dama ni nasan baka mutu ba kana raye, ka tashi mu tafi gidanmu muci gaba da rayuwarmu cikin farin ciki mai d'orewa..........". 
    Sai kawai ta kife kanta a kirjinshi tana jan numfashi ta sake fashewa da wani sabon kukan.
    Hajiya ce da tayi saroro ta dubi likita fu'ad ta sake duban arfah tace, "ke kina cikin hankalinki kuwa? Doctor ko itama tana da mental case ne? Wannan fa d'ana ne kuma sunan shi Muhammad ba farouk ba, sannan bai tab'a yin aure ba ta Ina ma ya sanki shida yaune karon farko daya tab'a taka k'afarshi Kano..... Doctor fu'ad kayi mata bayani.....". 
   Murmushi fu'ad yayi ya durk'usa kusa da ita yace, "zo muje office muyi magana a nutse yadda zaki fahimta fatima". 
    Da wani irin yanayi a fuskarta ta d'ago ta dubeshi tace, "kana nufin na tafi na bar mijina anan doctor? Bayan wahalar da nasha tsawon lokaci Ina nemanshi da kewarshi? Ai wallahi in kaji mai rabani da mijina anan gurin sai mutuwa......". 
   Yanzu kam hajiya cikin fusata da b'acin rai tayi mata magana, "keee! Ki kama kanki tun kafun na mance da lalurarki na sab'a miki, na fad'a miki wannan yaron d'ana ne babu abinda yake had'a shi da mata balle ke ya had'u dake, doctor ku taimaka mun ku fara bashi taimakon gaggawa dubi fa kamar baya numfashi.....". 
    
    Nurses doctor fu'ad ya kira Suka zo Suka d'auke shi da kyar saboda arfah data kanainayeshi a lallai itafa mijintane Babu abinda zai rabasu, ana tafiya dashi kuwa taku d'aya biyu ana uku itama ta yanke jiki ta fad'i. 

   Nan fa itama akayi kanta, shuraim kam sai kuka yake yana Kiran sunanta. 

      _A asibiti after some hours_

   Tana zaune a tsakiyar gadon da aka kwantar da ita tana ta faman kuka duk ta cire d'ankwali da ribboms d'in kanta sai uban kuka takeyi dama gyale tuni yayi nashi guri, doctor fu'ad yau ya had'u da tashin hankali kamar me azumi ko breakfast bai samu dama yayi ba, ita tana nan ta hana kanta da kowa sukuni akan lallai Muhammad mijintane, yayinda shi kuma yake kwance d'aure da igiyoyin allurar bacci amma lokaci bayan lokaci sai ya fad'i, "a Nemo ta". 
    Ya kasa fahimtar komai shi, yayi tambayar duniya hajiya tace su basu tab'a ganin me kama da ita ba ma, kuma shi kanshi shaida ne tunda shine likitan Muhammad tsawon shekaru the only and beloved child of Mrs honourable. 

   Yanzun ma rarrashinta yake ta famanyi, so yake ya lallab'ata ta tattara ta bar mishi asibitin zuwa gida ko ya samu nutsuwar lura da wancen majinyacin idan ya tashi. 
    Suna tsaka da wannan matter hajiya ta turo k'ofar ta shigo, da sauri arfah ta dire daga kan gadon tun kafun ma ta k'araso ta nufeta ta durk'usa  gabanta ta rik'e k'afafunta, "Don girman zatin Allah, don isar sa da kwad'aitakar sarautarsa ki taimaka mun da mijina, hajiya farouk shine farin cikina shine komai na, na rabu da farin cikina, iyayena da komai na jikina saboda shi, saboda na rayu tare dashi nayi hak'uri da rayuwa cikin uk'uba da bahaguwar rayuwa da bansan akwai irinta a wannan duniyar ba saboda shi. ....... Hajiya Ina son shi, Ina k'aunar shi da duka zuciyata fiye ma da yanda zan fad'a, da haka nake rok'on ki don girman Allah ki dawo mun dashi gareni.......". .

    Cikin tausayi yanzun hajiya take kallonta, yarinyar ta matuk'ar bata tausayi musamman data tuna yadda soyayyah take a gurin y'an mata da samarin wannan zamani, more especially wanda suka rayu cikin turawa sukaga yadda suke rik'e alk'awari da muhimmancin da suke baiwa soyayyah a rayuwarsu. Arfah batayi mata kama da fitinannun yara ba, sannan batayi mata kama da yarinyar da ta futo cikin wahalar rayuwa ba, to amma tana tunanin anya zata iya bar mata Muhammad d'inta da take dashi kwaya d'aya tilo yanzu a duniya ta aureshi, musamman duba da lalurorin shi, gashi a cikin wannan shekarun wata sabuwar shak'uwa da soyayya ce take sake shiga tsakaninta dashi, bata son abinda zaisa ya gusa daga kusa da ita ko nan da can.

    Durk'usawa tayi a gabanta ta d'ora hannunta akan ta cikin muryar rarrashi ta soma mata magana, "tsawon shekara nawa kuka zauna tare dashi da aure?".

Da ta samu abinda takeso a gurinsu kuma ta koma inda ta futo......
