        _Gidan uncle abdussamad_

   Shamsudden daya d'auki uzuri a kasuwa ne tsaye tsakiyar parlon yana ta faman jera kiran wayar arfah, sai dai tayi ringing harta katse ba'ayi picking ba, kusan karo na ba adadi kenan da suke ta jera Mata kira shida Auntie husna, cikin damuwa ya zauna a hannun kujera yace, "Auntie kin tabbatar kuma da wannan layin take amfani?". 
    Ita kanta auntien cikin wani yanayi take cewa, "wallahi shine sim d'inta, ga abban suhail yana gab da k'arasowa kuma sai sake jadadda mun yake na tabbatar ta dawo kafun ya k'araso ni yanzu bansan ma ya zanyi ba....". 
   Ajiyar zuciya mai nauyi shamsudden ya sauke yace, "kuma kince tare da shuraim ta tafi?". 
    "Eh nina takura mata ma ta tafi dashi". 
    "Toh aikuwa ki kwantar da hankalinki Auntie don ba inda zata d'ara maybe akwai abinda ya rik'e ta a hospital d'in ne, kuma matsalar ma don kince bakisan asibitin ba baki San sunan shiba da sai inbi bayanta yanzu". 
    
    "Hum ka bari kawai wauta ce kam ai nayi ta sai dai nace Allah ya futar dani". Husna ta fad'a tana nufar dinning inda zata k'arasa aikinta. Shima shamsudden d'akin shi ya koma. 
 
    Matsawarsu da mintuna k'alilan taji horn d'in mota, sai kuma taji su suhail da suke varrendar suna ihun abberh oyoyo. 
    Gabanta saida ya fad'i ta nufi d'akin arfah da sauri ta d'auko key ta kulle shi ta b'oye a saman window ta nufo parlour. 
    Turus tayi tana bin fuskokin su da kallo d'aya bayan d'aya, a cikinsu babu wanda bata sani ba a hoto sai dai wannan shine karon farko data tab'a ganin su zahiri. 
    Da sauri ta k'arasa shiga parlon fuskarta Washe da fara'a tace, "barkanku da zuwa maraba". 
     Cikin takun nutsuwa suka shigo parlon d'aya bayan d'aya suka samu guri duk suka zauna, abin kamar a mafarki ga y'an uwa hud'u duk a had'e, jafar, ibraheem, sulaiman da mijinta da bakinshi yak'i rufuwa yau. 

    Husna saboda farin ciki komai jera musu ta shiga yi har saida abdussamad yace, "ko abincin gidan duka zaki kawo ne?". 
     Murmushi tayi kawai, sai a lokacin Suka gaisa, shamsudden ma ya futo cikin happie Suka gaisa da babanshi da sauran y'an uwan baban. 
     Sai lokacin husna ta gane bazatar da abdussamad ya shirya yi mata kenan, shiyasa ya sata ta shirya abinci kaka_kala. 
    Jafar kam hankalinshi duk yana kan abu d'aya ne, wato farin cikin shi hasken idaniyarshi d'iyarshi guda tilo fad'imatu arfah. Wato me karatu Idan kaga yadda wannan bawan Allah mai kud'i da fad'a aji ya dawo zaka mugun tausaya mishi, ya rame kamar Wanda ya shekara yana jinya baya ko iya d'aga hannu, sannan shekarun shi sun futo ba kamar da da hutu da kwanciyar hankali Suka b'oye ba. 
     Abdussamad ne yace da husna, "Husna ina mai sunan mama ne?". 
      Sai lokacin hankalinta ya dawo jikinta, ashe tare da mahaifinta zasu zo shiyasa yake ta jaddada ta tabbatar bata d'ara ko nan da can ba, wayyoh Allah yanzu ni da wane idon zan iya duban wannan mutumi ince ta futa tun safe har yanzu bata dawo ba, ai d'auka zaiyi tasan ze zo ta gudu don kar ta had'u dashi, inkuwa yaji haka to tabbas sai dai a kira likitanshi ya futa dashi don zuciyarshi zata iya yin bindiga. 
     "Husna Ina tunanin ki ya tafi". 
    Abdussamad ya fad'a cikin d'aga murya, murmushi ta kakalo a saman fuskarta ta saci kallon shamsudden da shima ya kame yana tunanin yadda auntien zata futa. 
    "Tana d'aki tun jiya tak'i bud'ewa ba yadda bamuyi da ita ba nida shamsu tun safe". 
    Ajiyar zuciya ya sauk'e a b'oye, a zahiri kam cewa yayi ashe abinda su suhail Suka fad'a mana gaskiya ne. 
     
    Alhaji jafar girgiza kanshi yayi yace, "har yanzu baby bata girma da irin shagwob'e shagwob'en nan ba". 
    "Dama tun a gida tanayin haka kenan?". Ibraheem ya tambayeshi, murmushi mai kyau yayi don a duniya ba abinda yafi sashi farin ciki kamar a dinga yi mishi hirar baby, nan ya dinga basu labarin abinda yake halayenta da d'abi'arta data fi zame mata jiki, banbancinta da da a yanzu k'alilan ne. 
    Sunci gaba da hirarsu duk da zuwa wannan lokacin jafar ji yake kamar yayi tsuntsuwa yaje yaga yanda ta dawo, (abu biyu ne basu sani ba, haihuwar shuraim da tayi da kuma rasuwar farouk, saboda halin kara da yakana kuma na ibraheem har lokacin bai tambayi labarin d'anshi ba) har saida jafar ya tuna ashe fa tana da aure yanzun, sai ya maida dubanshi ga abdussamad yace, "toh amma ya mijin nata yakeyi idan tayi irin wannan fushin? Yana Ina ma d'an nawa ya kamata ace shima yau bai futa kasuwa ba ya tsaya mun ganshi, rabonshi da mahaifinshi kusan shekara biyar zuwa shida, Ni kuma rabon dana ganshi kusan 23 years......". 
    Duk tsuru_ tsuru sukayi kamar marassa gaskiya ko wanda sukayi silar mutuwar tashi, gashi duk sun tsare su day ido suna kallo, abdussamad ne yayi k'arfin hali don husna ta kasa ko kwakkwaran motsi ma, "Wato husna yauma Saida ya futa kasuwa ko?". 
   Ya k'arasa fad'a yana tambayarta, murmushin yak'e tayi tace, "eh amma yace da wuri zai dawo". 
    
    Duk shiru sukayi kowa da abinda yake tunani a ranshi, shikam shamsudden kasa jurar sauraron wannan k'aryayyaki yayi ya kama hanyar d'akin shi, yana tafiya su suhail Suka shigo da gudu saddiq rik'e da ball yace, "abberh wannan abokin naka me kirki yazo yace mu Kira mishi Auntie fa". 
     Da sauri husna ta kamo hannunshi ta mik'e tana fad'an, "Ni bana son sakarcin banza da wofi komai Kai sai kayiwa mutane shirme". 
    Suhail ne yace, "Allah ba shirme bane haka ya.....  ". 
   "Dallah rufe mun baki kaima d'an uwan d'ayan zo muje sama ku sauya wasu kayan duk kun b'ata wannan". 
     Ta fad'a cikin katse musu hanzari tayi saman, tana jin Yaya jafar yana fad'in ya za'a daka musu tsawa haka ku fara bincikawa mana kafun ku k'arya tasu, bata ji abinda abdussamad ya ce mishi ba ita dai tayi sama rik'e da hannun su.
     Abdussamad futa yayi bayan wasu mintuna ya sallami abokin nashi ya dawo. 
    Mahaifin farouk ne yace, "toh abdussamad ita waccen ta kulle a d'akin haka zataci gaba da Zama ne? Ace tun jiya tana rufe ko bacinci bata ci bafa kenan?". 
      "Ai da bari nayi ku Soma cin abincin tukun ku nutsu nasan tana jin muryar Yaya jafar ma zata futo".
    Girgiza musu Kai jafar yayi a lokacin da duk suka kalleshi don jin ta bakinshi, "bana jin cin abincin nan kuci kawai". .

     Dafa kafad'ar shi sulaiman yayi yace, "amma ka rage sawa kanka damuwa haka don Allah, tun da muka had'u kake a haka har yanzu babu walwala ko guda a tare dakai, kasani tuni kawai zanyi maka komai rubutacce ne daga indallah daga mu harkai babu wanda zai iya sauya k'addarar shi.....". 
     
    Murmushi ya k'ak'alo akan fuskarshi yace, "kada ku damu da yanayina stress ne kawai so nake da komai yayi settling naje naga doctor nberass". 
   Duk shiru sukayi suna kallonshi cike da tausayawa. 
    Abdussamad ne ya mik'e saboda ya fahimci muddin farin ciki biyu na rayuwarshi bai samu ganin d'aya ba haka zasuci gaba da ganinshi. 
    Har ya Soma tafiya jafar d'in ya biyo bayanshi Suka nufi part d'in tare. 
    Da farko knocking Suka soma, jin shiru yasa abdussamad soma kiran sunanta, nan ma dai shirun ne ya biyo baya, hakan yasa mahaifinta ya Soma yin magana da kanshi, "babyy! Open dis door please ko bakya son had'uwa da Abbie d'inki ne? Babyy please come closed to your daddy and see how much he miss you..... Koda yake nasan Mani mai laifine a gurinki, ba zaki so ganina ko jin murya taba......". 
   Yana gama fad'in haka ya juya da nufin barin gurin idonshi taf da ruwan hawaye. 
     Abdussamad ne yace, "kada ka tafi.... don Allah Ina ganin kamar bacci takeyi, amma zanyi amfani da spare key na wajena in bud'e ta". 
    Anan ya barshi cike da tausayi ya nufi saman d'akin shi da sauri. 
    Su sulaiman duk suna zaune inda Suka barsu jigum kowa da abinda yake tunani a ranshi, suna matuk'ar tausayin halinda d'an uwan nasu ya tsinci kanshi a ciki. 
    Kusan tare suka sauko da husna data firgita jin zai bud'e d'akin da spare key, Sam ta manta da yana da coppyn ko wane key na gidan a gurinshi. 
    Jafar yana jingine da k'ofar ya hard'e hannuwanshi biyu a k'irjinshi kanshi yana kallon rufin gurin. 
    Matsawa yayi gefe abdussamad ya bud'e k'ofar, husna kasa shiga tayi sai su biyu kawai ne Suka shiga cikin parlon, bata nan a parlour, haka d'aya bedroom da yake kusa da wanda take kwana a ciki, hakan yasa suka shiga na tan suna Kiran sunanta a tare, "arfah! Baby". 
   Sai dai nan ma wayam ga bathroom nan duk a bud'e, bathroom d'in abdussamad ya lek'a shi kuma jafar ya zauna gefen gadon yana dudduba tarin diaries da memo's da tayi rubutu rututu, wani sanyi ne ya sake kwaranya a ruhinsa, ganin rubutun babyn shi tar tar handwriting, koda abdussamad yace mishi tana gidan shi bai wani ji abin can cikin ranshi ba sai yanzu daya jita kusa da ruhinshi. 
    A rikice abdussamad yayi inda husna take tsaye k'ofar parlour yana tambayarta "Ina ta tafi? Husna ina arfah ta tafi ita da shuraim, shin ban fad'a miki kada ki sake yarinyar nan ta futa daga gidan nan ba.....". 
   Ya fad'a cikin fusata kamar zai rufeta da duka, jikinta a sanyaye ta fashe da kuka tana sake jan jikinta donta manta rabon da ta ganshi cikin irin wannan yanayin. 
     Shi kuwa abdussamad fad'a yakeyi muryarshi tana amsa kuwa a gidan bil hak'k'i da iya gaskiyarshi, abinda ya d'auki hankalin su sulaiman da suke zaune jigum jigum a parlour kenan sukayi d'akin da hanzari. Shi kanshi shamsudden futowa yayi don jin abinda yake faruwa. 
    Cikin laluma Ibrahim ya dafa kafad'ar abdussamad yana tambayarshi ko lafiya, bai iya cewa komai ba sai parlour daya koma ya zauna ya had'e kanshi da gwiwa. 
    Kuka yakeyi abun gwanin ban mamaki saboda gaba d'aya tunanin shi ya bashi arfah ta fahimci zasu zo da jafar mahaifinta ne ta gudu. 
    Babu wanda ya iya Zama cikinsu sukayi tsaye hard'e da hannaye a k'irji cirko cirko. A haka jafar ya futo da sanyayyen jiki shima ya samu guri ya zauna kurum ya had'a kanshi da gwiwa. 
    Abun fa ya soma tsorata su sulaiman saboda tunanin su suma ya Soma basu there most be something wrong da aka kuskure kuka ibraheem ya sanya a lokacinda yaga jafar yana sharar hawaye, cikin muryar kukan yake fad'in, "meyasa haka take faruwa damu ne? Na d'auka duk ranar da muka kasance tare munbar rayuwar bak'in ciki kenan har abada, sai gashi a yau abdussamad Allah ya bashi k'arfin gwiwar d'aukar nauyi sama da wanda mu yayyenshi zamu d'auka, yayi aiki tuk'uru tsayin daka har ya dawo da wannan rusashshen *AHALI* Waje guda, sai dai kash wani abu da bamu san ko meye ba yana Shirin tarwatsa duk wannan farin ciki a lokaci guda". 
    K'arasawa yayi kusa da jafar shima ya zauna ya had'a kanshi da gwiwa kamar yadda yayi yaci gaba da maganarshi, "don Allah abdussamad ka dubi girman Allah ka fad'a mana gaskiya kada ka b'oye mana komai, dukkanin mu nan musulmi ne, kuma munyi Imani da Allah mun yarda da kowacce irin k'addara mai kyau ko akasinta.....". 

      Abdussamad jikinshi a sanyaye ya kasa d'agowa ya kalli idon d'an uwanshi saboda tausayi, Babu abinda yafi mishi illah ya bayyana gaskiyar da yake ta b'oye musu akan farouk dama ta yanzu akan arfah. 
      Cikin raunananniyar muryarshi ya Soma magana da fad'in, "ban San wane tudu wane gangare ba arfah ta gudu yau, shi kuma farouk.....  Shi kuma farouk......Allah yayi mishi rasuwa shekaru uku da Suka huce a sanadiyyar had'arin mota..........".

Page 66 _(sixty six)_



 Arfah da tunda ta tunkaro gidan take jin matsanancin fad'uwar gaba, bata gama tsinkewa ba saida taga k'atuwar mota a k'ofar gidan nasu da mutum uku a ciki sanye da suit, "bak'in manyan mutane kenan Uncle yayi yau?" Ta tambayi kanta da kanta. 
    A hankali taci gaba da takawa har takai k'ofar main parlour daya had'a dukkan part d'insu waje guda, inda su Abbie suke zaune a lokacin, a dai dai lokacinda uncle yake fad'in ta gudu farouk kuma ya mutu ta saka k'afarta cikin parlon. Saboda shork da Suka shiga babu wanda ya lura da ita cikinsu sai kakkaifan harshenta da sukaji tana fad'in, "meyasa kuke son cewa farouk ya mutu? Toh farouk yana nan da ranshi bai mutu ba kamar yadda na dad'e ina  fad'a muku, k'arewa ma yau na ganshi da idona a asibitin doctor fu'ad......". 
    Sai a lokacin idonta ya bud'e fesss akan bak'in fuskokin da suke binta da kallo wanda itama kallonsu take d'aya bayan d'aya har ta sauke idonta akan last hope d'inta bayan mijinta, kamar a mafarki haka ta k'urawa mahaifinta ido tana kallon yadda ya sauya gaba d'aya kamar bashi ba, muryarta a matuk'ar sanyaye da raunane k'asa k'asa tace, "Abbiee........." 
    Bata kaiga k'arasa fad'a ba kuma ta juya da hanzari zata fuce daga parlon shamsudden yayi ta maza ya riga ta Isa ya dafe k'ofar yana girgiza mata kai. 
    Kifa kanta tayi a jikin bango ta fashe da wani bahagon kuka mai ban tausayi. Shi kanshi jafar k'asa ya mayar da kanshi yana zubda hawaye, duk yadda yaci burin ganinta, duk yadda ya dinga mararin had'uwa da ita, bai tab'a d'auka zata ganshi ita ta gujeshi ba, a rayuwa ya d'auka laifin wani sam baya shafar wani amma sai gashi shi laifin sofiyyah ya shafe shi, lallai bak'in kashin da sofiyyah ta siya ba k'aramin wari gare shiba tunda har gashi ya raba tsakanin y'a da uba. 
     Duk cikinsu an rasa wanda zai iya wani motsi ko yink'urin yin wani abu, saboda a yanzun shi kanshi ibraheem jinshi yake kamar robbot, farouk nashi ya mutu kamar yadda abdussamad ya fad'a? Ko kuwa yana raye kamar yadda Fatima ta fad'a yanzu, "innalillahi wa'inna ilaihi raji'un" ya dinga maimaitawa a zuciyarshi yana sauraron yadda zufa take zuba a duk sassan jikinshi. 
     Lokaci guda gidan ya d'auke wuta difff kamar wad'an da aka turowa da sak'on mutuwa, koda yake sak'on mutuwar ne ma.  
    Kuka arfah takeyi iya k'arfinta, shi kanshi shuraim da baisan abinda akeyi ba a lokacin kukan yake yana jera Kiran sunanta da tambayarta. 
    Tana son ta tafi ga hujjojinta gudun kada tayi rashin mijinta a karo na biyu, sai dai tana tunanin yadda zasu barta ta futa don shamsudden ya tsare k'ofa. 

      Cikin al'ajabi shi kanshi sulaiman yace, "abdussamad menene gaskiyar magana? Shin da maganarka zamu yarda ko data maamaa da tace bai mutu ba". 
    Yadda ibraheem ya zuba musu ido abdussamad ya fahimci so yake yaji magana guda d'aya da zuciyarshi zata iya d'auka. Tunda arfah take maganar farouk yana raye basu tab'a gasgatata ba a gidan, hasalima gani yake kamar ta kasa yadda da abinda Allah ya k'addaro mata ne, Amma a yau saboda idon mahaifin farouk a karo na farko yaji bakinshi da taya arfah kin yadda da k'addara wajen fad'in, "muna tunanin bai mutu ba, gashi arfah ma ta fad'a". 
    Babu wanda ya sake cewa komai tsakanin ibraheem da sulaiman har zuwa lokaci mai d'an tsayi. 
    Jafar kam dama tunda yayi k'asa da kanshi bai d'ago ba ya d'ora da sana'ar tashi da take baiwa y'an uwanshi mamaki har suke ganin kamar bashi ba, jafar mutum mai dakiya, juriya had'e da k'arfin zuciya, shi a duniya ba komai ne yake sakashi kuka ba, amma sai gashi a yanzun kuka ya zamo babbar d'abi'ar shi. 
     Ganin arfah ta soma kiciniyar bud'e k'ofa sai ibraheem ya mik'e tsam cikin k'arfin hali, k'arfin zuciya had'e da dauriya ya isa gareta. 
    Rik'o hannunta yayi dana yaron da baya ko tantama jinin sane, daga tsatson farouk da Fatima ya futo. 
     Ba tayi musu ko yink'urin yin komai ba har ya k'arasa da ita gaban mahaifinta ya durk'usar da ita shima ya zauna.  
    Magana ya soma yi da murya mai cike da dakiya da ban tausayi inda yace, "wato Fatima bazan b'oye miki ba nayi mamakin abinda kikayi har ga Allah, ban tab'a tunanin yadda Yaya jafar ya dinga nemanki gidajen television da radio idan kika ganshi zaki guje Shiba, sai gashi abun mamaki wai y'a tana gudun had'uwa da mahaifinta akan abinda ko bare ne yayi mata ba iyayenta ba zuwa wannan lokacin yaci ace ta yafe musu, haba Fatima ya da hankalinki har kin haifi d'a ba zaki gane muhimmancin iyaye a rayuwar y'ay'an suba....... Menene laifi a abinda mahaifiyarki tayi da zaki had'a duk ki k'ullace su har mahaifinki, auren Fatima? Auren ne yasa kika rik'e su har haka........?". 
    Ya dakata da zancen ba wai don maganar bakinshi ta k'are ba sai don ganin kamar akwai abinda take son fad'a maganarshi take katseta. Shi kuwa jafar shuraim ya zubawa ido yana kallo cikin lokaci guda yaji yaron ya shiga zuciyarshi, tabbas wannan d'an babynshi ne. 
  Ita kuwa arfah sai lokacin ta samu damar fad'an abinda yake ranta. 
   "Baffah ni ban tab'a d'auka zai neme niba tunda su da kansu suka koreni a gidansu suka nuna basa buk'ata ta harda bada sallahu ga ma'aikatan gidanmu kar na sake na sake rab'ar su, baffah ni a tunanina ko wane irin laifi nayi musu ban cancanci hukuncin kora daga gare suba a matsayina na mace mai rauni koda kuwa ban had'a komai dasu ba, ka tuna a lokacin shi kanshi farouk bansan wane irin mutum bane, saboda kawai su huce fushin wata tsohuwar dad'add'iyar gabarsu a kanmu da bamu san ummul'aba'isin abinda ma ya haddasa tab'a, ni bana jin haushin auran da sukayi mun kamar yadda nake jin zafin korata da sukayi..... Baffah abin bak'in ciki a lokacin fareeda k'arya ta fad'a saboda wani dalili nata da ban sani ba....... Ba tare da ammie tayi tunanin komai ba, zan aikata ko bazan aikata ba ta yadda.  Koda yake alhamdulillah Sam basu cuceni ba, hasalima taimakona sukayi don sun had'a ni da miji d'aya tamkar da dubu, wanda ya nusar dani yadda rayuwar duniya take da zamantakewa, baffa a lokacinda na fara Zama da farouk sai na fahimci ashe ni bansan komai ba, ilimin da nake ik'irarin ina dashi ba wanda zai amfani rayuwata bane...... Farouk yayi mun abinda bazan tab'a iya mantawa dashi ba, kamar yadda suma da Suka kasance sanadi bazan tab'a mantawa dasu ba, baffah ni na dad'e da yafe musu ka tambayi Uncle gashinan, sai dai banso ganin su shi da ammiey yanzu ba har sai na Soma ganinku Kai da ummie na fahimtar daku bahaguwar fahimtar da kukayiwa farouk a kaina.......". 

     Lokacinda taje nan a zancenta kukane yaci k'arfinta yasa dole tayi shiru. 
   Hankie jafar ya zaro a aljihun shi ya sauko k'asa shima ya durk'usa gabanta ya d'ago kanta yana share mata hawaye, cikin sanyin murya kuma yana fad'in, "har abada babyy! Har abada bazan tab'a iya korar mai only and beloved daughter ba, Sam bansan abinda sofiyyah ta aikata ba har saida na dawo daga Italy na tarar bakya nan, kuma a ranar itama na rabu da ita har hazar yau bama tare". 
    Kallon mahaifinta tayi da mamaki da kuma d'inbin tausayi, "da gaske ka neme ni duk gidajen television da radio?". 
  Ta samu bakinta da tambayarshi. 
    "Kwarai kuwa babyyy!". Nan ya labarta mata kad'an daga abubuwan da Suka faru bayan tafiyarta. 
    Itama nan ta bashi labarin yadda ammiey tayi mata korar kare da k'aryar da Isma'il ma'aikacin gidansu yayi mata da taje jin ko ya dawo k'asar a lokacin. 
     Arfah kwantar da kanta tayi a gefen kafad'ar shi ta had'a hannunta biyu tace, "kayi hak'uri Abbie ka gafarceni, na k'ullace ka akan abinda baka da masaniya akai, abinda ammiey tayi mun ne yasa na dinga tunanin ma ku d'in ba ku kuka haifeni ba, saboda nasan uwar da tasha wahala ta haifi y'ar ta ba zata koreta bayan tasan ita kad'ai gareta akan abinda bata da tabbas akai ba, Abbie don Allah da gaske ammiey ce ta haifeni? ......". 
    Rufe mata baki yayi da hannun shi yace, "ummina ki daina wannan maganar idan ba ita ta haifeki ba taya zakiyi kama da ita? Ni yanzu ina son naji  inda kika je, bayan auntien ki ta d'auka kina rufe a cikin d'aki, sannan a ina kika ga farouk da abdussamad yace ya mutu ke kika ce bai mutu ba? Kuyi mana bayanin abu d'aya da zamu fahimta ko hankalinmu zai kwanta".

    Da sauri ta mik'e tsaye firgigit tuno da mijinta data bari hospital a hannun wata da take tutiya da ik'irarin wai d'anta ne. 
    Abbie labarine mai d'an tsayi kuma a halin yanzu ba muda lokaci, sai dai tabbas yau naga farouk a wani yanayi kamar bashi da lafiya da idona uncle tare da wata mata da ta nace wai d'anta ne, amma ni yanzu munyi yarjejeniya da ita......... Nan ta basu labarin yadda sukayi da matar har ta taho yanzu ta had'a mata hujjoji, baffah da suke zaune jigum suna kallonta cikin mamaki da rashin fahimtar inda zancen ya dosa gaba d'aya ta kalla bayan ta sake durk'usawa a gabanshi, "Ni da gidan da muka zauna zanje na had'o hujjoji, to amma yanzu dana ganku sai naga duk hujjar da zan nema ba zata kai taku ba, indai har zanga farouk na gane shi a d'an sanin zaman shekaru biyu da y'an watanni da mukayi tare, to la shakka kaida ka rayu tare dashi tun yana yaro ba zaka kasa shaida shi ba...,..". 
    "Me kike son kice ne mamana, don ni dake da abdussamad d'in duka na kasa fahimtar abinda kuke nufi me zai hana kuyi mun bayani dallah dallah......". 

   "Baffah babu lokacine". Amma kuzo muje hospital d'in doctor fu'ad a can komai zai warware muku". 
    
   Duk shiru sukayi kafun Uncle yayi magana bayan lokaci mai tsawo, "yanzu farouk d'in yana can?". 
   "Eh Uncle muje kada su gudu duk da dai sunyi mun alk'awari, a bisa yadda da hakan na baro asibitin nazo nan..". 
    "Mik'ewa yayi ya dubi yayyun nashi ya kamata muje muga abinda arfah take nufi". 
   A tare kusan suma suka mik'e, abdussamad yace da husna ke ku zauna tare da yara shamsudden ma zai zauna mu muje mu dawo". 
   Gyad'a mishi kai kawai tayi don ita kanta a rud'ani take har yanzu. 

  Kusan tare duk suka fita, ita da Uncle da baffan farouk a mota d'aya suka yi gaba, Abbie kuma da baba mahaifin sulaiman drivern Abbie ya jasu. 
   Kasancewar asibitin bashi da nisa da gidan uncle cikin mintuna k'alilan suka isa.

   Ita tayi musu jagora har office d'in doctor fu'ad da rikicin su ya hanashi komawa gida, kusan a tare suka shiga office d'in bayan sun nemi izini. 
    Baisan lokacin daya mik'e ba sakamakon ganin mutane har hud'u da arfah ta kawo a matsayin hujjarta, shi fa har yanzu gani yake kamar arfah ta rikice ne kuma bai d'auka rikicin nata zai mik'a har haka ba, sannu da zuwa ya soma yi musu ya basu seat don su zauna, sun zauna inda suka gaggaisa dashi. Shirun seconni ya biyo baya kafun jafar ya tambayi doctor, "yana Ina farouk d'in?". 
    Mik'ewa doctor fu'ad yayi duk da patient d'in nashi yana buk'atar nutsuwa amma mafi a'ala ya kaisu su ganshi, yana gaba suna bin bayanshi har d'akin da Muhammad yake kwance har lokacin yana bacci yayinda hajiya ameena ta kife kanta jikin k'arfen gadon da yake kwance. 
    Duk bakinsu d'auke da sallama suka shiga, hajiya ameena ta d'ago da wani irin yanayi akan fuskarta tana binsu da kallo. 
    Babu wanda ya iya ce mata komai tsakanin su saboda kusan rabin hankalinsu ya tafi a kallon fuskar patient d'in dake kwance a kan gadon marassa lafiya. 
   Ba k'aramin nauyi da kunyar su Abbie ce ta cika idon arfah har ta kasa zuwa kan farouk a lokacin ba. 
    Baffah kallon tsaf yayiwa matashin saurayin sannan ya kai dubanshi ga matar da take binsu da kallo har lokacin. 
  "Malama barka dai, kiyi hak'uri fa mun shigo ko gaisawa dake bamu tsaya yiba, Ni dai sunana Ibrahim yuseep jauro baffi, kuma nine mahaifin wannan matashi da kike ik'irarin d'anki ne na cikin ki farouk".  
   Hajiya ameena tsuru tsuru tayi ta k'arewa mutumin kallo sannan tabi y'an uwanshi da kallo d'aya bayan d'aya ta d'ora hannu aka ta fashe da kuka, "na shiga uku doctor fu'ad kana kallo zasu raba ni da d'ana farin cikina kwanciyar hankalina, doctor kayi musu bayanin shi kad'ai ne d'an da na mallaka a duniya nake gani nake jin dad'i......". 
    Sai ta durk'ushe a gurin tana k'ara sautin kukanta, abdussamad as a barrister zuwa yanzu ya Soma d'ago wani abu tare da matar to amma yafi son Muhammad d'in ya dawo cikin cikakkiyar nutsuwarshi suyi magana dashi, yasan a take gaskiya zata futo. 
     Guri ya samu ya zauna cikin su babu wanda yace mata tak har arfah da take zaune can gefe guda tana addu'ar wannan bawan Allah da yake kwance ya farfad'o gaskiya ta futo. 
   Doctor fu'ad ne ya shiga tsakiya ya dinga rarrashin hajiya ameena da bata shawarar tunda dai yana cikin nutsuwarshi to a jira ya farfad'o ya fad'i gaskiya da bakinshi, tunda ai duk haukarshi bazai zab'e ta ya bar mahaifinshi ba indai da gaske shi d'in farouk ne. 
   Har ga Allah wannan shawara bata yiwa hajiya ameena ba to amma data tuna wani abu sai taji hankalinta ya d'an kwanta kad'an.  
   
     Sunci gaba da zama don duk sallolinsu a asibitin sukayi har zuwa lokacinda alluran jikinshi Suka gama aikinsu. A wannan lokaci bugun zuciyar hajiya k'ara tsananta yayi kamar ta faso k'irjinta saboda zullumi da fargaba. 
    Cikin ikon Allah suna kewaye da gadon ya soma motsa bakinshi da sassan jikinshi irin su k'afa da hannuwa, "kada ku bari ta tafi? Ku nemo ta". 
   Abinda bakinshi yake fad'a kenan cikin kwantaccen sauti, doctor fu'ad daya kasance a kusa dashi a wannan lokaci matsawa ya sakeyi kusa daf da saitin fuskarshi yadda zai jishi sosai yace, "wacece kake nufin a nemo maka Muhammad?". 
     Firgigit yayi ya tashi zaune yana fad'in matata ce doctor, wallahi Fatima itace matata da nake yawan yiwa hajiya maganarta, likita idan har ba'a samo mun itaba wallahi rayuwata zata shiga mawuyacin hali.....". 
    Duk da wani irin yanayi suke kallonshi jin irin furucinda yake futa daga bakinshi, hajiya ameena kam kuka ta sanya tana fad'in, "ka gani ko likita? Wallahi kusan wata guda kenan yana ambatar wannan fatiman Ni bansan yadda zanyi ba ma....... Ni a iya Zama na tare dashi bamu tab'a yi mishi aure ba amma haka siddan ya dinga ambato mana iyalai...."
    Shi kuwa Muhammad har lokacin hankalinshi bai Kai kan mutanen da suke ciki a parlon ba, yayinda ita kuma hajiya ameena ta manta da wanzuwarsu a gurin har tayi wannan b'arin baki. 
     Inkiya doctor fu'ad yayi Fatima da hannu alamun ta k'araso kusa, ta taso a nutse har zuwa gabanshi, kanshi yana durk'ushe har lokacin, doctor fu'ad yayi mata alamun tace wani abu?". 
    Cikin sanyi da tattausan lafazinta ta kira sunanshi, "farouk.....". Ai bai bari ta k'arasa ba ya wani d'ago a sukwane yana kallonta, sai dai me kafun yace wani abu gefen idonshi ya hasko mishi fuskar wani tamkar baffan shi, aikuwa sai gashi ya diro a saman gadon yana bin fuskokin su da kallo d'aya bayan d'aya. 
     Suma duk kallonshi sukeyi suna jira suga irin hukuncin da zai yanke, shin Muhammad d'in ne? Ko kuma farouk nasu. 
   "Baffahna" ya fad'a yana duban fuskar mahaifinshi da ba zata tab'a b'ace mishi ba har abadan abada.
     Wata irin ajiyar zuciya kusan mutanen gurin suka sauke a tattare, doctor fu'ad kanshi yayi mamaki koda yake dama shi tunda arfah tace mijinta ne ya shiga rud'ani zargi da tantama. 
    Hajiya ameena kuwa fashewa tayi da kuka tana fad'in, "shi kenan ta faru ta k'are sun rabani da d'ana". 
    Hankalin su duk kanta yayi har farouk da ya cika da mamakin wai yau gashi ga arfah tashi ga kuma mahaifinshi da y'an uwan baffahn shi, kuka takeyi sosai suna kallonta kafun can farouk ya nufi inda take yana tambayarta, "hajiya kukan me kike kuma? Ya kamata ki tayani murna wannan sune family na ga matata da kullum nake tambayarki inda take". 
    Cikin muryar kuka tace, "Ni duk ba wannan ne ya dame niba yanzu, kawai ina tunanin yadda zasu rabani dakai bayan mun d'auki tsawon lokaci tare, ka tuna nasha fad'a maka bana da kowa sai kai, tunda muke da honourable bamu tab'a haihuwa ba, kuma munsha d'auko yara daga gurin y'an uwa suna gudu su barmu, don Allah kada ka tafi kaima ka barni". 
    Cikin tausayinta matuk'a yake share mata hawaye, shi kanshi hawayen yake, tabbas hajiya ameena abun a tausaya mata ce to amma idan ya zab'i Zama tare da ita ya zaiyi da matarshi da yake matuk'ar so kamar koma fiye da ranshi, sannan iyayenshi da ya dinga yawo da fushin suna rashin sani a kanshi suma yayi ya dasu, gaskiya a cikin abubuwan nan biyu bazai iya hak'ura da ko guda ba. 
    Doctor fu'ad ganin komai ya warware cikin k'aramin lokaci hamdala yayi ga Allah subhanahu wata'ala sannan ya basu shawarar su tafi gidan su farouk d'in kawai sai su k'arasa case d'in nasu a can. 
    Da wannan shawarar sukayi na'am tunda kwarai asibiti ba gida bane suka had'a yanasu yanasu sukayi gidan uncle. 
    Hajiya ameena dai kuka yak'i tsaya mata tun tana basu tausayi har ta Soma basu haushi kuma. 
  Sun shiga cikin gidan da sallama, Husna da shamsudden Suka futo kusan a tare kowa daga d'akin shi. 
    Mutum biyu da suke bak'i a tafiyar ta kalla, ko ba'a fad'a mata ba tasan wannan matashin saurayin shine mijin arfah farouk. 
     Guri ta basu mai kyau Suka zazzauna sannan ta gabatar musu da drinks, ko ruwa ba wanda ya iya sha a tsakanin su duk da tarin yunwa da gajiyar da suke ciki kuwa. 
   Jafar ne ya Soma magana bayan sun nutsu kad'an da, "toh yanzu dai ba abinda zamuce sai alhamdulillah, Allah abin godiya, hakika duk wannan abu da muka ga ya faru ba komai bane sai kad'an daga jarrabawar ubangiji, sai abu na biyu mu yanzu muna son muji ya akayi har farouk ya shiga hannunki ya rayu na tsawon shekaru uku bayan ga matarshi da uncle d'inshi suna fad'in ya mutu". 
   






    _Yau dai kam nasan a Ahali d'aya fans za'a sha shagali, abinda suke dad'e suna jira ya samu_.

Page 67 _(sixty seven)_



 A gurin kowa sauraronta ya Soma a lokacinda ta share hawayenta ta Soma basu labari kamar haka, "Ni dai sunana ameena abu ribad'o, haifaffiyar garin katsina, mijina kuma honourable sulaiman shima haifaffen garin katsina ne, munyi aure da kusan shekaru 30 yanzu amma Allah bai tab'a bamu haihuwa ba, mun d'auki y'ay'an rik'o da yawa sai dai gayyar bata zuwa ko'ina take watsewa, nayi yink'urin zuwa gidan marayu sau babu adadi amma dana tuna yadda rayuwa yanzu ta koma sai Inji jikina yayi sanyi na sare, toh haka mukaci gaba da rayuwa daga ni sai honourable.   Ranar wata alkhamis da safe muka shirya tafiya garin Abuja nida mijina kamar yadda muka Saba a duk k'arshen wata na kanyi mishi rakiya, mun d'auki hanya munyi neesa kawai drivern mu cikin rashin kula farouk yazo zai tsallako titi yayi awon gaba dashi, duk hankalinmu ya tashi nida mijina saboda ba k'aramin duka yayi mishi ba, da Allah ya taimake mu babu wanda ya lura da abinda ya faru a mutanen gurin, gudun kada su tara mana police yasa muka d'auke shi muka shigar dashi cikin motar ko numfashi bayayi, muka ci gaba da tafiya har garin Abuja. 

    Muna zuwa gidan mu nacan honourable ya sallami drivern musamman daya ga mummunan halin daya jefa farouk a ciki, na Kira personal doctor na honourable inda ya dubashi ya tabbatar mana da karaya kusan uku a jikinshi, sai raunika daya ji. 
    An Soma kula dashi anan muka ga abin baiyi mana ba honourable yayi mana ciku ciku nidashi muka huce Germany inda yayi jinyarshi har ya warke ya koma sumul, toh bayan mun dawo gida sai ya Soma bijiro mana da wasu bak'in halaye da basu dame muba a lokacin da yake jinya don d'aukar mu duk zafin ciwo ne, tambayar duniya mukayi mishi sunanshi yak'i fad'a, daga ina yake kuma suwaye iyayenshi duk ba amsa, hankali a tashe muka sake d'aukar shi zuwa ga doctor fu'ad kwararren likitan kwakkwalwa, shi yayi mana bayanin sakamakon dakuwar da kanshi yayi ne ya shiga cikin wani mataki na d'imuwa a lokacin ba lallai ya tuna komai ba sai dai zai d'ora shi akan magani zuwa nan da y'an wasu shekaru, da wannan bayani na doctor muka dawo dashi gida cike da tausayawa. 
    Mun ci gaba da kula dashi cikin dokoki da karb'ar magani daga gurin likita, rasa sunan da zamu kirashi a lokacin kuma sai muka sanya mishi suna Muhammad tunda dai ai musulmi ne, toh a hankali a hankali ya Soma samun sauk'i, zuwa lokacin shak'uwa mai yawa ta shiga tsakanin mu dashi nida honourable, sakamakon kyawawan halayenshi da muke gani a kowacce mu'amula tashi, ranar da ya Soma furta magana sunanki ya Soma ambata Fatima, koda na fad'awa doctor fu'ad sai yace, watakila sunan wata da take da muhimmanci ne a cikin rayuwarshi, mu bincika a k'asar da mukace mun kaishi karatu ya dawo a haka ko akwai wadda yayi soyayyah da ita mai wannan sunan, (da yake mun b'oye ma doctor fu'ad gaskiya). 
    Lokaci yana dad'a tafiya haka shak'uwa mai tsanani tana sake shiga tsakanin mu, a lokuta da yawa zai shiga kitchen ya tayani girki har mamaki nakeyi, duk da bazai ce da kowa komai ba, a fahimtar da nayi bayan matsalar daya samu shi d'in dama asalin miskili ne. 
   Toh wata d'aya baya kafun had'uwata dake kwakwalwarshi ta dawo dai dai gaba d'aya, na fahimci hakane ta sanadiyyar kiran sunanki daya ke yawan yi da kuma wasu mutanen daban, toh kunsan akace maso mutum, ni a lokacin duk abinda zai rabamu ba sonshi nakeyi ba, hakan ya d'aga hankalina har na manta shi d'in fa tsintar shi mukayi, kuma ta iya yiwuwa wanda yake fad'a ahalin shine da makusantanshi, toh ban sake tsorata ba sai ranar da na tarar dashi zaune a d'akin shi yana ta rubuce rubucenshi, a lokacin ba komai yake rubutawa ba sai kalmomin godiya da karamcin da mukayi mishi, baisan na shigo ba hakan yasa na koma da sauri na fad'awa honourable komai a waya, nan ya ce mun lallai akwai abinda yake shiryawa Amma kafun nan na fad'awa security karsu sake ya futa daga gidan nan ko da wasa, hakan kuwa nayi mamaki na biyu wata rana yana cin abinci na Kira sunan da muka saka mishi, Muhammad sai dai ga mamakina bau amsa mun ba, hakan yasa nace Muhammad kanaji Ina kiran sunan ka fa, bud'ar bakinshi sai cewa yayi hajiya ni na fad'a miki ba sunana Muhammad ba. 
   Ranar kasa bacci nayi kamar yadda shima ya kwana bai rintsa ba, sau uku yana futowa cikin dare security suna hanashi futa. 
    Washe garin ranar na takurawa sulaiman daya siya mana ticket a satin muje gurin doctor fu'ad ko zai iya maganin mana matsalar (kuji k'arfin hali dole sai sun maida d'an wani nasu)
    Bayan na gama yima doctor fu'ad bayanin komai saida yayi zargi, amma sai ya share zargin da K'arfafa mun gwiwa, yace yana gab da dawowa cikakken hayyacinshi shiyasa zai dinga kira mana bak'in abubuwa, in kin tuna muna haka na ganki a office d'in, kuma tun farkon ganin ki da nayi Saida gabana ya fad'i, gashi kuna kama da Muhammad d'ina sosai, sai dai ban sake firgita da tsorata da lamarinki ba saida kikace kin sanshi mijinki ne, kiyi hak'uri duk wannan abun da nayi miki a asibiti nayi ne don banson abinda zai shiga tsakanina da shine, koda nace ki kawo hujjah duk ba don ban yadda da abinda kika fad'a bane, a'a sai dai na sake d'aukar lokaci dashi kafun lokacinda zaki had'o hujjah ki kawo d'in, tunda ni tun a gurin naji zamana tare da Muhammad yazo k'arshe. Toh kunji tarihin yadda na tsinci farouk d'inku". 


   Duk sun yaba mata kuma sun jinjina mata bisa ga namijin k'ok'arin da tayi wajen kula dashi, da soyayyar tsakani da Allah data nuna gareshi. Duk wannan abun da ake gogan yana can kusa da baffan shi amma hankalinshi yana kan matarshi gaba d'aya, ita kuwa ta lafe jikin Auntie husna sai share hawayenta take lokaci bayan lokaci a zuciyarta kuma tana hamdala ga Allah. 
    Baffah ne yace, "toh duk da dare ya somayi Amma zamu so ku kuma muji yadda komai ya gabata ta gefenku" 

   Da kyar arfah ta iya basu labarin yadda ya tafi don had'uwa da PA d'in mahaifinta don ya gyara tsakanin su da yadda ta samu mummunar sak'on mutuwarshi, har zuwa yanda su uncle abdussamad suka sameta suka d'auko ta zuwa asibiti aka ciro shuraim a cikinta, daga k'arshe ta k'are da fad'in, "dama ni ban tab'a yadda farouk ya mutu ba, kullum Ina ji a jikina yana raye sai dai ko nesa da inda nake rayuwa, shiyasa a kullum addu'a ta bata huce Allah ya bayyana mun shi......". 
    Ta k'are maganar da fashewa da kuka. 
   Baffane yace, "ba kuka zamuyi ba arfah, godewa Allah zamuyi daya cika mana burikanmu masu kyau, da ubangiji yaso sai ya barku a haka, yana raye a wani guri kema kina rayuwarki daban, kuma harku mutu ba zaku had'u ba, toh kinga saiki godewa Allah mai kyauta da k'ari". 
    Auntie husna abinci ta sake kawo musu, ita dai arfah bata ci gaba da Zama a gurin ba ta nufi part d'in ta, kanta har lokacin bawai sauk'i yayi ba, duk wannan abun dauriya kawai takeyi, shi kuwa farouk ji yake kamar ya mik'e yabi bayan matarshi ya furta mata yana sonta tun kafun wata k'addarar ta sake rabasu, yana son ya nuna mata yadda yayi kewarta kuma ya tambayeta abinda ta haifa.....ai zaren tunanin shi tsinkewa yayi daya tuno da yaron da ya gani a asibiti wanda yace sunanshi, "farouk shuraim" ya fad'a a fili ba tare daya masan yayi hakan ba. 
     Kusan iyayen nashi biyu duk sun jishi amma ba wanda ya nuna yaji abinda yace don su kansu har yanzu bawai kansu ya gama warwarewa bane. 
    Husna a d'akin kusa dana arfah ta yiwa hajiya ameena masauki, ta kawo mata abinci da duk abin buk'ata. 
     Su kuwa mazan kusan tare suka ci abincin anan parlour cikin jin dad'i da farin ciki. 
    Bayan sun gama uncle yayi musu masauki a d'akin sitting room da yake akwai komai da zasu buk'ata tunda yana yawan sauke bak'in kwana shida husna a gurin. 
    Farouk kuma yace, zai kwana tare da shamsudden. 
    Duk da yanason yin magana da baffan shi akan su ummie da k'annen shi Amma kunyar idon mahaifin arfah yasa ya hak'ura yabi shamsudden kawai. 
     
   Arfah kuwa tana shiga wanka ta fad'a, bata futo ba kuma saida ta d'auro alwala don salloli uku yau sun kwace mata. 
   Tana tsaye jikin wardrobe zata ciro kayan bacci Auntie husna ta shigo rik'e da tray na abinci da ruwa. 
    Ajiye mata tayi a k'asan carpet ita kuma ta zauna a gefen bed, da sauri arfah ta zura rigarta ta k'araso kusa da ita ta zauna a k'asa tana fad'in, "aikuwa kin taimaka mun Auntie don yunwa nakeji rabona da wani abinci tun jiya". 
    "A'a yoo yaza ki iya cin abinci kinga farin cikin ruhinki"
    D'an dariya tayi tana k'ok'arin kai lomar abinci bakinta tace, "Kai Auntie". 
  "A'a ba wani auntie arfah ni ai ba bak'uwar ki bace, kunyi magana dashi ma kuwa?" 
   Tsayawa tayi tana kallonta kafun ta girgiza mata kai a sanyaye, dafa kafad'ar ta tayi tace, "na tayaki murnar samun mijinki arfah, gaskiya nayi mamaki da naga abinda kike fad'a ya tabbata, ya akayi kika San bai mutu ba?". 
   Murmushi tayi tace, "Auntie ni kawai ji nake a jikina yana raye, koda yake masu iya magana sukace maso rai Wawa". Duk dariya sukayi inda auntie ta dinga zolayarta wai gobe zata sata a lalle tunda ita yanzu amarya ce sai ansha gyara. Ita dai arfah dariya kawai take tana faman b'oye fuska. 
    Da haka auntie ta fuce ta barta. 

  Kusan a daren ranar wanda suka iya rintsawa a cikin gidan nan k'alilan ne, su jafar sun raba dare suna hira, haka shamsudden da farouk ma, ita kuwa arfah farin ciki ne ya hanata bacci gaba d'aya, tsawon shekaru uku bata tab'a samun nutsuwa da kwanciyar hankali irin ta daren ranar ba, ko abinci ma na musamman taci a ranar. 
   Ita kuwa hajiya ameena a daren ranar ta kwashe komai ta fad'awa mijinta, suka yita jimantawa kansu daga k'arshe Suka baiwa zuciyoyin su hak'uri akan d'an rik'on nasu. 
   
                 *************


Washe garin ranar har k'arfe goma arfah bata tashi a bacci ba har saida surutu da hayaniyar su shuraim tayi yawa sannan. Fad'a suke tayi shida mammie akan chocolate shi yace tashi ita tace tata, data rasa gane me gaskiya a cikinsu sai ta kwace duka ta zura a jaka. 
   Suna kumburi suna komai Suka d'auki hanyar futa daga d'akin. 
     Wanka ta shiga don tasan lokaci ya k'ure balle tace zata taya Auntie had'a breakfast, riga da zani ta saka na wata atamfa da uncle ya d'inka musu ita da Auntie, abun mamaki kuma sai gashi ta samu kanta da kallon mirrow duk da bata shafa komai a fuskarta tata ba amma tayi d'aurin d'an kwali mai kyau, daga k'arshe ta shafa khumrah ta sako hijab dogo ta futo, lokacin auntie da shamsudden ne kad'ai a parlon, ta samu guri kusa da auntien ta zauna suka Soma gaisawa. 
    Daga nan kuma ta mik'e ta shiga sitting room inda suke gaba d'aya. Suna zaune dukkannin su da alamu basu dad'e da karya kumallo ba, farouk tunda ta shigo yake binta da kallo k'asa k'asa kamar yaga sabuwar halitta. Sai da tabi d'aya bayan d'aya duk ta gaishe su banda farouk. 
    Suma zolayarta Suka dingayi musamman uncle da baba, tasa tafin hannunta ta rufe fuskarta tana d'an dariya. 
   Koda ta futo daga sitting room d'in zamanta tayi a parlour ta tambayi auntie, "me zan samu na musamman yau Auntie". 
   Ita husna in arfah tana magana haka mamakin ta takeyi, bata tab'a sakin jiki dasu irin haka ba sai yanzu, lallai tana matuk'ar son farouk d'in nan, koda yake shima haka yake mugun sonta ta karanta don tunda sassafe yake zarya tsakanin d'akin su da parlour kuma duk hucewa sai ya kalli part d'insu arfah, banda kara irinta jinin fulani usul da suka had'iyi nonon fulani da tuni ya shiga d'akin tasan, to amma ko ita bai tambaya ba da kanta ta karanta, haka da shamsudden yake nuna mishi shuraim bai wani jashi jikinshi kamar da farko ba, sai yafi nan nan dasu mammie akan yaron, kararsu tana matuk'ar burge ta, gasu y'an zamani dasu amma suna da sauk'in rawar kai. 
   Shayi ta had'a da k'osai don tana k'aunar shi ta Soma ci suna hira, abun mamaki hira da shamsudden sosai kamar ba itace take amsa gaisuwarshi da kyar kwanakin baya ba. 
   Tana haka farouk ya futo ya zauna kusa da shamsudden, bai dai ce komai ba sai wayar shi da yake aikin dannawa, ita kanta yi tayi kamar bata ganshi ba, a haka ta kammala shanye shayin ta ta maida komai kitchen ta had'a duka kayan da aka b'ata ta wanke sannan ta futo, lokacin da ta futo hira sukeyi tsakanin su, duka labarin dai na lokacin yana matashi ne a ABU Zaria, kusan duk dariya sukeyi don labarin wautar da suka tabka ne suda abokan su. 
    Yadda arfah Tasha mur ku bakwace a gabanta yake duk wannan dariyar ba. 
    Husna ce ta tambayi farouk bayan duk sunyi shiru tace, "mama fa bata futo ba farouk har yanzu". 
   "Eh ba damuwa a k'a'idar ta idan tayi sallah bata komawa bacci sai ta zauna lazimi har rana sannan ta sake kwanciya" farouk ya fad'a ma Auntie husna kai tsaye. Basu sake cewa komai ba har arfah ta gaji ta tattara yanata yanata tayi d'akinta.
    A parlon ta sami hajiya ameena ta futo daga d'akinta itama, ta durk'usa da sauri ta gaisheta, ta amsa ta cikin sakin fuska tana tambayarta shuraim me wayo, "yana gurin su Abbie". 
  "Toh bari in k'arasa gurin su mu gaisa". Tana gama fad'in haka tayi gaba ita kuma arfah tayi nata d'akin donta kintsa. 
    Aiki ta b'aro tuk'uru don ta hargitsa komai kafun ta tafi asibiti wancen ranar, koda ta gama rana ta d'aga, hakan yasa ta sake watsa ruwa ta d'auro alwalar zuhur prayer, ko abinci bata tsaya iya ciba ta kwanta sai bacci wanda har sai kusan asr prayer ta tashi, sallah ta sake gabatarwa. 
   Lokacin data futo babu kowa a main parlour na gidan, hakan ya bata damar shiga kitchen kai tsaye, d'an abinda zata iya ci ta had'a a plate ta futo, gidan kamar Allah bai halicci mutane a ciki ba ita tafi tunanin ma ko sun futa ne. 
   A hanyarta ta futa taci karo da farouk tsaye ya hard'e hannuwanshi a k'irji yana kallonta da kaifafan kwayar idonshi masu kashe jiki da laka, sau d'aya ta kalleshi gabanta ya fad'i amma ta dake ta kewayeshi ta futa daga kitchen d'in. 
   
     A daren ranar kamar jiya haka aka zauna har hajiya ameena duk da abune na familyn su amma sun lamince taji don su basu iya b'oye b'oye ba sam, labarin yadda uncle ya had'u da yaya sulaiman akayi da kuma yadda duk suka had'u a yola lokaci guda, uncle abdussamad bayan sunyi maganar nan da arfah hankalin shine ya maro take a lokacin ya tuna da mahaifiyarsu da take raye Suka manta da ita tsawon shekaru. Hakan yasa ya bada uzuri a office ya d'auki hanyar garinsu cikin tashin hankali, sai dai abin mamaki gidansu yana nan bai sauya ba, haka itama y'ar dattijuwar matar, sai shekaru da suka k'aru mata kawai, da farko kuka abdussamad ya dinga yi sosai, sai dai daga yadda ta karb'i yafiyarshi ya gano bata rik'e su shida yayyenshi da komai ba. 
     Minti talatin cikakke da zuwanshi kuma saiga jafar da sulaiman da Suka had'u k'ofar shiga gidan. 
  Nan fa aka sake rikicewa gida inno tasa jikar lirwan da take rik'o ta kira waya ta sanar da mahaifinta komai, kafun fad'uwar rana saiga y'an uwa bakwai cif sun had'u a gidan, a ranar komai ya warware harda labarin abinda Inna harira tayi na saita wargatsa kan y'ay'an fatsime da suke rik'e da ita, shine abinda ya haddasa wai suka tafi suka barta tsawon shekaru, kuma ba zasu sake dawowa ba har sai ranar da wannan asiri ya karye, duk sun ji kam kuma sun tsorata amma basu yadda da abinda ta fad'a ba, sukace dama can Allah ya k'addaro hakan saita faru dasu ba wai yinta bane. Kukan da inno tayi a wannan rana yana da yawa, sunyi kwanaki uku suna hirar Yaushe gamo kamar karsu rabu ma, haka kamar wata y'ar tsama bata tab'a shiga tsakanin suba, ba hajiya fatsime mahaifiyarsuba hatta makwabtanta sai da suka san y'ay'an ta masu kud'i sunzo garin, don abdussamad da jafar Saida Suka d'auko hanyar yin dallah dallah da komai sannan Suka futo daga garin akan yarjejeniyar kowa zaije after one week ya dawo da iyalanshi. 
    Su jafar da Ibrahim kuma Sai a lokacin Suka tattauna abinda ya faru da y'ay'an su ba tare da sunji shakku ko nadamar yin abinda Suka aikata ba, anan shima abdussamad ya basu labarin komai banda na mutuwar farouk da haihuwar arfah. 
    Sun yanke hukuncin su Soma zuwa suga idan yaran sun had'a kansu suna zaune lafiya, in basu had'a ba kuma suyi musu bore don wannan zumunci Allah da kanshi ya k'ulla basu ba. 
    Wannan shine ummul'aba'isin had'uwar mu da kuma tahowarmu gidan abdussamad. 
     Duk tsit kakeji parlon kamar ruwa ya cinye kowa sai k'arar fanka da ac kurum. 
     D'aya bayan d'aya suka dinga mik'ewa har ya rage daga su sai su. Hajiya ameena da arfah suna zaune a parlour tana sake rok'on ta akan ta bari ta kwana musu biyu sai ta tafi, sai dai fafur ta kafe akan gobe honourable yana zuwa tare zasu tafi daman zuwan nashi ne ya zame mata tsaiko. 
   Suna tsaka da haka farouk ya shigo bayan yayi sallama parlon. 
    D'an matsawa nesa tayi ta zuba tagumi tana satar kallonshi ta wutsiyar ido kamar wani dodo. 
   Shi kuwa Kusa da hajiya ya zauna suka sake gaisawa.  Ya d'an yi shiru kafun ya d'ora da jawabin yi mata godiya akan duk d'awainiyar da tasha dashi ita da mijinta, sai dai ko kafun ya sake ce wani abu ta fashe da kuka, "wato har abada ba zan samu wanda zai maye mun gurbin d'a ba a wannan duniyar". 
   Kusan a tare suka tsinci kansu a gabanta. Cikin sake nuna ko in kula da juna, arfah ta d'ora hannunta a saman  na hajiya ameena ta soma yi mata magana da fad'in, "har abada indai muna raye kin daina amsa tamvarin rashin haihuwa, ki d'auke mu a matsayin y'ay'an ki da zasu kasance masu yi Miki addu'a ko da bayan ranki daga yau".
    Da fuska duk hawaye take kallonsu rauninta yana sake bayyana. Farouk ma d'ora hannunshi yayi a saman nata ya gyad'a mata kai,  "tabbas abinda ta fad'a haka yake ada baki da d'a kina kukan hakan, a yanzu kuma bake kad'ai bace ki dinga tuna mu d'in y'ay'an kine a duk inda kike zaki samu nutsuwar zuciya". 
    Murmushi ta d'ora a saman fuskarta ta dubi su biyun tace, "insha Allah amma na tambayeku wani abu mana?". 
   Duk suka gyad'a kai suna sauraron ta, tashin su tayi kowa ya zauna a gefenta suka sata a tsakiya. 
  "Mene tarihin soyayyarku ku fad'a mun yadda ta fara har ta kaiku ga aure". 
    Zuba ma arfah ido yayi ita kuma ta sunkuyar da kanta. 
   "A'a kuga yaraa meye hajiya arfah hadda duk'ar da kai kuma". Arfah idonta cike da hawaye ta d'ago ta kalleta, "mama auren mu ba auren soyayyah bane kamar yadda kike tsammani, asalin auren mu had'i ne". 
    Wani irin murmushi tayi mai k'ayatarwa ta sake rik'o hannun arfah cikin nata ta Soma share mata hawayenta, "a wasu lokutan mutane sukan zage wajen son ganin sai sun yiwa kansu zab'in komai, Amma da zasuyi hak'uri su fawwala dukkan lamarin su ga Allah, sai kiga yayi musu kyakkyawan zab'in da zaifi zame musu alkhairy fiye da nasu, a yau ko da Allah yayi ku ma'abota kara da kawaici, saboda idon iyayenku kuke ta k'ok'arin b'oye da k'in futo da soyayyar ku fili duk wanda ya kalle ku ko makahone ya shafa saiya gane kuna cikin matsananciyar soyayar juna". 
    Arfah kwantar da kanta tayi tana tuna kalmomin mahaifiyarta, "duk yadda zakiyi baki Isa ki hana Allah ikon shi ba" wannan maganar tasha yinta ga k'awayenta da abokan kasuwancinta. Sai gashi itama Allah yayi mata dole, an nada ta wakilcin isar da sak'o, kuma ta isar bada son ranta ba, k'arshe har gashi ta samu tukuicin tafiya da aurenta. 
   "Muje ki rakani na kwanta". 
   Muryar hajiya ameena ta katse mata d'an k'aramin zaren tunaninta, mik'ewa tayi tayi sukayi sallama da farouk tayi gaba, har inda zata kwanta arfah ta gyara mata sannan tayi mata sallama zata fuce, sai dai tanayin gaba muryar hajiya ameena ta katse ta.  
  "Nikam nace duk kiran mijina ne shi farin cikina ne hajiya don Allah ki bani shi, a haka zai k'are, ko kwakkwaran kallo ba zaki iya yi mishi ba......". Murmushi kawai arfah tayi cikin jin nauyi tace, "mama Saida safe....". 
   Ta fuce tana murmushi. 
  Sai dai a dai dai k'ofar d'akinta ta ganshi ya tokare duka hannun shi a k'ofar. 
   Kasa kallon idonshi tayi haka kawai taji yayi mata kwarjini da nauyi ko don bata tsammata ganin shi bane. 
   Taku ya somayi zuwa inda taci burki yana kallonta da nazari kafun yace, "Anya kinyi kewata kuwa?" 
D'ago kanta tayi ta dubeshi kamar ba zata ce komai ba sai kuma tace, "meyasa zaka ce haka?". 

 "Saboda Ni banga alamun hakan a tare dake ba, yadda muka d'auki lokaci bama tare I can't believe cewa zaki ganni ki kasa fad'in koda gaisuwar Ina kwana da ya kake, sannan baya ga haka banga alamun wani dokin ganina a tare dake ko farin ciki ba ko kad'an, koda yake mu ajiye duk wancan batun a gefe koda bakiyi duk wad'an can ba ai ya kamata ki bani labarin yadda kika Haifa wancen d'an mai kama dani amma surutu kamar ke, shin taya zan yadda kinyi kewata ma wai babyyy.....".
   Tsare shi tayi da wani irin kallo da ita kanta batasan ma'anar shi guda d'aya ba. 
     Shima baiyi k'asa a gwiwa ba wajen mayar mata da martanin irin kallonta. 
   Shiru shiru kafun ta Soma k'ok'arin huce shi don ta kama nata wuri, k'in bata guri yayi yace, "baki bani amsa ta bafa madame me". 
   Ita dariya ma yaso bata amma ta shanye ta sake d'aure fuskarta ta kewayeshi ta shige d'akinta. 

      "Sleep tight dear" ya fad'a yana bin bayanta da kallo har ta shige. 



             @@@@@@@@



Washe garin ranar suka tashi da Shirin tafiyar hajiya ameena da mijinta da zai iso a ranar daga Abuja. 
     Tun asubar ranar arfah da husna suke kitchen suna aiki har rana bai k'are ba. 
    Da misalin k'arfe uku na ranar ranar alhaji sulaiman honourable ya iso gidan uncle abdussamad bisa jagorancin farouk. 
     Bai wani dad'e ba bayan gaisuwa da taya su murna yace zasu tafi, sun so ko abincin ya tsaya yaci yace, a'a ya gode amma yaci abinci shi. 
   Baiyi cikakken minti arba'in ba suka yi sallama da kowa shida matarshi Suka tafi bayan anyi exchange na phone no had'e da alk'awarin zai zo musu zuwa na musamman ko ba cikin lokacin ba saboda shima yanzu yana da uzurirrikan da Suka sha kanshi masu tarin yawa yanzun. 

     Hajiya ameena tana kuka Suka rabu da familyn farouk kamar kar ta tafi, dama shi farouk tun safiyar ranar yayi mata sallama bai yarda sun sake had'uwa ba kuma har ta tafi.

Page 68 _(sixty eight)_



 _After three days_
   
Duk wasu shirye shirye da ya kamata na tafiyarsu yola su Yaya jafar sun kammala shi cikin kwanaki ukun nan, ta waya Suka shirya yadda tafiyar zata kasance da iyalansu baffa dake garin kaduna ba tare da sunje ba, duk yadda farouk yaso ya had'u da mutanen shi da akayi zaman amana cikin kwanakin abin faskara yayi, banda sallah da take futar dashi masjid ba yake zuwa, kullum yana gida cikin y'an uwanshi ana hirar yaushe gamo, idan an had'u parlour yana satar kallon matarshi da har yanzu tafiyarsu su bata sauya zani ba. 
     A ranar da zasu tafi tun asubah suke shiri, ko zuwa k'arfe 7 na safe duk sun Zama ready har yaran, kusan duk a motocin abie zasuyi tafiyar, data abdussamad guda d'aya, amma bashi zaiyi driving ba. 
     Abie, baffa da baba suna mota d'aya, yayinda uncle da iyalanshi suka had'u a mota guda, sai arfah, shamsudden da farouk ma suka had'u a mota d'aya, dama shuraim yana mak'ale gurin uncle sai ya kasance motarsu ba yara ko d'aya a ciki, wannan had'in tafiyar ba kowane ya shirya shiba sai auntie husna bisa shawarar abdussamad, saboda su samu kusanci a tsakaninsu tunda ta fahimci kowa miskilin kanshi ne, watakila sanadin haka su rage fusgewa juna kai. 
     Sun d'auki hanya har sukayi tafiya mai nisa shiru kowa da abinda yake sak'awa a zuciyarshi tsakanin su. Shamsudden da yake kusa da driver seat dama ana Soma tafiya ya jona headphone a kunne ya kwantar da kanshi sai bacci. 
     Kamar kurame haka Suka kasance a wannan zaman sai dai Allah kad'ai yasan nutsuwar da take kwaranya a ruhin kowanne d'aya cikin su, sun samu kusanci irin wanda suka dad'e basu samu ba, k'amshin turaren su daya had'u ya cakud'e yake bada wani scent na musamman. A haka bacci mai nauyi ya d'auke arfah da ta jinginar da kanta jikin kujerar da take zaune, kamar mai jira hakan ya kasance farouk ya tsurawa fuskarta ido yana binta da kallon tsaf da tsanaki, Zara zaran gashin ido dana gira, siririn dogon hanci irin nashi, da matsakaitan pink lips masu shek'i da d'aukar hankali, suna nan sun sake kyau bisa round shape face d'inta. 
    Ci gaba da kallonta yayi from up to toe, komai nata bai sauya ba kamar d'a bai tab'a tsaga jikinta ya futo ba. Ganin wuyanta ya langab'e sai ya kwantar da kanta kafad'ar shi ya mata sight hug yana sauke wata b'oyayyar ajiyar zuciya. 
     A haka sukaci gaba da tafiya har suka zo inda motocin da suka d'auko mutanen kaduna zasu had'e da yake drivovin duk escort d'in abie ne, farouk yana rungume da arfah motar da mahaifiyarshi da k'annen shi suke tazo ta kewaye su ta huce, yabi ta da kallo kamar ya daka tsalle ya futo yaje gurin ummien shi haka yaji a lokacin, he Soo much miss his family.  
  Tafiyar awanni...... Cif ta kaisu garin adamawa yola. 
     Arfah taci bacci har ta gode Allah saboda dama akwai gajiya a tare da ita sosai cikin kwanakin aiki suke yini yi itada Husna. A hankali ta zare jikinta ana farouk tana ambaton sunan Allah. 
    Shima janyewa yayi daga jikinta ya juya kanshi yana kallon window kamar baisan da zamanta ba. 
    Itama juya kanta tayi tana tunanin yadda ta kwantar da kanta a cinyarshi kane kane take bacci haka sadidan. 

   Lokacinda suka isa Farouk kasa daina mamaki yayi ganin gidan kakanninsu mak'ota da gidan kakanninsu Salman abokin shi, aiki akeyi a gidan tuk'uru jafar duk ya had'e da mak'otan gidajen da iyayensu Suka mutu ya Zama na gado, ya siye da ninkin baninkin d'in kud'i yana gina musu babban family house, rik'e da jakar kayan arfah ya futo su mammie da shuraim sukayo gurinshi da gudu suka rungume shi, "yeeeh! Da kai akazo kaima yaya?"
    Murmushi yayi musu ya rik'e hannun mammie suka yi gaba little farouk na biye dasu yana ta tambayarsu ko Ina ne nan d'in da Suka zo, "nan shine adamawa yola tushenmu". 
      Ya bashi amsa ba tare daya kalleshi ba, "meye kuma tushe Yaya?" 
    Shamsudden ne yanzun ya rik'o hannunshi ganin har sunyi gaba tuni ya ci gaba da taya shi. 
  
     A babban parlon da aka had'a kamar d'akin taro suka sauka duk da ba'a gama aikin d'akin ba, an dai saka tiles da plaster bango.
    Kusan guri d'aya matan suka zauna, hakan yasa arfah ma ta shiga cikinsu can gefe guda ta zauna a d'arare. Gaggaisa aka somayi da matansu lirwan da suke ta kaiwa da komowa wajen gabatar musu da abinciccikan gargajiya kala_kala. 
    Fara y'ar dattijuwar matar dai sai binsu da kallo take tana godewa Allah mai kyauta da k'ari, basuyi doguwar hira ba sukaci abinci suka soma haramar gabatar da sallolin da suka hucesu a hanya. 
    Sai a lokacin ummie ta samu damar ganin arfah a gurin alwala. Sun gaisa cikin sakin fuska daga b'angaren ummin amma bayan nan ba abinda ya sake shiga tsakanin su tayi alwalarta tayi nata guri. 
     Arfah tunda tayi sallarta a d'akin cikin parlon bata futo ba tayi zamanta ciki tana lazimummukan ta. 
    Tun tana lazimin har tunani yaci k'arfin kwakwalwarta ta jingina da jikin gini tana tunanin amminta, duk da kasancewarta cikin tsakiyar y'an uwanta dangi duka kuma babu d'aya da yayi mata kallon banza ko tsangwama cikinsu sai taji ta tamkar marainiya rashin amminta a kusa ita, d'an abinda ya faru tsakanin wata k'anwar farouk da umminsu d'azu a gurin alwala yasa ta tuna mahaifiyarta kwarai, taji kewarta kuma a karo na farko. A hankali hawayenta yake sauka d'aya bayan d'aya bisa kuncinta a lokacin da kwakwalwarta take yi mata tariyar abinda ya shiga tsakanin su da ita tun a wancen lokacin. 
    "Na yafe miki ammie, wallahi ban rik'e ki da komai ba, yanzu na sake fahimtar ba Abbie ne kad'ai yake da muhimmanci a cikin rayuwata ba, kema wani b'arin na jikina ce......"

  Duk a fili take yin maganarta ba tare da tunanin wani a kusa yana sauraronta ba, Zahra da ta shigo d'akin ba jimawa juyawa tayi ta futa, sukaci karo da Khadija zata shigo ta dakata tana tambayarta "ya kika futo matar big bro d'in bata ciki ne?". 
    Da sauri arfah ta share hawayenta ta sake gyara rolling d'in gyalenta taci gaba da laziminta, su kuwa tare suka k'arasa shiga suna sake kwad'a sallama, da fara'a a fuskarta sosai ta amsa musu tana gyara musu gurin zama, duk da yawan y'an matan data gani a famylin su sa'anninta dama wad'an da suka d'ara ta da wanda ma basu kaita ba, kanta bai rikice wajen kasa banbance jinin farouk a ciki ba, wannan dai ko da ba'a fad'a mata ba tasan k'annen shine, duk Zama sukayi suka Soma gaisheta, ita nauyin suma taji barin ma Khadija da kallo d'aya ta gane ta, don ita ta bata hijab a lokacin da y'an iska suka kusa raping d'inta Allah ya kawo farouk. 
    Bayan gaisuwa shiru ne ya biyo baya kafun zahrah ta gabatar mata da kansu d'aya bayan d'aya. 
    Duk ta nuna jin Dad'in had'uwa dasu, tun tana d'ari d'ari sai gashi a k'arshe ta ware cikinsu anata hira, rabin hirar su ta makaranta da kuma yadda rayuwa ta koma yanzu ne, ko anan saida arfah ta sake jinjina tarbiyyah da nutsuwa irinta yaran, saboda duk maganarsu ta hankali ce ba hauka ko burbushin jahilci a ciki.
     Ranar tare suka k'arasa yininsu, har y'ay'an ragowar y'an uwansu sai gashi suma sun shigo cikinsu anata harkar zumunci. 
    Da daddare bayan iyayensu sun gama hirarsu da inno sun tafi masauki, duk matasan kewayeta sukayi suna mata hirar jika da kaka, duk dasu babu wani sabo ko shak'uwa a tsakaninsu amma basu kasance masu duhun kai ba sun shiga ciki anata raha dasu, ita dai baiwar Allah binsu kawai take da kallo tana jin sunayen wanda bata shaida girmansu ba. 
     Ita dai arfah ta riga kowa tsame jiki ta tafi makwanci saboda gajiyar dake jikinta da kuma rashin nutsuwar zuci har yanzu a tare da ita. 
    D'akin da suka yi hira kafun su tashi ta koma, inda ta tararda Auntie husna da ummie sai ragowar matar k'annen Abbie da basu gama hucewa ba, da sallama ta shiga, duk suka amsa mata, sai dai ganin su yasa ta fasa zama ciki ta koma parlon, a can k'arshe ta samu guri ta zauna tana tunanin inda ta jefa jakarta da wayarta ke ciki. 
    Y'ar uncle yakub mai suna suwaiba itace tazo inda arfah take, tace tazo suje gidansu duka a can y'an matan zasu kwana, ba musu tabi bayanta sai dai har sunyi gaba ta koma d'akin dasu aunty husna suke, da sallama yanzun ma ta shiga, duk suka amsa mata, cikin jin nauyi ta k'arasa kusa da auntie husna ta durk'usa tace, "Auntie zamu je gidan uncle yakub mu kwana tare dasu suwaiba ko jakata tana gurinki?". 
    "Owk ba dumuwa ga jakar sai Allah ya kaimu". 
   Auntie husna ta fad'a tana mik'a mata handbag d'inta. 
    Sai data d'auki doguwar riga ta bacci da hijab sai kayan da zata sauya sannan tayi musu sallama ta nufi k'ofar fita, ummie ta bita da kallo har ta kusa futa sai kuma ta kira sunanta a sanyaye, "Arfah". 
   Juyowa tayi da nutsuwa tana kallonta cikin ladab tace, "na'am ummie". 
   "Ki tafi tare da shuraim sannan ki turo mun Zahra". 
  "Toh ummie" ta fad'a sannan ta juya ta futa zuciyarta cike da tunanin yadda ummie tasan da shuraim da kuma maganar da tayi mata na ta tafi tare da shi, a k'ofar parlour ta tarar dasu Khadija suna jiranta, ta fad'a musu sak'on ummie don tsakanin zahra, haseena da khadija ba wani gane sunan su takeyi sosai ba, sunyi gaba zuwa k'ofar gida ita da Khadija inda zasu jira Zahra da ragowar y'an matan su huce arfah rik'e da hannun shareefa (y'ar da Khadija ta haifa, in kun tuna tun a farkon novel d'in Ahali d'aya Khadija tayi aure wanda bai jima ba ya lalace tazo gida da satittika ta soma laulayi)
     A k'ofar gidan taga tawagar matasan masu aure da samari kan tabarmar kaba ana ta hira, sau d'aya arfah ta kalle su ta d'auke kanta gefe. 
    Farouk da yake zaune a can gafe kare da waya a kunne kallonta ya dinga yi ta cikin hasken farin wata ganin ba ita kad'ai bace sai ya taso a nutse ya nufo inda suke, Khadija k'anwar shi da fara'a akan fuskarta tace, "lahh ashe kune anan, nifa tun d'azu dana ganka a parlour ban sake ganinka ba, gashi ina son akwai maganganu da yawa zamu tattauna da hirar yaushe gamo, ga wani kyakkyawan yaro da naji ana fad'awa ummie d'an kune kaida Auntie Fatima". 
   Murmushi yayi yana satar kallon arfah da tayi mirsisi kamar bata ganshi ba a gurin, a hankali yace, "nima kaina akwai maganganu da yawa da nake son mu tattauna daku saboda baffa yace mun ba wadda tayi aure a cikinku, amma yanzu tukun ina zaku?"
     "Gidan baffa yakub" ta bashi amsa. 
   "Toh me kuke jira anan kuma? Muje na rakaku kawai ina tunanin muma acan zamu kwana tunda shine mafi kusa kuma akwai d'akuna da yawa". 
   Kallon Arfah Khadija tayi tace, "muje ko in yaso sa taho su tare dasu suwaiba". 
     D'an duddubawa arfah tayi ko zata ga shuraim kafun tace, "eh ba damuwa amma ummie tace na tafi tare da shuraim gashi tunda muka futo ban ganshi ba, ni tunda muka zo ma sau d'aya na ganshi"
   "Toh ko yana gurinsu baffah? Nikam ko a idona ban saka shiba". 
    Sai lokacin farouk yace, "a'a nasan inda yake bari ina zuwa?". 
   Mintuna k'alilan sai gashi ya dawo sab'e da yaron a kafad'ar shi, sun jera shida Khadija Arfah tana binsu suna hirarsu ta Yaya da k'anwa ita dai tana sauraron su, basuyi wani tafiya mai nisa ba Suka Isa gidan. 
    Ba laifi ginin bulo ne gidan kuma da d'an girmanshi, kasancewar yana da rufin asiri kuma ko'ina na gidan a gyare yake sumul. 
    Matarshi tana zaune a tsakar gida da hasken lantarki ya haske tarwai itama bata dad'e da dawowa ba daga can gidan Suka shiga da sallama, da fara'arta ta tarye su tana musu lale marhabin, sun russuna inda suka sake gaisheta ta amsu cikin kulawa itama, da kanta ta nuna musu d'akin da suwaiba ta gyara musu suka shiga, farouk ya kwantar da shuraim dake kafad'ar shi saman bargo, ita kuma ta d'auki rigarta ta bacci da duk abinda zata buk'ata. 
   Khadija da take zaune gefen gadon d'akin ta dube ta tace, "wanka ko? Ni kaina sai nayi wankan nan zan iya bacci". 
   Murmushi arfah tayi kawai ta saci kallon farouk da yake tsaye still jingine da bango kanshi na kallon saman rufin d'akin, so take ya futa ta cire rigar jikinta, ganin bashi da niyyar futa sai kawai ta futa da rigar, matar baffan nata tana Shirin kai musu fura ta ganta ta futo, sai ta dakata har saida ta had'a mata ruwan da zatayi wankan sannan. 
      Har tayi wankan ta futo cikin Shirin bacci yana nan sunata hira da Khadija, shaidar bashi da niyyar tafiya ma ya samu guri yayi zamanshi gefen bed. 
     Gyara gurin da zata kwanta tayi kusa da shuraim ta zauna tana tambayar shareefa, "bakya jin bacci shareefa?". 
    Gyad'a mata kai yarinyar tayi, sai bata sake ce mata komai ba tayi kwanciyarta tana karanto addu'o'in tsari na kwanciya bacci. 
    Tana daga kwance tana jiyo hirarrakin su, duk labarin abinda ya faru bayan tafiyarshi suke tattaunawa, haihuwar shareefa da kuma addmision da baffa ya nema mata taci gaba da karatu, ta had'a degree d'inta yanzu haka ta kammala aiki ne bata fara ba, shima kuma baffa ne ya hana yace ta bari ta sami miji tayi aure sai ta Soma aikin a gidanshi in yana da buk'atar hakan, harsu haseena ma yanzu sunci gaba da karatun su a cewar baffansu ba zai sake yadda ya aurar da y'ar shi a irin auren da ya yiwa khadija ba, shiyasa duk ya tattara su ya adana a cikin gida. 
     Bayan takai k'arshen labarin, tambayarta yayi "Ni kuma Sam banga dabara a cikin abinda baffa yayi ba, yanzu kenan ba wadda zatayi aure a cikinku?". 
    Shiru tayi na y'an mintuna kafun tace, "eh to ni kuma banga wani abu na kuskure a abinda baffa yayi ba Yaya, kuma shi aure nufine na Allah, yanzu haka akwai wad'an da suke son haseena da Zahra da sun kammala NCE  za'ayi maganar aure" 
    Jinjina kai farouk yayi kafun ya tambayeta, "ke kuma fa?". 
   K'asa tayi da kanta tana murmushi, shima murmushin yayi ya mik'e don tun d'azu su Zahra Suka k'araso, jin maganar shi suka kasa shigowa d'akin, don su tunanin su ko tare da arfah suke hira. 
    Tare suka futo da ita kamar zatayi mishi rakiya, saida suka bar arean d'akin cikin kulawa tace, "Yaya amma sai naga kamar bakwa wani magana da Auntie Fatima, Allah yasa dai ba haka kuke zaune tunda akayi auren ba, don nasan auren da kukayi da ummie ta bamu labari bawai kuna son junan ku bane, baya ga haka hankalin mu ya tashi sosai da mukaji irin sharrin da gidansu suka k'ulla maka, yadda muka sanka sosai nasan ba zaka tab'a aikata abu makamancin haka ba, ina fatan ba d'an da ake tunanin tana da cikinshi bane wancan don sak copying kane....". 
    Farouk Saida ya sauke ajiyar zuciya mai tsayi kafun ya Soma magana da fad'in, "labarin mai d'an tsayi ne Khadija, abinda ya faru a lokacin sharri k'awarta ta had'a ita kanta bata san hawa ba bata san sauka ba, ni kaina a lokacin ban san komai ba haka nayi taji haushinta, su kuma ummie da amminenta saboda tsohuwar rigimarsu ta family basu tsaya tantance komai ba suka yanke hukunci cikin fushi, Khadija duk yadda zan kwatanta miki arfah ta huce, arfah ta zarta duk yadda kike tunaninta, munyi zama da ita na amana a yanayinda bani da sana'ar komai, cin yau bare na gobe, kiyi tunanin yadda yarinyar data saba rayuwar hutu da kud'i ita kad'ai a gidansu sai abinda take so, zata iya rayuwa cikin k'aramin d'aki da irin rayuwar talauci k'arshe, to arfah ta rayu dani a haka sannan bata tab'a raina abinda nake dashi ba, duk kankantar abu na kawo mata zata karb'a tayi farin ciki, yanzu abinda kika ga tanayi ba komai bane illa hali na kawaici da yakana sannan tun asalinta tana da miskilanci dama, zakiga bata fiye shiga hayaniyar mutane ba, ba wani abu bane haka yanayinta yake kada ma hakan ya dameki". 
    Gyad'a kai kahadija tayi tace, "toh Allah yayi mana jagora yaya, ya kamata na kyaleka ka tafi haka kaga dare ya somayi hirar nan tsayi gareta ba k'arewa zatayi ba gobe in Allah ya kaimu ma d'ora". 
    "Kwarai kuwa kije kawai sai Allah ya kaimu". 
  
    Sallama sukayi kowa ya nufi nashi guri. 
  

                    @@@@@@@


A tak'aice Saida sukayi kusan kwana uku a yola ana yawon gaida y'an uwa da sanin juna, kuma alhamdulillah zumunci mai k'arfi ya k'ullu tsakanin yaransu, har dana auratayya ma ana tunanin zai k'ullu, a cikin kwanakin ba wanda inno bata shaida shi da fuskarshi ba, more especially ma Arfah da Zahra, tasu tazo d'aya dasu kwarai, a wasu lokutan bata yiwa arfah magana da hausa sam, tunda ta fahimci ta iya yara fulatanci sab'anin sauran yaran da akazo tare dasu, a maza kuwa dama farouk ne, don bata manta fuskarshi ba a lokacin da yazo bikin Sarah y'ar mak'otansu ta rik'e shi da sunan jafar. 
    A kullum zasu yini tare da iyayensu mata da kakarsu, idan dare yayi su tafi gidan baffa yakub su kwana a can, basa dawowa kuma sai sunyi wanka da breakfast, haka zasu bi iyayensu d'aya bayan d'aya su gaishe su. 
   Alak'a mai kyau ta shiga tsakanin matar Yaya da k'annen miji, ta ganin mutumcin juna haka ba raini, ummie kanta ji takeyi da ita sosai, wata irin k'imar ta take gani tunda ta fahimci kyawawan halaye da d'abi'unta masu shiga ran duk wanda ta zauna dashi, ummie har fad'a tayi mata akan kawaicin da takeyi akan shuraim yayi yawa, ta daina kallon idon kowa ta jawo abinta jiki, ita dai murmushi kawai tayi da taji abinda ummien ta fad'a. 

   Ta b'angaren farouk kuwa an warware musu komai na tafiyarshi da accident d'in da yayi har ma yayi shekaru uku ba tare da an San yana raye ba. 
    Ummie har kuka tayi saboda tausayin yaron nata. 
   Washe garin da akayi haka kuma ta samu zaman kad'aici dashi, abinda farouk ya somayi shine neman yafiyarta, da sauri ta dakatar da rok'on shi ta hanyar fad'in, "Ni ban tab'a rik'e ka da komai ba, a lokacin ni kaina bansan abinda ya shiga kaina har na kaiga aikata irin wancen aikin ba, kuma daga baya nayi nadamar hakan ba kad'an ba, har na dinga tuba wa mahaliccina, tabbas abinda ya tushe kwakwalenmu ba komai bane sai rabon haihuwar wancen yaron, kuma alhamdulillah da Allah ya nuna mana iyakar mu tun kafun aje da nisa, farouk nice ya kamata ma na rok'i yafiyarka don Allah ka yafe mun......".

   Rik'e hannunta da take rok'on shi farouk yayi da sauri yana girgiza mata kai, "har abada! Har abada uwa ba zata tab'a yin wani abu da d'anta zai kasa yafe mata ba, ni bakiyi mun komai ba". 
    
   Sunci gaba da hirarsu cikin farin ciki, har a k'arshe ta fad'a mishi dalilin da yasa batayi dogon tunani ba ta zargeshi da abinda Sam bai aikata ba, tun wani kud'i data tab'a gani a d'akin shi ne ummul'aba'isin komai, farouk yayi mamaki ashe taga kud'in a lokacin, shima anan ya bata labarin komai tun farkon had'uwar shi da Arfah da yadda abubuwan suka dinga faruwa a bai bai. 
      Nan dai duk suka jimanta ya kuma d'ora da bawa ummie labarin kwawawan halayen Arfah da girman halaccin da tayi mishi a rayuwa wanda ita tayi a lokacin ba'a matsayin komai ba (koda wasa Farouk bai fad'i sharrin arfah a gurin ummien shiba, ya fad'i iya halinta na gari ba don komai ba sai don ya sake siya mata k'ima a idon familyn shi, tunda dama sharrin nata ma k'alilan ne irin na ajizancin d'an Adam). 

     
    Sun d'an kwana biyu a yola suna gudanar da rayuwarsu cikin farin ciki da yanayin garin mai dad'i da iskarsu pure mara algus. 
     Ana i gobe zasu tafi, tana zaune tana ninke kayan shuraim da nata bayan ta ware nasu mammie gefe data wanke tana zubawa a jakar kayansu haseena ta shigo ta zauna a gefanta tana fad'in, "washh gaskiya yau mun yawo da yawa". 
    Kallonta Arfah tayi tace, "Ina da ina yau kuma kukaje?". 
    "Ai ki bari kawai matar big bro ba inda bamu je ba cikin garin nan a k'afarmu nan duk bakiji k'afata ba kamar na musanya da naki". Ta k'are fad'a tana dariya k'asa k'asa. 
    Da sauri Arfah tace, "wahh Ni! Rufa mun asiri ki sauya dana d'anki gashi can yana bacci". 
    Dariya sosai haseena tayi tace, "a'a Auntie tashi ai bata kai kwarin taki ba". 
    "Ai nima har yanzu jaririyar ce fa gara ki rufani ki saya". 
     Dariya duk sukayi, wayar haseena dake hannunta tayi ring, kallon wayar tayi sai kuma ta kalli Arfah da sauri tace, "afff kinga har na manta ma, Auntie ina kika jefa wayar kine Yaya yace in ya kira baya samunki, yanzu haka yana waje yace na turo ki". 
     Oohhh tanan ya b'ullo shida ko no na bashi da zaice wani ya kira bai same niba, a zuciyarta tayi wannan magana, a zahiri kuma murmushi ta k'alato tace, "ohh wayar tawa ce a kashe, bari na sauya kaya yana Ina a wajen". 
    Dai dai inda yake haseena ta kwatanta mata, kamar gaske ita kuma ta zura wata doguwar rigar less data tsaya a jikinta ta fudda kafatanin shape d'in jikinta ta zura, gashinta da khadija tayi mata kalba k'anana tayi parking ta yafa medium gyale ta d'auki wayarta tace da haseena, "Ina zuwa". 
    Haseena ta bita da kallo har ta fuce, ita komai na arfah burgeta yake, baya ma dressing d'inta da yanayin tafiyarta, gaskiya dole yayansu ya susuce a kanta, cox ta had'a komai da ta Isa amsa sunanta na mace. 



     _kuyi hak'uri data ta bani matsala jiya shiyasa kuka jini shiru_


  _ahali d'aya warwara_

Page 69 _(sixty nine)_



 Yana tsaye jikin k'atuwar bishiyar dake bayan gidan hannunshi hard'e a bayanshi, tunda ta futo ya k'ura mara ido yana kallonta da fuskarta kadaran kadahan. Ita kam bata sake kallon shiba tun bayan kallon farko da tayi mishi harta k'arasa kusa da inda yake tsaye tace, "barka da safiya".  Ta fad'a amma still tana duban wani direction daban. 
    Farouk da mamaki ya amsa mata, "barkanki dai". 
    Daga nan shiru yaci gaba da wanzuwa kamar dama sun had'u ne donsu tsaya haka cirko cirko. 
    "Haseena tace kana nema na?". 
    Arfah ta katse shirun nasu. Sake fuskantarta yayi da kyau yace,
    "Eh magana nake son zamuyi akan matsayar auren mu". 
   "Duf! Duf taji fad'uwar gaba ta risketa marar tushe bare takamaiman dalili. 
    Gyara tsayuwarta tayi ta dawo tana fuskantar shi itama sosai sannan tace, "owk ina sauraronka". 
    "Kina saurarona ko Ina sauraron ki?". 
  D'ago kanta da yake k'asa tayi tana dubanshi, shima har yanzu ita yake kallo. 
    "Ina ganin baka fahimci abinda nake nufi ba, kace kana son magana dani akan matsayar aurenmu, to me kake tunanin ni zance kuma? Magana ai taka ce, duk hukuncin daka yanke dai dai ne". 
    Murmushi Farouk yayi har lokacin idonshi a kanta yace, "kina nufin ko datse igiyoyin auren nayi dai dai ne?". 
      Itama murmushin yak'e tayi tace, "of course indai haka shine abinda kake ganin ya dace". 
     "Humm! Saboda kin daina Sona Fatima shine kike buk'atar saki daga gurina ko? Well banga laifinki ba tunda kema kina da hak'k'in zab'a ma kanki abinda yake dai dai da rayuwarki.....". 
    Cikin rashin fahimtar hautsinanniyar hausar shi ta sake kallonshi zata bud'a baki tayi magana yayi saurin d'aga mata hannu. 
    "No need to explain na fahimci komai daga kwayar idonki da irin tarbar dana samu a gurinki tun dawowa ta, anjima after magrib ki sameni a gidan kawu yak'ub". 
    Ya k'arasa fad'in haka da fuskar tausayin kanshi da kanshi, daga nan bai bata damar sake cewa komai ba ya tafi ya barta tsaye saroro. 
   Ta kasa fahimtar inda mutumin nan yasa gaba sam, tunda ya dawo ba taga alamun ya damu da ita ko wata kulawa irinta da ba, sai shashshareta yakeyi, ita kuma don itace bita zai zai sai tayi ta binshi, wato yaji Dad'in wulak'anta ta kenan?wata zuciyar tata ce tayi saurin kwabarta, "kema kin zura jiki da yawa Arfah! Banda haka yaushe farouk yace yana sonki bare ma har ya baki tabbacin rayuwa dake abadan? Anyi muku auren had'i ya hak'ura da k'addara ya zauna dake faqat". 
    Rintse idonta tayi tana ambaton sunan Allah a ranta. 
   Da sauri kuma ta bud'e jin an rik'e k'afarta ta baya, a hankali ta juyo tana kallonshi, kamar zaiyi kuka ya soma fad'in, "Auntie kinga su shareefa ko? Wai zasu karb'o ma inno fura  shine ba zasu je dani ba". 
    Hannunshi ta kama Suka nufi cikin gidan tana fad'in, "rabu dasu muma anjima zamu karb'o kindirmo ba zamu je dasu ba". 
    Dariya yaron yayi yace, "kuma ba zamu tsan musu chocolate d'in mu mai dad'i ba in muka koma gida". 
    Itama dariyan ta k'alato tace, "ehh mana ka rabu dasu kawai". 
   Suna tafe yana mata zance tana amsa shi har Suka Isa cikin gidan, inda ta samu su safiyya zahrah dasu suwaiba da sauran y'an matan family anata shafta irin tasu ta wanda suke ganiyar lokacin su. 
    Ita dai gefe guda ta samu taci gaba da aikinta, rabi tana sauraron su rabi kuma tana tunanin maganar da farouk ya mata data kasa barin ranta. 
    Duk kusan yinin ranar haka ta yini sukuku ba sukuni ko nutsuwar zuciya, tsoronta d'aya kada da gaske ya yanke igiyoyin aurensu kamar yadda ya fad'a, idan har yayi haka to tabbas yaso jefa rayuwarta ne a garari Allahumma ajirni fil musibati.....
    Kasancewar gobe zasu huce yau mutanen gidan inno har sunfi na kullum saboda sallama da za'ayi da dangi, sai ta rasa inda zata tsoma ranta taji sanyi, a ranar ta sake tabbatar da maraicinta na rashin uwar da zatayi kuka a kafad'ar ta a fili, tabbas tayi kewar ammien ta kewa ba kad'an ba.  


     Da yammacin ranar tana kwance kan gadon dattijuwa inno tana ta bata tarihin Abbie da uncle's d'inta na yadda suka taso, tana jin Dad'in hirar kwarai saboda labarine irin na da lokacin kowa yana zaune ba yanzu da duniya ta Zama abinda ta Zama ba mutanen cikinta suka mik'e tsaye kan k'afafun su, wayarta ta katse musu hanzari ta hanyar soma ringing, da sauri ta d'aga ganin no uncle abdussamad. "Kina ina Fatima"
   Uncle ya tambayeta kai tsaye. 
   "Uncle Ina tare da inno"
Ta bashi amsa. 
  "Okay kije d'akin da muka sauka abie yana son ganinki". 
  Da "toh" ta amsa shi sannan ta ajiye wayar, hijab d'inta ta jawo tace, "inno Abbie yana kirana, in na dawo saiki k'arasa bani labarin yadda aka k'are"
   D'an murmushi y'ar dattijuwar tayi tana kallonta da harshen fullanci tace, "toh ba damuwa". 
    
    A hankali ta dinga ratsa masu aikin ginin gidan da y'an uwa har zuwa parlon dasu Abbie d'in suka sauka. 
   Shi kad'ai ne a cikin parlon, zaune bisa lallausan rug yana operating wayarshi, da nutsuwa ta k'arasa shiga tana sake yin wata sallamar, ya amsa mata yana k'ok'arin ajiye wayar hannunshi gefe, a gefen carpet d'in ta zauna tace, "barka da hutawa abbie" 
   Zare farin tabaran idonshi yayi yace, "barkanki dai ummina Ina fatan kina lafiya". 
   Da Murmushi a fuskarta tace, "Ina lafiya qalou". 
   Gyara zaman shi yayi yace, "toh Masha Allah, dama nasa abdussamad ya kira mun ke ne saboda akwai magana mai muhimmanci da nake son mu tattauna dake, game da matsayin aurenki da Umar farouk". 
   Yanzun ma saida gabanta ya fad'i, amma bata daice komai ba taci gaba da sauraronshi, "kinsan gobe zamu huce kaduna right".

Soyayyar farouk sabuwa fil ta kasance mata a daren ranar.

Toh tun asubar ranar su Arfah suke ta shirye shiryen tafiya, ko kafun wani lokaci duk sun shirya sun had'e kayansu a jakunkuna kamar yadda suka zo, naseeha sosai inno tayi musu mai ratsa jiki had'e da rok'on ko nan gaba a rayuwa suci gaba da hak'uri da junansu, Su rik'e juna Amana, daga k'arshe ta saka musu albarka suda yaransu da jikoki gaba d'aya, tare dayi musu fatan alkhairy a duka rayuwar su gaba d'aya.

     Da sauri ta kife hoton jin motsin mutum a cikin d'akin. 
    Farouk ne ya shigo ajiye mata shuraim da yayi bacci, kan bed ya kwantar dashi ya tsaya yana k'arewa bayanta kallo, kanta har lokacin a k'asa yake wanda ko ba'a fad'a ba yasan kuka takeyi, makeken elergement d'in da ta kifar yabi a hankali ya d'aga. 
    "Waye wannan kuma? Ko shine muhsin d'in da zaki aura da?"
   Farouk ya samu kanshi da tambayarta cike da kishi daya kasa b'oyuwa muraran a kwayar idonshi.
