    A kitchen ta dire k'arshe, sai dai akace duk sammakon ka wani a tafe ya kwan, ko data shiga tuni d'aya daga masu aikin gidan ya soma had'a abin karin kumallo. 
   Da girmamawa ya gaisheta, ta amsa mishi kadaran kadahan tunda namiji ne, taso tayi girkin nan yau da kanta duk da ba wai tasan irin abincin da yafi so bane, sai dai a matsayinta na d'iya mace musulma ba zata iya tsayawa ga kafad'ar ta gata wani k'ato a kitchen da sunan had'a breakfast ba, hakan yasa ta koma part d'in ta dole ta barsu anan. 
     Lokacin da taje tuni shuraim ya tashi, wanka tayi mishi as usual ta d'aura mishi alwala sannan ta shirya shi cikin d'aya daga expensive kayan da Abbie yasa aka jibgo musu. 
   Sai data tabbatar ya hau sallaya zaiyi sallah sannan ta koma ta kwanta. 
    Baccin da ya d'auke ta nisan lokaci ba tare data sani ba, shi kuma shuraim kad'aici yasa yau ko rigimar tashinta babu ta kan k'ara da fad'a tsakanin ta da mammie, da Allah yasa ya futa ya gama gararanbar shi har ya had'a shi da Abbie ya tafi gurinshi bai waiwaye ta ba, tare suka ci abinci bayan sun gama ya zaunar dashi yana ta yi mishi labarai, a haka farouk ya futo ya same su, bayan ya durk'usa har k'asa ya gaishe da Abbie irin tambayar da yayiwa arfah dai yayi mishi, aka samu amsa iri d'aya kamar sun tattauna batun tsakaninsu. Nan ma albarka abbie ya sanya yace farouk yaje yayi break ya dawo nan da hour biyu ko uku. 
    Cikin biyayyah da jin nauyi ya karb'i umarnin ya tashi ya tafi. 
     
     Hour biyu ta cika cif farouk yana lissafe, ko abincin kirki bai iya tsayawa ci ba saboda gan dokin abinda zai tarar na bazatarsu abbie, agogo kuwa duk bayan wasu mintuna sai ya d'aga ido ya duba. 
     Cikin manyan Kaya yanzun ma ya futo kamar d'azu, inda ya barsu d'azu nan ya same su yanzu sai banbancin kaya da mutane, shuraim yana kwance cinyar Abbie yana bacci, su kuma ragowar mutum biyun suna zaune a d'aya kujerar. 
   Duk rik'e da carbi kamar limamai. A k'asa farouk ya zauna kan carpet ya gaishe dasu, sai a lokacin yaga tabbas yasan fuskar d'ayan, kamar shine limamin da ya karb'a mishi auren arfah. 
    Bayan gabatar da juna Abbie ya d'ora da tambayar su hukuncin auren farouk da Fatima a mahanga ta addini bayan ya kwashe labarin rud'anin komai ya fad'a musu. 
    Sunyi nazari sosai akan batun kafun suyi musu bayanin komai dallah dallah, tunda komai yazo da sauk'i da batayi wani auren ba, dama da tayi aure ne to dole sai in ta amince zata ci gaba da zama dashi, idan kuwa ta zab'i sabon mijinta to sai dai yayi hak'uri. 
     Basu tashi a gurin ba saida aka gyara aurensu wanda malam liman da Abbie Suka jagoranta. Farin cikin farouk a lokacin gaza b'oyuwa yayi har Saida ya bayyana a saman fuskarshi, dukkan yabo da godiya sun tabbata ga ubangijin talikai mai kyauta da k'ari, sarkin da babu wani sarki a bayansa, a yau farouk ya sake mallakar arfah a karo na biyu ba tare da komai nashi ba, shiyasa ko a masu gata ba kowane zai samu irin wannan gatan ba, Amma shi sai gashi ubangiji ya tsaya mishi ya samu har sau biyu. Irin matar da kud'i, kyau ko nasaba ba zasu tab'a bashi ba, amma daya dogara da Allah ya bashi dukkan zab'in alkhairy a rayuwarshi sai gashi ya mishi babban tukuicinta. A irin yanayin daya auri Fatima da farko yadda mutanen duniya suka gurb'ace da son abin duniya ko zai kewaye garin su babu wanda zai bashi y'ar shi, ba shi da komai, idan yace komai yana nufin hadda kwakkwarar sana'a. Auren shi yazo ba irin kowanne aure na farin ciki ba, hasalima ya shiga tsakanin kyakkyawar mu'amular dake tsakanin shi da iyayenshi, da yayi hak'uri k'arshe sai gashi gaskiyar ma tayi halinta.......
    
    Farouk ya Lula cikin dogon nazari kanshi saman tafukan hannayenshi ta yadda har Abbie ya dinga magana bai san yanayi ba. 
   Sai da na kusa dashi ya tab'a shi da hannunshi, firgigit ya dawo cikin nutsuwarshi, kallon tuhuma abbie yake yi mishi kafun tambaya ta biyo baya, "komai lafiya kuwa farouk?". 
    Cikin murmushi da jin nauyin uban nasa yayi k'asa da kai yace, "lafiya lou ba komai Abbie". 
    "Tom haka nake son ji, yanzu tunda duk shirye shiryen da muke son yi sun kammala ya kamata kaje gidanku gurin ibraheem suma su samu damar yin hira dakai cikin nutsuwa, in yaso gobe sai ka dawo kafun lokacin tafiyar mu airport, da ku zan tafi Egypt insha Allah". 
    Sai da Abbie yakai k'arshen zancen tsab sannan farouk ya Soma tashi maganar, "kayi hak'uri Abbie amma ba buk'atar sai naje gida na dawo, kaima mahaifine a gareni a yau idan nace na dawo gurinka da zama dungurun gum ban aikata laifin komai a gurin ku ba kai dashi, Ina nufin koda ba maganar auren arfah a tsakani". 
     Murmushi Abbie yayi cikin sake jin k'aunar yaron har zuciyarshi yace, "hakane Umar anjima akwai anguwar da zamuje tare daku ga lokaci yana tafiya tun safe banga ummin nawa ba ma ko zaka taso mun ita?". 
    Cike da ladabi yace, "toh Abbie". Sannan ya tashi cikin jin nauyi ya nufi saman nata. Cikin nutsuwa ya murda handle d'in k'ofar parlon ya shiga bakin shi d'auke da sallama, babu kowa a parlon sai komai da yayi zaman dirshan a muhallin shi. Bedroom d'inta ya nufa direct amma bai shiga ba saida yayi mata knock sau biyu. Lokacin da ya shiga kan bed ya hangota can k'arshe kamar d'an fure tana bacci cike da nutsuwa da kwanciyar hankali. 
    K'arasawa yayi cikin sand'a ya haye kan gadon ya zuba mata ido kamar yaga sabuwar halitta,  sanye take da rigar bacci mai sulb'i brown colour, gashin kanta da yasha kitson manyan kalba ya tarwatse wasu kan pillow wasu kuma sun biyo ta gaban fuskarta, da ganin baccin da take zakasan bacci ne mai d'auke da tsabar gajiya da kyawawan mafarkai, ba don Abbie umarni ya bashi ba da ba abinda zaisa ya katse mata baccinta tana tsakiyar jin dad'in shi. 
    Gashin kan nata ya tattare ya mayar dashi bayanta sannan ya soma d'an jijjiga k'afarta kad'an kad'an. 
    A hankali ta soma bud'e idonta cikin mayen bacci tana fad'in, "shuraim ka barni nayi baccin nan kaji ma son". 
    Jin ba'a fasa ba saita mik'e a zafafe ta mik'a hannu ido rufe zata kamo shi sai dai ga mamakinta sai taji kamar hannun babba, aikuwa da sauri ta watsake idonta tarwai akan kyakkyawar fuskarshi yana jifan ta da miskilin murmushi. 
    Batayi tsammanin ganin shi ba sam don haka ta tsaya tana kallonshi kane kane kan gadon baccinta yana tashinta a bacci, ganin irin kallon da yake yi mata da tunawa da shigar jikinta sai tayi saurin durowa daga kan gadon ta lalubi hijab zata rufe jikinta muryarshi tayi saurin katse mata hanzari, "Abbie ya futa tare da shuraim tun safe! Ma'aikata sun gama aikinsu tuni suna b'angaren su! Ni kuma gani a d'akin ki cikin bedroom kan gadon baccinki, sannan duka d'akin ba mab'oya a tak'aice ma taku biyu zan iya kamo ki kuma babu wanda zai iya cetarki". 
    "Ban shigo don nayi miki komai ba har ga Allah, Amma idan kika nemi ayi wani abu d'in I can easily change my mind". 
     Cikin zama kalar tausayi ta juyo tana kallonshi a marairaice, "abu biyu zakiyi ki ceci kanki babyy". Ya k'arasa fad'a yana kashe mata ido d'aya. 
    "Meye ne don Allah?" Ta tambaye shi kamar zatayi kuka.
     "Ki cire hijab d'in nan na gama kallon mallakina salin alin in fuce abina"
    Babu musu ta Soma zare hijab d'in har ta ajiye shi gefe gaba d'aya. 
     Sai da ya lumshe ido saboda kyakkyawan ganin da yayi da surar jikinta data k'ara cika fiye da da, tsabar nauyin shi da take ji ta kasa d'ago ido ta kalleshi, da murya mara amo yace, "rigar tayi miki kyau baby na gani daga gaba amma ki juya baya ma na gani". 
     Kamar wadda yake control da remote haka ta juya bayanta ta sake juyowa, wani irin ajiyar zuciya yayi kafun ya dire k'asa yana sake saisaita yanayin shi, "Ni zan tafi Abbie yace ki shirya akwai anguwar da zamuje". 
    Yana gama maganar shi ya futa ya barta saroro sake da baki, lallai ma guy nan wato ita zai mayar wawuya ko? Koda yake ba komai zata rama ne itama lokaci. 

    In less than 40 mint ta shirya cikin d'aya daga kayan da ta tarar cikin closet sababbi, doguwar riga ce ta material brown colour, d'inkin ya d'an kamata kad'an saboda anyi measuring da kayanta tun irin wanda ta bari a gida, jaka da takalmi milk ta d'auka sai gyale wadatacce shima milk, duk da bata san inda zasu ba har lokacin. 
    Wayarta kad'ai ta d'auka ta futo fuskarta ko powder babu bare wetlips, babu kowa a main parlour na gidan, hakan ya bata damar zama kan dinning, babu komai sai black tea, shi kad'ai tasha ta soma kiran no farouk, katsewa yayi ya kira ta, "kace zamu futa tare da Abbie kuma na futo bangan shiba?". 
    Yadda ta fad'i sak'on ta kai tsaye haka shima ya katse kiran shi kai tsaye, baisha wahalar gano inda take ba, duk d'auke wuta sukayi shida ita a lokacin da idonsu ya fad'a kan juna, yadda tayi mishi kyau cikin kwalliyarta haka shima yayi mata kyau cikin shadda butter colour, ba hula a kanshi sai gashin daya taru a kan ya kwanta bak'i sid'ik yana d'aukar ido, takalmin k'afarshi bak'i half cover sai d'aukar ido yake yi, sai da ya k'araso gab da ita sannan ta iya d'auke kanta daga kallonshi, shi kam murmushi yayi still idonshi a kanta yaja kujera ya zauna. 
    "Kwalliyarki tayi kyau, duk da ni anga tawa anki yabawa, koda yake idan muka futa ai bazan rasa wadda zata yaba ba a waje". 
     Tab'e baki tayi taci gaba da buga game a wayarta. 
    Bayan y'an seconni suna zaune shiru no Abbie ya lalubo ya danna mishi kira, yana d'agawa abinda ya Soma fad'a shine, "kun futo ko? Gamu nan zuwa nida sadauki". 
     Daga haka duk suka ajiye wayar. 
     Suna nan zaune shiru har Abbie ya futo rik'e da hannun shuraim daya sake shirya shi cikin wasu kayan daban, da gudu ya nufe ta yana fad'in, "Auntie kinga kayan da Abbie ya sauya mun". 
    Rik'e hannunshi tayi tana murmushi tace, "inye kaga d'an gatan Abbie, kayi kyau sosai". 
    Cike da farin cikin an yaba ma kwalliyar shi ya tafi gurin farouk ma yana fad'a mishi Abbie ya sauya mishi sababbin kaya. Duk dariya suka sa mishi a k'arshe, Kusan tare suka sauka Abbie da shuraim a gaba su kuma suna bin bayanshi har Suka Isa gaban motar da zasu futa da ita. 
     Abin mamaki bayan an futo da motar da zasu tafi malam saddiq ta gani a matsayin driver, mutumin data ciwa mutumci tayi mishi kora ta rashin mutumci hadda mari a shekarun baya, jikinta a sanyaye kanta a k'asa cikin jin nauyi ta shiga gidan baya, shi farouk ne yayi nufin shiga gidan gaba sai dai Abbie ya dakatar dashi ta hanyar fad'in, "ka koma baya ba mota d'aya zamu tafi ba". 
   Sake handle d'in motar yayi ya bud'e back seat ya shiga ya zauna. 
   Shi kuma Abbie Suka shiga wata shida sadaukin Uncle. 
    Sam arfah bata kawo ba ko a ranta, ba tayi tsammani ba ko zato, hasalima ta mance da rayuwarsu gaba d'aya sai a yau da motarsu taci burki a katafaren harabar gidan. 
    Gidan yana nan yadda ta barshi ba abinda ya sauya, da ido ta dinga bin gidan da kallo tana tuna wasu abubuwa da suka shud'e na tarihi a cikin gidan. 
   "Abba, Maama, Auntie amarya, fareeda da Yaya muhsin". 
    Ta fad'a sai kuma ta lumshe idonta hawayen daya taru mata ya shiga silmoyawa.

Page 71 _(seventy one)_



 Farouk ne ya rik'e hannunta yana K'arfafa mata gwiwa da kalamai masu kwantar da hankali, yasa ta karanto addu'o'i masu sanya nutsuwar zuciya. 
    Lokacin da suka futo tuni Abbie da shuraim sunyi gaba, sai suka bi bayanshi suma.
    Da Auntie Suka Soma cin karo tana ta faman jijjiga yaron hannunta. Kamar a mafarki haka taji kanta a lokacin da tayi ido hud'u da arfah tsaye a bayan Abbie, bata iya yin shiru da bakinta ba ta shiga kwala kiran rufaeda da muhsinu. 
     Har kusan cin tuntub'e muhsin yayi, a lokacin da suke rige rigen amsa Kiran auntyn don a zatonsu wani abune ya sameta take musun kiran mafarauta su kawo mata d'auki. 
     Turus! Muhsin da ya riga rufaeda isa gurin yayi a lokacin da idonshi ya shiga cikin na arfah, don shi duk mutanen gurin bai gansu ba ita kad'ai Allah ya bashi ikon fara gani. 
    "Fatima!". Muhsin ya harhad'a sunan yana kallonta da mugun mamaki. Rufaeda ma da take bayan shi  cike take da al'ajabin ganinta. 
      Auntie ce ganin duk sunyi cirko cirko tace, "ku shiga daga ciki ai bai kamata ku tsaya anan ba, sai lokacin muhsin ya dawo cikin hayyacinshi yabi mutanen da kallo d'aya bayan d'aya. "sannu da zuwa Abbie". Ya fad'a da fara'ar ganin babban aminin mahaifin nashi. 
    A nutse Suka dinga takawa har suka Isa tsakiyar parlon, Abbie ne ya zauna kan kujera su kuma duk suka zauna k'asan carpet, nan da nan ma'aikatan gidan suka shiga gabatar musu da drinks. 
    Sun Soma gaisawa tsakanin Abbie da auntie har yana tambayarta mai jiki, daga nan su rufaeda da muhsin Suka gaisa dashi, farouk da arfah ma sun gaisa da aunty, ganin basu tambayi me jiki ba Abbie yace, "hajiyar su muhsin ce fa ba lafiya". Sai a lokacin suka yi musu ya me jikin, Abbie sunci gaba da tattaunawa shida Auntie akan cigaban da aka samu game da ciwon nata, paralysed ne amma an samu yayi sauk'i har tana iya daga right hand k'afar ce sai a hankali. 
    Rufaeda dai sai kallon arfah take yadda ta zama wani cool tunda ta zauna kanta a k'asa kamar bak'uwa a gidan nasu, koda yake dama ita tun asalinta bata da yawan magana sai bada umarni da rashin mutumcinta inya tashi ko waye kai ba ruwanta in taso zata bi ta kanka. 
    Muhsin kanshi rabin hankalinshi yana kanta, sai dai yana yawaita satar kallonta gabanshi yana yawaita fad'uwa, da farko ya Soma murnar wata kila rabon arfah ta dawo rayuwarshi ne ta dawo, sai dai tunanin da yayi akan labarin da yaji a lokacin da aka samu matsalar nan ya sake sanyayar mishi da jiki, tabbas fareeda tace aure ammie tayi mata da wani da basu san shi ba a lokacin, sai dai abinda yake tsoro yanzu shine Allah yasa ba tafiya ta mik'a ba kenan, don daga yanayin ta baiga wani abu na tashin hankali ko rayuwar cikin k'unci ba, hasalima shi ya ganta neat cikin nutsuwar da a gidan suma bata samu irinta ba, sunci gaba da Zama kafun auntie ta yiwa Abbie jagorancin yaje yaga jikin nata, duk da tsauraran dokokin da likitoci suka sa a kanta amma don shi d'aya inya ganta tana ganin ba damuwa. 
    Bayan tafiyarsu kusa da arfah shuraim ya koma ya d'ora kanshi a shoulder ta yana sake bin gidan da komai na gidan da kallo. Rufaeda ce da duk ta zak'u taji komai ta kasa yin shiru har saida ta dawo kusa da arfah tace, "wai babyn Abbie kece duk kika Zama haka? Munji mamaki sosai da muka ji labarin abinda ya same ki barin ma Yaya muhsin, k'aramin hauka ya kusa mana a gidan nan Allah yasa auntie ta dinga saito mana shi, a lokacin ya shiga mawuyacin hali ya bar komai har business d'inshi ya dawo zaman gida kamar mace". 
     Arfah dai kanta yana k'asa ta kasa d'ago ido ma bare tace komai, don kwakkwaran motsi tayi kukan da take dannewa zai samu damar silalowa, ba rufaeda ba muhsin kanshi yaso jin ta bakinta a wannan gab'ar, to amma ya zasuyi haka halinta yake musamman yanzu da yasan dole zata rik'e wani abu a cikin ranta, tabbas fareeda ta cuce shi da yanzu baby a matsayin matarshi take, wannan yaron kuma?........
   Sai yayi saurin cin burki lokaci d'aya ya sake maida cikakken duban shi kan yaron, duk cikin lokaci guda again ya kalli fuskar matashin da suka shigo dasu abbie sai danne dannen waya yake kamar baisan wainar da ake toyawa ba, yaron yayi kama dashi kamar an tsaga kara, muhsin duk sai ya shiga kwokwanto da tashin hankali, meye alak'ar arfah da wannan guy? Kaddai shine mijin nata wannan kuma d'an da suka haif.......... Ai bai kai k'arshen tunanin ba ya mik'e tsaye da sauri cikin d'aga murya out of his sense yace, "Ina ba zai yiwu ba Sam hakan bazai tab'a kasancewa ba". 
   Duk kallonshi sukayi har farouk da wutar kishi take ta azalzalar ranshi, tuntuni yake jin kamar ya kama hannun arfah su bar gidan. 
    "Yaya muhsin me yake faruwa kuma?". 
    Sai a lokacin ya tuna abinda yake shirin yi, numfashi ya sauke ajjejjere just to calm himself down ya koma ya zauna a inda ya tashi still idonshi akan su duka ukun. 
    Shi kam farouk ci gaba da danna wayarshi yayi, rufaeda kuma dama bata sake cewa komai ba tun daga maganar da ta yiwa arfah d'azu taga ta shareta, ita duk a zatonta arfah ta k'ulla ce sune duka saboda abinda auntie fareeda tayi mata. 
    Sun k'ara mintuna k'alilan zaune kafun Abbie da auntie su sauko stairs, suna tafe tana dad'a bashi labarin ciwon da yadda abin ya sameta asali, bayan sun sauko k'asa ne yake sake tambayar ta, "ko ya labarin fareeda?"
    Shiru auntie tayi tana jinjinawa kafun tace, "ai lamarin fareeda har yanzu sai addu'a kurum, don har yanzu babu d'uriyarta, kwanakin baya dai can ta tab'a kiran waya sai dai kafun ta kaiga fad'ar abinda take son fad'a Kiran ya katse zancen da nake yi maka dar har yanzu shiru". 
     Sunyi shiru cike da jimami kafun abie ya sake tambayar, "kuma ba kidnapping bane, koda yake da kidnappers ne zasu kira tun a lokacin ma"
   Aunty tace, "eh wallahi sai dai muci gaba da addu'a kawai Amma ba kidnapping bane gaskiya". 
    Daga nan sallama sukayi da Auntie bayan ya kawo kud'i masu d'an nauyi ya bata. 
    Farouk ne ya Soma sallama dasu yayi gaba, kafun Abbie ya mara mishi baya, ita kam arfah saida ta tsaya gurin rufaeda a lokacin da d'akin ya rage daga su sai muhsin daya kasa samun cikakken nutsuwa har lokacin, hannunta ta rik'e idonta taf da ruwan hawaye ta soma magana da fad'in, "kiyi hak'uri rufaeda tabbas rayuwa takan zo mana da tarin sauye sauye, a kullum muna yin gaba sababbin abubuwa suna zo mana da bamu San dasu ba, nasan kinsan komai game da abinda ya faru tsakanin mu da fareeda, tabbas da farko na d'auka fareeda ta gama cutar rayuwata data had'ani da wahalalliyar rayuwar da ban tab'a sanin ana irinta ba a duniya, amma daga baya saina fahimci fareeda ta wullani a babbar makarantar da zanyi karatun menene rayuwa, da kuma suwaye mutanen duniya, ta taimaki rayuwata da irin mijin da na dad'e ina mafarkin samu, ma'abocin duk wasu qualities da macen da tasan kanta zata nema a gurin namiji, rufaeda wannan arfan da kike kallo a gabanki tana da banbanci da waccen arfahn da kika sani ta baya, a yanzu komai ya huce don ban tab'a rik'on ku da komai ba, ke fareeda kanta ban rik'e ta da komai ba, hasalima dazan ganta yanzu zanyi mata godiya bisa ga babbar kyautar da ta bani.......  Zame hannunta tayi cikin na rufaida da tayi shiru tana sauraronta, share hawayenta tayi sannan ta d'ora da fad'in, "wannan da kika gammu yanzu shine mijina, yaron hannunshi kuma d'an mune da muka haifa Umar Farouk......"

    Duk wannan dogon bayanin da tayi baisa muhsin ya fahimci gundarin abinda take nufi ba har saida ta ambaci kalmar mijinta, da wani irin hanzari ya tari numfashinta ba tare daya bari ta k'arasa maganar data d'auko ba, a gabanta ya tsaya yana kallon cikin idonta da wani irin yanayi yace, "me kike nufi Fatima? Dama a duniya kina da wani mijin bayan ni?" Saiya d'ora hannunshi aka "wayyo Allah na! Taya zan yadda da jure rashin ki a rayuwata? Bayan saboda ke da zaman jiranki na Kai har wannan lokacin banyi aure ba". 
   Tabbas ta tausayawa yanayin da yake ciki, domin son maso wani babbar jarabawa ce, to amma komai ya riga ya faru, ubangiji ya juya al'amarin shi gaba d'aya, yayi mata zab'i mafi alkhairy..... Juyawa tayi da nufin futa daga d'akin sai dai taku biyu kwarara taci burki saboda rik'e gyalenta da akayi ta baya, a hankali ta juyo dai dai lokacin da farouk ya shigo d'akin, hannun shi ya had'a gaba d'aya yana kallonta idonshi hawaye wani nabin wani suna sauka yace "Ina yi Miki fatan alkhairy".
    Da wani irin sauri ya nufi stairs, arfah ta lumshe idonta da sauri gudun kada hawayen daya taru a idonta ya bayyana farouk yak'i fahimtar komai a dai dai, rufaeda kanta kuka takeyi saboda tabbas sunga samu kuma sunga rashi, tana ji tana gani arfah ta d'aga mata hannu tabi farouk suka fuce a parlon, koda auntie a parking space ma gajeriyar sallama tayi mata ta shiga motar da suka zo, shuraim daya biyo su wannan karon sai zuba zance yake amma tunda ta kwantar da kanta baya bata sake d'agowa ba har motar su ta tsaya, sai a lokacin ta futo rik'e da hannun shuraim daya kasa hak'uri har lokacin yake faman tambayar ta me akayi mata. 
   Gaban saddiq driver ta tsaya farouk yana bayanta shima tsaye, cikin russunawa tace, "ka gafarceni saddiq, na musguna maka na ci zarafinka hadda mari, sai dai daga ranar dana koreka a gidan nan, daga ranar hak'k'in ka ya soma bibiyata, driver na farko ya kaini wajen mugayen da suka kusa tarwatsa rayuwata, na biyu kuma aka biya shi kud'i ya lik'a mun bak'in fenti..... bamu tab'a katari da driver mai Amana da gaskiyar ba malam saddiq don Allah ka gafarceni". 
    Da al'ajabi da mugun mamaki yake kallonta a lokacin, duk da tunda ya fara ganinta ya fahimci ta sauya duka amma a yau ya sake tabbatar da hakan, cikin K'arfafa gwiwa yace, "ya huce hajiya arfah ni tun a lokacin tarin alkhairan mahaifinki suka shafe guntun laifinki". 
    Sai a lokacin hawayen idonta ya samu damar zubowa, ta share da tafin hannunta tayi gaba cikin jin dad'in nauyin nan data sauke. Bata tsaya a ko'ina ba sai a bedroom d'inta, ko kafun shuraim ya shigo ta rufe k'ofar ta da key ta fad'a gadonta tana risgar kuka, ji take Ina ma baya zata dawo ta gyara kurakuren da ta tabka. 
   Ranar bata sake futowa ba duk da irin bugun da shuraim ya dinga mata, k'arshe dole ya hak'ura ya koma gurin farouk suka k'arasa yinin su tare, Abbie ma bai dawo gidan ba sai yamma. 


             @@@@@@@


*EGYPT*


_CAI CAIRO INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT_


 Misalin k'arfe hud'u na yammacin ranar talata suka sauka a k'asar ta Egypt, tafiyar da ta d'auke su 4 hours and 12 mints. Su hud'u ne tsaye, Abbie, farouk, arfah da shuraim. Dukkannin su suna sanye da kaya masu kyau na alfarma, arfah rataye da Jakarta yayinda farouk ke Jan trolley guda biyu, ta Abbie da kuma wadda arfah ta had'a musu kayansu gaba d'aya, tafiya suke a nutse kai da ganinsu kasan suna cikin matuk'ar farin ciki barin ma arfah da take jin kamar k'arshen matsalolin sune yazo. 
    
    Da sannu Suka k'arasa har inda motocin da zasu d'auke su suke, (wani abokin alhaji jafar ne da yake aiki da Sheraton heliopolis a k'asar yazo d'aukar su). 
   Sun gaisa shida alhaji jafar duk da sun dad'e basu had'u ba kafun su gaisa dasu farouk cikin harshen turanci. 
     Yanzun ma motar su farouk daban, Abbie da shuraim ma daban, ita dai arfah sai baza ido take tana k'arewa k'asar mahaifiyarta ta haihuwa kallo, a anguwar dasu ammie suke shima abokin Abbie na karatu yake, mallawi, tsiran suma gida biyar ne. 

    Iyalan gidan ma'abota karamci ne, sun karb'e su hannu bibbiyu da girmamawa, sun sauki kowanne cikinsu a muhallin shi kafun su bi su da abinci da drinks. 
     
        Da yamma arfah bayan sun huta ta ware kayan farouk daga nata saboda batasan adadin kwanakin da zasu d'auka anan kafun su aiwatar da gundarin abinda ya kawo su ba. 
    Da yammaci ta futo sanye da dogon hijab d'inta, tsarin gidan irin gidajen larabawa ne asalin mazauna k'asar, hakan yasa arfah ta d'an sha wuya kafun ta gano ainahin inda b'angaren jama'ar  gidan yake, yadda ta fahimta Mata biyu ne a gidan kuma kowacce tana da yaranta ba laifi, duk da babu mai k'aramin yaro a ciki amma wasu daga y'ay'an su mata sunyi aure har sun haihu hakan yasa gidan yake cike da jikoki. 
    Da mai aikin data kaita masaukinta taci karo, hakan yasa taji Dad'in tambayar ta inda farouk yake, matar bata da English mai kyau sai larabci, shiyasa da arfah ta gane sai Suka koma maganar da larabci, ta fad'a mata bata sani ba amma zata had'a ta da sahra ta tambayeta, koda ta had'a ta da ita ba b'ata lokaci ta kaita har inda aka sauke shi. Sai data yi mishi knocking ya bata izini sannan ta dusa kai da sallamarta. 
    D'akin shimfud'e da carpet sai resting chair guda d'aya da gado da drower, kallo d'aya dai zaka fahimci dama an shirya d'akin ne don saukar bak'i. 
     Kallo d'aya tayi mishi yana zaune k'asan carpet ya mik'e k'afarshi yana danna waya, bata ce mishi kanzil ba ta zura mishi kayan cikin drower. 
   Koda ta d'ago shuraim ta kalla da yake bacci sadidan a kan gado. 
   K'arasawa tayi kan gadon ta d'ago shi tana jijjigashi, ya bud'e idonshi yana kallonta cikin magagin bacci ya kira sunanta, "Auntie". 
    "Umm! Ka tashi baccin ya Isa haka" 
    Farouk ajiye wayar hannun shi yayi yace, "da kin kyale shi da anyi magrib zan tashe shi ai". 
   "A'a baccin la'asar bashi da kyau ko ga yaro, da a gurina yake ma bazan bari ya fara wannan baccin ba".   Tana gama fad'in haka ta d'aga shi cak tayi cikin bathroom dashi. 
    Wanke mishi fuska tayi sannan ta rik'o hannunshi suka futo. 
   Tare suka fuce dashi bayan farouk ya had'a ta da kwanon abincin da yaci ta tafi dashi ciki. 


           @@@@@@@


Toh a tak'aice dai saida sukayi kwana uku cikakke a gidan Muhammad Shariff abokin Abbie saboda tabbacin da aka basu na sofiyyah tayi tafiya Alexandria kwana biyu kafun suzo, taje gurin y'ar uwarta Khadija dake aure a can kuma zata dawo nan da kwanaki uku zuwa hud'u masu zuwa. 
    Abubuwa da yawa sun faru bayan tafiyarta Nigeria, babbah a ciki shine rasuwar mahaifin ta alhaji abbu, da matar yayanta ibraheem, a lokacin farouk ji yayi jikinshi ya sake laushi, zuciyarshi ta tsinke har ya Soma fidda rai da sake dawowarta cikin rayuwarshi a karo na biyu. 
   




   Afwan kwana biyu na shiga uzuri sosai🤦‍♀️ Amma insha Allah zamu d'ora yadda muka saba. 


  Ahali d'aya warwara

Page 72 _(seventy two)_



 A ranar da Suka cika kwana uku Muhammad Shariff ya shaida mishi dawowar sofiyyah daga Alexandria, washe garin ranar kuma ta koma bakin aikinta da takeyi da companyn mahaifin ta alhaji abbu, aikin da bata dawowa sai yamma lis a kowacce ranar aiki, kuma da zarar ta shiga gida ita da sake futowa sai wata goben, weekend kuwa ranar hutu ce through out bata zuwa ko'ina.  
    Jin tsarin irin rayuwar da take gudanarwa sai jafar ya rasa ta inda zai soma tunkararta again, hakan yasa suka d'an sake d'aukar lokaci a gidan Shariff. 
    Ranar wata lahadi Abbie ya shirya da yammaci ya futo rik'e da hannun shuraim da wata irin shak'uwa ta sake shiga tsakaninsu a kwanakin, kullum yana tare da Abbie suci abinci tare, suyi bacci tare, su sha hirarsu kamar abokan juna. Duk shirmen shuraim Abbie zai tsaya ya saurareshi wasu lokutan ma har ya tayashi, yana son k'uruciyar yaron saboda wayon shi, a mafi yawan lokuta in yana abu yakan tuno mishi da k'uruciyar farouk a lokacin da yake kamarshi. 
   Suna tafe ranar weekend d'in da yammaci, sanye yake da rigar shadda ashh ya d'ora hularshi da takalmin shi kamar sabon saurayin da zaije zancen farko gurin budurwarshi, shima shuraim irin shaddarce a jikinshi sai dai kanshi babu hula sai sumar da tasha gyara ta kwanta lub. 
   A harabar gidan ya jira Muhammad Shariff ya futo suka soma tattaki da k'afa zuwa gidan su sofiyyahn, tsirarsu gida biyar ne. 
    Tsayawa jafar yayi a k'ofar gidan nasu mai tsohon tarihi yana tuno wani dad'ad'd'en abu daya shud'e lokaci mai tsawo.  
   Gidan su sofiyyah k'aton gida ne ko a jerin gidajen layin ma babu kwatankwacinshi, da sannu ya k'arasa ga bak'uwar fuskar da take gadin gidan nasu bayan ya yiwa Shariff daya rako shi sallama, sallama yayi wa mai gadin had'e da bashi hannu, bayan sun gaisa Abbie yake tambayarshi ko zaiyi musu iso gurin hajiya sofiyyah idan ba damuwa, shiru getman yayi yana nazari kafun can ya nisa yace, "kuyi hak'uri yallab'ai amma bata yarda taga mutum in bata da appointment dashi, in kuna da appointment dama kuma takan sanar dani a waya. 
    Murmushi jafar yayi yace, "ba wani abu bawan Allah, sai dai ni bak'one a k'asar ban dad'e da zuwa ba, Soo bansan tsarin ta bama yanzu, amma Ina ganin idan ba damuwa kaje kayi mata shigen wannan bayanin Dana yi maka in yaso sai ka fad'a mata sunana jafar yuseep jauro baffi. 
   Da farko mutumin yaso musu gaddama gudun kada ya aikata laifi, to amma daga baya sai ya nufi cikin gidan don sanar da sak'on mutumin. 
   A wajen garden ya sameta tana duba magazine, da kallo na bita don ganin na fahimto a yanayin da take, ta sake fari amma fa ta rame, sai dogon hancinta ya sake futowa a saman fuskarta, sanye take da doguwar riga mai had'e da gyale irin shigar asalin y'an k'asar, kanta a bud'e yake sai gashin data tubke a k'eyartane yake d'aukar ido yana shek'i. 
    Russunawa mai gadin yayi cikin ladabi ya isar da sak'on da aka bashi, da wani irin hanzari ta mik'e tana duban mutumin tana jin maganar kamar a mafarki, cikin harshen larabci ta mayar mishi da wata tambayar, "yana Ina shi wanda ya turo kan?". 
   "Yana can waje izininki nazo nema kafun a masa iso".
   Bata sake tambayar shi komai ba ta d'auki hanya gabanta yana mai luguden duka. 
   A dai dai bakin get d'in farko taci burki tana kallonshi ba ko k'ifta ido, shi kuwa ma baisan da zuwanta ba yana can ya shagala wajen yiwa shuraim wasa. 
   A k'alla ta d'auki sakanni da yawa tsaye kafun shuraim ya ankara da ita ya nunawa Abbie, "Abbie kaga wata tana kallonmu" .
   Gurin da yaron ya nuna yabi da kallo sai gashi kuwa idanun shi sun fad'a cikin nata, mik'ewa yayi da sauri zai tunkareta tayi saurin dakatar dashi ta hanyar d'aga masa hannu, slowly hawayen idonta ya soma zuba tana ci gaba da kallonshi still, "me kazo yimun?" Ta tambayeshi directly. 
    Sunkuyar da kanshi k'asa yayi kafun ya rik'o hannun shuraim da yake gefenshi tsaye yace, "ki bani lokacin da zan same ki a nutse magana nake son muyi". 
   Yaron tabi da kallo sannan ta sake kallon jafar d'in, wato magana yazo suyi! Cikin dakakkiyar murya tace, "jafar ai komai ya k'are tsakanin mu, bani da wani lokaci na kuma saurararka, ko a dama dana saurareka saboda yadda dakai da nayi da kuma zuciyar soyayyah ne, wanda Kai da kanka daga baya ka tabbatar mun hasashena k'arya ne Sam babu wani abu mai kama da haka, arfah da tazo a bayan bayan soyayyar mu ta fini matsayi da k'ima a gurinka,hasali ni d'in kaina kana zaune dani ne kawai saboda ita! Shiyasa ka rufe ido ka koreni a gidan ka akan kuskure da duk d'an Adam baya rabo dashi, Don haka Ina rok'on ka salin alin ka kama hanyarka ka tafi tun kafun wani a mutanen gidan nan ya ganka ka sake jefani a uku"
   Wani irin gumi ne ya karyowa Abbie dama yayi tunanin haka, fahimtar da ita komai a wannan d'an k'aramin lokacin bazai yiwu ba, dole ya samu wadataccen lokaci da ita don ya warware mata komai, idan har bata hak'ura dashi ba to wannan shine k'addarar su saiya koma ya k'arasa jinyar sonta har zuwa lokacin da zai bar mata duniyar duka. Sai ya ja dogon numfashi ya sake tunkarar inda take tsaye a karo na biyu, "na fad'a maka kar ka sake ka matso inda nake alhali kasan baka da had'i dani". 
   Bai saurareta ba haka bai fasa nufar tanba hannun shi rik'e dana shuraym har lokacin, ganin da gaske idon jafar ya rufe ita kad'ai yake kallo sai ta kwalawa security gidan kira, "security". 
    Da gudu gudu mutum biyu masu uniform d'in bada tsaro suka k'araso gurin, a lokacin da tuni ya isa daf da inda take, ID card ya ciro daga gaban aljihu ya nuna musu, "sunana jafar yuseep"
    Duk tsayawa sukayi suna kallonsu suka kasa cika umarninta. 
    Ko sune shugaban mahaukata tasan ba abinda zasu iya yi mishi a wannan lokacin tunda har suka San matsayin shi. 
    Don haka da tsawa ta kore su daga gurin ta juyo da dubanta fess kan jafar cikin sabon had'e gira tace, "mallam ka fad'i abinda ya kawo ka Ina jinka". 
   Sam baiji haushin kurarinta ba, hasalima yana jin duk rashin mutumcin da zatayi mishi a yanzu ba zata tab'a rama abinda yayi mata ba. 
    Sai baice Mata komai ba ya k'arasa shiga cikin garden d'in gaba d'aya yaja kujera biyu Suka zauna shida shuraim da har ya soma mishi tambayar wace ita? 
    Dafa kan yaron yayi yace, "sadauki wannan itace grand ma d'inka". Juya kai yaron yayi ya kalleta sannan ya sake cewa, "Abbie grandma fa uncle d'inmu yace maman mommy na ce, toh ni kuma bani da mommy, banda grandma....". 
    Duk zancen nan a kunnen sofiyyah data k'araso gurinsu itama taja kujera ta zauna, bata katse suba, hasalima sai taji tana son jin amsar da jafar zai sake bashi, sannan tana son tasan inda ya samu yaro haka. 
    Shi kuwa Abbie ta b'angaren shi murmushi ya sake yi yace, "aunty fa! Ta gidan uncle wacece ita a gurinka?". 
    Shiru ya d'anyi kamar me nazari kafun ya ce, "ita Auntien muce nida su mammie da Yaya suhail amma ba ita ta haife ni ba". 
    Y'ar dariya Abbie yayi yanzun kafun ya ce, "toh wannan daka tambaya maman aunty fa ce?". 
    Sake kallonta yaron yayi, cikin tab'ara ya maida dubanshi ga Abbie yace, "Abbie wannan fa bak'uwa ce! Auntie fa kamar ni itama bata da mama". 
    Wannan karon kasa had'iye dariyar shi yayi har Saida ya dara kad'an kafun ya sake cewa, "sadaukin uncle wannan ba bak'uwa bace maman auntie fa ce, ita kuma Auntie fa itace maman ka data haife ka". 
    Kallonta ya sakeyi sannan ya maida dubanshi ga Abbie bai daice komai ba. 
   Ita kuwa sofiyyah suman hucin gadi tayi bayan ta gama harhad'a maganganun Abbie gaba d'aya ta dunk'ule su inda daga k'arshe ta gane wannan yaron kamar yadda ta zarga farkon ganin shi d'an arfah ne. 
   Kawai sai ta kasa magana tana kallon yaron da sake jinjina al'amarin ubangiji, ta yadda da gaske rabo yana iya kawarda kowa da komai a ban k'asa har sai ya bayyana a doron duniya. 
    Ita gashi da kwananta bai k'are ba aurenta ya girgiza ya girgije ma za'a ce. 
  Sam ba zata iya ba... Ba zata iya sake wani yink'uri ba, tabbas ta jima tana neman wannan damar, damar da zata sake ganin shi ko wani nashi a rayuwa, ta yi alk'awari a ranta muddin bashi ya nemeta ba ita ba zata tab'a zuwa inda yake ba, amma banda wannan dalilin da tuni ta ajiye duk wani girma da jinkai ta Kai kanta gareshi da ban hak'uri. 
    Siraran hawayenta da Suka sauka bisa kuncinta ta Soma sharewa da gefen hannunta, ta durk'usa gaban shi da gwiwarta biyu zube a k'asa ta Soma magana da fad'in, "ka gafarceni jafar, tabbas a zamantakewar mu na kasa fahimtar ka, na kasa yadda da k'addarah! Na yiwa y'an uwanka bahaguwar fahimta duk da tarin alkhairan su gareni da yadda suke nuna mun so, a k'arshe na Zama silar rashin jutuwarku. A dalili na ba gaira ba sabab na d'ora arfah a wani bigiren k'arya na tsanar talaka da talauci. Kuma at last na azabtar da ita da irin rayuwar data tsana d'in, Sam ban zamo uwa mai adalci ba......"
    Kuka takeyi sadidan yayinda jafar ya zuba mata ido yana kallo ko k'ifta ido babu. 
   Sai data d'an tsagaita da kukan sannan ta ci gaba da maganar ta, "nayi kuskure mai girma a gareka, sai dai hukuncin daka yanke mun yayi tsauri a gareni sosai, ban zata ba, ban tsammata, ko a mafarki ban kawo zaka kore ni a gidanka watarana ba, toh Amma kuma hakan da kayi ya tuna mun da asalina da iyayena dana gudu na bari na manta ma da babinsu. Shiyasa dana bar gidanka kwana uku ban sake yi cikakke a Nigeria ba na kama hanyar dawowa Egypt zuwa ga asalina, bazan b'oye maka ba nasha wahala sosai kafun y'an gidan nan su karb'e ni barinma yayata maman Fahad da tafi kowa d'aukar zafi dani, a zuwan ne na iske mummunar labarin mutuwar mahaifin mu sama da shekaru goma da Suka huce ba tare da mun had'u ba, haka ibraheem yace har ya rasu yana tambayar ko nazo? Ko nasan bashi da lafiya kuwa? Shi dai suje duk inda suka san zasu sameni su nemo masa ni, sauk'ina d'aya daya ce ya yafe mun shima don Allah in nazo bayan rasuwarshi ace na yafe mishi, nayi nadama jafar! Nayi nadamar abinda nayi a baya kuma bazan sake yarda na maimaita kwatankwacin wannan kuskuren ba a yanzu". 
    Shi kanshi ji yake a lokacin kamar yayi kukan, cikin tausayinta da tausayin kanshi na irin kuskuren da sukayi shida ita ya kamo duka k'afad'unta ya mik'ar da ita zaune. 
    Kifa kanta tayi tana sake risgar kuka, yayinda shuraim yake ta kwala ido yana musu kallon bin ba'asi. 
     Cikin tattausan lafazi da kalami ya fara maganar shi shima da fad'in, "kiyi hak'uri ki gafarceni akan abinda nayi miki, na kasa yadda da cewar keda kanki zaki iya korar baby a gidan nan akan abinda baki da tabbas, bayan kinsan ita d'aya tilo muka mallaka a duniyar nan. Sannan tunda kika tafi sofiyyah ban tab'a samun nutsuwar zuciya ba dede da second, Ina sonki fiye da yanda nake son kaina kema kin sani, Soo ki ajiye maganar wai Ina zaune dake ne saboda y'ar da muka haifa wadda b'urb'ushin soyayyar ki ne ya rab'e ta, korar ki da nayi a gidana kuma wannan shine k'addarar mu da bamu Isa mu kauce mata ba, abu na k'arshe kuma tabbas nima nayi kuskure, ko sau d'aya ban tab'a tunanin kai ki donki nemi yafiyar iyayenki ba, y'an uwanki da duk wanda kuka samu rashin fahimta a wancen lokacin, na kasance mai son kaina da yawa sofiyyah! Mun lalata goma biyar bata gyaru ba a zaman mu". 
    Sai ya kasa k'arasawa saboda wani zafi da k'irjin shi yakeyi. Shiru ne ya biyo baya na y'an mintuna kafun jafar ya kuma fad'in, "Allah ya jikan Abbu yasa aljannah firdaus ta zamo makoma a gareshi".  Da kyar cikin muryar kuka ta iya amsa mishi da "ameen". 
   "Ni yanzu nazo k'asar Egypt ne da niyyar mu gyara komai ki koma gidanki sofiyyah, saboda haka a shirye nake dana tunkare su na karb'i kowanne irin hukunci da zasu yanke mun, Amma kafun nan Ina Fahad yake?". 
   Kanta na kallon k'asa tace, "yana Alexandria gurin mom d'inshi, kwana biyu da Suka gabata naje na gano shi yayi aure matar harta haihu". 
   "Masha Allah, to kinga k'addara ko sofiyyah wannan yaron ma d'an baby ne?" 
   Kallonshi tayi na y'an sakanni ta maida dubanta ga yaron tanayi mishi kallon tsab da tsanaki, bakinta yana rawa bugun zuciyarta na k'aruwa ta tambayeshi abinda ta dad'e da sani cikin sanyi. 
  "Yaron da ta tafi da cikinshi?". 
  D'an murmushi Abbie yayi kafun ya tambayeta, "kina lissafi dai dai kuwa wifey". 
    Shiru tayi don bata gane ainahin abinda yake nufi ba, ganin bata d'ago bakin zaren ba sai ya gyara zama don yayi mata dallah dallah, "kina ganin arfah zatayi shekara nawa da aure yanzu?".  Sai data d'anyi jim kafun tace, "za'ayi kusan five years I thought abi?". 
  Gyad'a mata kai yayi ya sake cewa, "toh kina ganin yaron nan zaiyi kamar shekara nawa?". Kallon yaron tayi irin na lura da kyau kafun ta dawo da dubanta gareshi, "zaiyi kamar 3years ko?". 
   Cikin farin cikin yadda take cankar komai dai dai yace, "toh meya had'a cikin shekara biyar zuwa shida da yaron shekara uku?". 
   "A tak'aice me kake son kace mun jafar?". 
   Murmushi yayi yana kallonta still yak'i cewa komai, ganin yana ja mata rai sai ta soma rok'on shi da hannunta bibbiyu, "na kasa fahimtar komai jafar don Allah kayi mun cikakken bayani kar ka barni cikin rud'ani, Ina cikin da baby tayi aure dashi".
   "Kwantar da hankalin ki sofiyyah yanzu kuwa zakiji komai a tak'aice".

Wayyoh Allah fareeda kin cuce ni, kin rabani da baby, bayan Ina sonta Ina k'aunar ta hasalima tunda muka rabu da ita ban sake samun cikakkiyar nutsuwar zuciya ba, kullum Ina cikin tunanin wane hali take? Me takeyi yanzu?". Sai ta kamo hannunshi cikin murya mai cike da rauni taci gaba da fad'in, "don Allah jafar ka tayani fahimtar da ita gaskiyar komai......". 
    Sai ta kife kanta jikin table ta sake fashewa da sabon kukan da ya dad'e a mak'ogwaronta kuma. 
   "Bakya buk'atar wahalar da fatar bakinki wajen yiwa baby dogon sharhi ko jawabi, a yanzu idan kika ga yadda baby ta koma ba zaki tab'a cewa itace budurwar nan shekaru biyar da Suka gabata ba, sofiyyah arfah has totally change, she change beyond your expection, and you will meet her soon yanzu ma don bata San gurinki muka zo bane, lastly ina son na gana da ibraheem in mik'a sak'on ta'aziyya ta gareshi da sauran family naki, sannan in mik'a kaina garesu a matsayin babban mai laifi kuma d'an fashin da ya sace zuciyar y'ar su ya gudu da ita wata k'asa".

    Da arfah ya soma cin karo tana magana da d'aya daga ma'aikatan gidan.  Abun mashi dariya ya bashi, wai Ina yini kamar wata budurwar k'auye, ga wani sabon salo in sukeyi face 2 face ta dinga wani sunkui da kai kenan duk tayi tsuru tsuru da ita kamar mara gaskiya.

Girgiza mishi kai tayi, ya sake cewa, "all these sudden change of you Ina buk'atar cikakken lokaci da nutsuwa ne kad'ai, da kinzo hannuna zaki ware ki koma asalin yadda kike, asalin Fatima na shagwob'ab'b'iya y'ar daru da komai kuka take yi mishi k'arami da babbah". 
   Murmushin gefen baki tayi wai zai sauyata kamar wata kayan sawarshi. 
    So take ta huce yayi bakare bakare a wajen, gashi ta soma gajiya da tsayuwar tun d'azu saboda shuraym daya ke kafad'ar ta. 
   Hannu yasa zai karb'i shuraym d'in, ba musu ta sake mishi shi ta mik'ar da hannunta da har ya sage, k'asa yayi da muryarshi har lokacin suna tsaye gab yace, "babyy Ina cikin kad'aici cikin kwanakin nan Allah daga ni sai television k'arfe 9:00 tuni nayi bacci, plzz kizo ki tayani hira anjima kad'an sai ki d'eben kewa". 
    Wani irin kallo tayi mishi na tantamar anya yana cikin hayyacinshi, "ya dai madam me! Kallon fa?".

  D'an shagwob'e fuska yayi yace, "koda shuraym babie in kina nan hirar sai tafi dad'i please kizo kawai kinji". 
   Kauda kanta tayi gefe ta rab'a ta gefenshi ta huce ta barshi a nan, ko a ranta bataji zatayi abinda yake so d'in ba, ba zata iya ba, Sam ba zata tab'a iyawa ba, ta kamo hanya zugui zugui da sunan ta tafi taya miji hira a gidan mutane... Ina zata kai wannan sabun abun kunyan ita kuwa?.

Aikuwa da sauri ya nufe shi ya rungume kana ya saki sassanyan kuka, "nayi kewarka Abbie, nayi kewar ku kaida babie wai shin duk tsawon wannan shekarun Ina kuka shiga ne?". 
   "Muna nan Fahad babie tare muke da ita, muma munyi kewarka....". Cikin sauri ya saki Abbie d'in yana tambayar shi "tana Ina me yasa ita ba tazo ba?". 
   Dafa kafad'ar shi yayi yace, "ka dawo nutsuwar ka Fahad arfah tare muka zo da ita gata can". Ai bai gama jin abinda Abbie zai fad'a ba ya nufe ta da wani irin sauri zai rungumota jikin shi, sai dai rashin samun kwarin gwiwa daga gare ta da kuma idon farouk daya yi mishi shamaki yasa ya dakata a gabanta yana kallon yadda tayi k'asa da idonta tana kallon yatsun hannunta, "kin sauya! Arfah gaba d'aya kin sauya..... Meyasa! ko baki yi kewar yayan naki bane? Ko kuma bakya son ganina? Shin ba kiji farin ciki da gani na ba, baby kice mun wani abu don Allah..." 
  Still tak'i motsi gudun kada ya sake tsokano musu abinda zai zame musu rigima ita da mijinta, 
   Kamo hannunta yayi duka cikin nashi, kusan a tare suka ji tashin hankali ita da Farouk har saida ta saci kallon gefen da farouk yake, idonshi a kansu kuwa. 
   Shi kuwa Fahad maganar shi kawai yake yi don ya mance ma da akwai banbanci mai tarin yawa da wancen lokacin da kuma yanzu, "babie abubuwa da yawa sun faru kwatsam sai dawowa aiki nayi na tarar bakya nan! A waccen ranar,masu aikin gidan suka fad'a mun wai ammiey ta kore ki abu kamar almara..... Shikenan fa tafiyarki......". 
   Wani d'an murmushin takaici tayi don wannan abu ne da har gobe bata son tuna shi, ace mahaifiyar data haifi y'arta a cikinta ta kore ta...... Sai kuma ta lumshe idonta, hawayen da Suka taru a idonta suka samu hanyar zubowa, Fahad ma cike da jin tausayin ta ya matsa zai rungume ta jikin shi sai dai ba zato farouk da yake kusa ya matso ya hana masa damar aikata hakan ta hanyar jawota jikin shi da mik'awa Fahad d'in hannu a lokaci guda, ba yabo ba fallasa Fahad ya amshi hannun shi Suka gaisa sama sama, cike da son jin k'arin bayanin waye guy nan ya juya akalar kallonshi zuwa ga Abbie, sai yaga hankalin Abbie d'in ma Sam baya kansu ya juya yana amsa waya daga gaba dasu kad'an (shi kuwa Abbie tunda yaga yadda farouk yake bin Fahad da kallo tun a farko yasan akwai matsala idan har Fahad yayi gigin tab'a arfah da sunan y'an uwan taka, don ya fahimci yaron yana da zafin zuciya da matuk'ar kishi, ilai kuwa sai gashi hasashen shi ya zamto gaskiya, dai dai ya had'a ta da jikinshi Abbie ya juya don sun bashi kunya kwarai). 
   "Waye kai?" Fahad ya tambayi farouk yana binshi da kallo, murmushi yayi ba tare daya kalle shi ko ya bashi lokaci ba ya soma share mata hawayen idonta, "sunana Umar Farouk mijin arfah a halin yanzu". 
  Wani irin dumm dumm Fahad yaji duk da dama yayi zaton hakan, amma saboda shanye komai da wayewa data wadatu a dukkan lamuran rayuwarshi sai yace, "I'm sorry, nice to meet you Mr Umar wish you are taking care of mie dear sis u know I much love her". 
   "Beyond your expection" shima farouk ya mayar mishi, duk murmushin yak'e suka sake yima juna. 
   Sun d'an jira Abbie har zuwa lokacin da ya gama wayar ya dawo, Fahad yayi musu jagora cikin gidan Kai tsaye kuma zuwa babban parlon na gidan don a ganin shi sun huce bak'in da za'a sauke a sitting room, ya kamata yau ayi wadda za'ayi kawai. 
    Kusan a tare mutum uku a gurin suka mik'e suna bin su da kallon tsantsar mamaki. 
   Sofiyyah dama pretend ne, don she already plan all she will do at that very moment. Don haka without waste of time ta fashe da kuka ta soma fad'in, "me kazo yimun nan? Me kake nema a gurina! bayan duk abinda kayi mun, naga da kanka kace baka son ganina a gidanka, ka koreni saboda na kori y'ar ka mafi soyuwa a gare ka....". 
   Sai kuma ta bud'e baki da nufin rushewa da kuka, sai dai yayanta jafar ya taka mata burki ta hanyar d'aga mata hannu, "don Allah ki kama kanki anan, duk munsan wace ke, shima jafar haka, maybe ma fiye da yanda muka san ki, sofiyyah duk anan munsan yadda kika rayu tsawon shekaru biyar a gidan nan bayan dawowar ki daga Nigeria babu mijinki, Soo put dis your pretend aside no need of it here". 
   Dawowa yayi ga su jafar ya nuna musu gurin zama a parlon, suka zazzauna kuwa. 
   Shiru ya biyo baya kafun jafar ya Soma gaishe su a d'arare, duk cikin sakin fuska Suka amsa mishi kamar babu wani abu na rashin fahimta a tsakaninsu, har ta'aziyyar rashin alhaji abbu yayi musu, yayinda mamakin su ya kasa barin ran jafar, Sam bai d'auka zasu saurare shi haka farat da garaje ba. 

  Arfah ma sun gaisa dasu cikin yaren mahaifiyarta da ta kasa daina kallon duk wani motsinta, la shakka sunyi kewar juna wannan uwa da y'a. 


   _toh Allah yasa dai ba lumbu lumbu zasuyi maka ba abbie_


_ahali d'aya warwara_

Page 74 _(seventy four)_



Mahaifiyar sofiyyah da take zaune gefe a nutse ita dai arfah da farouk kawai take kallo, tabbas wannan yarinya sofiyyah ce, shiyasa koda suka had'a ido ta mik'o mata hannu alamun tazo gareta, babu musu ta tafi slowly ta durk'usa gaban matar zata sake gaishe ta, amma jawota jikinta tayi ta rungume cike da farin ciki so da k'auna, arfah ma kwanciya tayi a jikinta lib tana jin sabuwar k'aunar matar a cikin zuciyarta, "meye sunan ki yarinya?" Ta tambaya da harshen larabci daya zauna a harshenta daram, cikin sanyin murya arfah ta bata amsa da, "Fad'imatu arfah". 
   "Fatima!" Matar ta fad'i sunan akan harshenta. "Toh waye wancen da kuka zo tare dashi?". Ta sake tambaya
   Arfah janye jikinta tayi daga na matar ta kalli inda amman ta nuna mata, sai kuma ta yi k'asa da kanta cikin jin nauyi tace, "mijina ne". Shima kirawo shi amma tayi, ya tako a nutse ya zauna a d'aya gefenta, d'ora hannunta tayi a sumar kanshi tace, "Kai kuma meye sunanka". Farouk da yake d'anjin yaren larabci kad'an ya bata amsa da, "Umar Farouk". 
   Shima sai data maimaita sunan sannan ta kamo hannun su ta had'e waje guda ta shiga yi musu nasiha akan soyayyah da rik'e gaskiya da amana (kamar dama sunzo gidan ne don ta tunasar dasu hakan), a gurin har tarihin soyayyar jafar da sofiyyah ta sake jaddada musu, wanda dama arfah ta tab'a ji a bakin uncle, sannan ta d'ora da fad'a musu abinda yafi mata dad'i a cikin zamantakewar auren su, sama da shekara ashirin da biyar basu tab'a yin fad'an da aka shiga tsakanin su ba, har saida k'addarar aurenku tazo ta jijjiga wannan soyayyah, shima kuma tarihi ne yaso maimaita kanshi, hak'k'in iyaye da tayi rabuwa ta rashin dad'i dasu, sannan bayan dawowar sofiyyah nan k'asar ma komai ya dawo mata daki daki kuna ta bani labarin komai tun daga asalin rigimar ta da familyn jafar shekara ashirin da d'oriya da suka gabata har zuwa kan abinda ya shiga tsakaninta da jafar, sai abu uku ni na karanta a ciki, abu na farko aurenku ya zo da wani haske wanda ya yaye wa mutane da dama duhuwar da suke ciki, abu na biyu Allah ya juya al'amarin shi gaba d'aya a lokacin da iyaye uku sukaci buri akan mace d'aya tal ta yadda suke son dole sai ta auri maza biyu, jafar yana son ki auri d'an aminin shi, mahaifiyarki kuma tana burin ki auri yayanki Fahad, yayinda ke kuma kika dinga yaudarar kanki da sunan kina son Fahad wanda yake ba haka ba Sam a zuciyarki, hasalima a lokacin zamu iya cewa baki san soyayyah ba, sai gashi lastly ashe ke d'in ba matar ko d'aya a cikin wad'an can ba ce, bari na fad'a muku wani gundarin abu da baku sani ba a lokacin sofiyyah ta kore kine hadda bak'in cikin ganin hak'arta ba zai cimma ruwa ba, shiyasa ba dogon bincike ba bin ba'asi, zafin k'iyayyar da take wa mahaifiyar ki da ganin zata rasa damar komawa ahalinta har abada ta yanke miki wancen d'anyen hukunci wanda daga baya ya kaita ga shiga tafkin dana sani". 

   Tunda ta Soma magana a cikin d'akin kowa yayi shiru yana sauraronta, tabbas sun sani duk abinda ta fad'a haka yake ba wai bare haufi don abu ne da duk Suka sani a bayyane bayan dawowar sofiyyah, shi kam farouk rabin abinda ta fad'a ya fahimta don ba wai yana jin yaren ne duka ba, rabi kuma arfa ta fahimtar dashi a hankali. Shuraym da yake kusa da Abbie ta kira shima ta had'a shi da iyayen shi ta shiga kwararo musu addu'ar fatan alkhairy da dawwamammen farin ciki da kwanciyar hankali a cikin auren su, tare da fatan su kasance tare har zuwa k'arshen numfashin su cikin soyayyah da kuma fahimtar juna. 
  
    A ranar suka warware komai a tsakanin su, k'arshe Suka tattara Suka baiwa sofiyyah wuk'a da nama don ta yanke hukuncin da taga yafi mata a cikin rayuwarta, idan ta zab'i jafar falillahil hamdu. 
  A lokacin a take kuma ba b'ata lokaci ta fad'a musu irin abinda ta fad'awa jafar, "idan har kun amince naci gaba da Zama dashi a k'asar shi, to zan bishi, amma in hakan baiyi muku ba toh na hak'ura da auren shi har abada, Ni yanzu yadda kuke so haka zanyi bani da wani buri a yanzu sai na ganin nayi muku biyayyah". 

  Duk sunji Dad'in kalamanta sosai, ko ba komai ta gyara kuskurenta har na baya. Don haka yadda ta basu zab'i haka suka zab'a mata ci gaba da kasancewa da mijinta don su k'arasa rayuwar su tare. 
   An gabatar musu da abinci bayan an warware komai a k'arshe. 
   Sarah matar Fahad tazo itama daga baya, ibraheem ma ya kirawo yaran shi duka guda hud'u inda yake shaida musu taron k'arshen wata yazo da bazata suma ana buk'atar ganin su a gida zuwa gobe. Matan su tambayi mazajen su, mazan kuma suzo da matan su. 
  
     Daga nan aka rushe maganar komawarsu gidan Shariff akan zasu ci gaba da Zama anan gidan su sofiyyah har zuwa lokacin da zasu tafi, kayan su kuma idan ibraheem da jafar sun gama hirar su ta yaushe gamo sun futa zasu je yi mishi godiya su taho musu dasu. 

   Kowa an sauke shi a wadataccen guri, jafar yana k'asa d'akin cikin sitting room na farko, yayinda arfah ta sauka a d'akin kusa dana granny, farouk ma d'akin da aka bashi yana opposite da d'akin amman, Sarah da mijinta kuwa dama ba bak'i bane sukan shiga duk d'akin da suka ga yayi musu a gidan in sukazo suyi adadin kwanakin da zasuyi su ware, sannan ba ruwan wani dasu. 
    

   A daren ranar arfah bayan ta gama shirya shuraim cikin kayan baccin shi rigima yasa akan lallai ba zai kwana tare da ita ba shi sai an kaishi gurin Abbie ko Yaya, banza tayi dashi don ita ba kasafai ta fiya son sakalcin shi da tab'arar ba gaira ba sabab daya keyi ba. 
   Wanka ta shiga bayan ta futo ta shirya cikin doguwar riga ta bacci mai rub'i biyu saboda sanyin da yake d'an busawa kad'an kad'an. 
   Har lokacin yana zaune sai turje turje yake a k'asa yana kukan dai har lokacin, cike da jin haushi ta zura hijab d'inta dogo ta kamo hannun shi tayi waje zata kaishi gurin Abbie, sai dai tana futowa taci karo da farouk tsaye a bakin k'ofar d'akin da aka sauke shi ya rungume hannayenshi biyu a k'irji kanshi na kallon sama, a hankali suka k'arasa gare shi ita da shuraim, sassanyan k'amshin turaren jikinta ne ya soma yi mishi sallama, ya sauke ajiyar zuciya mai nauyi ya zuba idanun shi cikin nata, ita sai lokacin ta tuno da ashe baya jin dad'i kuma tana lura da baici abincin kirki ba ko d'azu da rana, haka da daren nan ma dama cewa yayi ya k'oshi, cikin nuna alamun damuwa ta saki hannun shuraim ya fad'a jikinshi, ita kuma ta nufi hanyar stairs, Allah ya taimake ta bata sha wahala wajen gano kitchen d'in gidan ba, ta zuge k'ofar glass d'in ta shiga bakinta d'auke da sallama, bata d'auka zata Sami wani mutum a ciki ba, shiyasa ma ta shiga kanta tsaye, Sarah ce tsaye tana juye ruwan tea a plask cikin nutsuwa, tana sanye da doguwar riga tayi rolling kanta da gyalen rigar shi kuma Fahad yana tsaye a bayanta ya d'an kwanto  bakin shi saitin kunnenta ga dukkan alamu dai akwai abinda yake fad'a mata take murmushi, da sauri ta soma k'ok'arin janye jikinta ganin arfah har ta shigo kitchen d'in, shi kuwa basarwa yayi maimakon haka sai ma ya sake shigewa jikinta ya zagaye hannunshi a cikinta, k'asa tayi da muryarta cikin harshen Arab tace, "arfah fa tazo". Bai amsa mata ba sannan bai bar abinda yake yi mata ba. Ita kuwa arfah abinda ya kawota ta shiga yi, bata sake kallon su ba sannan bata ji komai a kanshi ba don ita a halin yanzu mijin ta kad'ai take kallo, kuma da rayuwar shi ta damu duk matsalarta ma a yanzun rashin gane abinda yake damun shine. 
   Tana can duniyar tunani da had'awa mijinta abinci Sarah ta gama abinda take tayi mata sallama suka fuce, itama sallamar tayi musu har shi Yaya Fahad d'in da yake rik'e da tea plask da cups. 
   Bayan sun futa Sarah b'ata fuska tayi tana fad'an me yasa zaiyi haka a gaban arfah ba kyau fa. Cikin basarwa da kuma halin ko in kula yace, "toh haramun nayi, matata ce ke d'in fa kuma zan iya tab'a ki a ko'ina a gaban kowa muddin ba abinda Allah yace asirranta nace Zan bankad'a a gaban mutane ba, sannan ita wadda kike fad'an aiba yarinya bace, at least yanzu tasan rayuwar aure tunda har ta haihu ma". 
   Ta bud'e baki zata kuma yin magana ya d'aga mata hannu alamun baya son ta sake cewa komai, dole taja bakinta ta tsuke Suka k'arasa shigewa d'akin da suka zab'a. 

  Arfah kuwa mamakin shi ta dingayi, koda yake sufa maza ba ruwansu wani lokacin ba kunya ne dasu ba. Sai kuma tayi murmushi a fili tace, "su Yaya Fahad da soyayyah wai...."   Sai kuma tayi y'ar dariya duk ita kad'ai. 

  A tire ta jere komai ta futo daga kitchen d'in bayan ta kashe komai, yana nan inda ta barshi sai dai yanzun safa da marwa yake yi da shuraym a kafad'ar shi yana bashi labari da kasalalliyar murya mai cike da jin bacci. Shiya bud'e mata k'ofar d'akin ta shiga ciki shima ya biyo bayan ta, a kan sofa ya kwantar da shuraim shima ya zauna yasa hannu ya dafe kanshi, "soryy" arfah ta fad'a tare da fucewa a d'akin don d'auko mishi maganin shi. 
     Tana d'aukowa kuwa ta dawo d'akin, yanzun ma yana zaune ya had'a kanshi da hannun shi a gwiwar k'afar shi, daga yanayin shi ta fahimci yana jin jiki kwarai amma zurfin cikin shi ba zai tab'a bari ya fad'i takamaiman abinda yake damun shi ba, shuraim daya kwanta a gadon bayan shi ta janye gefe cikin sanyi tace, "ka kyale Yaya haka kaji abinci zaici ya kwanta baka ga ya gaji ba". 
   Matsawa gefe yayi bayan ya gyad'a mata kanshi, tea ta soma had'a mishi ta zauna a gefen shi ta mik'a mishi, bai karb'a ba sai bakin shi da ya kai wajen cup d'in da nufin ta bashi, da ido ta nuna mishi shuraim da yake kallonsu, sai ya karb'i cupin a hannunta ya jingina ya soma sha da kad'an kad'an, abincin ma kad'an ta zuba mishi ta mik'a mishi, bai karb'a ba a hannunta, haka ya dinga d'iba yana ci, ganin shuraim yana kallon su sai ya yafuto shi alamun yazo, aikuwa yaron ya taho da gudu ya fad'a jikinshi, abincin ya d'iba yasa mishi a baki, a haka Suka gama cin abincin shida yaron gaba d'aya ta bashi maganin ciwon kan yasha. Agogo ta kalla Sha biyu na dare saura y'an mintuna, sai ta kalla shuraim "ba zaka zo muje ka kwanta ba?" Mak'e mata kafad'a yayi yace, "umm umm ni dai Zan kwanta tare da yaya". 
   Kamo hannunshi tayi tace oya je ka kwanta toh, shima yayan yanzu zai je ya kwanta". Ba musu ya haura kan gadon dama bacci yake ji tuntuni don ba a gurinta bane bama da tuni ya dad'e da yin bacci. 
   Gurin ta d'an gyara, tayi parking kwanukan abincin daya gama ci a gefe don ba zata iya sauka k'asa ba ita kad'ai yadda gidan yayi tsit. 
    Shi dai farouk yana zaune yana bin duk motsinta da ido, sai data gama tazo gefen shi tayi mishi sallama tare da addu'ar Allah ya bashi lafiya, juyawarda zatayi wutar gidan duka ta d'auke, dole ta dawo da baya cike da tsoro ta kira sunan shi a sanyaye. 
   Wayar shi da take gefen su ya d'auka a ranshi yana al'ajabin har yanzu tana nan da tsoronta, haska flash yayi yace, "muje na rakaki" ba musu tabi bayan shi suna tafe daf da daf har suka Isa cikin d'akin, a gefen bed ta zauna tana sauke ajiyar zuciya ta kurb'i ruwan da ta ajiye a bedside drower ta dube shi carmly tace, "sweet dreams". 
    Murmushi farouk yayi ya kashe torch light d'in wayar yace, "kacal". Aiko kafun tayi wani yink'uri ma farouk ya kwanto jikinta duka, ba k'aramin tsorata tayi da zafin jikinshi ba, tasan kwarai bashi da lafiya dama amma bata d'auka ciwon ya kai har haka ba, cikin d'an shiga rud'ani ta Soma fad'in, "me kake yi haka dear! Ka baro shuraim fa shi kad'ai kuma baccin shi baiyi nisa ba zai iya tashi kowanne lokaci, ku..  kuma...... Mutanen gidan nan..."  Bai bari ta k'arasa ba ya had'e bakinsu waje d'aya ya shiga kissing d'inta cikin nutsuwa, yayinda ya tattare hijab d'in jikinta ya ajiye shi gefe, hannunsa ya cusa cikin gashin kanta da yake futar da wani sirrin k'amshi yana shafawa a nutse, lokaci d'aya ta diririce mishi duk jikinta ya d'auki kyarma ta soma yink'urin kwace kanta. Sai daya tabbatar data saduda ta daina wani yink'uri na kwatar kanta sannan ya saki mata lips ya raba jikin su, ita kuwa arfah zuwa lokacin har ta soma tafiya duniyar shauk'i don ba k'arya tayi kewar shi unexpected ta ga ya bar abinda ya soma, sai ta juya kanta d'aya side d'in, ya durk'usa gabanta da wata murya mai jan hankali yace, "Wai Ina duk haddar ki ta tafi? haka ake sallama da miji na tuna miki Soo take note". 
   Daga haka ya ja mata bedsheet har kafad'ar ta ya nitsa bakin shi cikin gashinta ya manna mata kiss cikin murya k'asa k'asa yace, "zuciya fanko ce idan babu soyayyah a ciki, kamar yadda rayuwa take lami idan babu y'anci, haka idanu ma duk d'aya idan babu mafarki, misalin haka rayuwata take idan babu ke a ciki I love you sleep tight my angel👼". 
   Yana gama fad'in haka ya juya ya futa saboda tsananin sarawa da kanshi yake har sai daya dafe shi da hannu d'aya, shi kad'ai yasan k'arfin halin da yayi wajen rako ta dama romance d'in ta da yayi kad'an da maganar nan, yana buk'atar bacci mai tsayi ko zai dawo dai dai a halin yanzu. 
   

                 @@@@@@


Washe gari bai farka ba sai wajen k'arfe goma na safe, alhamdulillah ya tashi jikinshi da sauk'i sosai, agogon bedside ya duba aikuwa cikin sauri ya diro daga saman gadon yana mamakin yadda har ya kasa tashi sallar asubah. 
   A gurguje ya fad'a bathroom yayi abinda zaiyi ya futo ya tada kabbarar sallah, bayan ya idar ya dad'e zaune yana lazimi ya gabatar da azhkar d'in safe sannan ya mik'e. 
    Wanka yayi ya shirya cikin d'aya daga kayan sawarshi riga da wando na yadi wadatattu, wayar shi ya d'auko data zama useless a wata k'asa tunda ba shida sim na k'asar ya jawo k'ofar d'akin bayan ya futo, kamar had'in baki itama arfah a dai dai lokacin ta futo rik'e da hannun shuraim data shirya shi fess sai uban k'amshi yake zubawa, ita kuwa uwar gayyar sanye take da doguwar rigar material tun irin kayanta ne na gidan uncle ta yafa gyalen rigar a jikinta, hakan ya d'an karanta ya hana aga zahirin kyaun dirin ta da rigar ta futar. 
    K'asa tayi da kanta saboda nauyi da kwayar idonshi ta mata aka tace, "Ina kwana ya jikin naka?". 
   Zaro ido yayi kad'an yana kallon ta, "toh baby wace irin gaisuwa ce kuma hakan? Ina kwana ya jikinka duk a lokaci guda?". Matsowa yayi inda ta k'ame still ya amsa gaisuwar shuraim daya durk'usa har k'asa yana gaishe shi, durk'usawa yayi gaban yaron suka daidaice tsayi ya amsa shi da "lafiya qalou habeeb na".    "Yee ai daini ba irin gaisuwar Aunty nayi maka ba ko?". 
   Kumatun yaron ya kama yace, "sarkin wayo itama ai ba laifi tayi ba". 
   "Toh amma ai bata durk'usa ba kuma ita take fad'a mana ba kyau gaishe da mutum a tsaye". 
   Farouk kallon ta yayi yace, "toh fa Auntie! ya me dokar bacci zai b'ige da gyangyad'i kuma?". 
  D'an b'ata face tayi zata yi gaba yayi saurin rik'o hannunta, sai daya lumshe idon shi saboda laushin tafin hannunta, ita kuwa kwace hannunta tayi da sauri saboda gudun idon shuraim, kuma abinda ta guda d'in ya gani, hakan yasa tayi gaba da sauri, ganin haka yasa shi kuma ya janye shuraim daga gabanshi yasha gabanta, k'ok'arin kewaye shi take ta huce ya hana mata damar hakan, sai ta tsaya cikin marairaicewa tace, "kana kallo fa yaron nan sai kallon mu yake, yana da wayo sosai kada ka d'auka baya sane da abinda mukeyi har labari zai iya bayarwa a gaba". 
    Murmushi yayi shima cikin shagwob'a yace, "ai ke ya biyo a wayo babie, sannan naga ai duk ke ce kika kyalesa ya zama magananne haka ....". Sake takawa tayi zata kewaye shi yayi gaba kad'an, "kika sake kwakkwaran taku wallahi ba ruwana da maganar shi zanyi duk abinda naga dama in yaso yasa microphone ya yad'awa duk mutanen k'asar Egypt". 
   Dole arfah taja jikinta gefe, duk Suka saci kallon yaron, yana tsaye har da kama k'ugu yana kallon su, duk dariya ce tazo musu, sai suka juyar da fuskarsu kawai Suka soma kyalkyala dariya. 
  Shima shuraim dariyar yayi yazo gabansu yace, "laah uncle kun fasa fad'an kenan?".  Wata dariyar arfah ta sake yi hadda rik'e window, farouk ma yana dariyar yace, "auntien ka ta bani hak'uri shiyasa muka fasa". 
   D'an zaro ido yaron yayi hadda juya hannu yace, "Yaya ai kafi ta k'arfi ko? Shiyasa ma ta baka hak'uri" 
   Farouk kallon arfah yayi ta kuwa wurga mishi harara, "au nice ma na baka hak'urin?"
    Farouk yace, "eh mana tunda na fiki k'arfi ya zakiyi? Sai dai ki bada hak'urin ai". 
   Sake b'ata fuska tayi cikin shagwob'arta tace, "Ni ba wani hak'uri dana baka".  shuraim kam dariya yayi yace, "Allah Auntie ki bashi hak'uri inba haka ba Yaya zaiyi miki duka kuma ni ba Zan iya tare miki ba". 
   Kallon shi tayi ta wurga mishi wata hararar had'e da murgud'a baki, "Allah ni ka daina cewa ma ka fini k'arfi inba so kake ya raina ni ba"  Farouk kam matsowa yayi gabanta yace, "toh k'arya ne ban fiki k'arfin ba?". "Ni baka wani fini k'arfi b......" Ai bai bari ta k'arasa ba ya wara hannayen shi ya matse ta jikin bango har sai da tayi wata y'ar k'ara, shi kuwa shuraim bayan su yayi yana dariya da fad'in, "Allah Auntie ki bada hak'uri inba haka ba yaya zai zane ki ba ruwana ni". 
    Farouk kam cikin jin tasowar wasu zafafan feelings yace, "kyaleta ai taurin kaine da ita wannan auntien taka shuraim"   
    Kallon kwayar idon shi tayi a hankali ta motsa lips d'inta, "ka bari don Allah yaron nan zai fahimci wani abu fa.....". 
  Lips d'in yabi da kallo ya faki idon shuraim ya lashe wetlips d'in data shafa yasa suke ta glowing, ya kai bakin shi saitin kunnenta ya hura mata iska mai zafi a ciki yace, "umm umm ki bani hak'uri". 
   Mak'e kafad'a tayi cikin soma shiga shauk'i ta soma kiciniyar ture shi yayinda shi kuma ya sake shigewa jikinta, yana jin yadda take sake kunna ki da yink'urin k'aryarta, shi kuwa shuraim sai kewaya su yake yana zuga su duk a zaton shi fad'an akeyi da gaske, ganin ta kasa wani katab'us kuma gurin kowa na iya zuwa ya gansu a haka sai ta soma bashi hak'urin, "I'm sorry please na yadda ka fini k'arfi Allah..." Sai ta d'an daga murya, "shuraim kaga dai na bashi hak'uri ko kace to ya rabu dani". 
    "Yaya to ka rabu da ita ai nima naji ta yadda bata da k'arfi kuma ta baka hak'uri". 
    Idonshi ya sak'ale cikin nata kamar magnet ta kasa gujewa mugun dafin da yake zuba mata daga idanun shi, wanda take jin tasirin shi har ta cikin jikinta da zuciyarta. K'asa k'asa da murya yace, "ayyah yarinya ai kuma kin makaro". 
   Yana gama fad'in haka ya soma shafo ilahirin jikin ta yadda yaron ba zai fahimci komai ba, abinda ya assasa mata shigewa jikinshi ba shiri tare da sauke bazatacciyar ajiyar zuciya. 
   A hankali ya zare jikinshi daga nata ya jawo hannun farouk da yake ta ihun murnar Yaya yafi auntie k'arfi yeeeh. 
   Da kyar ya iya maida kanshi d'akin saboda rawa da duk ilahirin jikinshi ya fara, bai zauna a parlon ba kai tsaye ya shige bathroom yana sauke ajiyar zuciya a jejjere, Sam bai yi duk abinda yayi da nufin d'agawa kanshi hankali haka ba, amma ya rasa gane dalilin da yasa a duk lokacin daya rabi jikin baby baya iya control kanshi da emotions d'inshi duka, sai daya d'an dawo normal sannan ya sake shiryawa don kayan jikin shi sunyi squeezing duk da yadin yana da sulb'i sosai. 
    A kan kujera ya samu shuraim sai jijjiga k'afar shi yake, Zama yayi kusa da yaron ya kama hannun shi cikin nutsuwa yace, "shuraim tunanin me kake yi kuma?". Yaron yana dariya yace ba komai. 
   Durk'usawa farouk yayi a gaban shi yace cikin kwantar da murya, "so nake inyi maka fad'a akan yawan magana yarona, kaga kokawar da mukayi da auntien ka d'azu? Ba gaske bane tsokanarta kawai nakeyi, sannan kada kaba kowa labari. Kaga dai dama yawan magana bashi da amfani, sannan ba kyau duk abinda mutum ya gani ace sai ya fad'a haramun ne kaji ma boy?". 
   Gyad'a mishi kai yayi da shagwob'ab'b'en muryar shi yace, "na daina Yaya bazan kuma ba, dama Auntie ma tace ba kyau na bari". 
   Jawo shi jikinshi yayi ya rungume yana shafa sumar kanshi yace, "da kyau ma boy Allah yayi maka albarka".

Arfah ma sai data koma d'akin ta ta kwanta na wasu adadin mintuna sannan ta mik'e ta sauya kayan jikinta don wannan ya gauraye da k'amshin turaren farouk gaba d'aya. 
  Da sauri sauri ta sauka k'asa gudun kada ta kuma had'uwa dashi ya ritsata a corridor irin d'azu, sai dai ga mamakinta suna zaune kusa da amma shida shuraim tana basu labari su sun ma tigata futowa.  farouk  rabi yana fahimta rabi kuma Saddam na translating zuwa English, in zai bada amsa ma shike bada amsar. 
   Su biyar ne a parlon, amma, farouk da shuraim sai Fahad da Saddam, amma hirar ma su uku suke yin abunsu sai lokaci after lokaci da Fahad yakan d'an yi dariya in anyi abun dariyar, so yake ya saba da farouk daga daren jiya zuwa yau shiyasa ya takure kanshi don ya yakice komai yake yiwa zuciyarshi dole, had'e da yak'i da b'urb'ushin soyayyar arfah da bata gama gushewa  ba a zuciyar shi har lokacin. 

    Hirar su suke gwanin dad'i arfah ta k'araso. Itama kusa da k'afar granny ta zauna suka Soma gaisawa da mutanen parlon d'aya bayan d'aya. Bayan sunyi shiru ne Saddam yake tambayar Fahad ko wannan itace y'ar Auntie sofiyyah. "Eh itace sunan ta Fatima", Fahad ya fad'a yana barin duk abinda yake yi, shi ya gabatar musu da juna aka kirawo har ragowar y'an uwan shi, ai ko kafun wani lokaci hira ta b'arke tsakanin su, tunda Suka fahimci arfah tana jin yaren su sosai. 
   K'arshe dole surutun su ya kori amma ta shige d'akin ta, kusan tare suka karya da abincin da ammie da Sarah matar Fahad suka dafa, ashe tuntuni sune a kitchen suke ta karakainar had'a abin kari. 
   Arfah ce tabi amma da nata, Fahad kuma ya kaiwa su Abbie da ibraheem a sitting room, su kuma matasan y'an matan Suka had'u duk a tire d'aya suka ci, mazan ma haka, Sarah ce kad'ai bata ci dasu ba, a cewarta zata je tayi wanka sai taci anjima, ammie data dad'e da sanin hali ba ta nuna komai ba ta had'a mata dai dai cin na mutum biyu ta haura sama dashi, koda mazan ma suka soma ci Fahad ce musu yayi yana zuwa minti uku su soma ci kafun yazo, da farko sun tsaya jiran shi Saddam daya Sansu shida sarah ciki da bai yace, "guys wancen fa kuna jiran rehu ne ya gudu zasu ci tare da matar shi gwara ma kuci tunda zafin shi ba sai ya huce ba, Muhammad yayan Saddam daya kasance ba mazauni ba sosai a k'asar cewa yayi, "Kai Saddam taya ka sani?". Dariya Saddam yayi yasa hannun shi da Bismillah ya Soma cin abincin, ganin still sun tsaya jira sai ya sake kyalkyala musu dariya da harshen turanci yace, "Allah guys rehu kuke jira wancen da kuke jira wai tunda sukayi aure basu tab'a raba kwano ba shida matar shi, shiyasa ko'ina suna lik'e da juna kamar magnet 🧲"
  Muhammad ne ya dubi farouk yace, "muci abincin mu da gaske yake don wannan daka gani y'an iska biyu ne duk jirgi d'aya ne ya d'ebo su shima ba tabbas d'in ne dashi ba.....". Murmushi farouk yayi, yayi Bismillah ya fara cin abincin. 
    Bayan wasu mintuna duk Suka gama, matan Suka tashi Suna tsabtace gurin. 
   Farouk kam yana can hankalin shi rabi akan matar shi da suke ta aikin gyare gyaren gurin kamar ba masu aiki a gidan, rabi kuma yana kan sauraren hirar Saddam da baya gajiya da magana,  suna haka Fahad ya sauko cikin sabuwar shiga shida matar shi yana rungume da yaron su. 
    Sai bayan ya zauna cikin su Saddam ya kalle shi da kyau yace, "Wai kai Fahad baka jin kunyar idon su mammie, duk hidima sai ka dinga zare jiki kuna abubuwa kaida matarka ba ruwanku da idon mutane, fi sabilillah idan ni baka jin kunya ta ai ya kamata kaji kunyar wannan bak'on da Muhammad ko?". 
    Wani irin kallo yayi mishi sai kuma ya kalli su Muhammad d'in, farouk kam murmushi kawai yayi, Muhammad kuma yace, "kaji sai kace irin shi kunyar mutane yake ji, Saddam sai dai ka yiwa farouk bariki amma ba ni ba, daga Kai har Fahad Ina ga lokacin da akayi rabon soyayyah kunfi kowa zak'ewa da karb'a shiyasa kuka fimu sanin muhimmancinta amma kun baro kunyar ku a can wajen karb'ar soyayyar gaskiya". 
   Dariya sukayi sosai Fahad da Saddam hadda tafawa, Muhammad ya kalli farouk yace, "ka gani ko? Da kai zasu bule da k'ura, to na bud'e ka....". Shi kanshi farouk dariya ya d'anyi saboda yanayin yadda Muhammad yayi maganar dole ya baka dariya. 
   Haka sukayi ta barkwancin su, shi dai k'ark'ari in sun sako sunan shi yayi dariya ko d'an murmushi. 

    Arfah ma ta b'angaren su group suka had'a matasan, matar Muhammad sai amaryar Saddam, Sarah da ibtisam k'anwar su Saddam itama tayi aure da kuma mai sunan ammie da sukewa laqabi da ummu. Hira sukeyi ta k'asashen duniya kowa tana bada labarin abinda ta sani game da wata k'asa data tab'a ziyarta. 
   Ba laifi arfah tana yin hira sosai a cikinsu, jin yadda tasan gurare sai suka koma ita suke tambaya tana wayar musu da Kai akan komai, duk yadda suke ji da wayewa da gogewa sai da suka shafa ma arfah lafiya saboda inda ta taka su basu tab'a zuwa ba ma. 
   (Kunsan a wancen lokacin abbie da arfah yake futa yawon kasuwancin shi idan ta samu hutun makaranta tazo gida)
   
  Ammiey kuwa tana gurin su Khadija da matar yayanta ibraheem suna tsare tsaren y'an abubuwan da ba'a rasa ba. 
   Rana tana d'an d'agawa ammiey ta sake nemo wasu cikin y'an matasan matan suka koma kitchen don shirya abincin da za'ayi lunch. 
   

   Toh a tak'aice dai ranar kusan haka suka yini tare suna hira hatta sallah bata sa sun rabu da juna ba, haka zasu yi jam'i daga mazan har matan su gabatar da ita anan parlon. 

   Har dare yayi nisa ranar basu tafi ba saida bacci ya soma cin k'arfin kowa a cikin su sannan suka soma kama hanyar su d'aya bayan d'aya. 
    Kusan duk a saman amma suka tare duk da irin jan kunnen su da tayi basu kula taba suka samu masauki da matan su, don ciki matar Muhammad da Fahad ne kad'ai suke da y'ay'a, shi Fahad d'aya Muhammad kuma biyu. 
    Sai da parlon ya rage daga arfah sai farouk sannan suka kama hanyar su farouk d'auke da shuraim Suka haura saman a gajiye, da kyar arfah ta iya amsar shuraim a k'ofar d'akinta, sukayi sallama da farouk da sauri sauri ta shige d'aki. 

   Bayan tayi wanka ta shirya cikin riga da wando masu d'an kauri na bacci, shafa'i da wuturin ta tayi ta kwanta tana jin yadda gajiya tayi mata ribdugu, ta gaji over yau ko idon Abbie ma ita bata gani ba, haka ammiey tana son su keb'ance suyi magana amma duk hakan bata samu ba saboda hayaniyar da sukayi yau a gidan. 

    Addu'o'inta tayi na bacci ta k'arasa kashe bedside lamp ta mirgina kusa da d'anta ta rungume shi sai bacci.

Toh kwanan su biyu a tare da y'an uwa anata hirar zumunci, cikin k'ank'anin lokaci suka fahimci juna kyakkyawar alaqa ta k'ullu tsakanin su. 
Y'an uwan su kamar y'ay'an yayyansu amma da abbu ma duk sun zazzo anga juna cikin kwanakin hadda exchange na phone no juna don zumunci ya K'arfafa. 
   Farouk har yanzu tsakanin shi da arfah in sun had'u a parlour ko tazo rako shuraim d'akin shi in yasa rigima cikin dare, shima tun wancen ranar da abin nan ya faru tsakanin su bata gigin shigar mishi d'aki, iya kacinta k'ofar d'akin ta mishi knock yana karb'ar yaron kuma zata juya. 

   A ranar da suka cika kwana na uku a gidan late alhaji abbu a ranar kowa ya soma kama gaban shi cikin matasan, ummu da ibtisam ma ana gama break dama sukayi nasu guri, Saddam kam dama bai kwana a gidan ba saboda wata matsala data taso musu urgent a gurin aiki, sai ya rage saura Muhammad da Fahad kawai, shi kuwa Fahad dama gidan amma kamar gida yake a gurin shi, in yaso sai suyi 2 month a nan tare da ammie da amma kakarsu, kuma duk dalilin baya rasa nasaba da mugun shak'uwar da yayi da ammiey ne. Sun shirya Khadija zata tafi da arfah can gidanta tayi mata lafiyayyen gyara irin nasu na asalin y'an k'asar. 
Ammiey da kanta ta rok'i farouk alfarmar yayarta zata tafi da arfah Alexandria bayan kwana biyu zasu dawo. 
   Ko kad'an bai so tafiyar arfahn ba ko ba komai yana ganin gilmawarta a cikin gidan sai yafi samun nutsuwa akan rashin ta a tare dashi gaba d'aya. Toh amma bashi da wani zab'i wanda yafi na amincewar shi akan tafiyar. 
   Arfah bayan ta gama Shirin ta gaba d'aya na tafiya tura ta ammie tayi don tayi musu sallama shi da shuraim. 
  Ba don taso ba ta haura stairs a nutse har zuwa k'ofar d'akin nashi, sai data fara neman izinin shi ta hanyar kwankwasa mishi k'ofar.

 Da sallama a bakinta ta shiga d'akin, yana zaune kan doguwar kujera sanye da dogon wandon shadda da singlet, ya hard'e k'afar shi duka biyu kan center table dake gaban shi. Waya ce a hannun shi yana buga game.

A gefen shi ma ta zauna ta soma gaishe shi, bayan sun gaisa take fad'a mishi abinda ammiey tace, "dama ammiey ce tace nazo nayi maka sallama anjima kad'an zamu tafi gidan Mom, sannan tace na k'ara neman izininka duk da kunyi magana da ita tace jiya".

    Kanta ta cusa tsakanin k'irjin shi tana gogawa cikin shagwob'a take fad'in, "ummm! Ummm". 
   "Okay to ni bari na baki wanda zaki jini a tare dake ko yaushe har ki dawo"
    Ai ko kafun tace wani abu ya soma romancing d'inta with passion, sosai ya motsa ta sai daya tabbatar da bai bata wata gab'a ko guda ta tunanin komai in bashi ba sannan ya dakatar da abinda yake.

    Janye jikin shi ya k'arasa yi daga nata da d'an sauran kuzarin daya rage mishi. 
   Arfah yanzun kam Cike da bak'in cikin abinda yake mata ta gyara hijab d'in jikinta ta fuce daga parlon da gudu gudu sauri sauri tana jin yadda ya maida ita hungrilly kuma ya rabu da ita ba ruwan shi. 
    A kan bed ta kwanta ta fashe da wani irin kuka mai cin rai, abinda bata tab'a sani ba kenan a zamantakewar auren su, koda Yaushe cikin kyautata mata yake da son ganin farin cikin ta, amma a yau ya bak'anta mata har tana jin tsananin tsanar shi irin wadda bata tab'a jiba ko a farkon zamansu, kuma ta lashi takobin sai ta rama duk abinda yayi mata ba zata tab'a d'aga mishi k'afa ba, sai ya d'and'ani bak'in cikin da yafi wanda taji a yanzu. 
   
   A hanzarce ta sake sabon shiri cikin wasu tsadaddun riga da wando na Pakistan ta d'ora hijab dogo a saman kaya, har lokacin bata daina jin tasowar sababbin emotions ba, "wannan wace irin masifa ce?" Arfah ta fad'a kamar meyin magana da wani. 
   
   A haka ta d'auki Jakarta data zuba kayan sawarta kala biyu sai inner wears ta futo, yana tsaye jikin k'ofar d'akin shi, kallo d'aya tayi mishi ta d'auke kanta har ta huce shi bata sake kallon inda yake tsaye ba, shima daman hucewarta ya futo gani, tana tafiya kuma ya koma yana murmushin mugunta. Daga yanzu zuwa kwana biyun da zatayi yasan ba zata tab'a shagala da wani abu ta manta dashi ba, ko tak'i ko tasu dole zata dinga jinshi cikin jikinta.
