Su mom da tuntuni dama ita suke jira tana zuwa sukayi sallama da kowa na gidan suka d'auki hanya. 
Mom ce take driving d'in ita kuma tana gefenta ta kwantar da kanta jikin seat kamar me bacci. 

   Tafiyar awanni da y'an mintuna ce ta kaisu Alexandria daga Cairo babban birnin Egypt, a wani katafaren gida mom tayi horn aka wangale mata get guda biyu ta cusa hancin motar ta ciki, sai data yi parking sannan suka futo ita da mom d'in zuwa cikin gidan. 
  Babban gida ne sosai kuma ba ma'aikata da yawa, maza biyu ne suke musu aiki kacal a harabar gidan sai mata biyu a cikin gida, ba kamar gidan abbu da komai akwai mai kula dashi a gidan ba. 
   A d'akin ta tayi mata masauki ita kuma ta futa zata ga mai gidanta da taga motarshi a parking lot shaidar yana gida. 
    Arfah wanka ta fad'a shap shap ta futo d'aure da towel kanta na d'igar ruwa, d'aya daga mayukan data gani kan dressing mirror ta d'auka tana dubawa mom ta shigo d'akin da sallama. 
   Cikin harshen English tace, "babyy kar ki shafa komai a jikin ki saboda gyaran jiki zamu Soma yanzun nan, me zaki ci nasa a dafa miki". 
   Ajiye man tayi tace, "okay but I'm not feeling hungry mom". 
  D'an zaro ido tayi cikin mamaki tace, "a'a nifa bazan yadda da Zama da yunwa ba, so kike a mayar wa mijin ki ke a rame, kuma gyaran jikin ai ba zaiyi ba in bakya cin abinci". 
   Murmushi tayi kanta a k'asa tana jin k'aunar mom d'in har cikin ranta, ganinta take kamar ammienta. 
   Doguwar riga ta ciro mata mai hijab ta ce "kisa wannan nasan sallah zakiyi ko?". Ta karb'a a nutse tasa ta kabbara sallarta. 
    Ko kafun ta idar mom ta kawo mata abinci mai lafiya da drinks na tsurar madara gangariya. Ita ta titsiye ta ta cinye abincin tass, a wajen madarar ne dai suka yita daru tace ita bata Shan madara sam, mom kuma tace yau ta kamata dole sai tasha ko da zata d'auke ta matsayin magani. Da kyar da toshe hanci gudun kada taji k'arni arfah ta shanye madarar tass ta ajiye cup d'in. 
   Mahaifin Fahad mom ta yi mata jagora suka gaisa sannan suka fara abinda ya kawo ta ba b'ata lokaci. 
   Gyara mom take yi mata na gaske mara algus tana dirje ta da k'alk'ale ta ciki da bai. K'amshi kuwa cikin kwanaki biyun nan ya gama manne fatar jikinta duka. 
   A cewar mom tayi mata har na bashin auren farko, saboda duk y'ar da za'a yiwa aure a family ita take mata gyaran jiki, ita kuma da bata nan yanzun sai a biya ta. 
   Sirrikan zaman lafiya da miji da naseeha mai shiga jiki tayi mata, duk da tasan arfahn bata da matsala daga ita har mijinta kuwa daga yanayin su, tunda Suka zo gidan take karatun su kuma duk cikin halayen su ba abinda yafi d'aukar hankalinta kamar son junan su da sukeyi da kuma kunyar su, lallai kowa ya gansu yaga y'ay'an da suka samu cikakkiyar tarbiya da ilimin islama. 

  Kwana uku arfah tayi madadin biyu, ana i gobe zata koma mom ta futa da ita shopping plaza ta yi mata siyayya ta bajinta, kayane arfah har saida ta soma rok'arta akan ta bari haka kayan sunyi yawa. 
    Bata saurare taba sai data dangane da gurin turarika y'an ubansu da kayan bacci masu kyau da Jan hankali. 

   Koda Suka dawo gida ita da kanta ta shirya mata kayan a jaka. 

  Washe gari k'arfe 9 da mintuna na k'asar Suka d'auki hanya sai Cairo. 
    Sab'anin yadda suka zo yanzun arfah ce ta karb'i driving d'in, suna tafe suna y'ar hirar su har Suka Isa. 
     A lokacin da suka shiga parlon amma Sarah ce kawai sai ammie da shuraim ke kwance akan cinyarta yana bacci. 
    Duk zuba mata ido sukayi suna yaba kyaun da tayi a cikin kwanaki uku kacal a zuciyar su, bayan sun gaggaisa ammie dafa kafad'ar mom tayi cikin harshen Arab tace, "sannun ki sis kinsha aiki, ni y'ar taki ma sai naga kamar kyalli takeyi". 
  D'an dariya mom tayi tace, "Allah ke d'in nan baki da dama, to idan ban gyara abata ba waye zai gyara mun ita haka kamar kwalba". 
Duk dariya sukayi banda arfah da kanta yake sunkuye a k'asa. 
   "Kina da gaskiya kam". Amma ta fad'a tana sake kallon yadda arfahn ta dad'a haske mai kyau. Kasancewar sun karya kafun su taho ruwa kawai suka Sha a gurin, sun d'an tab'a hira kad'an kafun arfah taja jakar kayanta ta nufi side d'inta, ko data zo shiga d'aki ma saida ta kalli d'akin farouk da yake a rufe sannan ta shige. 
    D'akin babu ko d'igon datti kamar baiyi kwana uku ba mutum a ciki ba, kan gado ta fad'a a matuk'ar gajiye tana jin yadda kanta yake sarawa, tunanin farouk da bai tab'a barin ta sarara ba tunda ta tafi ta fara, ko yasan ma ta dawo? Sai kuma taja tsaki a fili, ita ya kamata ma tayi zuciya dashi da abinda ya shafe shi, irin cutar da yayi mata har yanzu a yadda ta tafi haka ta dawo ba wani sauk'i saima k'aruwa da abin yayi, (abinda arfah bata sani ba kuma matsalarta hadda had'i da gyaran jikin da akeyi mata ma). 
     Tana y'an tunane tunanenta bacci mai nauyi yayi awon gaba da ita, tana baccin shuraim ya shigo ya ganta ya fuce da gudu da murna ya fad'awa farouk dawowarta, sai daya shigo da kanshi ya ganta har ya gyara mata kwanciya sannan ya fuce, sai after zuhr prayer ta tashi ta gabatar da sallah tayi wanka ta yi sabon shiri cikin riga da zani na atamfa, tana shirin futa ammiey ta shigo da plate na abinci. 
    Zama tayi akan sofa ta ajiye trayn da ruwan lemon hannunta, itama sai ta zauna gefen ammien. 
   Shiru ya biyo baya na adadin wasu mintuna kafun ammie tace, "kici abincin ki babyy". Plate d'in ta d'auka ta d'auki abincin ta soma ci da Bismillah, yayinda wani gefe na zuciyarta yake cike da farin cikin gata ga mahaifiyarta a yau, ita  fa duk wannan abun da zuwan da sukayi bata gama tabbatar da gaskiyar komai ba sai yanzun data ganta a gefenta wai har ta kawo mata abinci da hannunta, abun da ta shafe sama da shekara shida bai faru ba, taci! tasha! Bata sani bama ko ammien tana tuna hakan idan ta tuno ta. 
   Wasu hawaye ne suka Soma bin kuncinta, sai ta ajiye abincin gefe ta sa tafin hannunta tana sharewa, ita kanta ammien irin tunanin da takeyi kenan shiyasa ta kasa koda kwakkwaran motsi har Saida sautin kukan arfah ya soma futowa. 
    Cikin so, kewa da soyayyar uwa mara algus ta jawo ta jikinta ta rungume tana share mata hawayen, ita kanta hawayen ne tafff idanunta. 
     Bata katse taba sai data ci kukan ta son rai ta gode Allah sannan ta Soma yi mata magana da taushin murya, "kiyi hak'uri babyy, tabbas nasan na cutar da rayuwarki ta hanyar kasancewa uwa mai tsananin son kanta na jefa ki cikin halin ha'ula'i, shiyasa dole na barki kiyi kukan ki yadda kike so kada zaluncin ya zamo rib'i biyu har da na a dake ka a hanaka kuka".
   Girgiza mata kai arfah ta dinga yi cikin sanyin murya ta wadda taci kuka tace, "ki daina fad'ar haka don Allah, wallahi ki tambayi Abbie ni komai ya huce a gurina, na fahimci abinda ya faru duk ba komai ne ya haddasa ba sai k'addara da rabo, ammie ki duba komai kiga yadda ya faru, sannan ammiey ki godewa Allah daya had'a ni da mutum irin farouk, ammiey duk yadda zanyi miki bayanin kyawawan halayyar farouk saina rage miki wani abu, farouk k'arshe ne a komai yasan kanshi yasan abinda yake yi". 
   Nan arfah ta ajiye kunya a gefe ta dinga bata labarin kyaun halin farouk da irin kyautatawar shi gareta, abu biyu data d'an sirranta shine abinda ba zai fad'u ba na rayuwar auren su da kuma sab'anin da suka sassamu na rayuwar yau da gobe wanda ya zamo tilas ga duk ma'aurata more especially kafun su fahimci juna. 
   
   Sosai ammiey ta jinjina ta kuma yaba wa yaron kwarai da gaske, lallai bata damk'a amanar ta a mummunan hannu ba, koda yake ba abin mamaki bane idan ta tuna khubrah mahaifiyar shi da Ibrahim mahaifin shi, wato su biyun sun kasance wasu kwallin mutane da ta dad'e bata ga irin suba. Suna da nagarta, hak'uri da tsage gaskiya komai d'acinta koda a Karan kansu ne, abu d'aya da tasan khubrah ta tsana shine, k'ask'anci, cin mutumci da raini, ko waye kai ka raina ta da matsayinta zata futa sabgarka gaba d'aya. 
   Sun dad'e suna tattaunawa hira irin ta uwa da y'arta ta nutsuwa, da kyar arfah taci abincin ta, tasha ruwan lemon, a nan ammiey tayi sallar la'asar kafun ta tafi. 



        @@@@@.      @@@@@


 Toh kwana biyu da dawowar arfah suna wasan b'uya da farouk, tuk'uru take gudun shi da gudun had'uwa dashi, a kwana na uku kuma jirgin su ya d'aga daga k'asar Egypt zuwa gida Nigeria. 
  Tafiyar da ta d'aga hankalin mutane da yawa ciki kuwa hadda amma don ba k'aramin sabo tayi dasu a y'an kwanakin ba. Rabon ta da futa har ta manta amma sai gashi itace hadda raka su airport. Mutum uku ne sukayi musu rakiya a mutanen Egypt, mom Fahad da Sarah. 
   A cewar Ibraheem ai suna tare zai zo bayan sun nutsu. 
   Ko a cikin jirgi ma arfah sam bata yadda farouk yaga hak'orinta ba har suka sauka,mutanen Abbie Suka zo suka tarye su. 
   Kowa masaukin shi yayi a cikin su, Sarah kuma Fahad ya bud'e musu d'akin shi na da kafun yayi aure. Mom dama ammie a part d'in ta ta sauke ta. 

    Ranar sun sha wahalar tafiya babu wanda yayi kwakkwaran motsi ko yink'urin futowa a cikin su, da dare ne dai ma arfah ta futo ta d'auki abinci mara nauyi ta koma. 
    Shuraim kam an samu abinda ake so jama'a sun dad'u a gidan su, bashi gurin wannan bashi gurin wancan. 

    Kwanan su d'aya muhsin daya samu labarin dawowar su k'asar ta gurin Abbie ya kawo musu ziyara, da kuma neman su da yake saboda abinda ya taso musu urgent, tun suna Egypt yake jin kamar yayi tsintso ya je ya jawo shi, saboda shine ma sukayi wannan dawowar ta gaggawa. 



    _toh mallam muhsin ko me kake tafe dashi kuma?_

Page 76 _(seventy six)_



 Abbie ne ya tara ammiey arfah farouk da Fahad duka a parlon shi inda muhsin ke zaune, duk suna zaune shiru da tunanin abinda ya assasa wannan meeting na gaggawa. 
   Bayan an nutsu ne Abbie yayi gyaran murya ya warware musu komai da muhsin ya fad'a mishi kamar haka, "kwana ki biyu da Suka gabata muhsin ya kira ni, lokacin muna Egypt yake fad'a mun wanda ya d'auke fareeda ya kira waya, amma yana buk'atar jin muryar arfah don ya tabbatar da gaskiya abinda aka fad'a mishi na cewar ta dawo, yace idan har akayi haka ko zuwa gobe zai iya bayyana kanshi da fareeda, toh kasancewar ta inda aka hau ta nan ake sauka shine na taramu gaba d'aya a warware komai". 

   Shiru ne ya biyo baya a cikin su babu wanda yayi kwakkwaran motsi har ammie da bata fahimci kan zancen ba. 
    Abbie kam arfah yake kallo cikin son karanto yanayin yadda ta d'auki maganar yace, "ki ajiye tunanin komai, ki ceci rayuwar y'ar uwarki fareeda domin tana buk'atar taimakon ki a wannan gab'ar". 
    Shirun dai ta sakeyi sai fingers d'inta da take wasa dasu kanta a k'asa. 
   Cikin muryar tausayi da neman taimako muhsin shima ya Soma yi mata magana da fad'in, "tabbas fareeda ta cancanci ko wane irin hukunci a gurinki kina da dama da ikon rama duk abinda tayi miki ta kowacce hanya, sai dai abinda nake son ki soma lura dashi firstly shine, yanayin da mahaifiyar mu take ciki wanda fareeda ta d'auki 90% out of hundred a ciki ni kuma na d'auki 10, arfah a  Farkon dawowata Nigeria da labarin abinda ya faru dake ya shiga cikin kunnena kai tsaye na d'ora alhakin komai akan fareeda, kuma hasashe na bai tashi a banza ba, bayan kwana biyu da tafiyarki zuciyata ta kasa hak'uri nasa aka d'auke mun ita aka kaita guesthouse d'ina, na dinga azabtar da ita da abinci marar dad'i da aikin wahala ba tare da kowa ya sani ba har Allah yasa ta fad'a mun gaskiyar komai, ganin na samu abinda nake so kuma ta riga ta aikata duk abinda tayi niyyah sai naga ba amfanin naci gaba da tsareta, cuta ce dai nasan ta gama cutata kuma ba yanda zanyi da ita tunda jini jace, don har na mutu bazan tab'a manta abinda tayi mun a kanki ba, kullum Ina ganinta bak'in cikinta yana sake dad'uwa a zuciyata, hakan yasa na tattara ta na mayar da ita gida da mugun gargad'in ta sake ta fad'i cewar ni na d'auke ta tsawon wannan lokacin sai na b'ab'b'ala ta, sai dai kash Ina ga ko get d'in layin mu ban gama futa ba aka d'auke ta da gaske wanda shine har yau bamu San inda take ba, a lokacin da mama taji abinda na aikata ba k'aramin tashin hankali ta shiga ba, ta d'auki mugun fushi dani da kyar da taimakon Auntie ta yafe mun, abinda yasa nake baki duk wannan labarin ba komai bane sai don kiji irin tsanar da nayi mata duk da tana y'ar uwata ta jini, wallahi arfah Ina jin tsanar fareeda a raina sau dubu akan yadda kake ji, nafi ki jin ciwon komai saboda gashi ta silarta kin haramta a gareni har abada, toh amma a yau ina neman alfarmar ki saboda mamata don girman Allah ki taimaka mu kira kiyi magana dasu suji muryarki su tabbatar da gaskiyar ke d'in ce da gaske kin dawo ba wata ba su saki fareeda ko Allah zaisa mama ta kwantar da hankalinta jikinta ya warwarw....don  Allah.........".
     Ajiyar zuciya arfah taja mai tsayi cikin nutsuwar ta da sanyin murya tace, "Ni na dad'e da yafe mata bana jin haushinta da tsanarta a raina har ga Allah ko kad'an, ku kira su zanyi magana dasu amma fa bisa amincewar Farouk". 
   Jin ta fad'i haka sai farouk da hanzarin shi yace, "a'a ni babu komai ta b'angarena fatan Allah ya bayyana ta da alkhairy". 
    Cikin jin dad'i da farin ciki muhsin ya ciro wayar shi ya danna wa bak'uwar no ta k'asar waje kira,
    Ba'a d'aga ba hakan yasa ya sake dialling no cike da zullumi da tashin hankali, nan ma har ta katse ba'ayi picking ba, haka muhsin yayi ta jera kira har saida ya fudda rai sannan akayi picking, kusan a tare suka sauke ajiyar zuciya shida Abbie. 
    "Ka saka wayar a handsfree ka mik'awa arfah". 
   Arfah da taji komai cike da jin tsoro ta karb'i wayar a hannun muhsin ta ajiye a gabanta ta tsura mata ido. 
   Cikin kakkaura kuma kunburarriyar murya mutumin yace, "shin Fatima arfah tana iya jina a halin yanzu? Idan har da gaske tana kusa to tayi magana don naji muryarta, amma fa muhsin ka tuna da sharad'ina muddin naji watan arfah arfah to la shakka kuda fareeda har abada. 
   Duk cikin tsoro da jin barazanar da mutumin yayi suka soma bashi hak'uri. 
   Dakatar dasu yayi ta hanyar fad'in, "kuna b'ata mun lokaci bayan kunsan abinda nake buk'ata". Tsit kuma sukayi shiru. 
  Sai a lokacin arfah cikin taushin murya tace, "waye kai bawan Allah! Sannan me yasa ka d'auke fareeda". 
   Y'ar dariya mutumin yayi yace, "tabbas kuwa kece ga dukkan alamu kuma kin samu nutsuwa fiye da a lokacin da kuke tare da fareeda, hajiya Fatima ba komai bane yasa na sace k'awarki sai soyayyah, soyayyah kwatankwacin irin wadda yayanta muhsin yake miki, bana ji, bana gani, bana fahimtar komai akan sonta, yayinda ita ta mayar dani kwallon buga wasanta....". 
  Arfah cikin rawar murya tace, "don Allah ka fad'a mun waye kai?". 
   "Saurin me kike yi bayan nan da kwana uku da ikon Allah zamu dira Nigeria kamar yadda nayi alk'awari, zaki ganni ai sannan Ina son ki tabbatar da muhsin ya cika alk'awarin daya d'aukar mun..... Misalin k'arfe 3 nan da kwana uku Ina son duk ku had'u a gidan alhaji jafar zanzo muku da fareeda, har ma da tsarabar data kawo muku" Yana gama fad'in haka k'it ya kashe wayar. 
   Bayyananniyar ajiyar zuciya arfah ta sauke ta rintse idanun ta tana tariyo wani abu daya huce shekaru da nisa a cikin kwakwalwarta kafun ta motsa bakinta a nutse ta ce, "doctor shuraim". 
   "Doctor shuraim kuma?" Ammiey ta tambaye ta. 
   Sai ta bud'e idanunta da sauri tace, "wallahi ammie wannan doctor shuraim ne kuma zaku gani in yazo".

   Tana gama fad'in haka ta tashi ta tafi jiki a sanyaye, tausayin muhsin take ji shiyasa ba zata iya ci gaba da zama inuwa guda dashi yana ganinta haka ba, duk yadda take tunanin yana sonta abin ya zarta haka, ta yadda wata soyayyar k'addara ce, to shi kam tashi za'a iya cewa ta zame mishi musiba ma, yana can yana dakon soyayyar ta yayinda ita take rayuwarta da wani daban da take so cikin farin ciki. "Allah sarki Yaya muhsin! Allah ya yaye maka abinda kake ji a kaina ya baka wadda zata soka bil hak'k'i" arfah ce meyin wannan maganar a zahiri. 
   
   Duk sallamar kowa Abbie yayi bayan fucewar arfah, Suka tafi d'aya bayan d'aya suna mai yin addu'ar Allah ya bayyana fareeda a wannan karon. 


          @@@@.     @@@@


Toh arfah kam cikin lokacin sai ta sake zama so silent, yadda tayi rantsuwa a gaban kowa da kowa ba za tayi kaffara ba doctor shuraim shi ya d'auke fareeda duk tsawon wannan lokacin. Toh amma abinda ita kanta bata sani ba shine meyasa?, Koda yake yace sonta yake, soyayyar ce ma ta sabbaba mishi ya sace ta. 
   Kai wannan rayuwa akwai abin tsoro, a tak'aice tare suka tafi da fareeda? Gwara itama za'a iya ce aure tayi ita kuma fareeda fa?. 
   
  A daren ranar tana kwance kan doguwar kujerar parlonta, ta lula cikin duniyar tunani akayi knocking k'ofar, da sauri ta mik'e zaune tana duba yanayin shigar jikinta gudun bata san wanda zai shigo ba, ita kuma ko Fahad bata son ya ganta haka a halin yanzu, riga ce doguwa a jikinta armless gashin kanta daya sha gyara d'aure a k'eyarta, babu komai a kusa bare ta kare jikinta aka bud'e k'ofar aka shigo, zubawa k'ofar ido tayi don ganin wanda yake shigowa, ganin ammienta sai ta sauke ajiyar zuciya. 
    Zama tayi a d'aya daga kujerun parlon tana kallon yadda aka sabunta komai na part d'in. 
   Da fara'a sosai ta russuna ta sake gaishe da ammien. 
   "Kinci abinci kuwa arfahh". 
   Ammien ta tambaye ta bayan ta amsa gaisuwar ta. 
   "Eh ammie naci d'azu". 
  "Yauwa bana son zaman kin da yunwar nan mijinki ma yaci? Naga shima kamar ke wani lokacin baya son cin abinci". 
  Murmushi kawai arfahn tayi. 
  Ammie ta d'ora da fad'in, "ki shirya kayan ki saboda gobe zaku huce gidan su farouk ku kwana musu biyu, Abbie yace tunda kuka dawo baku je ba". 
  Shiru tayi har saida ammien ta kira sunanta, "kinyi shiru arfah ko ba kiji me nace ba?". 
    "Allah ya kaimu goben, ni duk yadda kuka ce ammie abinda kuke so shi zanyi". 
   Cike da jin dad'i tace, "toh Allah yayi miki albarka babyy, na nemi wayar eeman ban same taba Ina ganin idan kinje gidan khubrah kisa su nemo miki mai lalle ayi miki a can zaifi, inba haka ba kuma zaki tafi da farar k'afar ki don ba lokaci". 
   Da ameen ta amsa had'e da toh, sun d'an tab'a hira sama sama kafun ammien tayi mata sallama ta tafi. 
   
   Tana Shirin shigewa bedroom farouk ya turo k'ofar ya shigo da sallama. 
   Da sauri arfah ta k'arasa shigewa ciki ta murza key, shi abin ma dariya ya bashi, ya rasa gane kan wannan wasar b'uya da take yi dashi haka, tuntuni yake son ganinta suyi magana amma ta hana mishi damar hakan, koda yake ai komai ya kusa zuwa k'arshe.....
Sai yayi murmushi kawai ya fuce. 
   


             ##########


Wayewar garin yau arfah tun safe ta gama had'a duk abinda zata buk'ata na amfani, kayan shuraim dama bata tab'a ba saboda tasan farouk zai had'a musu tare. 
    Ko zuwa lokacin da zata futa gaishe da Abbie ta gama Shirin ta tsab cikin riga da zani na atamfar ta mai kyau, daga d'inkin har atamfar sun amshi jikinta matuk'a gaya. 
   Cikin takunta na nutsuwa da aji ta futo daga bedroom d'inta dai dai lokacin da shuraim da farouk suka turo k'ofar suka shigo. 
   Kallo d'aya tayi mishi ta d'auke kanta a ranta tana yaba kyaun da yayi cikin shigar shi ta yau, shuraim ne ya taho da gudu ya rungume ta yana fad'in, "oyoyo Auntie fa rannan mun jira ki har nayi bacci baki zo ba, bayan kuma Yaya yace kince zaki zo". 
    Shafa kanshi tayi cikin so da kulawa tace, "dama ni ai banyi muku alk'awarin zanje gurin ku ba, gurb'ataccen tunanin kune kawai ya baku hakan kaida uban gidan naka"
    Murmushi farouk da ya zuba mata ido yayi har jerarrun hak'oran shi na bayyana waje, shi dariya ma ta bashi wato shine uban gidan farouk. 

    Kan kujera ta zauna ta d'ora shuraim a kan cinyarta tana tambayar shi, "wa yayi maka wanka?". 
  Da hannu ya nuna mata farouk yana dariya yace, "Yaya ne". 
    Kallon inda farouk d'in yake tsaye tayi a karo na biyu, sai ta maida kanta k'asa idonta na kallon tattausan carpet d'in da aka malale k'asan tiles d'in d'akin tace, "Ina kwana?". 
   "Ba gashi kin gani ba". Jin amsar daya bayar sai ta sake d'agowa ta dube shi, sai dai suna had'a ido ya kashe mata ido d'aya ta sauke kanta k'asa da sauri. 
   Shuraim ne yaci gaba da bata labarin da ita Sam ba fahimta take ba, "shhhh! Ya Isa haka don Allah wai kai baka gajiya da magana ne?". 
     "Kae😳auntie ai na daina magana mara amfani yanzu tun rannan da Yaya yayi mun fad'a". 
   Kusan duk a tare sukayi murmushi kafun arfah ta janye shi a jikinta ta mik'e. 
  Gyalenta ta d'auko da y'ar k'aramar jaka ta had'a da jakar kayanta sannan ta fuce ta barsu a parlon. 
   Direct part d'in Abbie tayi, sai data nemi izini aka bata sannan ta kutsa kanta ciki. 
   Yana zaune kan darduma da carbi a hannun shi yana lazimi, yayinda ammiey take zaune gefen shi tana had'a mishi tea. 
  Kallo d'aya zaka San ya samu cikakkiyar nutsuwar jiki data ruhi, a kusa dashi ta zauna cikin tsantsar ladabi ta soma gaishe shi. 
  Ya amsa mata cikin kulawa har yana fad'a mata farouk da shuraim basu dad'e da futa ba. 
   Shiru tayi ba tare data ce komai ba saboda kunya ta gaishe da ammien ta, itama ta amsa mata tana fad'in, "mijin ki cike yake da d'okin tafiya gidan su kada ki b'ata Masa lokaci sannan ki tabbatar kunci abinci kafun ku tafi". 
   "Insha Allah ammiey"
   "Okay to". 
 Bayan ta d'an zauna Jim sallama tayi musu don tasan ba lallai sun futo lokacin da zasu huce ba. 
  
  Ko bayan ta futo part d'in ammiey tayi don su gaisa da Mom sai kuma ta tarar tana bacci. Drower ammiey ta duba ta samu paper and biro ta rubuta mata short note da harshen Arab "nazo gaishe ki na tarar kina bacci, mun huce gidan su Farouk! I will Miss you sweet mom 4 dis two days". 
    Tana gamawa ta ajiye mata kusa da kanta ta futa a hankali, a dinning ta tarar da Romeo and Juliet ana breakfast rabi kuma ana ta zuba love. 
   A tsaitsaye ta tsaya suka gaisa tayi hucewarta kitchen. A can ta samu abinci irin wanda take so, da farko iya nata ta d'auka, sai kuma tayi tunanin ko shida shuraim ma basuyi break d'in ba. 
    Yana zaune kan one seater cusion shuraim rungume a k'irjin shi yana kallon wani abu a wayar shi. 
   Duk yadda taso kasa d'auke kanta tayi daga kallonsu har saida ya d'ago kanshi suka had'a ido sannan. 
    Ajiye trayn tayi k'asan carpet ta soma had'a tea, ba tare data kalle suba tace, "shuraim Bismillahn ku abinci". 
   Da gudu ya zamo daga cinyar farouk yazo ya tankwashe k'afa a kusa da ita, "dama fa yunwa nake ji tun d'azu banyi magana ba saboda Yaya ya hana ni yawan magana". 
    Tana saving d'in su a plate d'aya ita dashi tace, "toh a haka ka bari kenan?". 
   D'an zaro ido yayi yace, "eh mana na daina Allah". 
   Za tayi magana farouk ya riga ta da cewa, "toh ai ni koda na hanaka magana ma bance in kanajin yunwa kayi shiru ba, surutun kama kanayi, abinda ka bari kawai yawan bawa mutane labarin mu nida Auntien ka". 
    Kyakkyab'e fuska yayi kamar zai fashe da kuka yace, "toh kuyi hak'uri". 
   Saukowa k'asa farouk yayi ya zauna kusa dashi irin zaman da yayi yaja kumatun shi yace, "is okay mie dear ka kiyaye kaji". 
   Kai ya gyad'a mishi bai sake ce komai ba. 

   Arfah ganin ya zauna a nasu abincin sai ta juye nashi a ciki, duk ta k'ara da had'a musu irin shayin da tasan sun fi So. 
   Tare suka ci abincin a karo na farko da suka tab'a had'uwa a plate guda haka su uku.

  Bayan sun gama jakar kayanta ta d'auka da hand bag, a nutse suke sauka shida shuraim tana bin bayansu tana waya da Auntien ta husna, sai shagwob'ar tayi kewar su take, a k'arshe hadda fake promise na zuwanta cikin satikan da za'a shiga. 
   Saddiq driver ne ya kaisu don daga Abbie sai shi suka San gidan. 

   Ba k'aramin mamaki farouk yayi da ganin dank'areren gidan da aka kaisu aka ce nan ne gidan mahaifin shi ba. 
   A k'ofar gidan yayi parking suka futo. 

  Shi ya fara knocking, bayan few mint Zahra tazo tana tambayar "waye?". "Mune" farouk ya bata amsa. 

  Ai da sauri ta saki k'ofar ta daka tsalle ta rungume arfah har tana shirin kayar da ita. 
  Hararar ta farouk yayi yace, "meye haka da girman ki Zahra?"
  Sake ta tayi ta rik'o hannun shuraim kanta a k'asa tace, ",sannu da zuwa Yaya". 
   Da yauwa ya amsa kafun su rankaya zuwa cikin gidan. Komai na gidan gwanin burgewa, an tsara shi yadda zai k'ayatar. Tun a k'ofar parlour Zahra ta soma kwalawa su haseena da safiyya kira. 
     Ummie ce ta futo daga kitchen tana tambayar ta lafiya. Cikin farin ciki tace, "Yaya farouk ne da Auntie Fatima Suka zo". 
   Itama cikin farin ciki ta tarye su tana musu marhaba. 
    Arfah k'asan carpet ta zauna kanta a k'asa cikin jin nauyi ta soma gaishe ta. 
   Duk su Khadija futowa sukayi suma suka fara yi musu lale marhaba, bayan sun gaisa da mutanen gurin gaba d'aya an gama jin lafiyar juna, ummie ta d'ora da tambayar ta, "ya kika baro su sofiyyahn? Ya gajiyar tafiya kunsha Egypt". da Murmushi hallau a fuskarta tace, "lafiya qalou muka dawo ammie tace a gaishe ki". 
   "Aikuwa ina amsawa Masha Allah".  

   Sai a lokacin farouk shima daya zauna k'asan carpet ya fara gaishe da mahaifiyar tashi cikin so da k'auna. 
   Bayan sun gaisa ne yake tambayar ummie ko baffa yana nan? A'a baffanku ya futa d'aurin auren y'ar abokin shi maybe daga can zai huce gurin neman abinci, idan zaku kai dare ai har ya dawo". 
   Murmushi yayi yace, "ai ummie har kwana biyu ma zamuyi".  Sai a lokacin ummie ta tuna tace, "owk na gane d'azu baffan ku abinda yake nufi kenan, shiyasa bai damu ba ya futa yasan har zaku had'u". 
    Sunci gaba da hirar su shida mahaifiyar shi yana ta tambayarta lafiyar y'an uwa da abokan arzik'i, abun farin ciki ya taya murna, na mutuwa ko rashin dad'i yayi addu'a, wani kuma yayi dariya. 
   Arfah cikin dubara ta gudu daga parlon ta bi su zahra don basu dama su tattauna shida mahaifiyar shi da kyau, kuma itama zata fi sakewa idan bata gaban surukar uwar tata. 
   A d'akin su zahra ta ajiye jakar kayanta da gyalen ta kishin gid'a kan gado tana sauraron labarin da suke bata bayan dawowar su daga yola. 
   Da yake akwai su da barkwanci rabin hirar tasu dariya take bata. 
  Suna hirar Khadija ta zo mata da abinci da tea, shuraim da duk ya zama silently a gidan, ta d'ago kanshi tana tambayar, "ko zaka ci wani abu yanzu". Girgiza mata kai yayi tace, "bar abincin nan zuwa anjima maman shareefa muna karya kumallo muka futo daga gida". 
    Haseena tasa ta mayar da abincin kitchen suka ci gaba da hirar su arfah tana sauraron su, tun shuraim na d'ari d'ari da bak'unta har aka taso shareefa daga makaranta ya ware suna wasa. 
   A nan arfah tayi sallar azahar da la'asar, taci abincin amma ba mai yawa ba cox bata wani jin yunwa sosai. 
    Bata sake saka farouk a idanunta ba har dare lokacin da ummie ta shigo, azhkar d'in yamma da bata samu damar yi a yammacin ba takeyi "ooh! kin dai maida kanki bak'uwa k'arfi da yaji arfah". Murmushi tayi har ummien ta samu guri nesa da ita ta zauna tana yiwa shuraim wasa, banda dariya ba abinda yake yi yaron kamar ya dad'e da saninta, sai data gama hirar ta dashi sannan ta juyo ga mahaifiyar shi tace, "baffan ku ya dawo tun d'azu na d'auka ma farouk ya kira ki kunje kun gaisa, sai dana shiga yanzu naji yana cigiyar ki nasan baki je ba". 
  Babu komai a fuskarta tace, "ayyah bari naje mu gaisa dashi". Tana gama fad'in haka ta mik'e ta d'auki gyalen data zo dashi ta yafa, rik'e da hannun shuraim ummie tayi gaba ita kuma tabi bayanta. 
    Yana zaune kan k'atuwar darduma k'afafun shi duka biyu a tankwashe, gefen su kuma kwanukan abincin da suka ci ne shida tilon abokin d'an nashi, hira sukeyi akan abinda ya danganci su zahra, rabi ma complain yake yi mishi na dalilin da yasa aka tare su duk ba'a sallame su sun tafi bautar Allah ba. 
   Shi dai baffan sauraron shi kawai yake, kuma koda ya kai aya ma bai yi mishi wani dogon jawabi ba yace, "Zan duba Umar farouk kada kaji komai". 
   Daga nan hirar gidan da suke ciki ya d'auko mishi da aiki mai kyau da aka samar mishi, ko ba'a fad'a ba daga yanayin gidan ya fahimci an samu sauye sauye masu tarin yawa da ci gaba. Ummie tun da rana bata b'oye mishi komai ba ta fad'a mishi Abbie ne ya Samar musu da duk wannan ci gaban, the same with baffan shi don shima labarin tarin alkhairan da d'an uwan yayi mishi yake bashi kafun sallamar su ummie ta katse hirar. 
    Da gudu shuraim ya bar gurin ummie ya tafi ya rungume farouk yana tambayar shi, "Ina ka tafi Yaya tun d'azu ban ganka ba". 
   Cikin jin nauyin idanu hud'u da Suka zame mishi mashi a gurin ya ture yaron yana yi mishi fad'ar ya dinga nutsuwa. 
    Baffah ne ya kira shi, ya tashi da kyab'ab'b'iyar fuska irin ta kuka ya nufi gefen baffahn ya zauna. 

   Arfah kam a d'an d'arare ta zauna cikin jin nauyi ta gaishe da baffahn, ya amsa yana tambayar ta gajiyar hanya. 
   "Hanya alhamdulillah". 
 "Toh Masha Allah" ya fad'a with much caring. Shima sunyi hira kad'an kad'an dashi kafun tayi musu sallama ta futa, a nan tabar uban zance sarkin saurin sabo yana ta hira da baffah. 

  Koda ta koma wanka tayi ta shirya cikin riga da wando na bacci masu sakin jiki, ta shafe jikinta da lafiyayyun turarukanta ta d'ora k'aton hijab sannan ta futo parlour gurin su. 
   Kallo suke yi wani series da ake haskawa a tivi channel, khadeeja kuma tana aikin gyarawa shareefa kai, "sannunki da futowa matar big bro" zahra ta fad'a cikin barkwanci. 
   Murmushi tayi musu tace, "kuma sannun ku". "Wallahi kin ganmu mun mutu a wani jafanies series da akayi translating da harshen turanci". 
    Khadija da take gefe kamar ita ake bawa labarin ta amshe da fad'in, "ai kin banza ba, ni wallahi da in b'ata lokaci na wajen kallan wannan shirmen gwara inyi bacci sau goma". 
    Duk dariya sukayi, hassena tace, "Allah Auntie Khadija don bakya gani ne da baza kiso kiyi missing ba, itama Auntie Fatima kafun ta tafi zamu koya mata". 
  Da sauri Khadija tace, "Mee? Allah yayi mata tsari kuma addu'a nakeyi muku Allah ya yaye muku".
   Ita dai arfah dariya kawai tayi, ganin suna ta wasa firm d'in su yayinda Khadija kuma take ta kushewa sai tace, "toh ai kunsan kowa da ra'ayin shi, na fahimci maman shareefa in zaku kwana kuna yi mata bayanin kyau da tsaruwar firm d'in ku ba zata gane ba, kuma kuma ba zaku fahimci abinda take nufi ba gaba d'aya, Soo ba laifi bane kawai kowa da ra'ayin shine". 
   Hassena ce tace, "yauwa matar big Yaya kin fahimci abin a dai dai kuwa". 
    Zahra zatayi magana ummie ta k'araso parlon, "Wai ba zaku huce ku kwanta bane? Ku kalli lokaci fa". 
   Cikin kwantar da murya Zahra tace, "Auntie khadija muke tayawa hira tana yiwa shareefa gyaran kai mu kuma muna kallon maimacin wani firm". 
    Girgiza kai kawai ummien tayi tace da arfah, "toh ke dai kar kiyi musu kawaici Fatima da kin ji bacci dama kar ki jira su". 
    "Toh ummie" ta amsa mata cikin ladab.  Wani abu ta tsaya dubawa a parlon. 
  A haka farouk ya futo daga d'akin baffah sab'e da shuraim a kafad'a. Kusa da zahra ya tsaya yazo da zummar yin magana da arfah sai dai ganin ummie sai ya sauya akalar abinda zai fad'a gaba d'aya. 
   "Hassena ki kawo mun ruwa mai sanyi da marar sanyi guda biyar". Sai da ummie ta d'ago ta kalleshi jin abinda yace, cikin jin nauyi shi kam ya d'auki hanyar d'akin da yayi masauki ya shige. Mik'ewa Zahra tayi ummie ta dakatar da ita, "ke zahra barshi matarshi ta kai mishi". 
   Wani irin dumm arfah taji, sai ta kasa kwakkwaran motsi a gurin har saida ummie ta ce, "arfah akwai tray akan fridge ki d'auki ruwan ki Kai mishi". 
    Ita dai ba don ummie ce ta bata umarnin nan ba da ba abinda zai hana ta fuskewa, ga kunya ga biyayyah, a haka tayi duk abinda ummien ta umarce ta ta shiga k'ofar da taga ya shiga. Tak'aitaccen kallo ta yiwa d'akin ta gano shi zaune kan katifa ya kwantar da kanshi jikin gini. 
   A k'asa ta ajiye ruwan zata fuce, sai dai har ta kai k'ofa ya dakatar da ita da abinda yake fad'a, "ki sa su hassena su raka ki asa miki lallen da kitso gobe, sannan ki rage jin kunyar ummie she's your mum too". Bata iya amsa shi ba sai k'arasa fucewa da tayi. 
   Shi kuwa ajiyar zuciya ya sauke a hankali saboda asali shi ya futo daga d'akin baffah da niyyar kiran ta akwai maganar da zasu tattauna, sai dai ganin ummien shi da yayi a parlon duk sai ya daburce ya fake da wani abun daban, amma duk da haka ummie da saurin ranfo inda mutum ya dosa sai data fahimci arfahn yake nufi ta turo ta, shi kuma bazai iya rik'e ta da magana ummie da take parlour har ta zargi wani abu ba, ita ma kuma yasan ba zata tsaya suyi maganar data haura minti goma ba balle har ta fahimce shi. 

   Toh washe gari kuwa ko da hantsi ya d'aga haseena ce ta futa ta nemo mata wata y'ar nan anguwar da take yi musu k'unshin lokaci zuwa lokaci. Ita ta zana mata jan lallan zanan yayi kyau kamar a ciro shi, haka kitson ma k'anana aka yarfa mata, kasancewar a d'akin su zahra akayi mata lallen anan ta zauna har ya kama ta cire. 
    Yinin ranar kam bata ga farouk a cikin gidan ba, tasan watakila yaje gurin abokan shine da suke waccen tsohuwar anguwar tasu. 
    Ranar bai dawo ba saida ta gaji ta kwanta bacci ita da shuraim da har yayi bacci yana tambayarta "ina Yaya". Ummie kam fad'a tayi ta mishi akan dad'ewar da yayi daga bari yaje a gaisa, bai katse taba sai da ta gama tass sannan ya fad'a mata abinda ya tsayar dashi duk yinin. 
    Nan ya bata labarin kad'an daga ciki hadda na cewar da aka tab'a yi musu ya mutu. 
   Suna hira da ummie tasa aka kawo mishi abincin shi nan yaci, daga k'arshe tayi mishi sallama ta tafi d'akin ta. 


     Washe garin ranar da zasu tafi arfah tun da wuri ta gama shirin ta, dama shuraim tunda suka zo hidimar shi tabar kanta, su zahra suke ta nan nan dashi, sune mishi wanka, shirya shi da yi mishi kayan kwad'ayi iri iri. 
    K'arfe Sha d'aya da mintuna sukayi sallama da y'an gidan saddiq driver ya d'auke su sai gida. 




   _Toh fa!_

Page 77 _(seventy seven)_



 Ko a gidan ma ba kowa ne yasan sun dawo ba, saboda har kowanne a cikin su yayi nashi side basu had'u da kowa ba. Shuraim suna shiga d'akin ta dama yayi bacci, itama kwanciya tayi kusa dashi bayan ta rage kayan jikinta. 
   Baccin daya d'auke ta har kusan 2 hours bata tashi ba, saida ammie ta shigo da kanta ta tashe su, ita ta fara farkawa sannan shuraim da yake kusa da ita shima ya mik'e. 
   "Wane irin bacci ne haka babyy daga dawowa kamar wadda bata yi bacci a can ba". Bata ce komai ba saida ta shiga bathroom ta wanke fuskarta ta d'auro alwala ganin lokaci ya ja, a kusa da ammien ta zauna sannan ta soma gaishe ta. 
  Bayan sun gama gaisawa tace, "kiyi sallar ki d'auki abinci kici, shima mijinki ki kai masa nasa ko ba tare kuka dawo ba?"
  "A'a tare muka dawo". 
   "Oya hurry up k'arfe 3 dai guy nan yace fareeda zata zo". 
  Da toh ta amsa sannan ta kabbara sallarta, tana jin ammiey suna magana da shuraim da yake cikin giyar bacci, kafun ta d'auke shi su fuce tare.  
   
   Tana idar da sallar kuwa tayi duk abinda ammien ta umarce ta, a kitchen ta samu auntie Sarah tana girki Fahad kuma zaune kusa da ita yana ma babyn su wasa, "Laila majnu". Arfah ta fad'a cikin sigar zolaya, duk dariya sukayi Fahad yace, "Ina kika tafi kamar ba zaki dawo ba auntien shuraim". 
    Murmushi tayi tace, "gidan su Farouk lokacin da muka tafi nasan baku tashi ba shiyasa ba muyi sallama ba". 
   Fahad ne yace, "ayyah haka farouk d'in yake fad'a mun d'azu, fatan kun same su lafiya? Nima kafun na tafi zanyi k'ok'ari na shiga mu gaggaisa dasu duka". 
   "Lafiya alhamdulillah, gaskiya kam". 
  "Masha Allah", Sarah da take kallon su bata jin yaren b'ata fuska tayi cikin harshen Arab tace, "gaskiya nima ku koya mun yaren nan". 
    D'an dariya arfa tayi ta zo ta dafa shoulder ta tace, "ki zauna damu 4 good 1 year ni zansa kiji hausa tass!". Harararta tayi tace, "wato na zauna keda kina gidanki ma taya zaki koya mun dama dai ammiey kika ce"
  D'an zaro ido arfah tayi tace, "toh ni ina zanje kuma mie aunty aini ina nan tare da ammiena har sai bayan shekara". 
   Murmushi kawai sukayi mata suna ganin bata san ita nan da kwana 3 ma zata bar k'asar ba. 
   Sun ci gaba da hira jefi jefi kafun ta tuna abinda ya kawo ta, abincin ta d'iba plate biyu, sai data Soma ajiye nata a d'akin ta sannan ta d'auki nashi ta kai mishi, ya futo daga wanka kenan ta shiga, bata yadda ta sake kallon shiba har ta gama ajiye abincin ta fuce. 
   
Misalin k'arfe 3 muhsin da aunty da auntyn fareeda Suka iso gidan, a parlon ammie wannan karon suka sauka, kallo d'aya ammiey tayi musu ta gane suna cikin matsananciyar damuwa, da auntien fareeda kawai suke hira sama har Abbie ya k'araso. Bayan sun gaisa ya tambaye su, "ya kira ku kuwa?". 
   Girgiza kai sukayi gaba d'aya. Sun d'an zauna Jim kafun Abbie ya sake tambayar ammiey, "kin kira arfah?". 
   "Eh tana zuwa yanzu". 

  Tana rufe baki kuwa sai ga arfahn ta shigo. Kusa da k'afar Abbie ta zauna ta gaishe da aunty da Auntie, muhsin kad'ai ta kasa gaisarwa har saida ammiey tace, "baku gaisa da yayanki ba fa". 
   Cikin sanyin jiki dana murya tace, "Ina yini" ya amsa mata da, "lafiya ya kike" a tak'aice. K'asa k'asa tace, "Ina lafiya". 
  Basu wani jima sosai ba aka kira wayar muhsin da new number ya d'aga a d'arare. 
    "Muna k'ofar gida kazo kayi mana iso". Da sassarfa ya mik'e ya fuce da wayar a kunnen shi, sannu a hankali ya soma ratsa falukan gidan har ya futa harabar gidan. 
   Ta k'ofar get yabi yana addu'ar Allah yasa ba solah shi guy nan yayi ba a ranshi. 
   A jikin 🚕 taxi ya hango mutum tsaye, a d'an tak'aitaccen lokacin yayi karatun shi, fari ne kuma yana da tsayi sosai, bai cika jiki da yawa ba, sanye yake da riga da wando na shadda irin d'inkin y'an asalin k'asar Niger. Fuskarshi rufe da mask hannun shi duka biyu hard'e a k'irjin shi. 
   Daga nesa muhsin ya tsaya ya d'aga mishi hannu, Saida ya dudduba gefe da gefen inda muhsin d'in yake ya tabbatar shi kad'ai ne sannan ya bud'e gidan baya. 
   Yaro ya d'auko wanda zaiyi a k'alla 5 years ya dire shi kan k'afafun shi, wani ya sake cirowa wanda zaiyi kusan sa'an shuraim kafun wata mace itama ta futo sanye da doguwar riga y'ar turkey maroon tayi rolling kanta da gyalen rigar, rik'e da handbag ta Soma tura zungureren cikinta gaba, duk da fuskarta a rufe take da nikab amma kwayar idonta data futo ta cikin nikab d'in tarrr akan muhsin da yake tsaye inda yake. 
   Guy sallamar mai taxin yayi sannan ya rik'o hannun k'aramin suka soma tafiya a tare. 
   Abun ma mamaki ya ba muhsin don Sam bai d'auka zai ga bak'in nasu haka ba. Mik'awa muhsin hannu yayi a lokacin da yazo gab dashi. 
  Sai muhsin ya kasa bashi hannun saboda zuciyar shi data karye. Gaba yayi Suka bi bayan shi a nutse suna takawa har zuwa babban parlon gidan. 
  A nan ya kira Abbie ya sanar dasu bak'in sun k'araso. 
   Arfah ce ta Soma yin gaba sai ammiey da aunties, aka kira farouk da Fahad don su zamo shaidu, Abbie shine ya Zama k'arshen zuwa. Cikin su babu wanda ya iya zama duk suna tsaye cirko cirko. 
  Wadda basa raba d'ayan biyu fareeda ce tana zaune kan kujera ta kasa had'a ido da kowa. 
    Shi kuma guy dama bai zauna ba har saida Abbie ya k'arasa shigowa sannan ya durk'usa k'asa ya kasa d'ago kanshi shima. 
    Abbie ne ya umarce su dasu zauna. Duk suka zauna amma banda arfah data soma takawa har zuwa inda matar me nikab ke zaune. Cikin shammata ta d'age nikab da gyalen data yi rolling gaba d'aya. 
    Da sauri tayi baya tana nuna fareeda da hannunta.    Guy ne ya cire mask d'in fuskarshi take kuwa ya bayyana, duk ido suka zuba mishi da mugun shork, koda yake arfah dama ta fad'a, sai dai ya akayi ta sani.

   Da wani irin b'acin rai muhsin ya mik'e ya cakumo doctor shuraim yana kunfar baki, "Kai macuci maci amana, Kai har kana da bakin da zaka wani zo kana mu yafe ka bayan duk abinda kayi. Wallahi yau ba sai gobe ba zansa a kulle mun kai saika girbi abinda ka shuka banza butulu.....". Cikin muryar kuka doctor shuraim yace, "kada ka Zama k'aramin mutum muhsin, ka tuna da girman alk'awarin da kayi mun, wanda akan haka nazo gare ku yau na bayyana kaina". 
    Fahad ne da farouk suka tashi suka shiga tsakanin su suna bawa muhsin hak'uri.  
   Ganin muhsin na neman kiran police sai Abbie ya tashi da kanshi ya karb'e wayar hannun shi, "ka saurara muhsin, tabbas kayi alk'awarin ba zaka tab'a shigar da case d'inshi ga hukuma ba, idan rai ya b'aci hankali bai kamata ya gushe ba".

A shekarun baya can da dad'ewa, Allah ya jarabceni da mugun son fareeda,wadda tayi burus dani ta toshe duk hanyar da zanvi don na bayyana mata hakan, nasha zuwa k'ofar gidansu na zauna ta cikin glass a mota kawai don in tazo hucewa na hango ta, nasha nuna mata alamu a wasu lokutan amma duk ta share, ganin nayi iya bakin k'ok'arina kuma na kasa samunta sai kawai na tattara komai na ajiye, na fidda tsammani na daina yaudarar zuciyata na samu wata yarinya zan aura a rashinta, toh kwatsam a lokacin da ake maganar auren muhsin da arfah sai ga fareeda ta dawo gare ni akan na taimaketa akwai aikin da take son zata bani, fahimtar da tayi Ina sonta sai ta nuna zata amince da aurena, tayi rantsuwa ta d'au alk'awari. First I denied but due to I really love her madly kuma gashi tana gab da kufcemun sai na amince ba tare dana duba tarin alkhairan iyayen arfah ba. A lokacin fareeda har ta soma sakin jiki dani na yaudara, tana nuna mun so sosai kamar mun dad'e cikin soyayyar juna. ...... Daga nan ya d'ora da fad'a musu yadda akayi har ya had'a results d'in k'arya akan arfah.

Tace za'a gaggauta d'aura auren yayanta da arfah ne saboda iyayen arfah suna sonta ba zasu yi wani yink'uri da har wani zai fahimci gurb'ataccen k'aryar daka yi ba, sai dai abu na farko dana fara fahimta kafun aje da nisa, fareeda bata fad'a mun akwai guy da zata lik'awa kashin kaji wanda bai jiba bai gani ba sai ranar na gani da idona, kuma a take naga ammie ta aurar da ita ga saurayin wanda alamu suka nuna arfah bata sanshi ba ma a lokacin, sai dai alamu sun nuna akwai wata dangantaka da basu sani ba game da iyayensu b'oyayyiya. Na biyu korarta da ammiey tayi daga gidanta gaba d'aya, Sam ban d'auka hukuncin da zata yanke zai kai tsaurin haka ba. Na uku bayan komai ya faru ya k'are na gama cika mata aikinta, saina fahimci ashe akwai wani buri nata da take son cimma, tayi amfani dani ne kawai donta samu biyan buk'atar ta. Wanda daga bayan na d'auke ta take fad'a mun Ashe ita Fahad take so a lokacin. 
  A lokacin K'iri k'iri fareeda ta juya mun baya, ta daina d'aukar wayata gaba d'aya. Hakan yasa na soma bincike a b'oye na tura mata text wanda yake nuna b'acin rai akan abinda tayi mun nace babu ni babu ita tunda ita d'in maci amana ce, banyi mamaki don tayi mun haka ba tunda bata iya kyale k'awarta da suka taso tare ba, kamar dama abinda take so kenan ta dawo mun da text d'in ita dama ba Sona take ba nine Wawa Dana d'auka zata iya son mutum kamarni, me nake dashi da Zan iya rik'e ta ma..... maganganu dai marassa Dad'in ji wanda suka sa na kuma fusata da ita. 
    Tun lokacin da muhsin ya kaita guesthouse d'inshi naso zuwa na d'auke ta, sai dai tsaron da yake gidan da kuma wani tunani da nayi yasa na fasa. A ranar daya mayar da ita gida ni kuma a ranar na d'auke ta na b'oye a gidana ban yarda ta ganni ba har sai washe garin ranar da zamu bar k'asar na kawo mallam mansur ya d'aura mana aure, bayan na toshe bakin ta da muguwar barazana. Washe garin  kuma jirginmu ya d'aga sai Switzerland inda nayi PhD na. 
   Bansha wahalar samun aiki ba saboda ba laifi nasan mutane a asibin makarantar da nayi karatu. 
   Sam ban yiwa fareeda rik'on wulak'anci ba saboda sonta nake bilhak'k'i da duka zuciyata. Da abu d'aya na azabtar da ita nasan shine rashin barta ta mu'amulanci mutane, sai ince shekaru biyar zuwa shida da mukayi a can bata tab'a huld'a da kowa ba, kullum zan futa zan rufe ta a gida ita d'aya har na dawo, nasha wahala sosai kafun naci nasarar fara samun kanta duk da ba wai ta amince da rayuwa tare dani hundred% ba ni nayi mata dole. 
   Fareeda ta haifa mun d'an mu na fari daya ci sunan mahaifinta late alhaji..... Sai d'an mu na biyu da yaci sunanka alhaji jafar, sannan yanzu nan da 2 months zata haifa mana wani babyy....... Duk da Ina Switzerland amma kunnuwana sunfi biyar a Nigeria ta haka ne nake jin labarin mafi yawan abinda yake faruwa, nayi alk'awarin duk ranar da arfah ta dawo toh ranar zata ga iyayenta da y'an uwanta itama, ta samu y'ancin kanta har ma da yanke ma kanta hukuncin da taga yafi mata, kuma alhamdulillah gamu munzo gare ku da tarin tulin laifukan mu. Kuma ba nayi muku duk wannan bayanin don ku sake ganin bak'inta ba, A'a nayi hakane saboda Ni bana b'oye b'oye na fad'i laifina ma bare nata, saboda kawai ku yafe mu more especially mani da nafi kowa laifi......". 
   Ajiyar zuciya Abbie ya sauke mai tsayi yace, "toh yanzu mu me kake son muyi maka shuraim?". 
    "So nake ku yanke mun duk hukuncin da kuka ga ya dace dani". Murmushi Abbie yayi ya girgiza kanshi. 
    "Ni na yafe maka tuni shuraim saboda b'annarka ta wani b'angaren gyara ta zame mun, sai dai bansan ba ko baby tana rik'e daku a ranta har yanzu". Da sauri arfah ta d'ago kanta tace, "Ni na riga kowa ma yafe muku Ina ga, saboda makircin ku ya saita mun hanya mai kyau a rayuwa, kuka k'ara da bani babbar kyauta, saboda kina son Yaya fahad kika lik'a mun sharrin ciki? Thank God yau naji duk dalilin ki na wancen sharrin, sai dai ba'a je da nisa ba Allah ya kama ki, kika shiga jarrabawar rayuwa da wanda bakya so, baki tab'a dreaming kasancewa dashi ba, wannan kad'ai ma nasan yanzu ya Isa ya zame miki izinina, rayuwa da wanda baka so hummm, I Soo much pity you k'awata".
    Har lokacin fareeda jikinta a sanyaye yake ta kasa daina kuka bare ta d'ago ta had'a ido da wani a d'akin. 
   Abbie ne dai ya k'ara yin wani jawabin ya kuma karantawa shuraim irin girman kuskuren da yayi, kuma tabbas idan fareeda ta zab'i rabuwa dashi ba zasu tab'a k'in amincewa ba, Cox ya cutar da ita da yawa a zaman tirsasawar da sukayi tare. 

    Dole anan aka samu maslaha, Suka yafe mishi saboda albarkacin y'ay'a da suke tsakani, Abbie ya ajiye ta a gidan shi yace zuwa kwana biyu inta nutsu sai a kaisu suga mama ita da yaran, muhsin kam baiso haka ba, yaso a barshi ya tisa k'eyar d'an iska zuwa prison, ba don kwatar ma fareeda y'anci ba, a'a sai don a hukuntashi na cin amanar wanda suka yarda dashi. 

    Abbie yayi hamdala sun tashi lafiya, ammiey dama ita ta fara fucewa kafun ragowar su dinga zare jiki d'aya bayan d'aya suna barin gurin. 
    Shuraim ba don yaso ba yayi sallama dasu ya futo yana jinshi sakayau, daya sake bai nemi yafiyar wad'an nan bayin Allah ba wato da ya dinga shiga musiba kenan a rayuwa, saboda hak'k'in mutum ba kyau akan mutum Allah ma baya yafewa sai in mutum ne ya yafe da kanshi.

Kwanan fareeda biyu a gidan amma tun ranar da tazo gidan bata sake ganin arfah ba, koda yake ita kanta b'oye kanta take saboda kunyar mutanen gidan more especially arfah da ammiey. Tasan ta cutar dasu ba kad'an ba, tunda ta silar abinda ta aikata ammiey har barin Nigeria tayi na a k'alla shekaru biyar kwarara, gashi yanzu ita bata san abinda zata yanke ma rayuwarta ba, Abbie ya bata kwana biyu zuwa uku tayi tunani, idan har ta amince taci gaba da zama da mijinta da yaranta toh shikenan, idan kuma bata buk'atar ci gaba da zama dashi toh zasu raba auren, sai dai kamar yadda shuraim ya buk'ata zasu bashi yaran shi duka har wanda zata haifa zai koma hannun ubanshi bayan shekaru biyu inda rai da numfashi. 
    Abubuwa da yawa sun cakud'e mata a lokacin, a haka dai ta tattara ta suka tafi gidan su ita da yaran. 
   A can ma ba k'aramin danbarwa akayi tsakanin ta da muhsin ba, wanda a k'arshe dole Auntie ce ta shiga tsakani ta dinga bawa muhsin hak'uri ya barta a gidan. 
    Mama kam farin ciki tayi da ganin last born d'inta. Ta rame tayi bak'i amma ta sake haske, sai dai babu nutsuwa a tare da ita ko taro. 



    Toh ta b'angaren Arfah kuwa a kwana na uku gidan su shamsudden suka wuni, suma gidansu mai kyau irin tsarin gidan su Farouk sak da sak. Sunyi murna, sunyi farin ciki kuma sunji dad'i da wannan ziyarar bazata tasu Arfah. 
   Rana ta hud'u da dawowar fareeda ammiey ta shiryawa Arfah kaya tunda wuri, tasa farouk ya shirya nashi, saddiq driver yazo ya d'auki jakunkunan ya zuba a boot. Ita dai arfah cikin rashin fahimta ta dinga kallon ammiey da Abbie a lokacin da suke yi mata wani jirkitaccen bayani, "auntyn ku Husna da Uncle suna can suna jiranku akwai inda zasu aike ku, amma kafun nan shuraim zai zauna damu". 
   Ita dai cikin rashin fahimtar komai tayi sallama da dukkannin su da sukayi mata rakiya harabar gidan. Ko bayan ta shiga mota kallon su ta dinga yi tana d'aga musu hannu har suka fuce a gidan. 
   Sun d'auki hanya kowa na kallon gefen window sai farouk dakan juyo lokaci bayan lokaci ya kalle ta da yatsun hannunta da sukayi maroon ta tallabe hab'arta dasu suna ta shining.

Page 78 _(seventy eight)_



 Har suka isa babu cikakkiyar magana ko kallo mai kyau tsakanin su, sunyi mamakin yadda saddiq driver ya san gidan Uncle. 
   Yana gama yin parking arfah dama ta shiga gidan da gudu gudu sauri sauri tana kwala kiran, "Auntie husna! Suhail". Da sauri Auntie husna ta soma saukowa k'asa cikin farin cikin ganinta tace, "kamar wanda suka taho akan iska? Gaskiya kunyi saurin zuwa..... Ina farouk d'in". Ita kuwa Arfah saroro ta tsaya tana kallon ta da mamakin yadda akayi tasan da zuwan su, "Ina tambayar ki Ina mijin naki kuma?". 
    Cikin mamakin daya gaza b'oyuwa a fuskarta tace, "Auntie dama kinsan da zuwan mune? Nifa nan surprising naki na so yi". 
   D'an dariya auntien tayi ta mata side huge tace, "Allah ke dai baby bansan ranar da zaki girma ba". 
   Tana kallon idon auntien tace, "I'm serious Auntie nazo da Shirin baki mamaki ke sai kika bani". 
   Girgiza kai Auntie husna tayi ta huce ta ta karb'i jakar kayan hannun farouk suka gaisa kuma. 
   Ta futa sun gaisa da saddiq ma tayi mishi ya hanya, farouk taba key d'in sitting room ya bud'e mishi ya shiga, abinci da abinsha tasa duk aka Kai mishi kafun lokacin da zai koma in ya gama hutawa. 
    A nan parlour suka zauna, Arfah sai tambayar su suhail take, kusan sau uku Auntie husna tana fad'a mata sun tafi school har ta gaji ta daina bata amsa ma. 
    "Farouk yasu mamanku ya shuraim?" Husna ta tambaye shi ganin yayi shiru, da Murmushi saman fuskarshi sosai yace, "alhamdulillah suna lafiya lou". 
    
    Sunyi hira tare anan parlon, Husna ta gabatar musu da duk abinda ta tanada domin su.

Y'an nasihohine dai da ban hak'uri a fakaice duba da yanayin zamanta da mijinta. Har fad'a tayi mata akan abinda takeyi wanda ya maida ita ta zamo kamar ba wayayyiyar mace me aji ba, tun Arfah na jin Auntien kawai har abinda take fad'a ya soma shiga kunnanta da kanta sosai, taji naseehar har ta k'udiri niyyar gyara kuskurenta. 
   Taso taji abinda ake ciki game da karatun ta sai dai Auntie husna bata fad'a mata komai akai ba, hakan yasa tayi alkunya ta share itama. 

   Sun rabu inda Auntie husna ta umarceta akan ta shirya cikin minti goma ta sauko k'asa tana jiranta, a bathroom d'in Auntien Arfah tayi sabon wanka, tayi mamakin ganin sabuwar doguwar riga ta atamfa Holland da gyale da takalmi da jaka har da innerwears data futo.

    Sharp sharp ta shirya, tayi d'aurin ta dass gwanin ban sha'awa da burgewa, kayan kamar anyi measuring d'inta. Tun data soma saukowa farouk yake kallonta bai d'auke idon shi ba kuma har tazo ta gifta ta gabanshi, a gaban Auntie husna ta tsaya ta wara hannaye tace, "thanks alot mie Auntie Allah ya k'ara rufa asiri, kayan nan sunyi mun, haka d'inkin ma..... Gaskiya naji dad'i kuma na gode". 
     Kamo hannunta tayi tace, "you don't have to worry dear, mijinki yana jiranki tare zaku futa". 
    Sake hannun Auntien tayi ta matsa baya kad'an tana jiranshi, sallama yayi ma Auntie husna yayi gaba itama tayi mata sallamar tabi bayan shi duk da batasan inda zasu je ba.

   Farouk ma kewayo wa yayi yazo saitin inda take ya kamo tafin hannunta ya had'e cikin nashi, a nutse kuma suka shiga takawa suna nufar cikin gidan bakinsu d'auke da sallama.

Gyad'a musu kai arfah tayi ta zame hannunta ta k'arasa gurin su don a gaisa, shikam farouk jikin tsohon d'akin da suka zauna mai tsohon tarihi yaje ya tsaya yana kallon d'akin, daga labulen jikin window yake iya fahimtar d'akin ya kasance a rufe tsawon lokaci. 
  Mukullin da auntie husna ta bashi ya zaro a aljihu ya bud'e d'akin sai dai bai shiga ba ya tsaya yana jiran Arfah.
    Ita kuwa gaisawa tayi dasu hadda zama a gurin da suka bata cikinsu, zainab ce jam'iar  bayarwa a siyo mata pure water. Bayan sun gaisa suke tambayarta, "sai kuma kuka b'ace b'at bake ba farouk bare hajiya husna data tafi dake tare da mijinta a sume, laah baiwar Allah me kika haifa ma". 
   Murmushi Arfah tayi ta duk'ar da kanta, "namiji ne yaci sunan farouk". 
   Mama saratu ce tace, "ooh ikon Allah kuma kuna garin nan dama amma ko ki kawo mana shi wata rana a gaisa mu ganshi, kinsan fa munso zuwa duba ki asibiti, toh matsalar bamu San a asibitin da aka kwantar dake ba, sannan bamu san gidan da hajiya husna suka sauya ba, shikenan tafiya ta mik'a kuma..... Musab yazo nemanku keda mijinki sau ba adadi, haka wani me suna Salman da yace shi abokin farouk ne, Kai da yawan sufa su alhaji Usman, alhaji asheer duk suna zuwa nemanku ruwa a jallo ke har gwawwo da wasu mata"

    In short Arfah tayi musun tak'aitaccen bayanin abinda ya faru, anan sukaji dangantakar ta da Husna. Sun sake raina kansu matuk'a don sun gane ita d'in da gaske k'addara ce ta jeho ta ta rayu a cikin su irin rayuwar su.

   Daga jikin k'ofa ta tsaya tana k'arewa komai kallo, k'ura fututu ba'a iya gane asalin colour komai. 
   Komai daya faru dasu daki daki ya soma dawo mata tun daga parkon zuwansu gidan har zuwa kan rikitacciyar rayuwar da suka gudanar a tsakiya kafun daga k'arshe su fahimci juna su k'are a yima junanshi wani bala'e'een sooo. 
   Cikin sanyi da taushin muryarta tace, "me yasa ka kawo ni nan". 
  Ba tare daya kalleta ba saboda kusan abu iri d'aya suke tunani a lokacin yace, "saboda nan shine mafarin mu, nan shi ya had'a mu ya bamu kusanci ya bamu hope, tun muna rayuwa a bai bai har muka dawo dai dai, sannan duk mutanen da muka sani a garin nan da zamu fara zuwa musu nan shiya had'a mu dasu. Nan shiya bamu babbar kyautar da muke alfahari da ita cikin soyayyah wato shuraim". 
   Taku biyu yayi zuwa gabanta ya tsaya daf da ita yana kallon cikin kwayar idonta, "can you remember? Baby can you remember how we ruin our lyf here in different ways, happiness sadiness and oll dat come over us? Tabbas Bazan tab'a manta gidan nan ba har k'arshen numfashi na".

   Ita dai arfah tana binshi da kallon mamaki, kwalalo ido tayi ganin ya zare wandon ma ya rage daga shi sai boxer, "ki tura k'ofar kada wani ya shigo mana unexpected". A sanyaye Arfah ta maida k'ofar ta rufe tana jiran taga abinda zaiyi, shi kuwa abubuwan da suke buk'ata masu tsohon tarihi ya soma bankad'owa yana goge su yana tarawa a tsakiyar parlon, Arfah tun tana tsaye tana kallon shi har taga bari ta taimaka don suyi su gama kada aikin yayi mishi yawa. 
   Ko kaya kala d'aya basu d'auka ba, amma har abun busar da inno ta tab'a bashi farkon ganin shi da ita lokacin da sukaje d'aurin auren Salman yola bai bari ba. 
    Bayan sun kammala Arfah karkad'e jikinta da jikin rigar ta da ya lik'e da k'urar d'akin ta soma. 
   Ganin ta tak'ark'are tana ta k'ara wata akan wadda take jiki, sai farouk yayi murmushi ya matso ta bayanta ya ja zip d'in rigar k'asa, da sauri ta wani irin zabura tana kallon shi, shima cikin kallonta yace, "ki bari na taimaka miki". Girgiza mishi kai tayi cikin shagwob'arta tace, "a'a nidai ka barshi.....". Bai saurare taba ya jawo ta jikin shi ya zare mata rigar tana mita tana komai, ganin ta dawo daga ita sai half vest da three quater wando sai ta ware d'ankwalin ta da sauri ta kare jikinta. Shi kam farouk hankie ya dauraye ya goge mata k'urar da dabara. Mik'a mata rigar yayi, tana zunb'ura baki gaba ta mik'o hannu da nufin karb'a. Aikuwa ya jawo ta jikinshi gaba d'aya, "Ni ka kyaleni wai meye haka kake yi". 
   Hannu ya d'ora kan lips d'inta ya murza cikin muryar rad'a yace, "shhhh! Niba wani abu zanyi miki ba kawai ina son naji dalilin da yasa ake wani shashshareni ana jamun aji, bayan ajin ya dad'e da tsinkewa ma tuni". 
   Kuka ta sanya mishi tana k'ok'arin raba jikinta da nashi tace, "Ni fushi nakeyi da kai ka rabu dani .....". Murmushi ya sakeyi na gefen baki yace, "toh fa! Fushin me akeyi dani kuma? Me nayi miki babbyna". 
   Sake b'ata face tayi tace, "Ni ka rabu dani kawai bazan sake yarda ka had'a jikinka da nawa ba.....". 
   Y'ar k'aramar dariya ce tazo mishi amma sai ya danne yaci gaba da binta yadda take so, "kiyi hak'uri amma na gane abinda kike nufi ma, sannan wannan maganar da kike yi tatsuniya ce, koda yake nasan kin samu kwarin gwiwar fara karanta wannan tatsuniyar ne duba da yadda kika ga muna zaune a yanzu, sai dai abinda ya kamata ki tuna shine, shin da kika ji d'aci a ranki a lokacin ko sau d'aya kin tab'a tuna shin nima lokacin da nake rayuwa dake a wannan d'akin cikin wane yanayi na dinga rayuwa? Shin baki san mace zata iya jure komai fiye da namiji ba? Babyy ba sai na bud'e miki komai dalla dalla ba amma Ina son ki tuna kiyi mun adalci da kanki, wallahi nasha kwana a zaune ko a lokacin da bama tare dake, saboda garkuwar jikina ya kasa sabawa da rashin ki, babby ina jin ninkin abinda kika ji a wancan d'an tak'aitaccen lokacin ninkin yadda kike ji ko a yanzu". Shiru tayi cikin zuciyarta ta aminta da abinda yake fad'a, ta tabbatar iya gaskiyar shi kenan? Sannan ta sake yin karatu mai yawa ko a maganar shi ta yanzu, cikin sanyin muryarta da taushi tace, "kayi hak'uri". 
  "Umm umm ni ya kamata na bada hak'uri saboda ni nayi laifin asali, ki gafarceni". 
    Janye jikinshi yayi ya soma mayar mata da rigar, "na kasa fahimtar abinda yasa su ammiey suke nisan tamu, duk da ko basuyi haka ba mu zamu iya yi muddin sun kasance a tsakiya, but still ban fahimta ba kamar suna tsoron ma mu keb'e da juna fa". 
   Murmushi ya mata hallau yace, "Ni nasan dalilin kuma zan fad'a miki idan kin tuna mun gobe insha Allah". 
    Daga haka Shirin su suka k'arasa, Suka futo kusan tare. Farouk ya rufe d'akin. Suka yiwa mutanen gidan sallama da zasu tafi ya ajiye musu kud'i masu yawa. Har sunkai soro wata mace ta futo da gudu tana kiran "Fatima, Fatima"
    Tsayawa Arfah tayi tana kallonta, da kyar ta iya gane ta cikin mabayyanin mamaki tace, "nabeela?". Kuka matar ta soma cikin muryar kukan kuma ta soma maganarta, "wayyoh Allah na Fatima ki yafe mun, na cutar dake da sharrance sharrancena wanda duk suka k'are mun a kaina. Akwai wani abu daya faru can da dad'ewa kin dawo makaranta da rana wata mace ta futo daga d'akin ki gurin mijinki zaki iya tunawa? Toh ba kowa bace nice, kuma ko y'an gidan nan basu sani ba saboda gidansu k'awata naje na karb'i kayanta na shirya kuma na b'oye duk yadda ba za'a gane niba bare watarana su tonan asiri kiji, kuma a lokacin abinda nayi duk plan ne hasalima shi kanshi farouk bai San na shiga d'akin ba har na futo.... Sannan nice dai na had'awa rahama da mijinta irin wannan makircin har aurenta ya kusa mutuwa, Ni yanzu bansan Ina ganta ba ma bare na nemi yafiyarta .......". Sai ta sake fashewa da wani sabon kukan tana juya kai. 
   Arfah kam girgiza kai tayi da zuciya d'aya tace, "ba komai Nabeela na yafe miki". 
   Ko data gama fad'in haka bata jira sake jin komai ba suka yi gaba ita da mijinta Suka barta a nan. 
  Daga nan gidan su mus'ab sukayi direct, da yake babanshi ba b'oyayye ne a anguwar ba, basu Sha wahala ba Suka gane gidan. 
   Nan ma ba k'aramin mamakin ganin su akayi ba, sunci sa'a sun had'u da mus'ab da dawowar shi kenan daga aiki. Ba inda bai nuna su an gaisa a cikin gidan ba, har alhajin su daya dinga yiwa farouk fad'an meyasa baya zuwa a gaisa lokacin da yana zaune gidanshi na zoo road, ai da an taimaka maka da abubuwa da yawa, shima kuma dama abinda ya hana shi zuwan kenan, yasan wata d'awainiyar tasu zasu sake d'ora mishi bawan Allah. 
   Ko bayan sunyi sallama da nan, gidan gwaggwo sukaje, aikuwa nan ma aka rikice da wata hirar, Salman yana kasuwa bai dawo ba amma saida gwaggwo tasa Sarah ta kira musu shi. Aikuwa ba b'ata lokaci ya rufe shago ya taho, hak'ik'a wad'annan mutane sunyi farin ciki da ganin su kuma sunji dad'i kwarai, in short Suka basu labarin kad'an daga abinda ya faru da kuma tarihin su dana aurensu a tak'aice, daga gwaggwo har Salman saida suka jinjina al'amarin ubangiji da hukuncin Allah mai yin yadda yaso a lokacin da yaso. 
   Sun taya su murna da had'uwa da iyayensu lafiya da kakarsu ma'abociyar nutsuwa dattako da halin kwarai, basu bar gidan ba sai yamma liss da alk'awarin zasu sake zo musu zuwa na musamman sannan watak'ila ma anan garin kano zasu ci gaba da zama saboda karatun Arfah, sai a nan Arfah taji halin da ake ciki game da makarantarta. 
   Tare da Salman suka tafi, farouk da Salman gaba ita kuma a baya. Gidan alhaji Usman suka je, nan ma sun d'an jima ana gaisawa kafun su k'are a gidan alhaji asheer don alhaji Usman ya tabbatar musu da yana neman farouk ruwa a jallo. 
   A sitting room ya sauke su duka, ba k'aramin mamakin ganin farouk yayi ba. 
   Shima bayan sun gaisa uzurun su Suka kawo mishi,  kuma ya aminta dasu kwarai, yayi mishi bayanin shagon shi yana nan an ajiye yaro mai Amana irinshi yana kula masa da komai, ribar da aka samu a shekaru uku kuwa tana da matuk'ar yawa, yana da kyau ya samu lokaci ayi lissafi, sun rabu a k'arshe kan nan da wata d'aya zai zo suyi magana da kyau in sun samu nutsuwar gurin zama. 
    

                @@@@@@


A matuk'ar gajiye suka dawo gidan, lokacin da suka shiga su suhail sun dawo school aikuwa suna ganinta suka nufe ta da gudu suna ihun murnar ganinta. 
   Itama cikin jin dad'i ta rungume su tana dariya. A haka farouk ma ya shigo, sai kuma suka bar gurinta sukayi kanshi shima. 
    Shamsudden da yake zaune saman kujera ne yace, "barkan ku da zuwa, kuce yau muna da manyan bak'i".
   Da fara'a a fuskarta ta k'arasa ta zauna kan d'aya daga kujerun parlon suka gaisa. Farouk ma zama yayi rik'e da hannun mammie data dame su da labarin shuraim ya b'ata wai, Abba yace baisan inda yake ba bare ya d'auko musu shi. 
   Daga kitchen Auntie husna ta futo rik'e da tray na abinci ta ajiye musu a tsakiyar su, "sannun ku da zuwa wannan tafiya haka kamar ba zaku dawo yau ba, sai tunanin ko kunci abinci nake". 
   "Aikuwa bamu ci komai ba, don gwaggwo ba yadda batayi damu akan fura ba, toh gwara ni za'a ce ma tunda nasha ludayi biyu, shikam abu shuraim bai yi ko 1 cokali ba". 
    Bai ce mata komai ba amma har ranshi yaji sunan data kira shi, da auntie husna suka yita hira tana cin abincin har ta kammala, shi kam farouk tare da shamsudden dasu suhail sukaci suna ta bashi labarai kala_kala. Sai suka fi sakewa dashi fiye da Arfah ko don ita a baya ba zama a cikinsu ta fiya yiba. 
    A nan suka yita hirar su har aka kira magrib su farouk sukayi masjid ita kuma tabi bayan Auntie husna upstairs, a can tayi sallar kuma bata sake saukowa ba sai bayan isha'i, lokacin uncle ya dawo taje suka gaisa dashi. 
   9:00pm ta koma d'akin Auntien, yanzun ma doguwar riga ta tarar mai matuk'ar kyau a gefen bed sabuwa. Ita fa ta kasa fahimtar dalilin da yasa Auntie take takura kanta da bata sababbin kayan nan bayan ammiey jaka guda ta had'a mata na kayan sawa, jakar ma k'arshe K'iri k'iri an hanata don k'arfin hali. 


                  ************


Washe gari tun da asubah data tashi bacci bata koma ba tayi wanka ta mayar da atamfarta ta jiya ta gyara d'akinta ta sauko k'asa. Akace duk sammakon ka wani a tafe ya kwan, auntie husna tuni tayi kane kane tana aikin had'a musu break. Bayan sun gaisa taso ta kama mata aikin Amma tak'i a cewarta sam wannan d'anyen aikin ba da ita ba sa amarya aiki. Dariya tayi tace, "Auntie ke kam bakya gajiya da shiga kitchen, ko lokacin da nake gidan nan fa da an neme ki an rasa to kina kitchen". 
   Itama Husna dariyar tayi, mutane da yawa suna fad'in haka ita ma kuma ta sani, tana son aikin girki ko a gidansu shine favorite aikin ta. 
    
   Kujera taja ta zauna, tana tayata hira tana shan tea har ta gama, ita ta tayata ta jere su a dinning. 

   Su suhail ne suka soma karyawa bayan ta shirya su cikin school uniform, ta had'a musu lunch box, ita zata tafi sauke su a school Arfah ta takura mata akan dole ta barta akan ita zata kaisu. 

    Tana ajiye su ta dawo, duk jama'ar gidan sun futo yin break lokacin. Da fara'ar Aunty husna tace, "gata ma har ta dawo". "yanzu nake ba mijinki hak'uri akan futarki babu neman izinin shi, gaba d'aya na manta sai da kika tafi na tuna wallahi". 
   Murmushi Arfah tayi ta nemi guri ta zauna tana fad'in, "toh ai mie Auntie nasan indai kece babu matsala kota b'angaren shi shiyasa". 
   "Abinda nima na fad'a mata kenan babyy, ba wani abun damuwa da lallai sai an fad'a mun". 
    Shamsudden ne yace, "wannan haka yake kam Auntie husna, barka da safiya matar bro fatan kina lafiya". 
   Ya k'are maganar da gaishe da Arfah. Cikin fara'a tace, "lafiya alhamdulillah shamsuddeni fatan kaima haka". 
   Sun ci gaba da hira cikin barkwanci har itama taci sandwich kad'an ta kora da tea shima kad'an. 
   Shamsudden ya fuce aiki ita kuma ta koma masaukinta donta shirya, yanzun ma kamar jiya Auntie husna ta futo mata da sabuwar shadda riga da skirt d'inkin kamar anyi measuring d'inta dai dai da dai dai. 
   Sai data sake kallon kanta a mirror bayan ta gama shiryawa, ta fahimci yauma futa zasu yi don ga jaka da takalmi da gyale nan a gefen kayan. Ita har yanzu ta kasa fahimtar dalilin da yasa tunda Auntie ta d'auke jakar kayanta ta hanata har yau, sai dai komai ta kawo mata sabo dal. 
    Tun data soma saukowa Auntie husna ke fad'in, "Masha Allah babyy kinga kyaun da kika yi kuwa?" Farouk ma abinda yace kenan, sai Suka sata jin kunya ma. 
   Murmushi tayi kanta a k'asa har ta sauko gaba d'aya, jakar kayanta ta gani a hannun Auntie husna shi ma farouk rik'e yake da tashi jakar ya shirya cikin irin shaddar jikinta exactly ma, shima tayi mishi kyau kwarai. 
   Tare suka futa harabar gidan da Auntie husna, ita ta bud'e musu motar da zasu fita a ciki ta sa Suka shiga back seat suka zauna, ita kuma ta juya tana waya. 
   Cikin son sanin abinda yake faruwa Arfah ta tambayi farouk, "ba komawa gida zamuyi ba? ko wani gurin daban zamu sake tafiya kuma". 







    _Kuyi hak'uri naso muyi completing a cikin satin nan, amma saboda uzururruka na hakan bazai yiwu ba, Ina matuk'ar baku hak'uri mu had'e a filin Sharhi bayan sallah_.

Page 79 _(seventy nine)_


_second to de last page_




 Uncle abdussamad ne shima ya futo cikin shiri, sun gaisa dashi kamar koda yaushe kafun ya shigo motar shima, Auntie husna ce take driving shi kuma yana gefenta, hira sukeyi wadda ta shafe su har suka Isa airport. Abun ya matuk'ar girgiza Arfah da farouk, ko a mafarki basu d'auka inda zasu je kenan ba. Sai kawai suka saki baki a lokacin da uncle ya mik'o musu passport nasu. Ganin ba wanda yayi yink'urin mik'o hannu domin ya karb'a a cikin su sai yace, "tafiya ce Abbie ya shirya muku zuwa Dubai ku huta na wata guda sai ku huce saudiyyah inda zaku had'u dasu gaba d'aya kuyi umrah". 
    A kunyace farouk kam ya karb'a, ita kuma Arfah cike da tsananin farin cikin bazatar ta mahaifinta, duk da bata wani nuna ba a fuskarta amma taji dad'i aynun. 
    Sun rabu da Auntie husna da uncle cikin jimantawa da kewar juna da zasu yi. 
    Ko bayan tafiyar su Auntie husna basu jima sosai ba aka soma screening suka shirya cikin jirgi aka keta sararin samaniya dasu. Karo na farko a tarihi da farouk ya tab'a yin tafiya a jirgi, yayi k'ok'ari kam don bai yarda an gane yanayin daya tsinci kanshi ciki ba na rud'ani, ya dai rik'e hannun Arfah Gam cikin nashi yana jin yadda d'umin tafin hannunta ke shigar shi. 
    Sun sauka a Dubai cikin aminchi a Hamad international airport dake qatar, tafiyar data d'auke su hour 6 da minti sittin cif ba tsaye_tsaye. 
   Basu sha wahalar samun taxi ba Cox arfah tasan garin, katin hannunta ta duba taga address na hotel d'in da akayi musu booking, Golden ocean hotel 🏨. Card d'in ta nunawa driver, without any waste of time ya kaisu har hotel din. 
   Bai San hanyar da tabi ta biya taxi drivern ba, duk da yaga guy d'in kamar bak'ar fata d'an k'asar su. 
   Basu sha wahala wajen karb'ar key da gane d'akin ba saboda Abbie yasa an gama shirya musu komai, hatta parks da restaurant d'in da zasu futa cin abinci in sun so an shirya musu. 
    D'akin tabi da kallo a lokacin data zauna kan sofa tana bin komai na d'akin da kallo, simple bedroom ne mai d'auke da Italian bed da plasma tv da dispenser, sai drowers left and right masu d'auke da bed side lamp da aka k'awata su kwarai, dogon glass wanda yake tsaye garai kana iya hango cikin garin daga inda kake yana kallon cikin d'akin. Babu cupboard sai wani d'an well design d'aki k'arami da zaka iya ajiye kayan ka kafun lokacin da zakayi balaguro tunda hotel dai kam ba tabbataccen gurin zama ba. 
  Farouk ma gefenta ya zauna yana kallon yadda zanen lallen ta ya sake futowa kamar a d'aye zanen daga jikinta sai shek'i da walk'iya yake, wato komai ya rab'i jikinta kyau yake mata. Ya fad'i hakan a zuciyar shi, ita kam a nata b'angaren d'an k'aramin tunani ta tafi kafun mik'ewar farouk ya ankarar da ita ta dawo hayyacinta, kallon juna sukayi lokaci guda Suka sakarma juna murmushi mai k'ayatarwa. 
   Bathroom yayi ya had'a ruwan wanka mai kyau, ya bud'e jakar kayanshi ya ciro sabon towel fari k'al ya koma, k'asa da minti 15 ya futo d'aure da towel d'in iya k'ugu da alwala don sauke farali. 
   Da sauri Arfah ta d'auke idonta bayan cikakken kallon second biyar da tayi mishi. Bata ce dashi komai ba ta d'auki nata towel d'in ta fad'a bathroom itama, wanka tayi mai kyau ta d'auro alwala duk da tana cikin menstruation ta yafo gyalenta akan d'aurin k'irjin da tayi da pitch towel ta futo hannunta d'auke da kayan su da suka cire a ciki. 
   Yana zaune gefen bed sanye da jallabiyyah milk gogaggiya sai tashin lafiyayyen k'amshi yake. Daga nesa dashi ta tsaya ta ciro manta lotion ta soma shafawa, don ya bata damar sakewa ta shirya yadda ya kamata sai ya juya mata baya yana danne danne a wayarshi, bayan ta gama shafe ko'ina na jikinta da had'ad'd'iyar khumrar ta da mom ta had'a mata, kayan da zata saka ta soma dubawa, sai dai ga mamakinta duk ciki babu irin kayan da take tsammanin samu, tarin kayan da mom ta siya Mata a Alexandria ne cike da jakar kayan nata. Kenan ammiey kayan data had'o mata kenan a matsayin kayan sawa? Sai kawai ta koma gefe ta zauna ta zabga uban tagumi tana tunanin yadda zata saka irin wad'annan kaya a matsayin dawwamammun kayan sawarta har na tsawon one month, to ya kenan idan zasu futa? Da irin kayan da zata futa kenan don tak'amar kawae zata saka hijab. 
   Ci gaba da zama tayi har farouk ya gaji da jiran tsammanin shirinta ya juyo ya kalleta duk data juya mishi baya, "waiting for what kuma? Ni na d'auka ma kin shirya mu tada sallar ga muktarin magrib yana gab da shigowa". 
   Ba tare data waiwayo ta kalle shiba tace, "ba kayan sawa kuma ma kayi sallarka kawae". Bai gane abinda take nufi ba sam don haka ya mik'e ya k'araso gabanta a nutse, "babie kiyi mun dallah dallah, kince ba kaya to wannan kayan na hannunki kuma na meye, sannan ita sallar....." Bai k'arasa ba saboda wani abu daya tuna, sai ya zuba mata ido kawai yana kallonta kallo irin na tsaf da tsanaki. 
    Duk da bata kallonshi hakan bai hana kaifafan idanun shi tasiri a cikin zuciyarta dama gangar jikinta baki d'aya ba. Shikam barin gurin yayi ganin lokaci yana tafiya, har ya kabbara sallah yaji alamun kamar ana knocking, sai ya tafi ya bud'e, as he expect abinci ne aka kawo musu ba tare da sunyi oder ba, Wanda yake cikin na k'a'idar kud'in da akayi settling na komai da komai ne. 
   Ko bayan ya ajiye abincin sallolin shi ya gabatar har magrib, bai tashi a sallayar ba saida yayi addu'o'i masu yawa. Tana kishingid'e kan gado ta rufe har tafin k'afarta da zunbulelen hijabinta tana ta kiciniyar had'a sim d'in k'asar donta kira su ammiey da baffah ta sanar dasu sun iso lafiya. 
   Kan darduma ya zauna ya soma duba abiciccikan, madrouba, kousa mahshi, sai rice and stew with fresh milk drink and chicken recipe, biyu a ciki kam zasu iya ci, amma ragowar biyun bai tab'a d'and'ana ko ganin ire iren su ba. 
   "Arfah me kike yi ne? Ya kamata kibar komai muci abincin nan first". 
   Ajiye wayar tayi a bedside ta nufo shi a hankali ta samu kusa dashi ta zauna. 
    Babu wanda ya iya cin wani abincin kirki a cikin su, saboda gajiya da kuma kasalar data dabaibaye su gaba d'aya. Suna gamawa dama farouk ya gyara gurin ya gabatar da isha'i da shafa'i da wuturi. Tana nad'e cikin bargo yanzun kam ta rufe idonta tana sauraron yadda yanayin zazzab'i ke bin each and every part of her yana ragargaza ta. Gefen ta farouk ya zauna ya zura k'afafun shi cikin bargon ya d'ora hannun shi forehead d'inta, akwai zafi kad'an, "dama baki da lafiya kika yi shiru?". Ya tambayeta da kulawa
   Mikewa zaune tayi ta jingina da fuskar gadon, "me yake damun ki? Ko asibiti zamu tafi tunda kinsan garin sosae". 
   Girgiza mishi kai tayi bayan ta rintse idanunta tace, "a'a haka nake jin jikina kwana biyun nan ba wani abu bane da nayi bacci na tashi Zan dawo normal". 
   Cikin damuwa sosai farouk yake dubanta yana mamakin yadda mutum bashi da lafiya zaice da yayi bacci ya tashi zai dawo dai dai baisha magani ba, "Anya kuwa baby hakan zai kasance?". 
  Ganin ya damu sai ta dake sosai ta nuna mishi babu wani abu kawai gajiya ce. Ba don ya amince ba ya kyale ta sai don kawai ba yadda zaiyi, a k'asar da ba tasu ba, bai San ko'ina ba. 
   Hasken d'akin ya rage duk da ba wani dare ne yayi sosai ba, ya matsa jikinta sosai ya rungume ta cikin jikinshi, itama sake shige mishi tayi tana shak'ar ni'imtaccen k'amshin jikin mijin nata tauraron zuciyarta. 
   Hijab d'inta ya tattare zai cire mata cikin k'asa da murya yana tambayarta, "ki bani labari mana babie" 
   Rik'e k'arshen hijab d'in tayi cikin shagwob'arta tace, "umm umm ni bani da wani labari kabar mun hijabi na". 
   K'arasa janye shi yayi ba tare da yace mata komai ba, aikuwa ta sake cikwuikuyeshi da nufin b'oye shigar jikinta, riga ce armless brown fitet ta tsaya mata iya cinya. Yadda rigar tabi ilahirin jikinta ta lafe haka surar jikinta ta fita sosai kamar an zana ta. Rigar ta yiwa farouk kyau matuk'a a jikinta kuma ya yaba sosai. 
   A haka suka ci gaba da kasancewa har bacci yayi awon gaba dasu kafun su ankara duka. 



    _🥴first night in honeymoon ya tafi salin alin Maryam sulaiman_


              @@@@@@@


Washe garin ranar har makara yaso yi wajen tashi bacci, shap shap ya fad'a bathroom ya d'auro alawala, ya shimfud'a darduma kamar jiya ya kintaci inda yake kyautata zaton nan ne alk'ibla ya kabbara sallar shi. 
   Bai tashi a sallayar ba kamar yadda yake bisa al'adar shi saida yayi muraji'a ta abinda ya sauwak'a a cikin alqur-ani mai girma.

Murmushi yayi a ranshi yana addu'ar Allah dai ya inganta lafiya, yasa cikin ya d'ore a haka ba laulaye laulayen nan na maseefa. 
   Sai da yayi wanka yaci abincin da ta dafa mishi ya huta sannan ya k'arasa gadon ya tashe ta ganin magrib ta kusa. 
   Mik'a tayi bakinta d'auke da salati ta sauke idonta cikin nashi, "sannu da zuwa" ta fad'a carmly "ke za'a yiwa sannu aynunnur". 
   Murmushi tayi tace, "ya kamata kayi wanka kaci abinci nasan kasha gajiya". Narke mata ido yayi yace, "toh muje babie ki taimaka mun". Ba musu ta mik'e don har ga Allah bata ankara da sauyawar kayan jikin shi ba, tana zuwa saitin shi ta shagwob'e mishi sosai tace, "to ka tashi mana". Jawota jikinshi yayi gaba d'aya ya rungume bakin shi saitin kunnenta yace, "da alama babyn nan nawa ba sadauki bane kamar little farouk, gaba d'aya ya langwab'ar mun dake daga bacci sai bacci, Soo calm down your mind nayi wankana tuni har naci abinci". Sai lokacin kuma ta ankara da sabuwar shigar da yayi taga ba wadda ya futa da ita ba. "baby yau na dawo da farin ciki mai tarin yawa........." Nan ya shiga labarta mata abinda ya tarar daya futa yau d'in nan. Ita kanta tayi farin ciki mara misaltuwa, a daren ranar suka kira Abbie suka dinga jera mishi godiya har saida ya gaji ya kashe wayar shi duka. 

    Rayuwa taci gaba da kasance musu cikin farin ciki da jin dad'i. A kullum da safe farouk zai futa kasuwa ita kuma tayi makaranta, shuraim ma ya koma makarantar da yake zuwa tun farko shi dasu suhail. 
   Duk sun nemo mutanen su na kirki anci gaba da zumunci, anyi bikin su Khadija da hassena da Zahra tuni bisa shawarar farouk amare har sun tare, Khadija da hassena suna kd, yayinda Zahra tayo Kano gidan ta kusa da gidan auntie husna. Lokacin cikin Arfah ya futo sosai, wanda tasha wahalar laulayin shi tun daga ranar data fahimci akwaishi a jikinta. 

   Wata Tara da y'an kwanaki ta haifo y'arta sanb'aleliya  mai kama da ita sak da sak. A washe garin ranar farouk ya mata booking ticket sai kaduna. 
    Ranar da sati ya cika anyi taron suna na ban al'ajabi wanda ya tara mutane masu yawa, dangin ammiey na Egypt har da mahaifiyar sofiyyah, haka danginta na yola duk sunzo, su Auntie husna da y'an uwanta. Rahama kanta ana I gobe suna tazo tare da y'an gidansu Salman. Hajiya ameena matar honourable kam kwananta uku kafun suna. 
   Ranar suna mai jego ta gaji da had'uwa cikin kayan da mahaifiyarta tayi mata order musamman, anci ansha an rabar da dukiya a wannan bikin suna, yarinya taci sunan sofiyyah (mahaifiyar Arfah). Mama alhamdulillah ta warware sosai, haka fareeda ma komai da ita akayi kamar dama wani abu bai tab'a had'a su ba a baya. 

      Mutanen gidan su na zoo road su auntie zainab da bin address da komai saida suka zo ta hannun Auntie husna don ganin kwakwaf. Aikuwa sun raina kansu har saida suka dinga jin kunyar abinda sukayi mata a baya, ita kuwa ba tare da nuna komai ba don ta manta da abinda sukayi mata ma tuni ta gabatar dasu ga ammiey da ummie. 
  Koda akayi suna zasu tafi kyauta akayi musu ta tashin kai, suka koma gwiwa lakwas, lallai sun yarda k'addara tana iya bin tuwo ciki, don lallai inba don k'addara ba da ba abinda zai kawo Arfah ta rayu cikinsu irin rayuwar su. 

    Mai jego tana arba'in aka rakata gidanta bayan an had'a ta da irin gyaran jikin Egyptian. A ranar data kwana biyu a gidanta, a ranar farouk yayi mata kyautar mak'udan kud'i ta account d'inta, dama ribar gurin alhaji asheer tuni ya zuba musu shi a hannun jari, shuraim sai nan nan yake da babie Nur tun suna kd ko barka aka zo sai anyi da gaske yake bari tayi minti goma a hannun mutum. Toh yanzun ma haka yake zama dirshan a d'ora masa ita a cinya. 



      Rayuwa taci gaba da tafiya musu cikin aminci, yayinda ci gaba yake k'ara samun su a kullu yaumin. 

    A shekaru uku kacal da aihuwar Nur haske ya cika musu gidan fal! Arfah ta sake haihuwar mace wadda taci sunan ummie, yanzun haka tana laulayin wani cikin, Sam basu d'ora rayuwar su bisa turbar nasara ta k'ayyade haihuwa ba, annabi S. A. W  yace, "kuyi aure don ku hayayyafa", to akan me su kuwa zasu yi watsi da wannan fad'a ta ma'aikin Allah saboda son duniyar da babu mai dawwama a cikinta. 
   Arfah ta had'a degree d'inta tuni harta juya masters. 


    Tammmat bi hamdullah😍
